cues.zh: 这张标签没有电池。读卡器靠近，芯片却醒了过来。它先从读卡器的场里取得能量，再借同一个场回答。我们跟着标签上的这一圈导线，拆开这次看似瞬间完成的对话。
cues.en: This tag has no battery. Yet bring a reader close, and its chip wakes up. First it takes energy from the reader's field. Then it uses that same field to answer. Follow the tag's coil as we open up this brief exchange.

cues.title: 变化的磁通，感应出电压
cues.caption: 穿过标签线圈的磁通在变，交流电压随之产生。
cues.captionEn: Changing flux through the tag coil induces an alternating voltage.
cues.zh: 读卡线圈里的电流不断换向，周围的磁场也跟着变化。真实电流每秒完成一千三百五十六万次完整振荡，画面已大幅放慢。变化的磁通穿过标签线圈，在线圈两端感应出交流电压。
cues.en: The reader's coil carries an alternating current, creating a changing magnetic field. In reality, it completes thirteen point five six million cycles each second. We have slowed it down. Changing magnetic flux through the tag's coil induces an alternating voltage.

cues.title: 把交流变成芯片的电源
cues.titleEn: Turn the induced voltage into a supply
cues.caption: 整流统一极性，储能电容缓冲供电波动。
cues.captionEn: Rectification and stored energy provide the chip's supply.
cues.zh: 芯片需要更稳定的电源。看这幅整流示意：它把两种方向的输入变成同一极性的输出，再由储能电容缓冲波动。只有供电足够，标签才能处理指令。这里展示功能，真实芯片的电路会更复杂。
cues.en: The chip needs a steadier supply. In this rectifier illustration, both input polarities become one output polarity. A storage capacitor smooths the supply. With enough power, the tag can process a command. This shows the function; the circuit inside a real chip is more complex.

cues.title: 读卡器把问题放进包络
cues.titleEn: The reader asks through the envelope
cues.caption: 读卡器短暂改变载波幅度，标签识别编码。
cues.captionEn: Brief carrier-amplitude changes encode the reader's question.
cues.zh: 读卡器开始发问了。快速振荡的载波里，出现一串短暂停顿。暂停的位置按照编码规则安排，标签从包络中识别这些变化。这里放大一小段信号，看信息怎样搭上供能的通道，并没有重演完整的通信协议。
cues.en: Now the reader asks a question. The rapidly oscillating carrier contains a pattern of brief pauses. Their positions follow an encoding rule. The tag detects those changes in the envelope. We have enlarged a short signal segment to show information riding on the power link, rather than a complete protocol exchange.

cues.title: 切换负载，就是回答
cues.caption: 标签改变负载，读卡线圈也能察觉变化。
cues.captionEn: A load change at the tag also changes the reader's current.
cues.zh: 轮到标签回答。看这个开关：它接入、断开一份负载，改变标签线圈的电流。互感也把这点变化带回读卡线圈。读卡器检测它，就能接收回答。这叫负载调制，标签不用另造一个强载波。
cues.en: To answer, the tag switches an extra load in and out. That changes the current in its coil. Through mutual coupling, the change also appears at the reader's coil. The reader detects it as a reply. This is load modulation; the tag needs no separate strong carrier.

cues.title: 跟住同一串比特
cues.caption: 开关节奏变成电流变化，再还原成同一串比特。
cues.captionEn: Switching becomes current changes, then the same bits again.
cues.zh: 跟住这串比特。每一位决定哪半段出现快速的负载切换，读卡器的电流也留下对应的细纹。接收端识别这些节奏，再还原出原来的序列。读卡器一直提供载波，而回答的信息来自标签对负载的控制。
cues.en: Follow this sequence of bits. Each bit selects which half contains a burst of rapid load switching. Matching ripples appear in the reader's current. The receiver recognizes the pattern and recovers the original sequence. The reader still supplies the carrier; the tag supplies the information by controlling its load.

cues.title: 为什么要靠近、对准
cues.caption: 供电和回传都依赖耦合；靠近后，还要对准。
cues.captionEn: Both power and the reply depend on useful coil coupling.
cues.zh: 先把间隙拉大。耦合减弱，拉得足够远，供电和回应都不足以维持通信。移回来，再把标签转一转：朝向也会影响耦合。重新靠近、对准，对话恢复。读取成功本身不代表身份已验证，也不代表支付完成。
cues.en: First increase the gap. Coupling weakens, and far enough away, power and the reply become insufficient. Bring the tag back, then turn it: orientation matters too. Closeness and alignment restore the exchange. A successful read alone does not prove identity or complete a payment.

cues.title: 一个中子，一滴核
cues.caption: 吸收一个中子后，核像液滴一样裂开。
cues.captionEn: After absorbing a neutron, the nucleus splits like a drop.
cues.zh: 看这颗铀-235 的核。一个慢中子靠近，被它吸收，核变成受激的铀-236，开始像一滴液体那样晃动。拉长，出现细颈，然后断开：两块碎片朝相反方向飞走，同时甩出三个新的中子。一次裂变，就放出大约一百七十三兆电子伏的能量。
cues.en: Watch this uranium-235 nucleus. A slow neutron drifts in and is absorbed. The nucleus becomes excited uranium-236 and begins to wobble like a drop of liquid. It stretches, a narrow neck forms, and it snaps. Two fragments fly apart, and three fresh neutrons are thrown out. One fission releases about 173 million electron-volts.

cues.title: 能量从结合能来
cues.caption: 碎片结合得更紧，多出的结合能变成动能。
cues.captionEn: Fragments are bound more tightly; the surplus becomes motion.
cues.zh: 能量从哪里来？这条曲线是每个核子的结合能。铁附近最高，铀在右端偏低。裂开后，钡和氪这两块碎片都落到曲线更高的位置：碎片里每个核子多绑紧了大约零点八兆电子伏。两百多个核子加起来，再扣掉放出两个多余中子的花费，就是那一百七十三兆电子伏。作为对比，一次化学反应每个原子只有几个电子伏，在这张图上连一个像素都画不出来。
cues.en: Where does the energy come from? This curve is the binding energy per nucleon. Iron sits near the top; uranium lies lower at the far right. After the split, barium and krypton both land higher on the curve: each nucleon in the fragments is bound about 0.8 million electron-volts more tightly. Add that up over more than two hundred nucleons, subtract the cost of freeing two extra neutrons, and you get those 173 million electron-volts. A chemical reaction gives a few electron-volts per atom. On this chart it would not fill a single pixel.

cues.title: 一代接一代
cues.caption: 每一代都比上一代多，几十代后就是天文数字。
cues.captionEn: Each generation outnumbers the last; eighty generations later, astronomical.
cues.zh: 每次裂变放出两到三个中子。如果它们都留在材料里，每个又能引发新的裂变，就长出这样一棵家族树：一，二，二，五，十二，二十五。少数中子被俘获，掉了队，但整体每一代大约是上一代的两倍多。一代只需要大约十纳秒。看右边的对数刻度：八十代之后，中子数已经超过十的二十四次方，而这总共不到一微秒。
cues.en: Every fission releases two or three neutrons. If they all stay inside the material and each one causes another fission, a family tree grows: one, two, two, five, twelve, twenty-five. A few neutrons are captured and drop out, but on average each generation is still more than twice the last. One generation takes only about ten nanoseconds. Look at the logarithmic scale on the right: after eighty generations the count passes ten to the twenty-fourth, and less than a microsecond has gone by.

cues.title: 小球：中子漏掉了
cues.caption: 球太小，中子还没碰上核就飞出去了。
cues.captionEn: Too small a sphere: neutrons escape before they collide.
cues.zh: 现在把同样的材料做成一个小球，半径只有一点六个平均自由程。从中心放出一个中子，跟着它走：每一段直线是一次飞行，拐点是一次碰撞。看蓝点，那是中子离开球面的位置。球太小，大多数中子还没碰到几个核就漏出去了。增殖因子 k 只有零点六七，每一代都比上一代少，链式反应几步就熄灭。
cues.en: Now shape the same material into a small sphere, with a radius of only 1.6 mean free paths. Release one neutron at the centre and follow it: each straight run is a flight, each bend a collision. The blue dots mark where neutrons leave the surface. The sphere is too small, so most neutrons escape after only a few collisions. The multiplication factor k is just 0.67. Every generation is smaller than the last, and the chain dies out within a few steps.

cues.title: 大球：过了临界
cues.caption: 体积长得比表面快；过了临界半径，链自己延续。
cues.captionEn: Volume outgrows surface; past the critical radius the chain sustains itself.
cues.zh: 把球慢慢做大。产生中子的核数随体积增长，漏出的机会随表面增长，体积长得更快，所以 k 一路上升。标记越过虚线的那一刻，k 等于一，这就是临界半径。继续到四点五个自由程，k 约为一点五。再从中心放出一个中子：这一次，漏出的仍然不少，但每一代留下的中子比上一代更多，链式反应自己延续下去。
cues.en: Let the sphere grow. The number of nuclei that produce neutrons rises with volume, while the chance of leaking rises with surface area. Volume wins, so k climbs. The moment the marker crosses the dashed line, k equals one: that is the critical radius. Keep going to 4.5 mean free paths and k is about 1.5. Release one neutron at the centre again. Plenty still leak out, but every generation now leaves more neutrons than the last, and the chain sustains itself.

cues.title: 反应堆与炸弹
cues.caption: 平均代时间示意：缓发中子延缓增长，实际瞬态需另求解。
cues.captionEn: Mean-time illustration: delayed neutrons slow growth; actual transients need a separate model.
cues.zh: 看这三条数量级曲线。前两条保持 k 等于一点零零一。灰线只计瞬发中子，增长很快；蓝线把缓发中子的等待时间折进一个平均值，约一分钟翻一倍。这是平均代时间的简化示意。实际反应堆还要跟踪前驱核、温度反馈和控制动作，不能用这条线预测。橙线另取 k 等于一点五、每代十纳秒，展示快速链式反应的量级。临界或超临界本身，都不等于发生爆炸。
cues.en: Compare these three curves as illustrations of scale. The first two keep k at 1.001. The grey curve counts prompt neutrons only and grows quickly. The blue curve folds delayed-neutron waiting into a mean generation time, taking roughly a minute to double. That is a simplification. Actual reactor transients require precursor populations, feedback and control action, which this chart does not solve. The orange curve separately uses k of 1.5 and ten nanoseconds per generation to illustrate a fast chain. Critical or supercritical does not by itself mean an explosion.

cues.title: 它为什么会停
cues.caption: 一膨胀，密度下降，k 跌回一以下，反应自己停下。
cues.captionEn: Expansion lowers density, k drops below one, and the reaction stops itself.
cues.zh: 增长如此之快，它是怎么停下来的？能量让材料急剧升温、膨胀。质量没有变，但密度下降，中子在两次碰撞之间要飞得更远，同样的球按平均自由程来量反而变小了。看标记沿曲线往回滑：膨胀到一点三四倍时 k 回到一，再大一点就跌回次临界。新放出的中子又开始漏掉，链式反应自己熄灭。这里展示的是膨胀、密度和中子泄漏的关系；具体会持续多久、有多少核裂变，这个模型并没有计算。
cues.en: If it grows this fast, how does it ever stop? The energy heats the material violently and it expands. The mass is unchanged, but the density falls, so a neutron travels farther between collisions. Measured in mean free paths, the same sphere is now smaller. Watch the marker slide back along the curve: at 1.34 times the original size k returns to one, and a little further it drops below. Newly released neutrons leak away again and the chain dies out. This shows how expansion, density and neutron leakage are related. The model does not calculate how long the process lasts or what fraction of the nuclei fission.

cues.title: 靠近，然后被推开
cues.caption: 两个核带正电，靠近就互相推开。
cues.captionEn: Both nuclei are positive; closeness pushes them apart.
cues.zh: 跟住这颗粉色的氚核。它朝着氘核冲过去，可两个核都带正电，越近，推力越大。火焰的温度只让它走到几百万飞米就折返；太阳核心能让它爬到七百多飞米；一亿多度，也只到一百飞米左右，离三飞米的接触点还差得远。让它们真正相遇的，是最后那一点隧穿的概率。
cues.en: Follow the pink tritium nucleus. It rushes toward the deuterium, but both are positive, and the closer they get, the harder they push apart. A flame turns it back millions of femtometres out. The Sun's core lets it climb to about seven hundred. Even above a hundred million kelvin it stops near one hundred, far from the three-femtometre contact point. What finally lets them meet is a tiny chance of tunnelling through.

cues.title: 合上以后，能量从哪里来
cues.caption: 氦-4 绑得更紧，多出的能量被释放。
cues.captionEn: Helium-4 is bound tighter; the surplus is released.
cues.zh: 看这条结合能曲线的左端。氘和氚每个核子只绑住一到三兆电子伏，而氦四高得多，每个核子超过七兆电子伏。把氘和氚合成氦四，再放出一个中子，多出来的十七点六兆电子伏就变成了动能，大部分由中子带走。按每个核子算，这比铀裂变还多四倍以上。
cues.en: Look at the left end of the binding-energy curve. Deuterium and tritium hold each nucleon with only one to three MeV, while helium-4 sits far higher, above seven MeV per nucleon. Fuse deuterium and tritium into helium-4, release a neutron, and the surplus 17.6 MeV becomes motion, most of it carried by the neutron. Per nucleon, that is more than four times what uranium fission gives.

cues.title: 温度决定分布的尾巴
cues.caption: 只有分布尾巴上的少数核对能穿过势垒。
cues.captionEn: Only the few pairs in the tail can tunnel through.
cues.zh: 现在把温度升上去。三千开时，所有核对的能量都挤在最左边那根针里。到了太阳核心的温度，分布才开始摊开；一亿多度时，尾巴伸到了几十千电子伏。紫色虚线是隧穿概率，随能量陡升。把分布和它相乘，中间出现这个亮色的峰，叫伽莫夫峰，聚变几乎全在这里发生。
cues.en: Now raise the temperature. At three thousand kelvin, every pair's energy is squeezed into that needle at the far left. At the Sun's core temperature the distribution begins to spread; above a hundred million kelvin its tail reaches tens of keV. The violet dashed line is the tunnelling probability, climbing steeply with energy. Multiply the two and the bright peak in the middle appears: the Gamow peak, where almost all fusion happens.

cues.title: 反应率随温度陡升
cues.caption: 温度提高几倍，反应率提高几千倍。
cues.captionEn: A few times hotter, thousands of times faster.
cues.zh: 把每一对核的平均反应率画在对数图上。亮点从一千电子伏走到三万电子伏，曲线几乎直着往上冲。从太阳核心到一亿度，温度只高了八倍，反应率却高了近四千倍。下面那条淡紫色曲线是氘氘反应，同样温度下慢一百倍。三千开的火焰远在图的左边之外，那里的反应率实际上是零。
cues.en: Here is the average reaction rate per pair on a logarithmic chart. As the bright dot moves from one to thirty keV, the curve shoots almost straight up. From the Sun's core to a hundred million kelvin the temperature rises eight times, yet the rate rises nearly four thousand times. The paler violet curve below is deuterium with deuterium, a hundred times slower. A flame lies far off the left edge, where the rate is effectively zero.

cues.title: 热核武器中的裂变初级
cues.titleEn: The fission primary in thermonuclear weapons
cues.caption: 裂变初级提供高温与辐射；聚变也有激光点火等途径。
cues.captionEn: A fission primary supplies heat and radiation; lasers provide another route to fusion ignition.
cues.zh: 看这架温度阶梯。三千开的化学火焰，在本模型里只给出极小的聚变反应率。热核武器使用裂变初级提供高温与辐射，加热并压缩聚变燃料。但裂变不是聚变点火的唯一途径，激光实验也已经实现点火。画面随后比较同一团燃料的压缩：密度越高，单位体积反应率越大。这张燃烧比例图只隔离密度和约束时间，不包含自加热点火过程。
cues.en: Watch the temperature ladder. At three thousand kelvin, this model gives a very small fusion rate. A thermonuclear weapon uses a fission primary to supply intense heat and radiation, heating and compressing fusion fuel. Fission is not the only route to fusion ignition; laser experiments have also achieved it. The picture then compares compression of the same fuel. Higher density raises the reaction rate per volume. This burn-fraction illustration isolates density and confinement time; it does not solve self-heating or ignition.

cues.title: 燃料自带下一份氚
cues.titleEn: Fuel that makes its own tritium
cues.caption: 中子把锂变成氚，燃料在燃烧中补给自己。
cues.captionEn: Neutrons turn lithium into tritium; the fuel restocks itself.
cues.zh: 氚会持续衰变，半衰期约十二点三年。长期储存需要考虑损失，不是完全存不住。这里说明一条公开的燃料路径：固体氘化锂能通过中子反应生成氚。跟住这颗中子，它撞上锂六核，生成一个氚核和一个氦核，并释放约四点八兆电子伏。新的氚可以参与后续的氘氚反应。这个图只解释核反应关系，不表示真实装置的布局或运行过程。
cues.en: Tritium decays continuously, with a half-life of about twelve point three years. Storage is possible, but long-term storage must account for that loss. This picture explains one publicly described fuel route: a neutron reaction in lithium deuteride can generate tritium. Follow the neutron to lithium-6. The reaction produces tritium and helium and releases about 4.8 MeV. The tritium can participate in a later D–T reaction. This picture explains nuclear reactions rather than a device layout or operating sequence.

cues.title: 三种留住高温的办法
cues.titleEn: Three ways to hold the heat
cues.caption: 磁场、惯性与引力：燃料和约束条件并不相同。
cues.captionEn: Magnetic, inertial and gravitational confinement use different fuels and conditions.
cues.zh: 同样的氘氚反应，要自持燃烧，密度、温度和约束时间的乘积得超过这条虚线。托卡马克用磁场，把稀薄的等离子体留住大约一秒。惯性约束走另一头：密度高出十一个多数量级，只留住一百亿分之一秒，二零二二年国家点火装置就这样首次实现点火。太阳则靠引力永久约束，烧的是慢得多的质子链，它有的是体积和时间。
cues.en: For the same D–T reaction to sustain itself, density times temperature times confinement time must cross this dashed line. A tokamak uses magnetic fields to hold a thin plasma for about a second. Inertial confinement takes the other end: density eleven orders of magnitude higher, held for a ten-billionth of a second. That is how the National Ignition Facility first reached ignition in 2022. The Sun confines by gravity and burns the far slower proton chain; it has volume and time to spare.

cues.title: 旋转的机翼
cues.caption: 机身原地不动，桨叶仍迎着空气。
cues.captionEn: The cabin stays still; the blades meet the air.
cues.zh: 直升机没有沿跑道加速，为什么还能飞起来？先盯住铜色的这片桨叶。它绕着主轴转动，本身就在相对空气运动。旋翼其实是一组旋转的机翼。悬停时，整副旋翼向上的推力，恰好抵住直升机的重量。画面放慢了旋转，让我们看清每一步。
cues.en: The cabin is staying in one place, yet the helicopter can stay aloft. Follow the copper blade. Rotation keeps that wing moving through the air. In a steady hover, the rotor’s upward thrust balances the aircraft’s weight. The rotation is slowed here so we can follow it.

cues.title: 桨距与空气
cues.caption: 桨距改变迎角，也改变剖面升力。
cues.captionEn: Pitch changes the angle of attack and section lift.
cues.zh: 把铜色桨叶切出一个剖面。看它的前缘抬起来：这就是桨距增加。空气除了掠过桨叶，还带着向下的入流，所以桨距和迎角并不相同。在这里的正常工作范围内，迎角增大，升力也会增大。旋翼把空气推向下，空气给旋翼向上的力。
cues.en: Look at a section of the copper blade. Its leading edge rises as blade pitch increases. The incoming air also has a downward component, so pitch and angle of attack are different angles. Within this model’s range, increasing the angle of attack increases lift. The rotor sends air downward.

cues.title: 一起改变桨距
cues.caption: 总距一起增加，两片桨叶一起增升力。
cues.captionEn: Collective raises both blades’ pitch together.
cues.zh: 现在把两片桨叶放在一起看。总距控制让它们的桨距同时增加相同的量，而旋翼转速保持不变。看主旋翼推力的读数：超过重量时，直升机就有向上的加速度。总距回到悬停值，受力重新平衡。真实飞行还要协调发动机功率，并考虑已经产生的运动。
cues.en: Now watch both blades. Collective pitch adds the same amount to each blade while rotor speed stays constant. Thrust rises above weight, giving an upward acceleration. Restoring the hover setting restores the force balance. This comparison shows instantaneous forces; an actual aircraft also has motion and engine power to manage.

cues.title: 一圈内的变化
cues.caption: 同一片桨叶，每转一圈改变一次桨距。
cues.captionEn: Each blade’s pitch varies around the circle.
cues.zh: 跟着铜色桨叶走一圈。周期变距让这片桨叶在某些方位增大桨距，在另一些方位减小桨距。对侧桨叶正好处在半圈之外，所以它们此刻的桨距不同。曲线记录的是同一片桨叶，而不是两片不同的桨叶。真实旋翼还会挥舞；这里只展示桨距变化本身。
cues.en: Follow the copper blade around one complete turn. Cyclic pitch makes its pitch larger at some positions and smaller at others. The opposite blade is half a turn away, so its pitch differs. The curve belongs to one tracked blade. Real rotor flapping adds dynamics that this pitch illustration omits.

cues.title: 把推力倾斜
cues.caption: 推力倾斜后，一部分指向水平方向。
cues.captionEn: Tilt gives the thrust a horizontal component.
cues.zh: 再看这架直升机，让旋翼盘缓缓倾斜。盯住主轴上的青色箭头，它始终指向旋翼盘的法线方向。真实旋翼通过周期变距和挥舞改变盘面方向，这里给定一个倾盘姿态。总推力现在既有垂直分量，也有水平分量：一部分托住重量，一部分让机体开始向前加速。
cues.en: Watch the same helicopter as its rotor disk tilts. The teal arrow at the mast stays perpendicular to the disk. Real cyclic control and flapping change that orientation; here we prescribe the pose. Thrust now has two components: a vertical part supporting weight, and a horizontal part providing forward acceleration.

cues.title: 尾桨抵住什么
cues.caption: 尾桨侧推产生力矩，抵住机身反扭矩。
cues.captionEn: Tail thrust counters the airframe’s reaction torque.
cues.zh: 主旋翼转动，需要发动机给它扭矩。机身同时受到反方向的扭矩。看尾桨处的青色侧推箭头：侧推力隔着一根长尾梁，产生反向力矩。让尾桨补偿变小，两条力矩条就不再相等；恢复补偿，它们重新平衡。真实飞行还需要处理尾桨带来的侧向力。
cues.en: Turning the main rotor requires torque. The airframe receives an opposite reaction. Look at the teal arrow at the tail rotor: its sideways force acts through a long lever arm. Reduce that compensation and the two moments no longer balance. Restore it and they match. Real flight must also balance the sideways force.

cues.title: 倾斜后重新平衡
cues.caption: 补足垂直分量，水平分量仍然保留。
cues.captionEn: Restore vertical balance while keeping horizontal thrust.
cues.zh: 最后保留旋翼盘的倾角。总推力虽然没有变小，垂直分量却比重量少了一点。缓缓增加总距，直到垂直推力再次等于重量。注意，水平分量并没有消失。这就是控制需要配合的原因：总距改变推力大小，周期变距改变旋翼盘方向，尾桨管理偏航力矩。
cues.en: Keep the disk tilted for the final comparison. Its vertical thrust is slightly below the weight. Increase collective until those two forces match again. A horizontal component remains. The controls work together: collective changes thrust magnitude, cyclic changes disk orientation, and the tail rotor manages yaw torque. This is a near-hover teaching model.

cues.title: 一条能量线
cues.caption: 跟住导气活塞与枪机框。
cues.captionEn: Follow the piston and carrier.
cues.zh: 看这件二十世纪的机械器物。今天跟住一条能量线。外壳变浅后，银色的活塞杆连着枪机框。接下来，靠近观察这组相连的部件，看看一股短暂的燃气能量，怎样让同一组部件走完一次往返。
cues.en: Look at this object from twentieth-century mechanical history. We will follow an energy path through it. As the exterior fades, a steel piston rod connects to the carrier. A closer view keeps their physical connection visible. How does one brief input move the linked assembly away, and then bring it back?

cues.title: 燃气做功
cues.caption: 短暂输入，让联动组开始移动。
cues.captionEn: A brief input starts the assembly moving.
cues.zh: 能量的起点不是弹簧。推进剂释放化学能，燃气膨胀，其中一部分经过导气支路，对活塞做功。跟住亮起的铜色能量线，运动能量开始增加。气体给予的是一段短暂的推动，而运动与储能还会在后面的过程里继续发生。
cues.en: The spring is not the original energy source. Propellant releases chemical energy, and part of the expanding gas does work on the piston through a gas branch. Follow the copper energy path as motion begins. The input is brief, while movement and energy storage continue beyond it. Stored energy keeps moving between forms.

cues.title: 始终相连
cues.caption: 活塞与枪机框保持连接。
cues.captionEn: Piston and carrier stay connected.
cues.zh: 现在只看银色的活塞杆与枪机框。它们一同后移，中间没有分开，两个标志之间的距离也没有变化。长行程导气强调的正是这种联动关系：活塞和枪机框一起经历这段运动。留意活塞杆的末端，再留意枪机框：它们的运动来自同一个相连的整体。
cues.en: Watch the steel piston rod and the carrier. They move rearward together, without separating. The distance between them remains fixed. This linked movement is the central idea of long-stroke gas operation: the piston stays connected to the carrier. Follow the end of the piston rod, then the carrier. They belong to the same moving assembly.

cues.title: 把运动存起来
cues.caption: 运动减慢，弹性储能增加。
cues.captionEn: Motion slows; spring energy grows.
cues.zh: 输入已经结束，运动却还在继续。联动组靠惯性后移，把回位簧压得更紧。留意能量条，运动能量减少，弹性储能增加。到了即将改变方向的位置，部件几乎停住，但能量并没有消失。它主要存进了弹簧，还有一部分在过程中耗散。
cues.en: The input has ended, but the assembly continues rearward through inertia and compresses the return spring. Watch the energy strip: motion energy decreases while elastic energy increases. Near the turning point, the assembly almost stops. Its energy has not vanished. Much is stored in the spring, and some has been dissipated.

cues.title: 把能量交回来
cues.caption: 输入已停，弹簧驱动回程。
cues.captionEn: The input ends; the spring drives the return.
cues.zh: 现在，弹簧把先前存下的能量交回来。它逐渐展开，推动同一组部件向前返回；绿色的储能减少，铜色的运动能量重新增加。注意，这时并没有新的输入。弹簧能让机构回程，靠的是刚才的储存，而不是自己产生了能量。
cues.en: Now the spring gives back energy stored earlier. As it expands, it moves the same linked assembly forward. The green share of stored energy falls, while copper motion energy rises again. Notice that there is no new input during this return. The spring transfers energy; it does not create its own supply.

cues.title: 同位不同向
cues.caption: 位置相同，方向相反。
cues.captionEn: Same position, opposite directions.
cues.zh: 把去程和回程放在一起，选同一个位置。两根弹簧压得一样紧，所以弹性储能相同；运动箭头却指向相反方向。同一个位置，可以对应两种不同的运动状态。再看灰色的耗散，它一直累积，因此有损耗时，返回时的运动能量也不必和去程相等。
cues.en: Compare the outward and returning states at one position. The springs have the same compression and the same elastic energy, but the arrows point in opposite directions. Position alone cannot describe the motion. The gray dissipation has accumulated along the journey, so the two motion energies need not be equal either.

cues.title: 一轮能量路径
cues.caption: 位置回来了，能量已转移。
cues.captionEn: Position returns; energy has been transferred.
cues.zh: 最后把这一条路径连起来：短暂输入，联动后移，弹簧储能，再驱动返回。回到边界后，教学模型把剩余运动能量计入耗散，整轮停止。位置回到起点，不代表能量也恢复了。本篇解释的是这个宏观关系，真实枪械还包含许多这里没有模拟的机构和控制条件。
cues.en: Join the path into one excursion: a brief input, linked rearward movement, elastic storage, and a spring-driven return. At the boundary, our teaching model dissipates the remaining motion energy and stops. Returning to the starting position does not restore the energy. Real firearms include additional mechanisms and control conditions beyond this conceptual model.

cues.title: 地表之下
cues.caption: 切面打开，地雷位置没有改变。
cues.captionEn: The section opens; the mine stays fixed.
cues.zh: 先看这片普通地面，草和落叶遮住了下面。教学镜头打开一个地层切面，地雷外壳才露出来。它一直留在同一位置，下方仍与土层接触。这不是挖掘过程，只是把被遮挡的空间显出来。看不见，不代表那里没有危险。
cues.en: Begin with ordinary ground, covered by grass and leaves. A teaching section opens to reveal a landmine casing. The object has stayed in the same place, in contact with the soil beneath it. This is an observation cut, not an excavation. Something hidden has not necessarily ceased to be dangerous.

cues.title: 完整外壳近看
cues.caption: 外壳保持封闭，镜头观察外部轮廓。
cues.captionEn: The camera explores the sealed exterior.
cues.zh: 镜头靠近，先看圆盘外壳，再看上方覆盖件、卷边和侧面的把手。这份外观参考一件博物馆收藏的反坦克地雷，内部始终没有打开。不同地雷的形式和触发方式并不相同。外形能帮助我们理解对象，却不能据此试探或判断实际状态。
cues.en: Move closer to the circular casing, its top cover, rolled edges and side handle. The exterior draws on a museum collection of an anti-tank mine; its interior stays closed. Landmines differ in form and activation. An exterior helps us understand the object, but it is no invitation to test its condition.

cues.title: 静止的外表，储存的能量
cues.caption: 外壳静止，不代表没有储能。
cues.captionEn: A still exterior does not mean no stored energy.
cues.zh: 从外面看，壳体可以一直安静不动。但地雷把某些外部事件和储存能量的快速释放联系起来。触发是一个事件，不是全部爆炸能量的来源；能量来自事先储存的化学能。这里继续保留完整外壳，只解释这个关系，不演示按压，也不模拟爆炸。
cues.en: The casing can look completely still. Yet a landmine connects certain external events to the rapid release of stored energy. Triggering is an event, not the source of all the explosive energy: that energy was stored chemically beforehand. The exterior remains closed while we explain the distinction, without pressing the object or simulating a blast.

cues.title: 地表在变，物体仍在
cues.caption: 草与落叶变化，同一外壳留在原位。
cues.captionEn: Cover changes around the same casing.
cues.zh: 回到土层，继续追踪同一枚地雷。草的高度和落叶覆盖发生变化，外壳与土壤的接触位置没有变化。地面可以变得很不一样，却没有提供安全结论。教学切面只保留观察机会；它不是探测设备的视野，也不是清理地面的指导。
cues.en: Return to the soil and follow the same mine. Grass height and leaf cover change; the casing keeps the same contact with the ground. A different-looking surface does not establish safety. Our teaching section preserves the view, but it is neither a detector image nor guidance for clearing the ground.

cues.title: 时间不是安全证据
cues.caption: 时间前进，状态仍是未知。
cues.captionEn: Time advances; the state stays unknown.
cues.zh: 再把时间拉长：当时，后来，多年以后。地雷的位置没有自动消失，安全状态也没有自动改变。地雷和其他遗留爆炸物可能持续危险许多年。战斗结束、植被恢复，或者很久没有发生事故，都不能代替专业核查。
cues.en: Now extend the passage of time: then, later, and years afterward. The mine does not automatically disappear, and the display supplies no safe verdict. Landmines and other explosive remnants can stay dangerous for many years. An ended conflict, returning vegetation or a long quiet interval cannot substitute for professional assessment.

cues.title: 磨损也不是答案
cues.caption: 涂层和磨损可见，安全状态仍未知。
cues.captionEn: Visible wear; unknown safety.
cues.zh: 近看外壳的涂层、磨损和泥土。它们让这个物体显得真实，却不能告诉我们内部是否安全。旧，不等于失效；外形完整，也不等于可以触碰。这个画面里的磨损是固定的外观细节，不是一把测量危险程度的尺子。
cues.en: Look closely at the coating, wear and traces of soil. These details make the object tangible, but they do not reveal whether its interior is safe. Old does not mean inert; intact does not mean touchable. The wear here is fixed visual detail, not a scale that measures how dangerous the object is.

cues.title: 让观察停在接触之前
cues.caption: 不靠近、不触碰，联系当地专业机构。
cues.captionEn: Do not approach or touch. Contact professionals.
cues.zh: 最后，镜头回到同一片土层。理解原理，是为了不把好奇变成接触。发现可疑物，不靠近、不触碰，并联系当地主管部门或专业排雷机构。遵循当地官方风险提示。我们能够回放的是教学画面，真实物体的判断和处理需要专业人员。
cues.en: The camera returns to the same soil. Understanding the idea should keep curiosity from becoming contact. If you encounter a suspicious object, do not approach or touch it. Contact local authorities or a professional mine-action organization, and follow local official guidance. Replaying a lesson is safe; assessing a real object requires professionals.

cues.title: 按下一颗键
cues.caption: 轴心下移，弹簧压缩，触点接通。
cues.captionEn: The stem moves; the spring compresses; contacts meet.
cues.zh: 按下一颗键，键帽带着轴心往下走。看剖面里的弹簧，它在压缩；再看金属触点，它们从分开变成接通。松开后，弹簧让轴心回升。接下来，我们保留这些部件的位置，只改变真正造成差异的结构。
cues.en: Press one key and follow the stem beneath its keycap. The spring compresses, while a pair of metal contacts changes from separated to connected. Release the key and the spring lifts the stem again. Keep these parts in view as we change the structures that make switches behave differently.

cues.title: 红与黑：同为线性
cues.caption: 没有段落，不代表按起来一样重。
cues.captionEn: A smooth stroke can still require different forces.
cues.zh: 先比较这里的红轴和黑轴。它们都没有明显的段落，轴心平顺下移；黑轴的弹簧阻力更大。同样压到触发位置，红轴标称四十五厘牛，黑轴六十厘牛。线性说的是力的变化形状，不是完全恒定，也不等于静音。
cues.en: Compare these Red and Black examples at the same depth. Both move smoothly without a tactile bump, but Black resists more strongly. Their nominal actuation forces are forty-five and sixty centinewtons. Linear describes the shape of the force response. It does not mean constant force, and it does not promise silence.

cues.title: 茶轴的段落从哪来？
cues.titleEn: Where the tactile bump comes from
cues.caption: 轮廓越过弹片，阻力先升后降。
cues.captionEn: The profile bends the leaf. Resistance rises, then falls.
cues.zh: 把轴心换成茶轴，近看它碰到弹片的那段轮廓。凸起挤过弹片时，阻力先增加，再下降，手指便感觉到一个段落。弹簧仍在压缩，变化来自轮廓与弹片的配合。这种触觉提示，不需要额外的发声套件。
cues.en: Now watch the shaped surface on the Brown stem meet the metal leaf. As the raised profile passes it, resistance builds and then drops. That change is the bump your finger feels. The return spring is still compressing; the profile and leaf add tactile feedback without a separate click-making jacket.

cues.title: 青轴多了一件会动的零件
cues.caption: 白色套件快速跳移，形成发声事件。
cues.captionEn: The white jacket jumps, creating a click event.
cues.zh: 青轴的轴心分成两件。盯住蓝色轴心和白色套件：越过段落附近，白色套件会相对轴心快速跳移，产生点击声。触觉变化、发声和电信号是有关联的事件，却不是同一件事。松开时再看一次，白色套件跟随轴心复位，为下一次按压做好准备。
cues.en: Blue uses a two-piece stem. Follow the blue stem and its white jacket: near the tactile transition, the jacket moves abruptly relative to the stem and produces a click. The force change, sound and electrical signal are related but different events. Watch the release: the jacket returns with the stem, ready for another press.

cues.title: 触发，不必按到底
cues.caption: 触发、触底和复位，是三个观察点。
cues.captionEn: Actuation, bottom-out and reset are separate events.
cues.zh: 继续按下，电信号已经出现，轴心却还能再走一段。这里的红轴在两毫米附近触发，总行程约四毫米。触发点不是触底位置。再慢慢松开，观察信号何时消失：回程的复位点也要单独看，不能拿段落峰值或触底力代替它。
cues.en: The signal is already on, yet the stem can travel farther. This Red example actuates at about two millimeters and reaches the bottom at about four. Those are different positions. Now release it slowly and watch the signal turn off. Reset belongs to the return stroke; neither a force peak nor bottom-out tells you where it occurs.

cues.title: 短行程与缓冲，是两种改变
cues.caption: 银轴改变行程；静音轴缓和撞击。
cues.captionEn: Silver shortens travel; damping softens impacts.
cues.zh: 先跟红轴对照银轴。银轴仍然是线性轴，但更早触发，行程也更短；这不等于更小的触发力。再看静音红轴的缓冲部位：按到底和弹回顶端时，缓冲材料减轻硬碰撞。它减少的是一部分机械噪声，不会让整把键盘完全无声。
cues.en: First compare Speed Silver with Red. Silver stays linear but reaches actuation sooner and has less total travel. That does not imply a smaller actuation force. Next, watch the damping pieces on Silent Red at the bottom and top of its stroke. They soften impacts. They reduce mechanical noise rather than make the complete keyboard soundless.

cues.title: 磁轴把位置交给固件
cues.caption: 持续测量位置，再按运动距离更新信号。
cues.captionEn: Position sensing lets firmware follow small reversals.
cues.zh: 换成磁轴，轴心里有磁体，电路板上的霍尔传感器读取位置变化。看同一段往返：固定触发点要等轴心经过指定位置；快速触发则在首次触发后，按回抬和再次下压的距离更新信号。这是位置测量加固件规则，不是弹簧突然变轻，也不是磁轴独有的手感。
cues.en: A magnet now moves with the stem, while a Hall sensor on the board tracks its position. Compare the same motion under two rules. A fixed threshold waits for a specified position; after initial activation, Rapid Trigger uses release and renewed press distances. Position sensing and firmware create that behavior. The spring has not become lighter.

cues.title: 光轴仍有机械运动
cues.caption: 轴心让光路接通，检测无需电触点。
cues.captionEn: Stem movement opens a light path to the receiver.
cues.zh: 这个通光型光轴保留轴心和弹簧。按下时，轴心的开口对准光路，接收器得到光，检测状态随之改变。手指仍在推动机械部件，改变的是检测方式。光轴可以做成线性，也可以有段落或点击结构，不能只凭光学两个字判断手感。
cues.en: This optical example still has a moving stem and a spring. Pressing aligns an opening with the light path, allowing light to reach the receiver and change the detected state. The motion remains mechanical; the sensing method changes. Optical switches can have different force profiles and click mechanisms, so optical alone does not describe their feel.

cues.title: 把三件事分开看
cues.caption: 手感、声音、检测方式，分别比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare feel, sound and sensing separately.
cues.zh: 再看这些轴体：手感来自受力和结构，声音来自振动与撞击，输入来自检测和固件。颜色只是这些代表型号的名字，不是跨品牌标准。没有电接点抖动，也不等于整机零延迟。理解每条因果链，比用一种颜色概括全部差异更准确。
cues.en: Now compare what each switch changes. Structure shapes the force you feel; impacts and vibration shape sound; sensing and firmware determine input. Colors name these particular examples, not a universal standard. Avoiding electrical contact bounce also does not remove every source of keyboard latency. Compare those dimensions separately.

cues.title: 一路走，一路换
cues.caption: 同一部手机，一路上被交给了好几个小区。
cues.captionEn: One phone on the move, handed from cell to cell.
cues.zh: 公交车上，一部手机正在通话。看路上的彩色记录：每换一种颜色，就换了一个服务它的小区。整条街走下来，它被交接了八次，通话却一直没断。地图上的虚线六边形，是课本里常见的蜂窝图。可仔细看，交接的位置并不总在六边形的边上。
cues.en: A phone on a bus, in the middle of a call. Watch the coloured trail: each new colour means a new cell is serving it. Over the whole street it is handed over eight times, and the call never drops. The dashed hexagons are the familiar textbook picture. But look closely: the handovers don't always happen on their edges.

cues.title: 频谱有限，所以复用
cues.caption: 每个小区都用同一段频率；基站越密，每人分得越多。
cues.captionEn: Every cell reuses one carrier; denser sites mean bigger shares.
cues.zh: 无线电频率是有限的。这座城里，每个小区用的都是同一段 10 兆赫的载波。手机所在的 F1 小区里有 14 个人，五十个资源块分下来，每人不到四块。把基站间距缩小一半，还是这些人、还是这段频率，手机所在的小区只剩 7 个人，每人分到的多了一倍。
cues.en: Radio spectrum is limited. Every cell in this city uses the same ten-megahertz carrier. The phone's cell, F1, is shared by fourteen people, so its fifty resource blocks give each of them fewer than four. Halve the distance between sites: same people, same spectrum, and now only seven share the phone's cell. Each share roughly doubles.

cues.title: 边界来自信号强弱
cues.caption: 哪个小区最强，哪里就归它；边界是比较出来的。
cues.captionEn: Each spot belongs to its strongest cell; borders come from comparing.
cues.zh: 现在把每个地点的信号都算出来：越亮，最强小区的信号越强。只考虑距离和天线朝向，各个小区的地盘正好拼成六边形。再加上楼房和地形的遮挡，边界立刻变得弯弯曲曲。看手机这里：最近的是 G 站，最强的却是远一点的 F1。
cues.en: Now compute the signal everywhere: the brighter the map, the stronger the best cell. With only distance and antenna direction, the territories line up as neat hexagons. Add shadowing from buildings and terrain, and the borders twist. Look at the phone: the nearest site is G, yet the strongest cell is F1, further away.

cues.title: 手机一直在听邻居
cues.caption: 手机一直在测量服务小区和邻区的信号。
cues.captionEn: The phone keeps measuring its serving cell and the neighbours.
cues.zh: 打着电话的手机，一直在给身边几个小区打分。下面的曲线就是它测到的信号强度。粗线是正在服务它的小区，细线是邻区。服务小区慢慢变弱，某个邻区慢慢变强，两条线越靠越近；交叉之后不久，手机就被交给了新的小区。
cues.en: While the call goes on, the phone keeps scoring the cells around it. The curves are the signal strengths it measures, in dBm. The thick line is the cell serving it; the thin ones are neighbours. As the serving cell fades and a neighbour grows, the lines close in and cross, and soon the phone is handed to the new cell.

cues.title: 迟滞与触发时间
cues.caption: 邻区强出 3 dB 并保持 320 毫秒才切换。
cues.captionEn: A neighbour must lead by 3 dB for 320 ms before a handover.
cues.zh: 放大这段路。两个小区的信号几乎一样，还在上下晃动。如果谁强一点就马上切换，手机会来回切换九次。现在加两条规矩：邻区要比服务小区强出三分贝，还要保持三百二十毫秒。同一段路、同一组测量，这一次只切换了一次。
cues.en: Zoom into this stretch. Two cells are almost equal, and the measurements wobble. Switch whenever one is slightly ahead, and the phone flips back and forth nine times. Now add two rules: the neighbour must lead by three decibels, and keep leading for three hundred and twenty milliseconds. Same street, same measurements: just one handover.

cues.title: 切换的那几十毫秒
cues.caption: 报告、准备、命令、接入；空档里数据先转发。
cues.captionEn: Report, prepare, command, access: data is forwarded in the gap.
cues.zh: 把这次切换放慢近两百倍。手机先报告测量结果，源基站问目标基站能不能接收，得到确认才下达切换命令。手机离开旧小区、接入新小区的这三十多毫秒里，源基站把还没送出的数据包转给目标基站。包的编号一个不少，最后核心网把路径改到新基站。
cues.en: Slow the handover down about two hundred times. The phone reports its measurements; the source asks the target whether it can take the phone, and only after a yes sends the handover command. In the thirty-odd milliseconds the phone spends switching cells, the source forwards the packets it still holds. None go missing, and the core network moves the path to the new site.

cues.title: 待机时，网络怎么找到你
cues.caption: 待机时悄悄换小区，跨区才报到；来电分区寻呼。
cues.captionEn: Idle phones reselect quietly, report new areas, and are paged by area.
cues.zh: 手机不打电话时，网络并不跟踪它在哪个小区。它自己换驻留的小区，不告诉任何人。只有跨进新的位置区，才发一次位置更新。来电时，核心网在整个位置区的二十一个小区里同时呼叫，手机听到后应答，通话才建立起来。
cues.en: When the phone isn't in a call, the network doesn't track its cell. It reselects cells on its own, without telling anyone. Only when it enters a new tracking area does it send an update. For an incoming call, the core pages all twenty-one cells of that area at once; the phone hears it, answers, and the call is set up.

cues.title: 同一部手机，两种速度
cues.caption: 速率盒：带宽 × 每格比特 × 层数
cues.captionEn: The rate box: bandwidth × bits per element × layers.
cues.zh: 同一部手机，4G 峰值大约一百五十兆比特每秒，5G 却能到两点三吉比特。差距从哪来？把速率画成一个盒子：宽度是频带，深度是每个资源单元装几个比特，高度是并行几层。先把盒子拉宽，再加深，最后叠高。三个乘数连起来，才是十五倍。
cues.en: One phone peaks near a hundred and fifty megabits on 4G, and about 2.3 gigabits on 5G. Why? Draw the rate as a box: width is the channel, depth is the bits in each resource element, height is the layers running side by side. Stretch it, deepen it, stack it. Three multipliers, not one magic signal.

cues.title: 把频带切成子载波
cues.caption: 子载波彼此重叠，却在对方中心为零
cues.captionEn: Subcarriers overlap, yet each is zero at the others’ centres.
cues.zh: 宽度里装的是 OFDM 子载波。4G 每隔十五千赫一个；5G 还能选三十、六十，毫米波甚至一百二十千赫。它们的频谱互相重叠，可在任何一个子载波的正中央，其他曲线都恰好穿过零点。4G 的一个资源块是十二个子载波乘七个符号；一毫秒里有两个，拼成这张十二乘十四的网格。
cues.en: The width is filled with OFDM subcarriers: fifteen kilohertz apart in 4G, while 5G can also use thirty, sixty, or a hundred and twenty at millimetre wave. Their spectra overlap, yet at the centre of any one subcarrier every other curve passes exactly through zero. A 4G resource block is twelve subcarriers by seven symbols; two of them fill one millisecond, this twelve-by-fourteen grid.

cues.title: 信号越干净，装得越多
cues.titleEn: A cleaner signal carries more bits
cues.caption: 噪声越小，越能分清更密的星座点
cues.captionEn: Less noise lets the receiver separate denser points.
cues.zh: 每个资源单元装几个比特，要看星座图。QPSK 只有四个点，每格两比特；256QAM 有两百五十六个点，每格八比特，可点和点挤得很近。现在让信噪比从三十二分贝降到十六分贝：同一串噪声把接收点推过判决线，红点就是认错的符号。只好退回 16QAM，每格少装一半。
cues.en: How many bits fit in each element? Watch the constellation. QPSK has four points, two bits each; 256QAM packs two hundred and fifty-six, eight bits each, much closer together. Now drop the SNR from thirty-two to sixteen decibels. The same noise pushes points across the decision lines, and the red ones are misread. The link falls back to 16QAM, carrying half as much.

cues.title: 更宽的频带
cues.caption: 4G 载波 20 MHz，5G 可到 100 MHz
cues.captionEn: A 4G carrier is 20 MHz; one 5G mid-band carrier reaches 100 MHz.
cues.zh: 5G 最大的一步，是把盒子拉宽。4G 常见的一个载波二十兆赫，一百个资源块；5G 在三点五吉赫附近，一个载波就能有一百兆赫。子载波间隔三十千赫，两百七十三个资源块铺满整条带子。同样四层、同样 256QAM，速率约是五点八倍。公平地说，4G 也能把几个载波拼起来，只是少有这么宽的连续频谱。
cues.en: 5G's biggest step is making the box wider. A typical 4G carrier is twenty megahertz, a hundred resource blocks. Around 3.5 gigahertz, one 5G carrier can span a hundred megahertz, with thirty-kilohertz subcarriers and two hundred and seventy-three blocks. Same four layers, same 256QAM, about 5.8 times the rate. To be fair, 4G can aggregate carriers too; it just rarely had this much contiguous spectrum.

cues.title: 频率越高，越难穿透
cues.caption: 阵列补回毫米波损耗，却穿不过墙
cues.captionEn: An array wins back millimetre-wave loss, but walls still block it.
cues.zh: 更宽的频带多在更高的频率上。跟着两条电平线看：两端都是单天线时，二十八吉赫比三点五吉赫多损失十八分贝。基站换成同样大小的天线面板，高频能塞进六十四倍的单元，增益正好补回这十八分贝。可一堵墙就不一样了：普通玻璃只差几分贝，混凝土墙对二十八吉赫却要吃掉一百多分贝。
cues.en: Wide channels mostly sit at higher frequencies. Follow the two level lines. With single antennas, 28 gigahertz loses eighteen decibels more than 3.5. Give the base station the same-size panel in both bands: the higher band fits sixty-four times the elements, and that gain wins the loss back. A wall is different. Glass costs a few decibels; concrete swallows over a hundred at 28 gigahertz.

cues.title: 天线阵列对准你
cues.titleEn: An antenna array aims at you
cues.caption: 逐个错开相位，能量汇成波束
cues.captionEn: Staggering each element’s phase gathers energy into a beam.
cues.zh: 阵列怎样补回损耗？一个天线向四面八方均匀地发。四个天线同相位，波在正前方叠加，旁边互相抵消。手机走到三十度方向，每个单元依次多转一点相位，波束就跟过去。单元加到十六个，波束更窄，增益到十二分贝；八乘八的平面阵有六十四个单元，正好十八分贝。
cues.en: How does an array win that loss back? One antenna radiates evenly everywhere. Four elements in phase add up straight ahead and cancel to the sides. As the phone moves to thirty degrees, each element shifts its phase a little more than its neighbour, and the beam follows. Sixteen elements narrow it to twelve decibels of gain; an eight-by-eight panel gives eighteen.

cues.title: 多路并行与更短时隙
cues.caption: 空间上并行几层，时间上切短时隙
cues.captionEn: Parallel layers in space; shorter slots in time.
cues.zh: 盒子的高度来自空间复用。基站和手机各有四根天线，如果信号沿几条足够不同的路径到达，同一块时频资源上就能并行四层数据，速率翻两番。再看时间：子载波间隔加倍，符号和时隙都减半。数据在零点三毫秒到达，十五千赫要等零点七毫秒，一百二十千赫只等零点零七五毫秒。
cues.en: The box's height comes from spatial multiplexing. With four antennas at each end and paths that differ enough, four layers of data share the same time–frequency grid, quadrupling the rate. Now look at time. Doubling the subcarrier spacing halves every symbol and every slot. Data arriving at 0.3 milliseconds waits 0.7 at fifteen kilohertz, but only 0.075 at a hundred and twenty.

cues.title: 速度不只取决于 5G
cues.caption: 分享、位置与回传一起决定速度
cues.captionEn: Sharing, your position and backhaul decide what you get.
cues.zh: 两点三吉比特，是一个人独占整个小区时的峰值。现在十个人分享同一个载波，你只分到十分之一的格子。基站后面的回传只有一吉比特，也要十个人分。再走远一些，信噪比降到十二分贝；按本篇的门槛规则，每格只能装两个比特。最后你拿到约五十八兆，同样条件下的 4G 估算只有十兆左右。
cues.en: 2.3 gigabits assumes you own the whole cell. Now ten people share the carrier, and you get a tenth of the cells. The one-gigabit backhaul is split ten ways too. Walk farther away and the SNR falls to twelve decibels; by this page's threshold rule, each cell carries only two bits. You end up near fifty-eight megabits. The 4G estimate, under the same conditions, is about ten.

cues.title: 落地，开机
cues.caption: 手机不选最强信号，先看 SIM 里的伙伴名单。
cues.captionEn: The phone follows the SIM's partner list, not the strongest signal.
cues.zh: 飞机落地，你打开手机。家乡的网络在这里一格信号也没有，手机只好扫描当地的网络：A、B、C 三家。C 的信号最强，手机却没有选它。它先翻出 SIM 卡里的优选名单，排第一的是 A，于是信号最弱的 A 被选中。这份名单列的，正是家乡运营商签过漫游协议的伙伴。
cues.en: The plane lands and you switch on. Your home network has no signal here, so the phone scans the local ones: A, B and C. C is the strongest, yet the phone passes it over. It checks a preference list on the SIM, where A comes first. So the weakest signal wins. That list names partners your home operator has roaming agreements with.

cues.title: SIM 卡里写着你是谁
cues.titleEn: The SIM says who you are
cues.caption: IMSI 前五位指明国家和运营商，K 不出卡。
cues.captionEn: The first five IMSI digits name country and operator; K stays put.
cues.zh: 当地网络怎么知道你是谁？SIM 卡里存着一串身份号码，叫 IMSI。前三位 001 是国家码，接着两位 01 是运营商码，剩下的是你在家乡运营商那里的编号。当地网络读出前五位，就拼出了你家网络的地址。再看那把钥匙：密钥 K 也在卡里，但它从来不会被读出来。
cues.en: How does a foreign network know who you are? Your SIM holds an identity number, the IMSI. Three digits give the country, two the operator, and the rest identify you. From those first five digits, the local network builds your home network's address. Now look at the key. K lives on the SIM too, but it is never read out.

cues.title: 当地网络去问你家
cues.caption: 当地网络经 IPX 向你家要认证数据。
cues.captionEn: Over IPX, the local network asks your home for authentication data.
cues.zh: 手机发出附着请求，报上 IMSI。当地网络自己核对不了，就把请求交给漫游专网 IPX，跨过大海送到你的归属网络。只有签过协议的伙伴，请求才会被转发。家里用只有它和 SIM 知道的密钥 K，算出一组认证向量，再原路送回。K 本身始终留在家里。
cues.en: The phone sends an attach request with its IMSI. The local network can't check it alone, so it asks your home network over a private roaming exchange called IPX. Only partners with an agreement get through. At home, the key K, shared only with your SIM, computes a set of authentication data, which is sent back. K itself stays home.

cues.title: 不交出密钥也能证明
cues.caption: SIM 算出的 RES 与家里的 XRES 一致。
cues.captionEn: The SIM derives RES from K and RAND; it matches XRES.
cues.zh: 当地网络留下期望答案 XRES，只把随机挑战 RAND 和校验码 AUTN 发给手机。SIM 先用 K 检查 AUTN，确认请求真的来自你家；再用 K 和 RAND 算出应答 RES。RES 和 XRES 一模一样，认证通过。要是 K 错了一位呢？应答里大约一半的位都变了，根本冒充不了。
cues.en: The local network keeps the expected answer, XRES, and sends the phone a random challenge, RAND, with a check code, AUTN. The SIM uses K to verify AUTN, proving the request came from home. Then it combines K and RAND into a response, RES. It matches XRES. You're in. And if K were one bit off? About half the answer changes.

cues.title: 家里记下你在哪
cues.caption: 家里记下你在 002-01，并下发签约数据。
cues.captionEn: Home records you on 002-01 and sends your subscription.
cues.zh: 认证通过后，当地网络再发一次位置更新。你的归属网络在用户记录里写下：这个用户现在在 002-01。原来在家乡为你服务的那台设备，被通知注销。家里还把签约数据发过去：能不能漫游上网，能不能打电话。手机收到附着接受，正式注册成功。
cues.en: Once you're authenticated, the local network sends a location update. Your home network writes it into your record: this subscriber is now on 002-01. The old serving node back home is told to let go. Home also sends your subscription profile: whether you may use data abroad, and make calls. The phone receives its attach accept. You're registered.

cues.title: 上网：绕回家，或就地出去
cues.caption: 绕回家出口更慢，就地出口更快但地址不同。
cues.captionEn: Home routing adds distance; local breakout is faster but looks local.
cues.zh: 打开一个当地的网站。常见的做法是绕回家：数据先钻进隧道，经 IPX 回到家乡的网关，再出去上网，所以网站看到的是家乡的地址。按模型估算，往返大约 250 毫秒。另一种是就地出口，直接从当地网关出去，只要 30 毫秒左右，但网站看到的就是当地地址了。
cues.en: Now open a local website. Data roaming is often home-routed: your traffic tunnels back through IPX to a gateway at home before reaching the internet, so websites see a home-country address. Our model puts that round trip near two hundred and fifty milliseconds. With local breakout, traffic leaves through a local gateway: about thirty milliseconds, but with a local address.

cues.title: 有人给你打电话
cues.caption: 来电先到家，再转到你所在的网络。
cues.captionEn: A call reaches home first, then is forwarded to where you are.
cues.zh: 家人给你打电话。你的号码属于家乡，所以呼叫先到归属网络。家里查记录，得知你在 002-01，就向那边要一个临时漫游号码，再按这个号码把电话接过去。当地网络寻呼你的手机，铃声响起。要是身边的当地朋友打给你，电话也得先回家再回来，跨国两次。
cues.en: Your family calls. Your number belongs to your home network, so the call lands there first. Home checks its record, sees you're on 002-01, and asks that network for a temporary roaming number. The call is connected to it, and the local network pages your phone. Even a friend standing next to you gets routed home and back: two border crossings.

cues.title: 同一道题
cues.caption: 三种安排，输入和权重保持相同。
cues.captionEn: Three schedules keep the same inputs and weights.
cues.zh: 先给三种处理器同一道题。跟住 Y 一一：一行输入和一列权重，四次相乘，再把积相加，得到二。最后把负数变成零。输入与权重始终不换，三种安排必须算出相同的十六个结果。
cues.en: Give all three processors the same task. Follow Y one one: one row of inputs meets one column of weights. Multiply four pairs and add the products to get two. Then replace negative results with zero. Keep the inputs and weights fixed: all sixteen answers must agree.

cues.title: CPU：跟着程序走
cues.caption: CPU 按程序乘加，再决定写入哪个值。
cues.captionEn: The CPU chooses what to execute and what to write.
cues.zh: 看 CPU 怎样算 Y 一一。一次乘加更新一次部分和，四个积凑齐后，程序判断要保留原值还是写零，然后处理下一项。这突出的是灵活控制。真实 CPU 也有多核和向量单元，并不只能串行算一个数。
cues.en: Watch the CPU build Y one one. Each multiply-accumulate updates a partial sum. After four products, the program chooses whether to keep the value or write zero, then moves on. This view highlights flexible control. Real CPUs also have multiple cores and vector units; they are not limited to one-at-a-time arithmetic.

cues.title: GPU：同指令，多数据
cues.caption: GPU 的通道执行同一指令，各自保留数据身份。
cues.captionEn: One instruction updates four lanes with their own data.
cues.zh: 换成 GPU，题目没换。一行里的四个输出分给四条通道，同一条乘加指令作用于各自的数据。你能看见四个部分和一起更新。画面只留四条教学通道；真实 GPU 的组织更大，还能有矩阵专用硬件，并不只是负责画图。
cues.en: Now use the GPU without changing the task. Four outputs are assigned to four lanes. A common multiply-accumulate instruction acts on each lane’s own data, so four partial sums update together. We show only four teaching lanes. Real GPUs have larger organizations and may also contain specialized matrix hardware. Their work extends well beyond drawing graphics.

cues.title: 分支，让部分通道等待
cues.caption: Y13 为负：先等待，再单独写零。
cues.captionEn: Y13 is negative: it waits, then writes zero.
cues.zh: 停住第一行的结果。Y 一三的部分和是负二，其余结果不为负。执行保留路径时，Y 一三被掩蔽；轮到写零路径，其余通道等待。编号和部分和都没丢。这是解释分支掩码的慢镜头，真实的 ReLU 也可能编译成无分支指令。
cues.en: Pause on the first row. Y one three has a sum of minus two; the other values are nonnegative. On the keep path, Y one three is masked. On the zero path, the other lanes wait. Their identities and sums remain intact. This slow view explains branch masks; actual ReLU code may use a branchless instruction.

cues.title: NPU：让数据流过阵列
cues.titleEn: NPU: stream data through an array
cues.caption: 输入向右、权重向下；每个交点保留部分和。
cues.captionEn: Inputs move right; weights move down; each cell holds its sum.
cues.zh: 这次把乘加排成阵列。蓝色输入向右，暖色权重向下。同一个 k 的两个数在交点相遇。乘积加入留在这里的部分和，输入和权重继续传给相邻单元。错开进入的时刻，计算就像斜着推进的波。这是一种 NPU 数据流示例，内部结构并非都相同。
cues.en: Arrange the multiply-accumulates into an array. Blue inputs travel horizontally; warm-colored weights travel vertically. Matching k values meet at a crossing. Their product joins the partial sum held in that cell, while the two input values continue to neighboring cells. Staggered arrivals create a diagonal wave. This is one NPU dataflow example, not a universal internal design.

cues.title: 还要把数据送到
cues.caption: 实际任务还取决于搬运、精度和算子支持。
cues.captionEn: Transfers and supported operators are part of the task.
cues.zh: 乘法器不能凭空得到数据。内存、搬运、启动和结果接回都属于任务。CPU 可以组织程序，把适合的并行工作交给 GPU，把受支持的张量算子交给 NPU。这只是协作示例。芯片再专用，也要看形状、精度和算子是否合适。
cues.en: Multipliers need data. Memory access, transfers, launches and consuming results are part of the task. A CPU can organize a program, dispatch parallel work to a GPU and supported tensor operations to an NPU. This is one collaboration example. Specialized hardware still needs suitable shapes, numerical precision and supported operators.

cues.title: 结果一样，分工不同
cues.caption: 十六个结果逐项相同；教学步数不是跑分。
cues.captionEn: All sixteen results match. Teaching steps are not benchmarks.
cues.zh: 最后逐项核对十六个结果：完全相同，权重也从未更新。CPU 强调通用控制，GPU 组织大规模并行，NPU 针对受支持的神经网络运算。画面的步数只是教学事件，不能拿来比较真实速度或功耗。选择处理器，先看任务，再看测量。
cues.en: Compare every one of the sixteen outputs: they match, and the weights never changed. CPUs emphasize general control, GPUs organize large parallel workloads, and NPUs specialize supported neural-network operations. These steps are teaching events, not measurements of speed or power. Choose hardware by the task, then by measurements made under stated conditions.

cues.title: 省掉卡槽，芯片还在
cues.caption: eSIM 省掉拔插，安全硬件仍在。
cues.captionEn: eSIM removes card swapping; secure hardware remains.
cues.zh: 手机没有卡槽，SIM 就完全消失了吗？看这张手机切面。主板上的小芯片，就是这里的 eUICC。它能保存运营商的身份数据，还能安全地安装新的 profile。接下来，我们跟着一份旅行订阅，看它怎样来到这个芯片里。
cues.en: A phone has no SIM tray. Did the SIM disappear? Follow the cutaway to its small eUICC chip. It stores protected operator profiles and can install new ones. We will follow one travel subscription all the way into that hardware.

cues.title: 扫码只拿到线索
cues.caption: 激活码定位订阅，没有网络密钥。
cues.captionEn: An activation code locates a subscription, not its network key.
cues.zh: 先看激活码。它告诉手机的本地助手 LPA：去哪个服务器，领取哪一份订阅。这里用的是不能扫描的示意，里面没有你的网络密钥。手机还要有互联网连接。扫码给出的是下载线索，并不是凭空造出一张能用的 SIM。
cues.en: The activation code tells the phone’s local assistant, the LPA, where to go and which subscription to request. This illustration cannot be scanned. There is no network key in it. An existing internet connection is needed before the profile can be downloaded.

cues.title: 先确认双方身份
cues.caption: 服务器与芯片互相证明身份。
cues.captionEn: The server and chip prove their identities.
cues.zh: 找到服务器，还不能立刻把身份数据交出去。芯片先检查服务器的证书和新鲜的签名，确认对方可信。随后服务器也验证芯片的证明。看两次检查依次通过。证书解决的是这次安全下载的信任，还不是后面的移动网络认证。
cues.en: Finding a server is only the beginning. The chip checks the server’s certificate and a fresh signed message. The server then verifies the chip’s proof. Watch both checks succeed in order. This establishes trust for provisioning; mobile-network authentication comes later.

cues.title: 封包绑定这一颗芯片
cues.titleEn: A package bound to this chip
cues.caption: 同一份封包给 B，不能安装。
cues.captionEn: Copying the same bound package to B does not allow installation.
cues.zh: 身份确认以后，服务器准备加密的绑定封包。跟住这份封包：它经过 LPA，由助手分段搬进芯片 A。助手负责搬运，并不能解出里面的网络密钥。现在把同一份绑定封包复制给 B。对象不对，安装被拒绝；它不是一份随处可用的电子复印件。
cues.en: The server prepares an encrypted package bound to chip A. Follow that same package through the LPA into the chip. The assistant forwards it without reading the network key. Now copy the bound package to B. Installation is rejected: this is not a reusable digital photocopy.

cues.title: 安装不等于启用
cues.caption: 完整安装以后，仍要单独启用。
cues.captionEn: Complete installation still needs a separate enable step.
cues.zh: 进入芯片以后，封包还要完整验证，才能安装。注意旅行线路：已经存进来了，却仍然是停用状态。然后用户确认启用，选中的线路才发生变化。日常线路没有被抹掉。本图用一个启用端口说明过程，能存几份和能同时用几份，是两个问题。
cues.en: Inside the chip, the complete package must pass verification before installation. Notice the travel profile: installed, but still disabled. A separate enable step selects it, while the daily profile remains stored. This diagram has one enabled port. Stored capacity and simultaneous active lines are different limits.

cues.title: 同样的无线网络认证
cues.caption: 换 profile 改变身份，天线没有变。
cues.captionEn: Changing profiles changes identity; the antenna stays.
cues.zh: 最后，下载完成，手机仍要向移动网络证明自己。网络发来随机挑战，芯片用启用 profile 的密钥计算应答。认证时，这把密钥留在芯片里。再切回日常线路，选用的身份改变，网络重新认证。负责收发无线信号的，仍是原来的基带和天线。
cues.en: After provisioning, the phone must still authenticate to the mobile network. The network sends a random challenge; the enabled profile computes a response using its key inside the chip. Switch back to the daily profile and authenticate again. The baseband and antenna continue handling the same radio link.

cues.title: 焦点落在前面
cues.caption: 焦点在视网膜前，接收时已散开。
cues.captionEn: The rays focus before the retina, then spread.
cues.zh: 先跟住远处的同一个光点。蓝色光线在眼内会聚，但焦点落在视网膜前。接收平面逐渐后移，焦点之后的光又散开，因此眼睛收到的不是一个清晰小点。这是等效眼的光学示意；真实近视还涉及眼睛的形状与屈光力量。
cues.en: Follow one distant point. Its blue rays converge inside the eye, before reaching the retinal plane. As that plane moves farther back, the rays have already spread again. This equivalent-eye illustration explains blur; a real eye has additional surfaces, shapes and aberrations.

cues.title: 先把图像看清
cues.caption: 负光焦度把清晰焦点送回视网膜。
cues.captionEn: Negative power returns the clear focus to the retina.
cues.zh: 现在加入普通单光镜片。注意光线经过镜片后先稍微发散，眼睛再把它们会聚到视网膜面。我们确实把这个光点看清了。但是，当前清晰并不能告诉我们以后眼轴会长多少。屈光矫正与减慢近视进展，接下来要分开看。
cues.en: Add a single-vision lens. Notice the rays diverge slightly after the spectacle lens, before the eye converges them onto the retina. The point is now optically corrected. That clear focus alone does not tell us how much the eye will grow in the future.

cues.title: 镜片表面的另一层结构
cues.caption: 中央矫正区周围，微透镜叠加正光焦度。
cues.captionEn: Surrounding lenslets add positive power to the correction.
cues.zh: 靠近镜片表面。这是 DIMS 设计的一种教学示意：中央矫正区周围，排列着小小的附加微透镜。单枚直径约一点零三毫米，附加光焦度为正三点五屈光度。基底仍提供远用矫正，微透镜在它上面加入另一种成分；位置采用抽样图案。
cues.en: Look closely at the lens surface. This DIMS illustration surrounds a central clear zone with small added lenslets. Each is about one point zero three millimetres across, with plus three point five dioptres added to the distance correction. The arrangement shown is a sampled pattern.

cues.title: 同一光点，两种成分
cues.caption: 入射角改变，选中的微透镜光才进入瞳孔。
cues.captionEn: Changing incidence admits the selected lenslet bundle.
cues.zh: 回到同一个远处光点，增加一点入射角。看金色光束：刚才它被瞳孔挡住，现在进入了眼内。蓝色矫正成分仍然会聚在视网膜；来自选中微透镜的成分，则会聚在前面。两束光来自同一光点，并不是两幅互不相关的装饰光路。
cues.en: Return to the same distant point and change its incident angle. The amber bundle from our selected lenslet was blocked by the pupil; now it enters the eye. The blue correcting component still focuses on the retina, while the added component focuses in front of it.

cues.title: 近看两处真实会聚
cues.caption: 矫正焦点留在视网膜，额外焦点在前方。
cues.captionEn: The clear focus stays on the retina; the extra focus is forward.
cues.zh: 暂停在两束光会聚的位置。蓝色小点贴着视网膜面，金色小点在它前方。它们的距离和交会来自同一个光学计算。自由探索时，减少附加光焦度会让金色焦点靠近蓝色焦点。但这个距离不是防控效果的刻度，不能换算成孩子将来的眼轴增长。
cues.en: Inspect the focal positions. The blue point lies on the retinal plane; the amber point is in front. Their positions come from the same ray calculation. Reducing added power brings them together. Their separation is an optical quantity, not a scale for predicting a child’s future growth.

cues.title: 效果来自独立临床比较
cues.caption: 两组仍在增长；图中是组平均，不是个人预测。
cues.captionEn: Both groups grew; averages are not individual forecasts.
cues.zh: 接下来单独看临床证据。这项香港研究比较八到十三岁的儿童，图中是完成两年随访者的平均结果。普通单光组眼轴增长零点五三毫米，DIMS 组零点二一毫米。两组都仍在增长，小误差线表示均值的标准误。这些数字属于特定研究，不能预测某个孩子。
cues.en: Now examine clinical evidence separately. This Hong Kong trial studied children aged eight to thirteen. Among two-year completers, mean axial growth was zero point five three millimetres with single vision, and zero point two one with DIMS. Both groups grew. Small bars indicate standard errors, not individual outcomes.

cues.title: 清晰焦点与长期证据
cues.caption: 计算解释光路；长期变化仍须研究与个体评估。
cues.captionEn: Optics explains the rays; longer-term change needs evidence and assessment.
cues.zh: 最后回看镜片与眼睛。远用矫正负责清晰焦点，附加微透镜安排另一种光学成分。我们的模型解释这两束光怎样走，没有模拟眼睛的生长。不同镜片设计也不能直接共用一项研究的结果。实际选用、验配和复查，需要结合专业检查与持续的证据。
cues.en: Return to the lens and eye. The distance correction forms the clear focus; added lenslets arrange another optical component. Our model traces both bundles without simulating eye growth. Different designs need their own evidence. Selection, fitting and follow-up depend on professional assessment of the individual child.

cues.title: 同一镜头，两条路径
cues.caption: 差别从镜头后开始：一条送光，一条送图像。
cues.captionEn: One path carries light; the other carries an image.
cues.zh: 先把注意力放在黄色光点上。它穿过镜头，进入机身。单反和无反都需要镜头与传感器；区别是拍摄前怎样看见。传统单反把光折向眼睛，无反先让传感器读出图像，再送到显示屏。接下来，我们打开机身，跟踪这两条路线。
cues.en: Follow the yellow point through the lens and into the body. Both cameras need a lens and a sensor. Their difference starts with how you see before taking the photograph. A conventional DSLR redirects light toward your eye. A mirrorless camera reads an image from the sensor and sends it to a display. Let us follow those routes inside the body.

cues.title: 跟着光到眼睛
cues.caption: 反光镜把光送向对焦屏，棱镜再折向目镜。
cues.captionEn: The mirror sends light to the screen, prism and eye.
cues.zh: 找到机身里斜放的银色反光镜。镜头来的光在这里向上转，抵达对焦屏。再沿黄色折线穿过五棱镜，最后到达目镜。眼睛看到的是这条光学路线提供的图像。主传感器还被快门遮住，所以光学取景不必等它读出一帧图像。
cues.en: Find the tilted silver mirror. It turns the incoming lens light upward to the focusing screen. Follow the yellow line through the prism and toward the eyepiece. This optical route supplies the view to your eye. The main sensor is still covered by the shutter, so optical viewing does not have to wait for that sensor to read a frame.

cues.title: 镜子先让路
cues.caption: 先抬镜、再开帘；取景中断发生在曝光之前。
cues.captionEn: Mirror up first, then curtains open: optical viewing stops.
cues.zh: 现在慢放一次拍摄。反光镜绕固定铰点抬起，连杆始终连着它。取景窗已经黑了，但快门还没有打开。镜子让出通道后，第一帘向下经过传感器，曝光开始。第二帘随后跟上，结束每一行的曝光。黑屏是取景光路中断，不是相机突然没有了光。
cues.en: Slow down one capture. The mirror lifts about its fixed hinge, with the linkage still connected. The finder is already dark, but the shutter has not opened. Once the mirror clears the path, the first curtain crosses the sensor and starts exposure. The second follows and ends exposure for each row. The blackout comes from interrupting the viewing route, not from light disappearing.

cues.title: 单反也能实时取景
cues.titleEn: A DSLR can use live view too
cues.caption: 实时取景让镜子保持抬起，传感器信号送到后屏。
cues.captionEn: A DSLR can raise its mirror and read the sensor live.
cues.zh: 反光镜落下，光学取景先恢复。现在切换到单反的实时取景。镜子再次抬起，快门开放，传感器持续读取镜头来的光。蓝色线路把信号经处理器送到后屏；光学目镜仍然是黑的。同一台单反也能走电子显示路线，只是那块反光镜必须让开。
cues.en: When the mirror returns, optical viewing resumes. Now switch this DSLR to live view. The mirror stays up and the shutter opens so the main sensor can keep reading lens light. The blue signal path passes through processing and ends at the rear screen. The optical eyepiece remains dark. A DSLR can use an electronic viewing route too, with its mirror out of the way.

cues.title: 显示屏发出新的光
cues.caption: 无反先读传感器，再用显示屏重新发出取景图像。
cues.captionEn: The sensor is read; a display emits a new viewing image.
cues.zh: 无反从一开始就没有反光镜。黄色光路抵达传感器，到这里变成电信号。跟着蓝色线路经过处理器，再来到电子取景器的小显示屏。现在提高预览补偿，取景图像变亮，因为显示内容可以被计算改变。眼睛接收的是显示屏新发出的光，并不是原来那束光一路穿过了机身。
cues.en: The mirrorless body has no reflex mirror to begin with. Lens light reaches the sensor and becomes an electrical signal. Follow the blue connection through processing to the small display in the electronic finder. Raise preview compensation and the displayed image brightens. Its appearance can be changed by computation. Your eye receives new light emitted by that display, rather than the original beam traveling directly through the body.

cues.title: 无反也可以有快门帘
cues.caption: 没有反光镜，也可以用两片机械帘控制曝光。
cues.captionEn: A mirrorless camera can use two mechanical curtains.
cues.zh: 留意无反传感器前的两片帘。取景时它们让光通过；在这一种机械拍摄时序里，快门先关闭，再由第一帘开始新的曝光，第二帘结束它。这一次没有任何镜子抬起。电子取景在这里也会中断，拍完后恢复；其他机型和快门方式可能冻结画面或持续取景。因此，无反不等于没有机械快门，也不保证拍摄时绝不黑屏。
cues.en: Notice the curtains in front of the mirrorless sensor. They admit light during live viewing. In this mechanical capture sequence, the shutter first closes, then the first curtain starts a fresh exposure and the second ends it. No mirror lifts. This example interrupts the electronic view and restores it afterward. Other sensors and shutter modes may freeze the view or keep it running. Mirrorless means neither mechanical-shutter-free nor automatically blackout-free.

cues.title: 把反光镜与快门分开
cues.titleEn: Separate the mirror from the shutter
cues.caption: 反光镜决定取景路线；快门方式是另一项选择。
cues.captionEn: The mirror defines the camera type; shutters are separate.
cues.zh: 最后只改变预览补偿。光学单反的取景亮度保持原样；电子取景的图像随补偿变化。把两个问题分开，就容易理解了：有没有反光镜，决定这里比较的取景结构；怎样开始和结束曝光，是快门方式的选择。镜头、传感器和图像处理，两种相机都需要。它们走的路线不同，不代表某一类天生拍得更好。
cues.en: Change only preview compensation. The optical view keeps its original brightness, while the electronic image responds. Separate two questions: is there a reflex mirror providing an optical viewing route, and how does exposure start and stop? The latter is a shutter choice. Both camera types still use lenses, sensors, and image processing. Different viewing routes do not establish that one type inherently makes better photographs.

cues.title: 先记录光，还没成像
cues.caption: 快门留下潜像；相纸尚未显出照片。
cues.captionEn: Exposure leaves a latent image; development comes later.
cues.zh: 拍立得是在相机里把照片打印出来的吗？先看这张相纸。快门打开，光经镜头和反射路径，穿过透明覆盖片，落到感光层。快门关闭以后，纸上留下了潜像，肉眼还看不到。相机先记录光，接着才让这张纸完成显影。
cues.en: Is an instant camera printing your photo? Watch the sheet inside. The shutter opens, and light travels through the lens, mirror and transparent cover to the sensitive layer. Closing the shutter leaves an invisible latent image. The scene has been recorded, but the picture still needs processing.

cues.title: 跟住同一张相纸
cues.caption: 拨片启动走纸；滚轮接住同一张纸。
cues.captionEn: A picker starts transport; rollers take the same sheet.
cues.zh: 接下来，跟住同一张纸的边缘。小拨片先顶住纸的后沿，把它推向出口。前沿进入两根滚轮以后，转动的滚轮接手牵引，纸连续向外走。厚白边里还藏着一个封闭药囊。到这里，照片没有换成另一张，也没有凭空出现。
cues.en: Follow that same sheet’s edge. A small picker pushes its trailing edge toward the exit. When the leading edge enters the nip, the rotating rollers take over. The sheet travels continuously. Its wide white border carries a sealed reagent pod: nothing is being swapped for a finished print.

cues.title: 药囊来到滚轮之间
cues.caption: 两面挤压药囊，释放内部试剂。
cues.captionEn: Two rollers compress the pod and release its reagent.
cues.zh: 近看这个鼓起的药囊。两根滚轮从两面压紧，药囊被挤破。释放出来的试剂没有漏到外面，而是进入相纸内部。看纸一直前进，滚轮也转过对应的角度。这处接触，正把机械走纸变成下一步的化学处理。
cues.en: Look closely at the raised pod. Both rollers compress it until it ruptures. The reagent stays inside the sheet rather than spilling outside. Paper travel and roller rotation remain linked. This contact converts the camera’s mechanical transport into the start of chemical processing.

cues.title: 铺出均匀的一层
cues.caption: 前沿跟着走纸，试剂铺进层间。
cues.captionEn: The front follows transport; reagent spreads between layers.
cues.zh: 现在从相纸的平面看。试剂从药囊所在的边缘开始，随着纸经过滚轮，逐步铺向另一端。蓝色区域表示已经处理的部分。这里的试剂含显影所需的成分，也含白色颜料和遮光成分。滚轮要把它铺匀；已经处理，不等于已经完成成像。
cues.en: View the sheet as a plane. Reagent spreads from the pod border toward the far end as the sheet passes through the rollers. Blue marks the processed region. The paste contains developing ingredients, white pigment and light-blocking components. Even coverage starts the chemistry; it does not instantly finish the image.

cues.title: 暗房就在层间
cues.caption: 曝光控制染料，接收层形成正像。
cues.captionEn: Exposure controls dyes; the receiver forms a positive.
cues.zh: 把层厚放大看。透明覆盖片下面，有接收图像的层、处理试剂，以及感光负片的多层结构。曝光影响负片里哪些染料留住，哪些还能迁移。能够迁移的染料进入接收层，组合成正像。图中的青、品红和黄，是三组染料的教学示意；相纸始终合在一起。
cues.en: Enlarge the layers. Beneath the transparent cover are the image receiver, processing reagent and multilayer negative. Exposure controls which dyes become immobilized and which can migrate. Mobile dyes reach the receiver and form a positive. Cyan, magenta and yellow illustrate three dye systems; the physical sheet stays intact.

cues.title: 成像还需要等待
cues.caption: 成像时间被压缩；真实等待通常十到十五分钟。
cues.captionEn: Time is compressed; real development typically takes ten to fifteen minutes.
cues.zh: 杯子的图像渐渐清楚了。注意这个分钟时钟：我们压缩了等待，没有让化学反应真的变快。现行彩色 i-Type 通常需要十到十五分钟，具体依相纸包装。遮光成分会变化，染料迁移和其他反应继续进行。排出只是开始，完整照片还要等。
cues.en: The cup gradually becomes clearer. Read the minute clock: we compressed the waiting, not the actual reaction. Current color i-Type film typically needs ten to fifteen minutes; follow its packaging. The opacifying veil changes while dye transfer and other reactions continue. Ejection begins processing, and the finished photograph takes time.

cues.title: 同一曝光，两种处理
cues.caption: 污点周期留下缺口；清洁用于下一张。
cues.captionEn: A repeating roller spot leaves defects; cleaning helps the next shot.
cues.zh: 最后比较同样曝光的两种处理。清洁滚轮能均匀铺开试剂；一处污点转一圈又压回来，就可能留下重复缺口。已经损坏的照片不会因为清洁而恢复，清洁是为下一张做准备。刚排出的相纸也要避强光，保持平整，不要甩动或挤压。
cues.en: Compare identical exposures processed with clean and dirty rollers. A spot returns after each turn and can leave repeated gaps in reagent coverage. Cleaning will not repair this damaged photograph; it prepares the next exposure. Protect fresh film from strong light, keep it flat, and do not shake or squeeze it.

cues.title: 跟住一把柔软的伞
cues.caption: 推动月水母的是伞与水，不是触手划桨。
cues.captionEn: The bell interacts with water; the tentacles are not oars.
cues.zh: 跟住这只月水母的一把伞。四个马蹄形生殖腺透过伞壁可见，口腕垂在中央，伞缘只有短细触手。推动它的不是触手划桨，而是伞收缩、展开，与周围的水交换动量。我们把一次脉动放慢，看清真正起作用的地方。
cues.en: Follow the flexible bell of this moon jelly. Four horseshoe-shaped gonads show through the tissue; oral arms hang beneath the center and short tentacles fringe the margin. Those tentacles are not rowing oars. Swimming comes from the bell contracting and reopening, exchanging momentum with water. Slow down one pulse to see that interaction.

cues.title: 收缩，挤出水
cues.caption: 伞下体积减少，出通量从同一形状算出。
cues.captionEn: The cavity shrinks; outward flux comes from the same shape.
cues.zh: 看伞缘向内收。伞下的空间变小，水被挤出去。画面中的体积和通量来自同一个半椭球形状，收得越快，体积变化也越快。它只是几何教学模型。真实月水母的宽伞推动还涉及周围压力和卷吸，不能当作狭窄喷嘴。
cues.en: Watch the margin contract. Space beneath the bell shrinks and water is displaced. The displayed volume and flux come from the same half-ellipsoid shape: faster deformation changes volume faster. This is a geometric teaching model. A real moon jelly’s broad bell also uses distributed pressure and entrainment; it is not simply a narrow nozzle.

cues.title: 水的运动卷成一圈
cues.caption: 收缩附近形成起始涡，随后进入尾流。
cues.captionEn: A starting vortex forms near contraction and enters the wake.
cues.zh: 注意蓝色的起始涡。伞缘运动让附近的水卷起来，三维里是一整圈，剖面里看到的是两侧。这一圈随后离开身体，成为尾流的一部分。图中涡的位置和转向只是机制示意，没有求解真实流体。先记住它，再找第二圈。
cues.en: Track the blue starting vortex. Margin motion rolls nearby water into a ring. It is a full circle in three dimensions, seen on two sides in a section. The ring moves away into the wake. Its location and rotation here are schematic, not a solved fluid field. Keep its identity in mind while looking for a second ring.

cues.title: 回弹，把第二个涡带到伞下
cues.caption: 伞展开时，反向旋转的停止涡来到伞下。
cues.captionEn: Reopening brings the counter-rotating stopping vortex beneath the bell.
cues.zh: 肌肉收缩结束，弹性的伞组织回弹，水重新填入。暖色停止涡的旋转方向与起始涡相反。展开中的伞缘把它增强，并移到伞下。放松并不是单纯重置形状，它也在安排周围的水。这个停止涡，接下来还能继续起作用。
cues.en: Muscle contraction ends and elastic tissue reopens the bell. Water refills the cavity. The warm-colored stopping vortex rotates opposite to the starting ring. Margin motion strengthens it and positions it beneath the bell. Relaxation does more than reset the shape: it organizes the surrounding water. That stopping vortex can keep acting in the next phase.

cues.title: 伞静止后，还有推力
cues.titleEn: Thrust after the bell becomes still
cues.caption: 体积变化已为零，停止涡仍可诱导二次推力。
cues.captionEn: Volume change is zero, yet the stopping vortex can provide secondary thrust.
cues.zh: 现在伞已经完全舒张，体积变化率为零。停止涡诱导的水流仍抵向伞内表面，可以形成正压，带来第二次推力。研究看到过这时再次加速，不能全部归为惯性。回收的能量来自此前的做功与流动；没有免费能量突然出现。
cues.en: The bell is fully relaxed now, and volume change is zero. Flow induced by the stopping vortex can still press against the inner bell surface, creating positive pressure and secondary thrust. Researchers observed renewed acceleration in this phase; inertia alone cannot explain it. The recovered energy comes from earlier work and fluid motion. Nothing appears for free.

cues.title: 同动作，移除回收项
cues.caption: 虚拟移除回收项；形变、初始状态和阻力相同。
cues.captionEn: Virtual comparison: same motion and drag; recovery changes.
cues.zh: 给两条轨迹完全相同的伞动作和阻力，只在一条里保留迟后的回收项。暖色阴影是完全舒张的阶段。这时保留回收项的速度仍可能上升。曲线来自未标定的低阶模型，只用来拆开因果，不能把距离当作真实水母的实验成绩。
cues.en: Give both paths exactly the same bell motion and drag, retaining the delayed recovery term in only one. Warm shading marks fully relaxed intervals. The modeled speed with recovery can still rise during those intervals. These curves come from an uncalibrated low-order model. They separate causes, not measured performance; the distances are not experimental results for a real jelly.

cues.title: 一次脉动，三段因果
cues.caption: 收缩、回弹和舒张后的流动，连成一个周期。
cues.captionEn: Contraction, recoil and post-relaxation flow form one cycle.
cues.zh: 再连起来看一次：收缩排水，弹性回弹回填，完全舒张后继续利用水的运动。月水母把伞和周围流体组成了一个连续过程。主片解释这个机制，不模拟完整海洋，也不把所有水母都当成一样。你可以停住、重播，再看暖色停止涡怎样来到伞下。
cues.en: Connect the phases again: contraction displaces water, elastic recoil refills the bell, and fluid motion can continue helping after full relaxation. The bell and surrounding water form one continuous process. This film explains that mechanism, not a whole ocean or every kind of jellyfish. Pause or replay to follow the warm stopping vortex into position beneath the bell.

cues.title: 一台秤，两种测量
cues.caption: 秤先测体重，再估计组成。
cues.captionEn: Weight is measured; composition is estimated.
cues.zh: 脚下这四片金属，不是四个小摄像头。体脂秤先测出体重，再让很小的交流信号通过身体的一段路径。我们始终跟着同一个虚拟对象：两只脚接触四片电极。接下来，把重量测量和身体组成估算分开看。
cues.en: Those four metal pads are not tiny cameras. The scale measures weight, then sends a small alternating signal through part of the body. We will follow one invented subject, with both bare feet touching all four pads. First, separate weighing from estimating body composition.

cues.title: 重量先落在测力梁上
cues.caption: 载荷增加，电桥输出随应变改变。
cues.captionEn: Applied load changes strain and bridge voltage.
cues.zh: 玻璃下面，四角各有测力结构。现在给模型逐渐加载，直到承受这个对象的全部重量。测力梁上的应变片被轻微拉伸或压缩，电阻随之改变，电桥输出小电压。近看把应变放大了一千倍。这里测的是力，并没有使用人体阻抗。
cues.en: Four load cells support the glass. Our separate loading demonstration increases the applied force to this subject’s full weight. Bonded strain gauges stretch or compress slightly, changing their resistance and bridge voltage. The close view exaggerates strain a thousand times. This chain measures force without using body impedance.

cues.title: 两片送电流，两片测电压
cues.caption: 电流闭合；电压由另一对电极采样。
cues.captionEn: A closed current path; a separate voltage pair.
cues.zh: 看暖色回路。交流源连接一只脚的电流电极，经腿和下躯干，再从另一只脚回到秤内。亮点来回摆动，因为这是交流。蓝色导线连接另一对电极，送到高输入阻抗的电压采样电路。两种角色分开，减少接触阻抗的影响。图中是一条等效路径，不是全身逐块扫描。
cues.en: Follow the warm path from the source, through one current pad, the legs and lower trunk, and back through the other pad. The markers oscillate because the signal alternates. Blue leads carry a separate electrode pair to a high-impedance voltage input. This reduces contact effects. The route is an equivalent path, not a whole-body scan.

cues.title: 一对波形，两种信息
cues.caption: 幅比给出大小，相位区分电阻与电抗。
cues.captionEn: Amplitude ratio and phase give complex impedance.
cues.zh: 电流已知，响应电压被采样。两条波形各用自己的量程，但时间轴相同。电压与电流的幅比给出阻抗大小；电压滞后的一小段给出相位。合在一起，才能分出电阻和电抗。此时还没有得到脂肪质量，只得到了这条采样路径的电学响应。
cues.en: Current is known, and voltage is sampled. Each trace has its own amplitude scale, but both share time. Their amplitude ratio gives impedance magnitude. The voltage lag gives phase. Together they separate resistance from reactance. We still have no fat measurement: only the electrical response of the sampled path.

cues.title: 频率改变可通过的支路
cues.caption: 频率升高，膜电容支路更容易通过。
cues.captionEn: Higher frequency admits more capacitive response.
cues.zh: 用一个等效电路放大组织。含离子的液体形成导电路径，细胞膜用电容表示。提高频率时，膜电容的阻抗变小，经过细胞内液的支路响应增强。它不是低频只走外液、高频突然全走内液的开关，更不能凭一条线读出每块组织。
cues.en: Zoom into an equivalent tissue circuit. Ionic fluids conduct; the membrane is represented by capacitance. As frequency rises, capacitive opposition falls, increasing the intracellular branch response. This is a gradual change, not a switch that suddenly sends all current inside cells. The diagram does not resolve individual tissues.

cues.title: 从电阻走到估计
cues.caption: 水分与去脂体重来自模型假设。
cues.captionEn: Water and fat-free mass depend on assumptions.
cues.zh: 回到五十千赫。模型用身高平方与电阻的关系估计水分，再假定水分占去脂体重的百分之七十三。总重减去估计去脂体重，才得到估计脂肪质量。注意每一次转换：本片系数只匹配一个虚拟对象，没有人群标定，不能用它测出或诊断个人脂肪。
cues.en: Back at fifty kilohertz, our model uses height squared over resistance to estimate water. It assumes water is seventy-three percent of fat-free mass, then subtracts estimated fat-free mass from total weight. Every conversion adds assumptions. Our coefficient fits one invented reference and has no population calibration. It cannot measure or diagnose anyone’s fat.

cues.title: 脂肪不变，估计会变
cues.caption: 脂肪质量固定，水分仍改变估计。
cues.captionEn: Fat mass stays fixed while estimates move.
cues.zh: 最后，只改变模型组织中的水分。真实脂肪仍是十五千克，干瘦组织也固定；总重会跟水分一起变化。可是估计脂肪质量仍然移动。真实百分比的分母也变了，所以不能说真实体脂率不变。这是一个受控的假想比较，不代表喝水后读数立刻按同样方向变化。
cues.en: Finally, change only the model’s tissue water. Actual fat stays at fifteen kilograms, and dry fat-free tissue stays fixed. Total weight changes with water, yet estimated fat mass also moves. The true percentage changes too, because its denominator changes. This controlled thought experiment does not predict an immediate reading after drinking water.

cues.title: 组织自己发光
cues.caption: 红外从组织出发，探头被动接收
cues.captionEn: Infrared starts at the tissue; the probe receives it
cues.zh: 耳温枪并不需要向耳内发射一束光。看这些暖色标记，它们从鼓膜和耳道组织出发，走向探头。温热物体本身就会发出热红外，只是眼睛看不见。这里把辐射画慢，让我们能跟住它。先记住方向：是组织发出，探头接收。
cues.en: An ear thermometer does not need to send a beam into the ear. Follow the warm markers: they start at the eardrum and canal tissue, then travel toward the probe. Warm objects emit thermal infrared even though our eyes cannot see it. We slow the markers so you can follow them. Tissue emits; the probe receives.

cues.title: 窄口决定看见哪里
cues.titleEn: A narrow opening selects the view
cues.caption: 接受路径先遇到哪块组织，就取样哪里
cues.captionEn: Each accepted path samples the first tissue it meets
cues.zh: 现在看探头前端的窄口。它限制了哪些方向的红外能直达吸收膜。展开的区域是本图的接受视场，不是照明。沿路径反向寻找，会先遇到鼓膜或者耳道壁；那块组织就是这条路径的信号来源。此刻大部分信号来自鼓膜，但一个读数可以包含多个区域。
cues.en: Look at the probe's narrow entrance. It limits the directions with a direct path to the absorber. The shaded region is our accepted view, not illumination. Trace a path backward and its first tissue intersection is the source it samples. Most of the signal now comes from the eardrum, but one reading can include several regions.

cues.title: 把辐射变成小电压
cues.titleEn: Turning radiation into a small voltage
cues.caption: 窗口 → 通道 → 吸收膜 → 电信号
cues.captionEn: Window → channel → absorber → electrical signal
cues.zh: 近看同一探头。红外穿过窗口，沿中空通道到达编号三的吸收膜，膜吸收能量后受热。膜附近的热端与封装上的冷端形成温差，交替材料的热电偶串联成一条线路，把很小的电压送到编号一的放大与转换电路。编号二还有独立温度参考，下一步它会参与计算。
cues.en: Look inside the same probe. Infrared passes through the window and hollow channel to absorber number three. Absorption warms the membrane. A temperature difference forms between hot junctions near the membrane and cold junctions on the package. Thermocouples in series send a small voltage to amplifier and converter number one. Number two supplies a separate temperature reference for the next step.

cues.title: 一条信号还不够
cues.caption: 净信号变小，参考变暖，补偿读数保持
cues.captionEn: Net signal falls; the reference warms; the reading holds
cues.zh: 保持组织温度不变，只让封装参考从二十二度升到三十度。看两条通道：热电堆的净红外信号变小，参考温度却上升。计算需要把两路合在一起，才能还原相同的示例读数。这里假定封装已经达到均匀稳态；真实探头的热梯度和冷却影响，不能靠这幅理想图自动消除。
cues.en: Keep the tissue unchanged and raise the package reference from twenty-two to thirty degrees. Watch both channels: the thermopile's net infrared signal shrinks while the reference temperature rises. Combining the two recovers the same example reading. We assume a uniform package at equilibrium. This ideal demonstration cannot automatically remove real thermal gradients or cooling caused by the probe.

cues.title: 已知温度作参照
cues.titleEn: A known temperature provides a reference
cues.caption: 已知黑体温度与信号建立对应关系
cues.captionEn: Known blackbody temperature is related to the signal
cues.zh: 把同一探头对准已知温度的黑体腔。腔体升温，接收信号沿曲线变化，这给仪器提供标定参照。本片已知一个理想的八到十四微米带通和示例增益，展示它们怎样建立对应关系。真实产品还要考虑自己的窗口、角响应和校准参数；图上的几个点并不是完整的商用算法。
cues.en: The same probe now views a blackbody cavity at a known temperature. As the cavity warms, its signal moves along the response curve, providing a calibration reference. Our model already knows its ideal eight-to-fourteen-micrometre band and illustrative gain. Real products need their own window response, angular sensitivity and calibration parameters. These few points are not a complete commercial algorithm.

cues.title: 温度不变，朝向变了
cues.caption: 偏转让视场更多接收耳道壁，读数随之改变
cues.captionEn: Turning collects more canal-wall radiation and changes the reading
cues.zh: 回到这只耳朵，所有组织温度都保持原值。现在只转动探头。注意路径的起点：越来越多落在耳道壁，来自鼓膜的信号份额减少。在这个示例里，壁面比鼓膜更冷，所以读数下降。算法先混合收到的辐亮信号，再反演一个等效温度；它没有从这一个数分辨出每块组织的温度。
cues.en: Return to the same ear with every tissue temperature held fixed. Turn only the probe. Watch the source points move onto the canal wall and the eardrum's signal share fall. Our illustrative wall is cooler, so the reading drops. The calculation mixes received radiance before finding one equivalent temperature. That single number cannot identify each tissue's separate temperature.

cues.title: 一个数来自一整个视场
cues.titleEn: One number comes from a whole view
cues.caption: 朝向、辐射与参考共同决定这个示例数值
cues.captionEn: Direction, radiation and reference together determine the example
cues.zh: 探头回到原来的朝向，取样区域和示例读数也回到开头。现在可以把过程连起来：组织发出红外，窄口选择视场，吸收膜产生小信号，参考与标定帮助反演。这里的耳道形状、壁温和器件响应都是教学设定。这个数解释的是模型所见的辐射，不是对真实人体核心温度或疾病作判断。
cues.en: The probe returns to its original direction, bringing the sampled region and example reading back to the start. Connect the steps: tissue emits infrared, the opening selects a view, the absorber produces a small signal, and reference information and calibration support inversion. Our anatomy, wall temperatures and detector response are teaching choices. The number explains modeled radiation, not real core temperature or a diagnosis.

cues.title: 先认出直线
cues.caption: 固定相机中，自由滑块匀速直行。
cues.captionEn: The free puck moves straight at constant speed in the fixed view.
cues.zh: 先盯住金色滑块。转盘暂时不转，滑块释放后，等时间留下的金点排成一条直线。我们假设没有摩擦和空气阻力，转盘也不再推它。因此滑块保留释放时的速度。先记住这条轨迹，接下来换的是观察坐标。
cues.en: Follow the gold puck and the equally spaced dots it leaves behind. The table is still, and the puck travels in a straight line. We assume negligible friction and air resistance, so nothing pushes it horizontally after release. Keep this simple trajectory in mind. We are about to change the coordinates used to observe it.

cues.title: 相机跟着转盘
cues.caption: 坐标轴转动，同一轨迹显出弯曲。
cues.captionEn: Rotating coordinates make the same trajectory appear curved.
cues.zh: 现在让转盘逆时针转动，再从中心释放同样的滑块。固定相机仍然记录直线。随盘相机却一直转着身，因此金点落在不断改变方向的坐标轴上。滑块相对盘面的轨迹向一侧弯曲，但没有新的水平接触力出现。
cues.en: Now the table turns counterclockwise, and we release the puck from its centre again. The fixed camera still records a straight line. The camera riding with the table keeps turning, however. Each new gold dot is measured against differently oriented axes. Its curved trail describes motion relative to the table.

cues.title: 把时刻配成一对
cues.caption: 两台相机记录的是同一个时刻。
cues.captionEn: Both cameras describe the puck at the same instant.
cues.zh: 看看金点之间的间隔，以及两幅观察中的时间。它们对应同一个滑块和同一个时刻，不是两次不同实验。把随盘位置按转盘已经转过的角度转回去，就会重合到固定坐标的位置。曲线与直线可以同时正确，因为它们回答的位置问题不同。
cues.en: Match the gold dots by time. These are two descriptions of one puck, rather than two independent trials. Rotate a table coordinate back through the angle the table has turned, and it lands on the fixed coordinate. A straight trajectory and a curved trajectory can both be correct when their reference frames differ.

cues.title: 只改变转速
cues.caption: 同一释放条件，转速改变相对轨迹。
cues.captionEn: Rotation rate changes the relative trail for the same release.
cues.zh: 这次固定释放速度和观察时长，只慢慢增加转盘角速度。固定坐标中的终点不变，随盘终点却绕着中心改变方向。注意不是把滑块的运动强行掰弯，而是每个时刻用不同角度的尺子重新量位置。转得越快，同样时间内坐标旋转得越多。
cues.en: Hold the launch speed and elapsed time fixed while the rotation rate rises. The endpoint in the fixed frame stays put. Its table coordinate turns around the centre.
