Reno’s temporary fast-recovery inflation is deliberately omitted.

cues.title: 靠近容量后，小步增加
cues.titleEn: Near capacity, grow in smaller steps
cues.caption: 每个新确认，窗口只增加约 1/W。
cues.captionEn: Each new ACK adds approximately 1/W.
cues.zh: 回退后的窗口已经到达新的阈值。现在每个确认只增加大约窗口倒数这么多，而不是再加一整个段。如果一轮确认的包数接近窗口大小，整个往返的增量就接近一个最大段。看实际算出的数值，它们可以带小数；真正允许发送的包数则取窗口的整数部分。
cues.en: After recovery, the window is at its new threshold. Each acknowledgment now adds about one divided by the window, rather than a whole segment. If roughly one window of packets is acknowledged, growth is about one segment per round trip. Window values can be fractional; the permitted packet count uses the integer part and accounts for packets still queued.

cues.title: 小增，大退
cues.caption: 加性增加，乘性回退，形成锯齿。
cues.captionEn: Additive increase and multiplicative decrease form a sawtooth.
cues.zh: 把观察拉长。发送端不断试探可用空间，反馈正常时小步增大，检测到丢包后按比例退让。于是出现熟悉的锯齿。它不是一条预先画好的漂亮曲线；每个点都由同一个有限队列、实际确认数量和窗口更新计算出来。不同算法会使用不同信号和增长规则。
cues.en: Extend the observation. The sender keeps probing available space, growing in small steps under normal feedback and backing off proportionally after loss. A sawtooth emerges. It is not a decorative curve: every point follows the same finite queue, actual acknowledgment count and window update rules. Other congestion algorithms can use different signals and growth laws.

cues.title: 把缓存变大，会怎样？
cues.titleEn: What changes when the buffer grows?
cues.caption: 出口仍是四个包，缓存从 4 增到 12。
cues.captionEn: Service stays at four while buffer size grows from 4 to 12.
cues.zh: 做一次受控改变：出口仍然每轮服务四个包，只把缓存从四格逐步加到十二格。比较同一轮的真实队列和窗口。更多空间改变了何时溢出，却不能把服务率变成十二。它可能容纳更多等待的数据，所以评估网络时，吞吐量、丢包与延迟必须分别看。
cues.en: Make a controlled change: keep service at four packets per round and increase only the buffer from four slots to twelve. Compare the same round’s computed queue and window. More space changes when overflow occurs without turning the service rate into twelve. It may hold more waiting traffic, so throughput, loss and latency must be evaluated separately.

cues.title: 反馈的价值，是少做无效工作
cues.caption: 同一出口下，对比响应反馈与固定窗口。
cues.captionEn: Compare feedback with a fixed window at the same exit.
cues.zh: 最后对照两个发送者。它们面对同样的四包出口和八格缓存，一个响应反馈，另一个始终维持十二的窗口。逐轮累计实际服务和丢失的包数。窗口更大并不自动换来更多有效服务，却可能持续制造丢失。这是拥塞控制要解决的资源共享问题，而不是可靠重传本身。
cues.en: Compare two senders facing the same four-packet service rate and eight-slot buffer. One responds to feedback; the other holds its window at twelve. The counters accumulate actual service and drops through the displayed rounds. A larger window does not automatically produce more useful service, but can continually waste packets. Congestion control manages shared capacity; retransmission alone does not.

cues.title: 机器数一变，取模结果大变
cues.titleEn: Changing the modulus changes many owners
cues.caption: 3 台变 4 台，许多取模归属改变。
cues.captionEn: Three nodes become four, remapping many modulo owners.
cues.zh: 先用最直接的分配办法：把同一个键的哈希值对机器数取模。三台机器时除以三，加入 D 后改成除以四。看这些真实计算的归属，许多键虽然原机器还在，却已经分给了另一台。扩容时如果都要搬，数据迁移就会成为很重的额外工作。
cues.en: Start with a straightforward rule: hash a key and take the remainder modulo the number of machines. Adding D changes the modulus from three to four. Many actual owners change even though their previous machine is still available. If expansion requires moving all those keys, migration itself becomes a substantial extra workload.

cues.title: 把哈希空间绕成一个环
cues.titleEn: Wrap the hash space into a ring
cues.caption: 从键的位置顺时针找第一个节点。
cues.captionEn: Find the first node clockwise from the key.
cues.zh: 把零到一之间的哈希位置绕成一个环。键和节点各自得到固定位置。跟住选中的键，从它的位置顺时针走，遇到的第一个节点就是归属。颜色表示当前归属，环上的弧段表示这个节点接管的范围。分配来自同一条后继规则，不是按图上谁离得近。
cues.en: Wrap hash positions from zero to one into a ring. Keys and nodes each receive fixed positions. Follow the selected key clockwise: the first node encountered owns it. Color records ownership, and an arc shows the interval assigned to that token. The rule uses the clockwise successor, not whichever node happens to look closest on the page.

cues.title: 经过终点，仍然接得上
cues.caption: 经过 100%，继续从 0% 顺时针找。
cues.captionEn: After 100%, continue clockwise from zero.
cues.zh: 注意这个接近环末尾的键。它到达百分之百之前没有遇到节点，就回到零继续寻找，最终归给第一个节点。环没有隐藏的断口。模型用同一个规则处理普通区间与跨过零点的区间，所以键的位置不需要因为越界而重新哈希。
cues.en: Watch a key near the end of the ring. It reaches one hundred percent without meeting a node, wraps to zero, and continues to the first token. The ring has no hidden break. The same successor rule handles both ordinary intervals and the interval across zero, so the key keeps its hash position throughout.

cues.title: 加入 D，只接管它前面的弧段
cues.titleEn: D takes only its predecessor interval
cues.caption: 已有位置不动；部分键改归 D。
cues.captionEn: Existing positions stay fixed; some keys move to D.
cues.zh: 现在加入节点 D。先看其他节点和每个键，它们的位置完全没有改变。D 只截走前一个节点到自己之间的弧段；这个弧段里的键，从原来的后继改归 D。其他键遇到的第一个节点仍然一样，因此归属不变。高亮的是实际改变的键，不是示意性随机闪烁。
cues.en: Add node D. Existing nodes and every key stay at exactly the same positions. D takes the interval from its predecessor to its own position. Keys in that interval change from the former successor to D; other keys still meet the same first token. The highlighted keys are the actual changed assignments, not decorative random flashes.

cues.title: 拿走 C，只有它的键找新家
cues.titleEn: Remove C and reassign only its keys
cues.caption: 原来归 C 的键，交给新的顺时针后继。
cues.captionEn: Only C’s former keys need a new successor.
cues.zh: 反过来拿走 C。原来先遇到 C 的键，现在继续顺时针走，交给下一个仍存在的节点。原来属于 A、B 的键不需要跟着搬。这种局部变化是这里的一致性含义：成员变动时，尽量保留未受影响的映射。它不等于数据库事务的一致性，也不是复制协议。
cues.en: Now remove C. Keys that previously met C first continue clockwise to the next surviving token. Keys already owned by A or B do not need to move. This is the consistency meant here: membership changes preserve unaffected mappings. It is different from database transaction consistency and does not by itself provide a replication protocol.

cues.title: 环很稳定，份额却未必平均
cues.titleEn: A stable ring can still be uneven
cues.caption: 随机弧段不等长，键的负载也不保证相等。
cues.captionEn: Random arcs need not be equal, and key loads can differ.
cues.zh: 先停在每台机器只有一个位置的环。三个节点并不自动把圆分成三个相等部分。看实际分给每台机器的键数，可能差得很多。即使弧长接近，热门键和冷门键的访问代价也可能不同。稳定映射解决了迁移范围问题，却没有单独保证真实业务负载均匀。
cues.en: Pause with one position per physical node. Three hashed tokens do not automatically divide the circle into equal thirds. The actual key counts can be uneven. Even equal arc lengths would not equalize a hot key and a cold one. Stable mapping limits migration, but does not independently guarantee balanced real-world work.

cues.title: 让每个节点拥有多段份额
cues.titleEn: Give each node several separate intervals
cues.caption: 每台机器映射成 8 个虚拟位置。
cues.captionEn: Each machine receives eight virtual positions.
cues.zh: 把每台物理机器映射成八个虚拟位置。环上位置变多，但实际存储机器仍然只有 A、B、C 三台。每个位置接管自己的前驱弧段，再汇总到对应机器。负载不再只依赖一个随机弧段，通常更容易分散；但有限样本仍有波动，图里只报告这批真实键的结果。
cues.en: Give each physical machine eight virtual positions. There are more tokens on the ring but still only three storage machines. Every token takes its predecessor interval, and those shares are combined by physical owner. Distributing several intervals usually reduces dependence on one unlucky gap. Finite samples still vary; the bars report only this actual set of keys.

cues.title: 多段接管，仍然保持局部迁移
cues.titleEn: Several tokens still preserve local migration
cues.caption: D 的多个位置，只接走各自前驱区间。
cues.captionEn: D’s tokens take only their own predecessor intervals.
cues.zh: 最后在虚拟位置的环里加入 D。它在多个位置接管多个小区间，而原有键和旧节点的位置仍然固定。只有真正落入这些区间的键改归 D。进入探索，可以改变物理节点数和虚拟位置数量，逐键检查归属。这里演示的是映射决定，不会假装已经搬完数据或解决副本同步。
cues.en: Finally add D to the ring with virtual positions. Its tokens take several smaller predecessor intervals while all existing token and key positions remain fixed. Only keys in those intervals change to D. Exploration changes physical membership and virtual-token count so you can inspect every assignment. This demonstrates mapping decisions, not completed data transfer or replica synchronization.

cues.title: 两种相反的转动趋势
cues.caption: 相同力臂，用相同的力平衡。
cues.captionEn: Equal moment arms need equal forces.
cues.zh: 先盯住蓝色负载。它对杆施加一百二十牛顿的向下力，离支点一米。另一端也离支点一米。两端的力一样大，但让杆转动的方向相反。中间的支点托住整个装置；两种力矩相抵，才不会开始转动。
cues.en: Follow the blue load. It pulls down with a force of one hundred twenty newtons, one metre from the pivot. The effort acts at the same distance on the other side. Equal forces now produce opposite turning effects. The pivot supports the assembly while those moments cancel.

cues.title: 把用力点移远
cues.caption: 距离翻倍，平衡所需的力减半。
cues.captionEn: Twice the radius needs half the effort.
cues.zh: 负载保持原样，只把用力点缓缓移远。注意力的读数一直在下降，力矩却没有变。到两米处，只要六十牛顿就能平衡。我们改变的是几何带来的转动能力，不是让负载变轻了。
cues.en: Keep the same load and slide the effort point away from the pivot. The force reading falls, but its moment stays constant. At two metres, sixty newtons is enough. The load has not become lighter. The geometry gives the effort more turning effect.

cues.title: 力臂要垂直量
cues.caption: 连接点不动，倾斜的力仍会失去力矩。
cues.captionEn: Tilting the force reduces its moment.
cues.zh: 现在保持六十牛顿，也保持连接点。只把力的方向倾斜。看紫色线段，它从支点垂直连到力的作用线。虽然杆上距离还是两米，这段真正的力臂却越来越短。到偏离竖直六十度时，它只剩一米，已经不能平衡原来的负载。
cues.en: Leave both the attachment and the sixty-newton force unchanged. Tilt only the direction. The violet segment meets the force line at a right angle. The attachment is still two metres away, but the perpendicular moment arm shrinks. At sixty degrees from vertical it is only one metre, and balance is lost.

cues.title: 把失去的力矩补回来
cues.caption: 力臂减半，力要加倍才能重新平衡。
cues.captionEn: Half the moment arm requires twice the force.
cues.zh: 保持这个倾斜方向，再逐渐增加力。力臂不再改变，力矩随着力一起增加。直到一百二十牛顿，两边的力矩重新相等。这个比较说明，决定转动效果的是力乘以垂直力臂，不能单独看杆长。
cues.en: Hold that tilted direction and increase the force instead. The moment arm stays fixed while the moment rises. At one hundred twenty newtons the two readings match again. The useful quantity is force multiplied by perpendicular distance, rather than the length of the bar by itself.

cues.title: 作用线穿过支点
cues.caption: 沿杆推，力再大也没有这个方向的力矩。
cues.captionEn: A force through the pivot produces no moment.
cues.zh: 再把方向转到沿着杆。紫色力臂缩到零，作用线穿过支点。此时用力确实存在，但它不再产生绕这个支点的转动效果。屏幕上的杆保持在参考位置，读数告诉我们它失去了平衡；这里没有把静态比较伪装成运动预测。
cues.en: Turn the force until it acts along the bar. Its line now crosses the pivot and the moment arm reaches zero. A force is still present, but it has no turning effect about this pivot. The bar is held at its reference position so we can inspect the imbalance, rather than pretending to predict its motion.

cues.title: 省力，也要多走一段
cues.caption: 一半的力走两倍距离，输入功没有减少。
cues.captionEn: Half the force moves twice as far.
cues.zh: 回到竖直用力、两倍力臂的平衡状态。让杆缓缓转过同一个角度，用力端下降的距离是负载上升的两倍。比较两笔功：六十牛顿乘较长的位移，与一百二十牛顿乘较短的位移相等。理想杠杆交换力与距离，没有免费增加能量。
cues.en: Return to vertical forces and the two-to-one radius ratio. During this slow lift, the effort end descends twice as far as the load rises. Sixty newtons through the longer distance does the same work as one hundred twenty through the shorter distance. An ideal lever trades force for travel without adding energy.

cues.title: 一个问题，两种服务
cues.caption: 应用等待答案，解析器负责追踪。
cues.captionEn: The application waits; the resolver follows the trail.
cues.zh: 输入名字之后，应用并不想收集一串陌生服务器。它向递归解析器提出一个问题：这个名字的 A 记录是什么？解析器接下工作。接下来的查询由它发出；应用等待的是地址，或明确的错误。
cues.en: After a name is entered, the application does not want a list of unfamiliar servers. It asks a recursive resolver for the name’s A record. The resolver takes on that work. It will send the next queries; the application is waiting for an address, or an explicit error.

cues.title: 根知道下一站
cues.titleEn: The root knows a next step
cues.caption: 根返回转介，不替解析器转发。
cues.captionEn: The root returns a referral to the resolver.
cues.zh: 先看根服务器的回答。它没有这台主机的地址，却知道 test 这一层该问谁。注意消息回到了原来的解析器。根没有把请求继续传下去；这张指路条，才是下一次查询的依据。
cues.en: Watch the root’s response. It does not hold this host’s address, but it can identify servers for the test level. The message returns to the original resolver. The root has not forwarded the request. Its referral is what lets the resolver make the next query.

cues.title: 再靠近一个区域
cues.caption: 顶级域指出 orchid.test 的权威。
cues.captionEn: The TLD identifies orchid.test’s authority.
cues.zh: 解析器现在联系顶级域服务器。它得到的仍不是主机地址，而是 orchid.test 区域的权威服务器。这次转介也返回解析器。层级描述的是谁负责哪段名字，不是数据包在现实网络里必须经过的路线。
cues.en: The resolver now contacts the top-level domain server. Again, it receives directions rather than the host’s address: this is the authority for orchid.test. That referral also returns to the resolver. The hierarchy describes responsibility for names, not a physical route that packets must follow.

cues.title: 地址终于出现
cues.caption: 权威应答带回地址和 60 秒 TTL。
cues.captionEn: The authority returns an address with a 60-second TTL.
cues.zh: 到了负责这个区域的权威服务器，A 记录才出现。解析器把地址返回应用，也保存收到的记录。请留意缓存里的三个键：两条是指路信息，一条才是主机地址。它们并不需要在同一时刻过期。
cues.en: At the authority for this zone, the A record finally appears. The resolver returns the address to the application and retains the received records. Notice the three cache keys. Two are directions; one is the host address. These records do not have to expire together.

cues.title: 命中不会重置时钟
cues.titleEn: A hit does not restart the clock
cues.caption: 20 秒后，地址还剩 40 秒。
cues.captionEn: After 20 seconds, the address has 40 seconds left.
cues.zh: 把下一次查询放到二十秒后。有效地址已经在缓存里，解析器不必再询问任何上游服务器。剩余时限是四十秒，不会因为刚刚被查询，就重新变成六十秒。缓存有效时，权威地址的修改也不会立即替换这份副本。
cues.en: Move the next lookup to twenty seconds later. A valid address is already cached, so the resolver needs no upstream query. Forty seconds remain. Asking for the record does not reset that lifetime to sixty. Even a changed authoritative address does not immediately replace a still-valid cached copy.

cues.title: 只重查过期的那条
cues.caption: 地址过期，仍可直达已知权威。
cues.captionEn: The address expires; the known authority remains usable.
cues.zh: 现在来到六十五秒。旧地址已经失效，但两条指路记录还有效。解析器直接询问已知的权威服务器，得到新的点九地址，而不是从根重来。这个虚构例子省略了服务器地址解析和重试；关键是每条记录有自己的时限。
cues.en: Now advance to sixty-five seconds. The old address has expired, while both referrals remain valid. The resolver goes directly to the known authority and obtains the new address ending in nine. It does not start again at the root. This fictional example omits server-address lookup and retries; the important point is that each record has its own lifetime.

cues.title: 两束反射
cues.caption: 改变膜厚，两束光的相对相位在变。
cues.captionEn: Thickness changes the relative phase of the reflected light.
cues.zh: 先跟踪同一束入射光的两次反射。一部分在膜的表面返回，另一部分进入膜，在底面反射后再出来。分开的两条光路便于阅读，实际正入射时它们重合。膜厚变化时，第二束多走的路也改变，底下两条波形的相对位置随之变化。
cues.en: Follow the two reflected contributions from one incoming wave. One returns at the first surface. The other enters the film, reflects at the back, and comes out again. The paths are separated for clarity; at normal incidence they overlap. Changing the thickness changes the extra optical path, so their relative phase moves.

cues.title: 零厚度的暗
cues.caption: 光程差趋近零，反射相位仍差半周。
cues.captionEn: The path difference vanishes, but the reflection phase does not.
cues.zh: 把空气中的膜逐渐看薄，直到厚度为零。两束的传播路程差消失了，为什么合成波形反而几乎消失？因为空气射向高折射率薄膜的反射发生半周翻转，而从膜射向空气的反射不翻转。这里的暗，不需要先多走半个波长。
cues.en: Now take the film thickness to zero. The extra propagation disappears, yet the reflected light goes dark. The first reflection, from air toward the higher-index film, reverses the electric field. The reflection from film back toward air does not. That half-cycle difference remains even when the extra path is negligible.

cues.title: 四分之一波膜
cues.caption: 2nd 为半个波长，补偿了反射的半周差。
cues.captionEn: A half-wavelength round trip compensates the reflection reversal.
cues.zh: 现在固定绿色光，把厚度设为约一百零三纳米。光在膜里往返，光程是两倍的折射率乘厚度，正好约半个真空波长。传播又增加半周，连同原来的反射差，返回的两束重新同相。合成波形增强，反射率到达这一周期的峰值。
cues.en: Keep the green wavelength and set the film to about one hundred and three nanometres. The round-trip optical path is twice index times thickness: half a vacuum wavelength. Propagation adds another half cycle. Together with the reflection reversal, the contributions now reinforce. The calculated reflectance reaches a peak for this cycle.

cues.title: 继续加厚又变暗
cues.caption: 再多半周，增强变成抵消。
cues.captionEn: Another half cycle turns reinforcement into cancellation.
cues.zh: 继续把厚度翻倍，并不会把亮度也翻倍。往返光程现在等于一个完整波长，传播带回原来的相位关系，反射的半周差又占了上风。波形重新抵消。亮暗随厚度周期变化，所以不能把膜厚简单理解成反射光的多少。
cues.en: Doubling the thickness does not double the brightness. The round-trip optical path is now one whole wavelength. Propagation returns to the same phase, leaving the reflection reversal uncompensated. The contributions cancel again. Brightness oscillates with thickness; it does not simply grow as more material is added.

cues.title: 换掉背面
cues.caption: 两次反射都翻转，亮暗条件随之互换。
cues.captionEn: When both reflections reverse, the bright and dark conditions swap.
cues.zh: 保留四分之一波的厚度，只把背面的空气换成玻璃。现在从薄膜射向折射率更高的玻璃，第二次反射也翻转。两个反射不再相差半周，原来增强的膜厚反而使两束接近抵消。实际振幅不同，最低反射率不一定为零；数值使用完整的多次反射计算。
cues.en: Keep the quarter-wave thickness, but replace the air behind it with glass. The second reflection now also encounters a higher index and reverses. The two reflection reversals cancel each other. The same propagation delay that reinforced before now opposes. Unequal physical amplitudes leave some reflection; the numerical readout includes all internal reflections.

cues.title: 白光中的色带
cues.caption: 同一膜厚，对不同波长给出不同相位。
cues.captionEn: One thickness gives different phases to different wavelengths.
cues.zh: 最后把膜做成逐渐增厚的楔形。同一个位置的厚度是确定的，但红、绿、蓝光的波长不同，因此相位差和反射率不同。图中用三个波长取样显示这种选择性，不是完整的颜色还原。彩色条纹记录的是光程与反射相位共同选择了哪些波长。
cues.en: A wedge gives a different thickness at each position. At any one position, red, green, and blue wavelengths accumulate different phase delays, so they reflect with different strengths. These three samples illustrate the selection rather than reproducing human colour vision. The bands reveal which wavelengths are reinforced by both propagation and reflection phase.

cues.title: 定滑轮只改变方向
cues.caption: 一段绳托住负载，仍需同样大的力。
cues.captionEn: One supporting strand needs the full load force.
cues.zh: 先沿着铜色绳子看一遍。绳子跨过固定的轮子，一端连着负载，另一端向下拉。轮子让我们换了用力方向，却没有把负载分给另一段支撑。要缓缓提升一百二十牛顿的负载，自由端仍然需要一百二十牛顿。
cues.en: Follow the copper rope over the fixed wheel. One end holds the load, while the free end is pulled down. The wheel changes the direction of the effort, but only one strand supports the load. Lifting slowly still requires the full one hundred twenty newtons.

cues.title: 让轮子跟着负载走
cues.titleEn: Move a pulley with the load
cues.caption: 两段绳各拉六十牛顿，共同托住负载。
cues.captionEn: Two strands share the supporting force.
cues.zh: 现在让一个轮子跟着蓝色负载一起移动。看两个向上的张力箭头，两段绳都在拉动同一个移动部分。理想情况下，同一根绳上的张力相等。每段六十牛顿，加起来就是一百二十牛顿，自由端所需的拉力因此减半。
cues.en: Attach a pulley to the blue load. Two strands now pull upward on the same moving assembly. In this ideal rope their tensions are equal. Sixty newtons from each strand adds up to one hundred twenty, so the free end needs only half the previous force.

cues.title: 两段绳同时缩短
cues.caption: 负载升一段，自由端要拉出两段。
cues.captionEn: The free end travels twice as far as the load.
cues.zh: 把负载缓缓抬高。不要只看轮子，要看两段承重绳。负载每上升一小段，两段绳都会各自缩短同样的长度。绳子不会凭空变短，合起来的长度必须从自由端拉出来。于是负载上升十五厘米，要拉出三十厘米的绳。
cues.en: Raise the load slowly and watch both supporting strands. Each one shortens by the amount of the lift. The rope cannot simply disappear, so the combined shortening must emerge at its free end. A fifteen-centimetre lift therefore takes thirty centimetres of rope travel.

cues.title: 四段绳共同承重
cues.caption: 四段各三十牛顿，不是数所有轮子。
cues.captionEn: Four strands carry thirty newtons each.
cues.zh: 换成四段承重绳，负载仍然是一百二十牛顿。数清直接向上托住移动部分的四段，每段只需要三十牛顿。上面的定滑轮负责把绳子导向下一段。机械优势要从支撑力来数，不能把所有轮子都算成一个省力倍数。
cues.en: The load is unchanged, but four strands now support the moving block. At thirty newtons each, their forces add to one hundred twenty. The fixed wheels guide the rope between strands. Count the actual support forces, rather than assuming every wheel contributes another factor of two.

cues.title: 拉力和路程一起算
cues.caption: 拉力剩四分之一，拉绳距离变成四倍。
cues.captionEn: One quarter of the force travels four times as far.
cues.zh: 再看一次完整提升。负载上升时，四段绳同时缩短，所以自由端走四倍的路程。下面两笔功使用同一组位移：三十牛顿乘长距离，等于一百二十牛顿乘短距离。理想滑轮组减小拉力，却没有减小这次提升所需的功。
cues.en: Watch the four-strand lift. All four supporting lengths shorten together, so the free end moves four times as far. Compare the work calculations: thirty newtons through the long distance equals one hundred twenty through the short distance. Less force does not mean less work for the lift.

cues.title: 移动的轮组也有重量
cues.titleEn: The moving block also has weight
cues.caption: 加入轮组自重，绳子必须一起托住它。
cues.captionEn: The rope also supports the moving block itself.
cues.zh: 刚才把轮组当成没有重量。现在逐渐加入四十牛顿的移动轮组自重。支撑总重变成一百六十牛顿，每段张力提高到四十牛顿。输入功也增加，多出来的部分正好用来抬高轮组本身。现实里的摩擦还会带来额外损失，这里没有把它藏进一个装饰性的效率数字。
cues.en: So far the moving block was weightless. Add forty newtons of block weight while keeping the same lift. The rope must support one hundred sixty newtons in total, which requires forty newtons per strand. The extra input work raises the block itself. Real friction would add further losses, outside this ideal model.

cues.title: 最短的一步，不是最短的路
cues.titleEn: The cheapest step is not the cheapest route
cues.caption: 局部短边走出 13，另一条路只需 7。
cues.captionEn: Cheap local edges cost 13; another route costs 7.
cues.zh: 先试一种看似省事的办法：每到一点，就挑眼前最便宜的出边。从 S 出发，这样会走过 A、C、D，最后到 T，合计十三。但经 B 和 D 的路线只需七。Dijkstra 虽然也叫贪心，却不是这样选。
cues.en: Try a tempting shortcut: at each node, take the cheapest outgoing edge. Starting at S, that leads through A, C and D to T, for a total of thirteen. A route through B and D costs only seven. Dijkstra is also called greedy, but this is not what it greedily chooses.

cues.title: 所有候选从同一起点计算
cues.titleEn: Every candidate starts at the same source
cues.caption: A 暂定 2，B 暂定 5。
cues.captionEn: A has tentative distance 2; B has 5.
cues.zh: 从 S 开始，把起点距离设为零，其他点设为无穷。沿着两条出边，A 得到二，B 得到五。队列比较的始终是从 S 累计的代价。A 是所有未定案点里最小的一个，所以接下来处理 A。
cues.en: Begin at S with distance zero; every other distance is infinite. Its outgoing edges give A two and B five. The frontier always compares accumulated costs from S. A has the least tentative distance among all unsettled nodes, so A is processed next.

cues.title: 第一次抵达，还不能定案
cues.caption: T 的第一个已知代价是 22。
cues.captionEn: The first known route to T costs 22.
cues.zh: 处理 A 时，C 的暂定距离变成四，目标 T 变成二十二。我们确实已经找到一条到 T 的路，但这只能说明最短路不会比二十二更长。它不是证明最优的证书。继续保留 T，还要看看其他候选。
cues.en: Processing A gives C a tentative distance of four and T a value of twenty-two. We have found a real route to the destination, but that only bounds the minimum from above. It is not a certificate of optimality. Keep T in the frontier and consider the other candidates.

cues.title: 跨回全局队列
cues.caption: C 之后选 B：比较的是 5、12、13。
cues.captionEn: After C, choose B: compare 5, 12 and 13.
cues.zh: C 以四定案，随后把 D 改为十二，把 T 改为十三。注意队列里的 B 仍然只有五。算法不会因为刚处理完 C，就必须沿 C 的某条边继续走。它跨回整个队列，选择累计距离最小的 B。
cues.en: C is settled at four. It offers D twelve and improves T to thirteen. But B is still waiting with only five. The algorithm does not have to continue along an edge from the node it just processed. It returns to the entire frontier and chooses the smallest total: B.

cues.title: 同一终点，再次被改小
cues.caption: B 把 D 改为 6，D 把 T 改为 7。
cues.captionEn: B improves D to 6; D improves T to 7.
cues.zh: 经过 B，抵达 D 的代价从十二降到六。D 随后成为最小候选，再把 T 从十三降到七。每次改变都能追溯到一条真实路径。这里更新的是累计代价和前驱，不是把节点的位置移近，或把画出的路缩短。
cues.en: Through B, the cost to D drops from twelve to six. D becomes the next minimum and lowers T from thirteen to seven. Every improved number corresponds to an actual route. We update accumulated costs and predecessors, not the screen positions of nodes or the lengths of drawn lines.

cues.title: 最低暂定值成为确定值
cues.titleEn: The least tentative value becomes final
cues.caption: T 现在以 7 定案。
cues.captionEn: T can now be settled at 7.
cues.zh: 轮到 T 时，七已经是全部未定案点中最小的值。只要所有边都非负，任何更晚的路线都无法先经过一个更便宜的未定案点，再把总价降下来。所以七可以定案。沿前驱回看，得到 S、B、D、T。
cues.en: When T is chosen, seven is the least tentative value anywhere in the unsettled frontier. With nonnegative edges, a later route cannot begin through a cheaper unsettled node and then reduce the total. Seven can now be settled. Following the predecessors gives S, B, D, T.

cues.title: 拆掉非负这个前提
cues.caption: 负边可以推翻已经定案的 2。
cues.captionEn: A negative edge can overturn a settled value of 2.
cues.zh: 最后只改一个条件：加入 B 到 A、代价负十的边。S 经 B 再到 A 只需负五，比 A 先前定案的二还小。这个反例不是另一轮合法的 Dijkstra 运行，它是在说明证明为什么需要非负边。遇到负边，应该换用适用的方法。
cues.en: Now remove one condition by adding an edge from B to A with cost minus ten. S through B to A costs minus five, beating A’s earlier settled value of two. This is not another valid Dijkstra run. It exposes why the proof needs nonnegative edges. A graph with negative costs calls for an applicable method instead.

cues.title: 光线在孔口交叉
cues.caption: 同一物点的方向穿过小孔，像上下颠倒。
cues.captionEn: Rays from each point cross the hole and form an inverted image.
cues.zh: 先认住三个不同颜色的物点。每个物点发出的光中，只有经过孔口的一小束能够进入暗箱。通过孔心的光线近似直线传播，越过孔口后，原来较高的物点落在接收屏较低的位置。这里的倒像来自几何方向，并不需要一片透镜把光转过来。
cues.en: Keep track of the three coloured object points. Only a narrow bundle from each can enter the dark box. The ray through the centre of the opening continues straight. After the crossing, the upper object point lands lower on the receiving screen. Inversion follows from this geometry; no lens is needed to turn the image over.

cues.title: 一个点变成一个斑
cues.caption: 孔径有限，同一物点会照亮一片区域。
cues.captionEn: A finite opening sends one object point to a finite patch.
cues.zh: 现在放大接收屏，保持同样三个物点。孔比较大时，通过孔上缘和下缘的光并不落在同一点，几何像斑因此有宽度。把孔逐渐缩小，两条边缘光线之间的范围也缩小。几何斑直径等于孔径乘上一加屏距与物距之比。
cues.en: Look closely at the receiving screen, keeping the same three points. With a large opening, rays through opposite edges do not land at one location. Each point therefore makes a geometric patch. Reducing the opening narrows that patch. Its geometric diameter is the aperture diameter multiplied by one plus the screen-to-object distance ratio.

cues.title: 缩孔也少了光
cues.titleEn: A smaller hole admits less light
cues.caption: 孔径减半，进入的光功率约为四分之一。
cues.captionEn: Halving diameter reduces admitted light power to about one quarter.
cues.zh: 继续缩孔时，别把归一化的光斑亮度当成真实曝光。屏上为了比较形状，亮度被保持可见；相对通光量单独列出。在均匀照明和相同物距下，进入的光功率与孔面积成正比。孔径减半，几何模糊更小，但通过的光约只剩四分之一。
cues.en: As the opening shrinks, do not read the displayed spot brightness as exposure. The patches are normalized so their shapes remain visible; admitted light is listed separately. Under uniform illumination at the same object distance, power scales with aperture area. Half the diameter reduces geometric blur, but admits only about a quarter of the light.

cues.title: 很小的孔会衍射
cues.caption: 继续缩孔，衍射扩展的尺度反而增大。
cues.captionEn: Shrinking further increases the diffraction spreading scale.
cues.zh: 几何光线还不是全部。孔非常小时，光的波动性不能忽略，光斑会因衍射扩展。这里列出圆孔远场的典型尺度：它随波长和屏距增加，却随孔径减小而增加。看两条宽度条，一条继续缩短，另一条反向增长；这就是无限缩孔并不会无限清楚的反例。
cues.en: Straight rays are only part of the account. At a very small opening, wave spreading matters. The displayed circular-aperture far-field scale grows with wavelength and screen distance, but also grows as diameter shrinks. Watch the two width indicators move in opposite directions. This is why a hole cannot become indefinitely sharper simply by becoming smaller.

cues.title: 比较两种模糊
cues.caption: 几何斑与衍射尺度要一起考虑。
cues.captionEn: Geometric and diffraction spreading must be considered together.
cues.zh: 把孔径回到两种尺度接近的范围。这里的合成光斑只用平方和开方提示两种趋势，不是精确计算出的点扩散函数。特别是在过渡区，不能把远场公式直接当作最优孔径的严格答案。真正选孔径，还要说明波长、箱体深度、曝光和允许的细节尺度。
cues.en: Return to a diameter where the two scales are comparable. The illustrated combined patch uses a root-sum-square width to show the competing trends. It is not an exact point-spread function. Near the transition, the far-field expression cannot certify a precise optimum. Choosing a real pinhole also requires a wavelength, box depth, exposure and acceptable detail scale.

cues.title: 移动接收屏
cues.caption: 屏距增大，倒像放大，模糊尺度也改变。
cues.captionEn: Increasing screen distance enlarges the inverted image and changes blur.
cues.zh: 最后固定孔口，把接收屏移远。光线仍由同一个孔口限定，倒像的高度随屏距与物距之比增加。与此同时，有限孔径的几何像斑和衍射尺度也改变。一个更大的像，并不自动含有更多细节；尺寸、清晰度和通光量是需要分别检查的量。
cues.en: Keep the opening fixed and move the screen away. The same rays now spread over a larger inverted image, with magnification set by the screen-to-object distance ratio. Both the finite-aperture patch and diffraction scale also change. A larger image does not automatically contain more detail. Image size, sharpness and admitted power answer different questions.

cues.title: 零读数发生在哪里
cues.caption: 检流计读零，电源仍有电流。
cues.captionEn: The detector reads zero while the supply delivers current.
cues.zh: 注意中间的检流计，指针正好停在零。再看电源电流，却是五毫安。两者并不矛盾：检流计只测量两个中点之间的电流，两条从电源正端通向零伏端的支路仍然在导电。零读数必须说清楚发生在哪条路径上。
cues.en: The detector needle rests at zero, but the supply current is five milliamps. These readings describe different paths. The detector measures current between two midpoints. Both resistor branches still conduct from the positive supply rail to the zero-volt rail. A zero reading is a local statement.

cues.title: 比较的是两个中点
cues.caption: A 与 B 都是二点五伏，没有差值驱动检流计。
cues.captionEn: Both midpoints are at 2.5 volts.
cues.zh: 把注意力放到标为 A 和 B 的两个节点。每条支路的上下电阻相同，所以两个中点都处在二点五伏。检流计并不是因为断路才没有电流，而是因为两端没有电势差。与此同时，每条电阻支路都有二点五毫安流过。
cues.en: Look at nodes A and B. Equal resistors in each branch put both midpoints at two point five volts. The detector is connected, but no potential difference drives it. Each supply branch continues to carry two point five milliamps. Equal potentials and absent current are not the same claim about the whole circuit.

cues.title: 只改变一个电阻
cues.caption: R4 改变，B 的电势偏离 A。
cues.captionEn: Changing R4 moves B away from A.
cues.zh: 现在只增加右下支路的 R4。B 的电势升高，两个节点不再相同，中间指针也开始偏转。负读数表示电流从 B 流向 A，和我们规定的正方向相反。仪表支路已经影响两边的分流，因此所有读数都由完整电路一起求出。
cues.en: Increase only R4, the lower resistor in its branch. B rises above A and the detector deflects. The negative sign means current flows from B to A, opposite to the chosen positive direction. That extra branch now affects the other currents, so the displayed values come from the full loaded circuit.

cues.title: 用比例恢复零点
cues.caption: R2 也按相同比例改变，两个中点重新相等。
cues.captionEn: Matching the branch ratios restores the null.
cues.zh: 保持 R4 的新值，再增加另一条支路的 R2。A 的电势逐渐追上 B，指针回到零。此时上面两只电阻是一千欧，下面两只是两千欧，四个值并不相同。平衡要求的是两条支路的分压比例相同。
cues.en: Keep the new R4 value and raise R2 in the other branch. A catches up with B and the detector returns to zero. The upper resistors are one kilohm and the lower ones are two kilohms. All four values are not equal. What matches is the division ratio in each branch.

cues.title: 电源变化，零点不变
cues.caption: 相同比例保持平衡，支路电流仍随电源变化。
cues.captionEn: The null stays while branch currents change.
cues.zh: 保留刚才的电阻比例，逐渐提高电源电压。A 和 B 一起升高，检流计仍然读零，但电源电流明显增加。桥路的平衡条件没有依赖某个恰好的电压数值。反过来，如果电源本来就是零伏，任何电阻组合都可能读零，那不能证明比例正确。
cues.en: Preserve the resistor ratios and raise the excitation. A and B rise together, keeping the detector at zero, while supply current increases. The balance condition does not depend on one special voltage. But a completely unpowered bridge also reads zero, even with the wrong ratios. That null proves nothing about balance.

cues.title: 仪表也属于电路
cues.titleEn: The instrument is part of the circuit
cues.caption: 失衡时，检流计电阻会改变被测电势差。
cues.captionEn: Away from balance, detector resistance changes the measured difference.
cues.zh: 最后重新制造失衡，逐渐增大检流计的电阻。它从两个节点之间取走的电流减少，而节点间的电势差却更接近开路分压的结果。测量并非总是没有影响。这个模型把仪表电阻明确放进电路，实际传感器还需要处理噪声、失调和自热。
cues.en: Unbalance the bridge again and increase the detector resistance. Less current flows through the instrument, while the potential difference approaches the unloaded divider result. Measurement can alter the quantity being measured. This model includes detector loading explicitly; practical sensors must also deal with noise, offset and self-heating.

cues.title: 接通的第一瞬间
cues.caption: 空电容电压为零，初始电流由电阻限制。
cues.captionEn: The resistor limits the initial charging current.
cues.zh: 先看空电容的两块极板，刚接通时还没有建立电压。五伏全部落在一千欧的电阻上，所以电流是五毫安。它不是无限大。电阻限制了电荷积累的速度，电容电压从零连续开始变化。
cues.en: Start with the empty capacitor. At connection, it has no voltage across its plates. The full five volts appears across the one-kilohm resistor, giving an initial current of five milliamps. That current is finite. The resistor limits the rate of charging, while capacitor voltage begins continuously from zero.

cues.title: 五伏在两处重新分配
cues.caption: 电容电压增加，留给电阻的电压减少。
cues.captionEn: As capacitor voltage rises, resistor voltage falls.
cues.zh: 注意极板上的电荷和下面的电压条。电容电压越高，留给电阻的电压就越少，因此电流逐渐减小。但只要电流还在原来的方向，电荷就仍在积累。电流说的是积累有多快，电压说的是已经建立了多少，两者不是同一个量。
cues.en: Watch the plate charge and the voltage strip. As the capacitor takes a larger share of the five volts, less remains across the resistor and current falls. Yet positive current still adds charge. Current describes the rate of change; capacitor voltage describes the state already built. A falling rate can keep building a rising state.

cues.title: 一个时间常数还没充满
cues.titleEn: One time constant is not full
cues.caption: 一秒到百分之六十三，五秒接近百分之九十九。
cues.captionEn: One second reaches 63%; five seconds approaches 99%.
cues.zh: 默认电阻和电容相乘，时间常数是一秒。在曲线上，一秒只到最终电压的大约百分之六十三，并不是充满。继续观察到五秒，电压越来越接近五伏，而电流越来越接近零。这条曲线渐近接近终点，没有在某个时间突然补齐最后一截。
cues.en: The default resistance and capacitance give a one-second time constant. At one second the curve reaches only about sixty-three percent of its final voltage. By five seconds it is close to ninety-nine percent. Voltage approaches five volts as current approaches zero, without a sudden final jump to completion.

cues.title: 同一秒，换一只电阻
cues.titleEn: Change resistance at the same time
cues.caption: 电阻更大，初始电流更小，同一秒充得更慢。
cues.captionEn: More resistance reduces initial current and slows the rise.
cues.zh: 把物理取样时间固定在一秒，只增加电阻。淡色虚线保留原来那次充电，实线显示新的结果。电阻变大，初始电流变小，时间常数变长，所以同一秒时的电容电压更低。最终目标仍是五伏，变化的是接近它的速度。
cues.en: Hold the sample time at one physical second and increase only resistance. The pale reference curve keeps the original experiment. The new curve rises more slowly because the initial current is smaller and the time constant is longer. The eventual target remains five volts; the approach changes.

cues.title: 换电容，初始电流不变
cues.caption: 更大电容需要更多电荷，初始电流仍由电阻决定。
cues.captionEn: More capacitance needs more charge for each volt.
cues.zh: 恢复电阻，再增大电容，观察时间仍然是一秒。曲线也变慢了，但原因和刚才不同。相同的电压变化，现在需要积累更多电荷。初始那一瞬间，电容电压依旧为零，电阻依旧是一千欧，所以初始电流仍是五毫安。
cues.en: Restore the resistor and increase capacitance, keeping the observation at one second. The rise slows again, but now each volt requires more accumulated charge. At the initial instant the capacitor is still at zero volts and the resistor is unchanged, so the initial current is still five milliamps.

cues.title: 移除电源，电流反向
cues.caption: 电容保持初始电压，通过电阻释放储能。
cues.captionEn: The charged capacitor drives current in reverse.
cues.zh: 现在从已经充到五伏的电容开始。电源移除，电容通过电阻形成闭合回路。电压没有瞬间消失，电流却反向了，负号表示和充电方向相反。随着储能释放，电压和电流的大小一起衰减。极板间没有画出穿过绝缘层的电荷流。
cues.en: Begin with a capacitor charged to five volts. Remove the supply and close a loop through the resistor. Capacitor voltage does not disappear instantly, but current reverses. Its negative sign means the opposite of charging. As stored energy is released, voltage and current magnitude decay together; charge is not shown crossing the insulating gap.

cues.title: 电源的能量去了哪里
cues.caption: 电源供能等于电场储能加电阻热量。
cues.captionEn: Source energy becomes field energy and heat.
cues.zh: 最后回到从空电容充电，把能量账展开。电源提供的能量，一部分存进电场，一部分变成电阻热量。默认条件下接近充满时，两部分都接近十二点五毫焦。改变电阻可以改变速度，但在这个理想恒压充电过程中，最终并不能把全部供能都留在电容里。
cues.en: Return to charging from empty and open the energy account. Some source energy remains in the electric field, while the rest becomes resistor heat. Near full charge, each approaches twelve point five millijoules with these parameters. Changing resistance changes the timing, but does not store all of the supplied energy in this ideal constant-voltage process.

cues.title: 固定的位置
cues.caption: 端点被加热，晶格位置没有沿杆迁移。
cues.captionEn: Heating an end does not carry the lattice sites along the rod.
cues.zh: 先看固体杆里的这些位置。它们围绕原来的位置振动，没有整排搬向另一端。加热端接上恒温热源后，温度变化从接触附近展开。这里的小球只是固体振动的定性示意，不是分子动力学计算；真正计算的是各段的温度和相邻段之间的能量交换。
cues.en: Watch the sites in this solid rod. They vibrate around their positions instead of travelling from one end to the other. Connecting a hot bath changes temperatures near the contact first. The beads are a qualitative lattice illustration, not molecular dynamics. The actual calculation follows segment temperatures and energy exchanged between neighbouring segments.

cues.title: 温度梯度与通量
cues.caption: 相邻段温度不同，就有净能量通量。
cues.captionEn: Neighbouring temperature differences produce a net energy flux.
cues.zh: 跟着温度剖面看，开始时靠近热端的坡度很陡。相邻段的温度差越大，局部的净能量通量越大。箭头指示这股通量，并不是一批物质顺着箭头飞走。随着杆内温度展开，热端流入和冷端流出通常不同，差额暂时储存在杆中。
cues.en: Follow the temperature profile. Early on, its slope is steep near the hot contact. A larger local temperature difference drives a larger net flux between neighbours. The arrows show that flux, not matter flying along the rod. During the transient, inflow and outflow differ; their difference is stored as thermal energy in the solid.

cues.title: 稳定不等于停止
cues.caption: 温度剖面稳定后，流入与流出仍可同时非零。
cues.captionEn: A steady temperature profile can carry nonzero inflow and outflow.
cues.zh: 让两端一直保持不同温度。剖面逐渐接近一条直线，杆内各处的温度不再明显变化。能量交换停了吗？看账本，流入和流出趋于相同，但都不为零。杆不再继续储能，却持续把能量交给冷端。这叫稳态，并不是热平衡。
cues.en: Keep the two ends at different temperatures. The profile approaches a straight line and each location stops changing appreciably. Has transfer stopped? The ledger shows equal inflow and outflow, both nonzero. The rod stores no additional energy while continuing to deliver energy to the cold bath. This is a steady state, rather than thermal equilibrium.

cues.title: 改变导热率
cues.caption: 相同温差与杆长下，提高导热率会增大传热。
cues.captionEn: At the same length and temperature difference, higher conductivity increases transfer.
cues.zh: 保留同一根杆的尺寸和两端温度，只改变模型中的导热率。导热率小，温度变化传播得慢；导热率大，传播更快，稳态下的传热功率也更高。这里固定体积热容，目的是单独比较导热率，不代表现实中任意两种材料只有这一个性质不同。
cues.en: Hold the dimensions and endpoint temperatures fixed, and change conductivity alone. Lower conductivity spreads the temperature change more slowly. Higher conductivity spreads it faster and increases the eventual steady transfer rate. Volumetric heat capacity is held fixed here to isolate one parameter; two real materials generally differ in more than conductivity.

cues.title: 改变传导距离
cues.caption: 同温差下，较长的路径降低稳态温度梯度。
cues.captionEn: A longer path reduces the steady gradient at the same temperature difference.
cues.zh: 接着保留导热率和截面积，把传导长度翻倍。端点的温差相同，却分布在更长的路径上，单位长度的温度变化变小。接近稳态后，传热功率约减半。这一章用同一标尺比较两种长度，实际米数由模型参数给出；比较的是传导距离，不是材料的弹性拉伸。
cues.en: Now keep conductivity and cross-section fixed, but double the conduction length. The same endpoint difference is distributed over twice the distance, giving half the steady gradient and about half the transfer rate. This chapter uses one drawing scale for both lengths. The metre-valued model parameter supplies the distance; the comparison changes conduction length, rather than elastically stretching a material.

cues.title: 均匀才是平衡
cues.caption: 整根杆同温，净传导通量为零。
cues.captionEn: When the whole rod is uniform, net conductive flux vanishes.
cues.zh: 把整根杆和两个端点都设为同一温度。微观振动仍然存在，但没有系统性的温度梯度，两个方向的能量交换在平均上抵消。所有净通量箭头消失，账本归零。只把两个端点调成相同温度还不够；如果杆内部更冷或更热，仍会先发生一段传热过程。
cues.en: Set the entire rod and both baths to one temperature. Microscopic motion still exists, but there is no systematic gradient and opposite exchanges cancel on average. Net-flux arrows disappear and the ledger reads zero. Equal bath temperatures alone would not be enough: a hotter or colder interior would still undergo a transient first.

cues.title: 反转梯度
cues.caption: 交换冷热端，净通量方向反转。
cues.captionEn: Exchanging the hot and cold ends reverses the net flux.
cues.zh: 最后交换两个端点的温度。剖面的坡度反转，净通量也随之反转。负读数表示相对于原先规定的正方向反向流动，并不是负能量。整篇从开始到结束，物质位置没有跟随热流穿过杆；变化的是温度分布、能量存储和跨越各截面的传导通量。
cues.en: Exchange the endpoint temperatures. The profile slope reverses and so does net flux. A negative reading means flow opposite the chosen positive direction, not negative energy. Throughout this sequence, the material sites have not travelled through the rod with the heat. Temperature, stored energy and flux across each section are the quantities that change.

cues.title: 先让冰升温
cues.caption: 相变之前，输入能量使冰的温度上升。
cues.captionEn: Before melting, added energy raises the ice temperature.
cues.zh: 先从零下二十度的一百克纯冰开始。加热器持续送入能量，温度计逐渐接近零度，格子仍表示固态。能量账本的第一段记录这部分升温。在这个常压、无散热的简化实验里，冰升温所需的能量由质量、比热和温差共同决定。
cues.en: Start with one hundred grams of pure ice at minus twenty degrees. The heater supplies energy and the temperature approaches zero, while the tiles still represent solid mass. The first part of the energy ledger records this warming. Under the stated constant-pressure, no-loss assumptions, the required energy depends on mass, specific heat and temperature change.

cues.title: 平台不是停电
cues.titleEn: A plateau is not a power cut
cues.caption: 温度保持零度，液态比例仍不断增加。
cues.captionEn: Temperature remains at zero while the liquid fraction grows.
cues.zh: 到达零度以后，加热器没有关闭，累计能量继续增加。温度曲线却出现平台。看相态格子，液态的质量比例正在增长：这段能量用于融化，而不是让固液共存的样品继续升温。只看温度计，会漏掉正在发生的这部分变化。
cues.en: At zero degrees, the heater is still on and cumulative energy keeps increasing. Yet the temperature curve becomes flat. The phase tiles reveal what the thermometer misses: the liquid mass fraction is growing. During coexistence, this added energy changes phase instead of raising the sample temperature.

cues.title: 在中途查账
cues.caption: 相变能量等于已经融化的质量乘熔化潜热。
cues.captionEn: Phase-change energy equals melted mass times latent heat of fusion.
cues.zh: 回到融化的中途，单独对照质量比例和能量账本。融化一半，所用的相变能量就是全部熔化潜热的一半。对于这一百克样品，完整融化大约需要三十三点四千焦，此外还要先支付冰升到零度的能量。这些能量没有消失，也不必表现成温度上升。
cues.en: Return to the middle of melting and compare the mass fraction with the ledger. Half the mass melted means half the total fusion energy has been supplied. Melting this one-hundred-gram sample requires about thirty-three point four kilojoules, in addition to warming the ice to zero. The energy is accounted for even while the temperature stays fixed.

cues.title: 融完以后再升温
cues.caption: 最后一份冰融完，新增能量再次使温度升高。
cues.captionEn: After the last ice melts, additional energy raises temperature again.
cues.zh: 等到最后一份固态质量消失，平台结束。同样的加热器继续供热，现在能量主要使液态水升温，温度点离开零度平台。冰和水的比热不同，曲线的两段斜率也不同。平台是否存在取决于相变状态，不是温度计恰好在零度失灵。
cues.en: Once the last solid mass has melted, the plateau ends. The same heater continues, but added energy now warms liquid water and the point leaves the zero-degree line. Ice and water have different specific heats, so their warming slopes differ. The plateau belongs to phase coexistence, not a thermometer that happens to stop at zero.

cues.title: 功率改变的是用时
cues.caption: 到达相同能量与相态，更大功率所需时间更短。
cues.captionEn: Higher power reaches the same energy and phase state sooner.
cues.zh: 把比较条件固定在同一累计能量。先用一百瓦，再用两百瓦。相态比例与温度相同，因为它们由这份能量和样品质量决定；变化的是到达这里所需的时间。功率加倍，在没有散热的模型中用时减半。横轴是能量，所以这条相变曲线不会因此移走。
cues.en: Compare the same cumulative energy, first with one hundred watts and then two hundred. Temperature and phase fraction match because they depend on energy and sample mass. What changes is the time needed to arrive. Doubling power halves that time in this no-loss model. The horizontal axis is energy, so the phase curve itself does not shift.

cues.title: 反向释放潜热
cues.caption: 移出能量时，液态比例减少，平台仍可存在。
cues.captionEn: Removing energy reduces liquid fraction while the plateau can persist.
cues.zh: 最后反过来，从零度的水中缓慢移出能量。样品逐渐凝固，液态比例下降，固液共存时温度仍保持在相变温度附近。释放的就是先前输入的潜热。本模型假设纯物质近常压并接近平衡，不模拟过冷、杂质或温度梯度，因此不能把这条理想平台套到所有真实加热和冷却过程。
cues.en: Reverse the transfer and slowly remove energy from water at zero degrees. As it freezes, liquid mass fraction falls while coexistence keeps the temperature near the transition value. The latent energy supplied earlier is released. This ideal pure-substance model assumes near-atmospheric pressure and equilibrium; it does not simulate supercooling, impurities or temperature gradients.

cues.title: 先看圆的特例
cues.caption: 圆上等时间，也对应等角度。
cues.captionEn: On a circle, equal time also gives equal angle.
cues.zh: 先把轨道设成圆。发光点既是焦点，也是几何中心。距离不变，速度也不变，计时相等的两段运动会走过相等角度。这个熟悉的特例很容易让人误以为，任何轨道都应该像匀速转动的指针。
cues.en: Begin with a circular orbit. The glowing focus is also its geometric center. Distance and speed remain constant, so equal time intervals cover equal angles. This familiar special case makes it tempting to imagine every orbit as a clock hand turning uniformly.

cues.title: 焦点不是几何中心
cues.titleEn: The focus is not the center
cues.caption: 椭圆中心与引力焦点分开了。
cues.captionEn: The geometric center and gravitational focus separate.
cues.zh: 现在把偏心率改为零点六五。十字标出椭圆的几何中心，发光点仍固定在焦点。运动天体与焦点的距离会不断变化。注意，椭圆是围着它的中心画出的几何形状，引力运动却要从焦点来理解。
cues.en: Now set eccentricity to zero point six five. The cross marks the ellipse’s center, while the glowing point stays at a focus. The distance from the moving body to that focus changes. The ellipse is a geometric shape centered on one point, but its gravitational motion is organized around another.

cues.title: 近处加速，远处减速
cues.caption: 距离与速度由同一个轨道状态给出。
cues.captionEn: Distance and speed come from the same orbital state.
cues.zh: 跟着同一个天体走一圈。接近焦点时，它很快掠过近拱点；到了远拱点，移动明显变慢。下面的速度已经除以同一半长轴的圆轨道速度。这不是人为调节动画快慢，而是由开普勒方程和同一个引力参数算出来的。
cues.en: Follow the same body around one orbit. It passes quickly through periapsis near the focus and moves more slowly near apoapsis. The speed readout is divided by the circular speed for this semi-major axis. This contrast is calculated from Kepler’s equation and one gravitational parameter, not assigned as an animation effect.

cues.title: 让两只时钟一起走
cues.caption: 两块形状不同的区域，同步扫过等面积。
cues.captionEn: Different-shaped sectors sweep equal areas together.
cues.zh: 同时开启两段等长的计时，一段跨过近拱点，另一段跨过远拱点。看两块颜色一起生长。近处扫过较大的角度，远处的扇形则更长、更窄，但它们占整个椭圆的比例始终相等。相等的是沿真实轨道弧扫过的面积。
cues.en: Start two equal-duration intervals together, one across periapsis and one across apoapsis. Watch both regions grow. The near interval sweeps a wider angle; the far sector is longer and narrower. Their fractions of the whole ellipse remain equal. The equality concerns area bounded by the actual curved orbit.

cues.title: 换形状，不换等时规则
cues.titleEn: Change the shape, keep the timing rule
cues.caption: 偏心率改变形状，等时面积仍然相等。
cues.captionEn: Eccentricity changes the shape, while equal-time areas remain equal.
cues.zh: 保持半长轴不变，逐渐增大偏心率。近处和远处的形状差异更明显了，两块区域却仍占相同比例。同一半长轴下，周期没有因此改变；改变的是一圈内部，时间怎样分配在不同位置。不要把更扁，直接理解成周期更长。
cues.en: Hold the semi-major axis fixed and increase eccentricity. The near and far shapes become more different, yet the two areas retain equal fractions. The period has not changed at this fixed size. What changes is how the time within a revolution is distributed. A flatter ellipse does not automatically mean a longer period.

cues.title: 放大轨道，周期才跟着变
cues.titleEn: A larger orbit changes the period
cues.caption: 半长轴 1.6 倍，对应周期约 2.02 倍。
cues.captionEn: A semi-major axis of 1.6 gives about 2.02 times the period.
cues.zh: 最后比较同一中心周围两条大小不同的轨道。两只钟经过相同时间，小轨道已经走得更多。采用这里的太阳单位，周期平方等于半长轴立方：大小变成一点六倍，周期约为二点零二倍。这是理想两体比较，不是某一天真实行星的位置预测。
cues.en: Finally compare two orbital sizes around the same center over the same elapsed time. The smaller orbit completes more of its motion. In these normalized solar units, period squared equals semi-major axis cubed. A size of one point six gives a period of about two point zero two. This ideal two-body comparison does not predict real planets on a particular date.

cues.title: 先数原来的总体
cues.caption: 一万张纸签中，一千张属于蓝色组。
cues.captionEn: Of ten thousand tickets, one thousand are blue.
cues.zh: 先别看星标，看看纸签原本来自哪里。一万张里面，一千张属于蓝色组，九千张属于非蓝色组。这个十分之一就是基准率。面积图的宽度保留了这两个组的大小；后面看到证据，也不能把这层信息丢掉。
cues.en: Before looking for stars, count where the tickets come from. Of ten thousand tickets, one thousand are blue and nine thousand are not. That one in ten is the base rate. The widths preserve the two population sizes. Observing evidence later does not erase this starting information.

cues.title: 同样星标，两种来源
cues.caption: 800 张蓝色纸签与 900 张非蓝纸签有星标。
cues.captionEn: 800 blue tickets and 900 non-blue tickets have stars.
cues.zh: 现在在蓝色组中给百分之八十加星标，也在非蓝色组中给百分之十加星标。前一个比例大得多，但别忘了两个组原本大小不同。算成实际张数，有星标的蓝色纸签是八百张，非蓝色纸签却有九百张。
cues.en: Mark eighty percent of the blue group and ten percent of the non-blue group. The first percentage is much larger, but the groups began at different sizes. In actual counts, eight hundred blue tickets have stars, while nine hundred non-blue tickets do. Width and marked height must be combined.

cues.title: 证据重新圈定总体
cues.caption: 不符合证据的纸签暂时退出比较。
cues.captionEn: Set aside tickets that do not match the evidence.
cues.zh: 已经看到星标，就只比较有星标的纸签。没有星标的部分淡下去，留下两块联合面积。蓝色这八百张和非蓝色这九百张，都是我们可能遇到的来源。条件概率的关键，是先说清楚现在站在哪个总体里数。
cues.en: Once a star is observed, compare only tickets that have stars. The unmarked areas fade, leaving two joint areas. Both the eight hundred blue tickets and the nine hundred non-blue tickets can explain the observation. Conditional probability begins by defining which population we are now counting within.

cues.title: 换分母，再问颜色
cues.titleEn: Change the denominator, then ask about color
cues.caption: 星标总体中的蓝色比例为 800 / 1700。
cues.captionEn: Within starred tickets, the blue fraction is 800 / 1700.
cues.zh: 把留下的两组重新铺满色带。数量没有改变，改变的是分母：从原来的一万张，变成一千七百张有星标的纸签。一千七百张里有八百张是蓝色，约百分之四十七。百分之八十回答的是另一个问题：已知蓝色，有多常看到星标。
cues.en: Spread the selected groups across the normalized strip. Their counts have not changed, but the denominator has: ten thousand becomes seventeen hundred starred tickets. Blue accounts for eight hundred of those, about forty-seven percent. Eighty percent answered a different question: how often a blue ticket receives a star.

cues.title: 只改基准率
cues.caption: 蓝色变少，同样的星标规则给出约 7.5%。
cues.captionEn: A rarer blue group gives about 7.5% under the same marking rule.
cues.zh: 现在只把蓝色基准率降到百分之一，星标规则完全不变。蓝色星标只剩八十张，非蓝色星标有九百九十张。重新归一化，蓝色只占约百分之七点五。同样的证据强度，可以配合不同基准率，得到非常不同的后验。
cues.en: Now lower only the blue base rate to one percent. Keep both marking rules unchanged. There are eighty blue starred tickets and nine hundred ninety non-blue starred tickets. After renormalization, blue contributes about seven point five percent. Evidence with the same likelihood ratio can produce a very different posterior when the base rate changes.

cues.title: 再看一次，不一定是新证据
cues.titleEn: A second look need not be new evidence
cues.caption: 重复同一证据不变；条件独立的新证据才再更新。
cues.captionEn: A repeated mark adds no evidence; a new one can.
cues.zh: 回到十分之一的基准率。如果只是把同一枚星标再看一遍，后验不会改变。只有另一枚标记在给定组别后与第一枚条件独立，才可以再乘一次似然。这时留下六百四十张蓝色和九十张非蓝色，后验约百分之八十八。独立性是前提，不是观察次数。
cues.en: Return to a one-in-ten base rate. Looking at the very same star again does not change the posterior. A new mark can supply another likelihood factor only if the marks are conditionally independent given the group. Then six hundred forty blue tickets and ninety non-blue tickets remain, yielding about eighty-eight percent. Independence is an assumption, not a count of observations.

cues.title: 先固定搬运目标
cues.caption: 同一个一百二十牛顿负载，升高一米。
cues.captionEn: Raise the same 120 N load by one metre.
cues.zh: 先把任务定清楚。这个木箱重一百二十牛顿，我们要把它升高一米。直接缓缓向上提，拉力大约等于重力。到达目标时，重力势能增加一百二十焦。接下来所有比较都保留这个木箱和这个高度。
cues.en: Define the task first: raise this one-hundred-twenty-newton crate by one metre. A slow direct lift requires a force equal to its weight and adds one hundred twenty joules of gravitational potential energy. Keep that load and destination fixed throughout the comparisons.

cues.title: 换一条更长的路
cues.caption: 三十度无摩擦斜面：六十牛顿，走两米。
cues.captionEn: A frictionless 30° ramp needs 60 N over two metres.
cues.zh: 现在换成三十度的光滑斜面。沿着斜面拉，只需要六十牛顿，但路程变成两米。木箱没有变轻，重力仍然竖直向下。斜面支撑了垂直表面的分量，我们用拉力平衡沿面的分量。省下的力，对应了增加的路程。
cues.en: Use a smooth thirty-degree ramp. The pull along it falls to sixty newtons, but the travel becomes two metres. The crate has not become lighter. The surface supports the perpendicular component of gravity, while the pull balances its component along the ramp. Force advantage comes with extra travel.

cues.title: 只改变坡度
cues.caption: 同一高度，坡越缓，路径越长。
cues.captionEn: A shallower route to the same height is longer.
cues.zh: 保持目标高度不动，逐渐把坡度放缓。注意斜面的端点和路径长度，路程正在增加。沿面拉力随之下降。这是一组不同坡道的匀速比较，并不是让运动中的坡道突然变形。图中的同一个高度约束，让几何和受力保持一致。
cues.en: Keep the destination height and make the slope shallower. Its endpoint moves farther away and the route length grows, while the required pull falls. These are separate constant-speed comparisons between ramps, not a claim that a moving ramp changes shape without exchanging energy.

cues.title: 把整段路程算进去
cues.caption: 理想斜面没有减少提升所需的功。
cues.captionEn: The ideal ramp does not reduce the lifting work.
cues.zh: 再走完一次三十度的坡道。输入功随着路程累积，重力势能随着高度累积。到顶时，六十牛顿乘两米，仍然是一百二十焦。只要没有摩擦和动能变化，换坡度就只是交换力和距离，不能凭空减少这次提升需要的能量。
cues.en: Complete the thirty-degree trip. Input work accumulates with distance while gravitational potential energy accumulates with height. At the top, sixty newtons over two metres still gives one hundred twenty joules. Without friction or changing kinetic energy, a different slope only trades force for distance.

cues.title: 给接触面加上摩擦
cues.caption: 拉力还要克服摩擦，输入功开始超过势能增加。
cues.captionEn: Friction makes input work exceed the potential-energy gain.
cues.zh: 让接触面逐渐变粗糙。木箱已经在匀速向上滑动，摩擦沿着斜面向下，所以需要更大的上拉力。橙色能量条记录克服摩擦的功。目标高度和势能增加都没有变，多出来的输入能量转移到接触表面的内能。
cues.en: Make the contact rougher. The crate is already sliding upward at constant speed, so kinetic friction points down the ramp and increases the required pull. The orange bar records work against friction. The destination and potential-energy gain stay fixed; the additional input becomes internal energy at the contact.

cues.title: 缓坡的另一笔账
cues.titleEn: The other cost of a shallow ramp
cues.caption: 有摩擦时，更省力的缓坡可能更费功。
cues.captionEn: A shallower rough ramp can need less force but more work.
cues.zh: 保持同样的摩擦系数，再把坡道放缓。拉力读数确实下降，但橙色的总耗能却增加了。原因是接触力在更长的路程上持续做功。所以省力和省功必须分开判断。本实验采用恒定滑动摩擦，不计算起步的静摩擦阈值。
cues.en: Keep the same friction coefficient and make the ramp shallower. The force reading falls, yet the total orange energy bar grows. Friction acts over a longer journey. A lower effort can therefore come with greater energy use. This comparison models kinetic friction during motion, not the static threshold for starting it.

cues.title: 转一圈，升一个导程
cues.caption: 旋转与轴向位移由同一条螺旋约束。
cues.captionEn: The helix couples rotation to axial travel.
cues.zh: 看固定螺母剖开的位置。丝杆一边转，一边向上前进，顶上的负载随之升高。默认这根单线丝杆转一圈只前进四毫米，这个距离叫导程。留意螺纹的接触面：螺母固定不动，丝杆只能沿着这条螺旋一边转动，一边前进。
cues.en: Look into the cutaway nut. As the screw turns, it advances axially and raises the load. One revolution of this single-start screw advances four millimetres: its lead. Follow the mating thread surfaces. With the nut fixed, the screw must rotate and advance along that helix.

cues.title: 把螺旋的一圈展开
cues.caption: 一圈圆周距离，对应很小的轴向升高。
cues.captionEn: A full circumference produces a small axial rise.
cues.zh: 把螺旋的一圈展开，保留实际的横纵比例。你会看到一条很缓的斜面。横向是一圈的圆周长度，竖向只有四毫米。旋转时绕了很长的一段路，负载只升高一点。对于单线螺纹，导程等于螺距；多线螺纹就不能把这两个词直接混用。
cues.en: Unwrap one helical turn without exaggerating its slope. The horizontal span is one circumference, while the rise is just four millimetres. A long turning path creates a small axial advance. Lead equals pitch here because the thread has one start; that equality does not hold for multi-start threads.

cues.title: 理想情况下的功
cues.caption: 小力矩转过大角度，仍要付出提升重物的功。
cues.captionEn: Small torque through a large angle supplies the lifting work.
cues.zh: 先把螺纹摩擦设为零，让丝杆转两圈。它升高八毫米，把一千牛顿的负载提升了八焦耳的重力势能。输入功等于力矩乘转过的弧度数，也正好是八焦耳。省下的不是能量，而是借助长转动路程换来的较小力矩。
cues.en: Remove thread friction and turn twice. An eight-millimetre lift gives the thousand-newton load eight joules of potential energy. Torque multiplied by rotation in radians supplies exactly the same work. The smaller torque comes from a longer turning path, not from an energy saving.

cues.title: 把导程加倍
cues.caption: 相同圈数升得更高，也需要更大的理想力矩。
cues.captionEn: More lead gives more lift and requires more ideal torque.
cues.zh: 比较两种导程，其他条件相同。先看四毫米，再换成八毫米，每次都转两圈。第二种丝杆每圈升得更高，所需的理想提升力矩也更大。细导程可以换来更细的轴向位移，但不能同时免费获得更快的提升和更小的力矩。
cues.en: Compare four-millimetre and eight-millimetre leads under the same conditions, turning each twice. The second screw rises farther per revolution and needs more ideal raising torque. A fine lead gives smaller axial increments, but cannot provide both faster lifting and lower torque for free.

cues.title: 接触摩擦要付出能量
cues.caption: 摩擦增加提升力矩，额外输入变成热。
cues.captionEn: Thread friction adds torque and dissipates energy.
cues.zh: 回到四毫米导程，把一圈提升作为固定任务，再逐渐增加螺纹摩擦。需要的力矩越来越大，而负载获得的重力势能仍然只有四焦耳。多出来的输入功计入摩擦热。这里把止推轴承理想化，真实设备还可能有其他损耗。
cues.en: Return to a four-millimetre lead and compare one-turn lifts as thread friction increases. Raising torque grows, but the load still gains only four joules. The extra input is frictional heat. The thrust bearing is idealized here; real devices can have additional losses.

cues.title: 自锁有一个条件
cues.caption: 摩擦不足时，负载可能反向驱动丝杆。
cues.captionEn: With insufficient friction, the load can back-drive the screw.
cues.zh: 最后减小摩擦，观察下降所需力矩的符号。摩擦角大于导程角时，需要主动施加下降方向的力矩，模型呈自锁。越过边界后，读数变负，意味着负载有反向驱动的趋势，慢慢下降反而需要制动。不是所有螺纹都会自锁，这个简化判据也不是现实起重设备的安全保证。
cues.en: Reduce friction and watch the required lowering torque. When the friction angle exceeds the lead angle, lowering needs an applied torque and the model is self-locking. Across the boundary the sign becomes negative: the load can back-drive the screw, and slow lowering needs braking. Not every screw self-locks, and this simplified criterion is not a lifting-safety guarantee.

cues.title: 圆盘先绕圆心转
cues.caption: 没有偏心，转动不会带来升降。
cues.captionEn: With no offset, rotation produces no lift.
cues.zh: 先看圆盘绕自己的圆心转动。表面标记在走，顶部高度却没有变化，滚子也不升降。单纯有一个转动的轮子，并不意味着它会产生往复运动。关键要看轮廓相对于转轴怎样变化。
cues.en: Watch the disc rotate about its own centre. The surface marker moves, but the top height stays fixed and the roller does not lift. A rotating wheel alone does not create reciprocating motion. What matters is how its boundary changes relative to the shaft.

cues.title: 把转轴移离圆心
cues.caption: 偏心距八毫米，完整升降行程十六毫米。
cues.captionEn: An eight-millimetre offset gives a sixteen-millimetre stroke.
cues.zh: 保持圆盘半径，逐渐增加圆心到转轴的偏心距。滚子的最高和最低位置拉开了距离。这里是偏心圆凸轮，完整行程恰好是偏心距的两倍。导向杆限制滚子只能上下走，不能跟着凸轮圆心一起绕圈。
cues.en: Keep the disc radius and increase the offset between its centre and the shaft. The highest and lowest roller positions move apart. For this eccentric circular cam, full stroke is twice the offset. The guide keeps the follower translating vertically instead of orbiting with the disc centre.

cues.title: 跟住真实接触点
cues.caption: 有限半径滚子与凸轮始终沿两圆心连线接触。
cues.captionEn: Two-circle tangency locates the actual contact.
cues.zh: 把转动放慢，跟住深色接触点。滚子不是没有大小的一个点，它和凸轮在两圆心连线的方向相切。接触点会横向移动，所以不能只在转轴正上方量凸轮高度，再随手加上滚子半径。接触点的横向移动，正好揭示了这段相切关系。
cues.en: Slow the rotation and follow the dark contact point. The roller has a finite radius. Its tangent contact lies on the line joining the two circle centres and moves sideways during the turn. Sampling the cam directly above the shaft and adding a radius would give the wrong motion.

cues.title: 匀速输入，非匀速输出
cues.caption: 升降方向改变之前，滚子速度先经过零。
cues.captionEn: Follower speed passes through zero at each reversal.
cues.zh: 现在保持恒定转速，看滚子的升降速度。接近最高点和最低点，它逐渐减速到零，然后反向。中间一段走得更快。下面的速度曲线记录了这种变化，零点对应上下行程的两个端点。均匀的转角并不等于均匀的位移。
cues.en: Hold the cam at constant speed and watch the follower velocity. It slows to zero near each end of the stroke before reversing, and moves faster in between. The plotted velocity is derived from the same contact geometry. Uniform increments of angle do not produce uniform increments of displacement.

cues.title: 凸轮不能隔空往下拉
cues.titleEn: A cam cannot pull across a gap
cues.caption: 高速、无弹簧时，滚子会离开凸轮。
cues.captionEn: At high speed without a spring, contact is lost.
cues.zh: 把转速提高到每分钟六百转，并移除弹簧的作用。凸轮下降得快，滚子只受重力时可能跟不上。看红色间隙，接触已经分开，实际接触力变成零。此后滚子按自己的运动方程飞行，直到重新碰到凸轮；模型没有用负接触力强行把它拉回来。
cues.en: Raise the speed to six hundred revolutions per minute and remove the spring force. The cam can retreat faster than gravity makes the follower descend. A red gap appears and actual contact force becomes zero. The follower then follows its own free-flight motion until re-contact, rather than being pulled back by an impossible negative contact force.

cues.title: 相同转速，加上预压弹簧
cues.titleEn: Keep the speed and add preload
cues.caption: 弹簧提供向下作用力，让这一组参数保持接触。
cues.captionEn: A preloaded spring maintains contact for these parameters.
cues.zh: 保持相同的高速，恢复有预压的弹簧。它持续向下推从动件，使滚子能跟随凸轮回落。现在整圈没有间隙，接触力也保持非负。但弹簧不是越硬越好，真实机器还要考虑应力、惯量、磨损和振动。这里证明的是这组模型参数的接触条件。
cues.en: Keep the same high speed and restore the preloaded spring. Its downward force lets the follower track the retreating cam. This parameter set has no gap through the full turn, and contact force remains nonnegative. A stiffer spring is not automatically a better real design; stress, inertia, wear and vibration also matter.

cues.title: 先保留所有可能
cues.caption: 候选区间按索引连续，数值已经有序。
cues.captionEn: The candidate interval is contiguous by index, and values are sorted.
cues.zh: 要在这些数里寻找三十七，不必从第一个逐个数过去。但开始之前有一个关键前提：数列已经从小到大排好。手机把数架折成了几行，索引顺序没有改变。接下来的每次跳过，都必须保留真正答案可能在的位置。
cues.en: We want thirty-seven without checking every value from the beginning. First comes an essential contract: the array is already sorted. On a phone the shelf folds into rows, but its index order stays the same. Every exclusion must preserve any position that could really hold the answer.

cues.title: 小于目标，整段都能排除
cues.titleEn: Too small excludes a whole prefix
cues.caption: 29 小于 37，所以索引 0–7 都不可能。
cues.captionEn: 29 is below 37, so indices 0–7 cannot match.
cues.zh: 先取区间中点，看到二十九。它比三十七小。因为数列有序，中点以前的数也都不大于二十九，所以这一整段不可能是答案。丢掉它们靠的是顺序带来的证明，不是猜测答案更可能出现在哪边。
cues.en: The midpoint contains twenty-nine, which is smaller than thirty-seven. Because the array is sorted, every earlier value is no larger than twenty-nine. That entire prefix is impossible. We eliminate it using a proof supplied by order, not a guess about which half is more likely.

cues.title: 大于目标，收回另一侧
cues.caption: 46 大于 37，候选区间缩到索引 8–10。
cues.captionEn: 46 exceeds 37; candidates shrink to indices 8–10.
cues.zh: 在剩下的区间中重新取中点，这次是四十六，太大了。中点之后的数只会更大，连同四十六一起排除。注意每次边界都越过刚比较的中点，而不是把它留在原地。这样区间才会严格缩小。
cues.en: Take the midpoint of the remaining interval. This time it is forty-six, too large. Every later value is at least as large, so exclude that suffix and the midpoint itself. Each boundary moves beyond the failed comparison. Leaving the same midpoint behind could prevent the interval from shrinking.

cues.title: 三次比较，命中索引九
cues.caption: 37 与目标相等，查找结束。
cues.captionEn: 37 equals the target, so the search ends.
cues.zh: 再取一次中点，正好是三十七。第三次比较已经命中，索引是九。这里寻找的是某个相等位置。若数列里有重复值，这个版本不承诺返回最左或最右的一个；要找边界，需要改变循环的前提。
cues.en: The next midpoint is thirty-seven itself. The third comparison finds index nine. This search promises some equal position. If duplicate values exist, this version does not promise the first or last match. Finding a boundary requires a different loop contract.

cues.title: 不存在，也要有明确结果
cues.caption: 找 38 时，最终 low 大于 high。
cues.captionEn: Searching for 38 ends with low greater than high.
cues.zh: 把目标只加一，改为三十八。模型继续比较，但最后没有任何候选位置留下。此时左边界大于右边界，闭区间为空，查找就以不存在结束。它不会悄悄返回旁边的三十七或四十一，因为“最接近”是另一个问题。
cues.en: Increase the target to thirty-eight. Comparisons continue until no candidate position remains. Low passes high, so the inclusive interval is empty and the result is absent. The search does not quietly return nearby thirty-seven or forty-one. Finding the nearest value would be a different problem.

cues.title: 乱序会毁掉舍弃的理由
cues.titleEn: Unsorted input destroys the exclusion proof
cues.caption: 索引 1 的 37 暴露了错误舍弃。
cues.captionEn: The 37 at index 1 exposes an invalid exclusion.
cues.zh: 最后把三十七搬到索引一，破坏排序，却保留中点二十九。如果还按二十九太小就丢掉整个前缀，真正答案也会一起消失。这个画面是错误推理的反例；实际模型会拒绝乱序输入。二分查找快，是因为有序信息已经提前准备好了。
cues.en: Finally move thirty-seven to index one, breaking order while leaving twenty-nine at the midpoint. If we still discard the prefix because twenty-nine is too small, we throw away the real answer. This illustrates invalid reasoning; the actual model rejects unsorted input. Binary search is fast because order has already supplied information.

cues.title: 先跟踪同一批对象
cues.titleEn: Keep track of the same items
cues.caption: 值可以重复，编号始终保留身份。
cues.captionEn: Values may repeat; item numbers preserve identity.
cues.zh: 这批数里有两个三，但它们不是同一个对象。旁边的小编号记录原始位置，移动时也不会变。排序不仅要得到从小到大的值，还要说清楚同一个对象去了哪里。先把这条混合的数带保留下来。
cues.en: There are two threes, but they are different items. The small numbers record original positions and stay with their items. Sorting must produce ordered values without losing track of what moved where. Begin with this one mixed ribbon.

cues.title: 一个元素，已经有序
cues.caption: 把原数带拆成单项有序段。
cues.captionEn: Split the input into one-item sorted runs.
cues.zh: 把长数带拆成一个个小段，每段只有一项。这样的段已经有序，不需要再比较。接下来不是把任意两堆东西随意拼接，而是利用一个明确条件：要进入合并的两段，内部都已经排好。
cues.en: Split the ribbon into one-item runs. A single item is already sorted and needs no comparison. What follows is not arbitrary concatenation. Merging depends on a specific premise: each incoming run must already be ordered internally.

cues.title: 小段合成较大的段
cues.titleEn: Make a larger run from smaller runs
cues.caption: 比较头部，把较小的一项送入输出。
cues.captionEn: Compare the heads and emit the smaller item.
cues.zh: 先合并一项与一项。只比较两个头部，把较小的送入输出，再接上剩余那项。一次合并就得到长度为二的有序段。对同一批编号重复这个过程，数值顺序开始出现，原来的对象没有增加或消失。
cues.en: Merge one item with one item. Compare the two heads, emit the smaller one, and append the remaining item. Each merge creates a sorted run of length two. Repeating this on the same numbered items begins to reveal order without creating or losing an object.

cues.title: 相等时，稳定性由规则决定
cues.caption: 两个 3 相等时，先取编号 2。
cues.captionEn: When the two 3s tie, take original item 2 first.
cues.zh: 再合并两段长度为二的队伍。两个头部都等于三：一个原本编号二，另一个编号四。这里规定相等时先取左段。于是编号二先输出，编号四随后输出。最终键相等的对象仍按原来的先后排列，这才叫稳定。
cues.en: Now merge two runs of length two. Both heads equal three: one originally had number two, the other number four. Our rule takes the left head on equality. Item two is emitted before item four. Equal-key items retain their original relative order; that is what stability means here.

cues.title: 头部之后不会藏更小的值
cues.titleEn: No smaller item hides behind a sorted head
cues.caption: 两个有序段，逐项合成完整结果。
cues.captionEn: Merge the two sorted runs into the complete result.
cues.zh: 最后合并两段长度为四的有序队伍。每一步仍只看头部。因为各段内部有序，藏在某个头部后面的值不会比它更小，所以两个头部中较小的就是全体尚未输出的最小值。输出一项，露出新头部，同一个理由继续成立。
cues.en: Finally merge the two sorted runs of length four. Each decision still examines only their heads. Nothing behind a sorted head can be smaller, so the lesser head is the least remaining item overall. Emit it, expose the next head, and exactly the same argument applies again.

cues.title: 一个藏起来的 2
cues.caption: 乱序段会让只看头部的推理失效。
cues.captionEn: An unsorted run invalidates head-only selection.
cues.zh: 现在故意换成左段一、四、二，右段三、五。只比头部会先输出一、三、四，才看见被四挡住的二，顺序已经错了。这个反例被正式合并接口拒绝。归并安全，不是因为头部有什么魔法，而是每一段先满足有序前提。
cues.en: Deliberately replace the left run with one, four, two and the right with three, five. Blind head selection emits one, three, four before discovering the hidden two. Order is already broken. The public merge function rejects this input. Heads are useful because of the sorted-run contract, not because they are magical.

cues.title: 选一个比较基准
cues.caption: 主元 3 把关系分成小于、等于、大于。
cues.captionEn: Pivot 3 separates below, equal and above.
cues.zh: 先选三作为主元。它是一个用来比较的值，不是预先知道的最终索引。现在所有项都还在问号区间。接下来保留这些编号，让每次交换都能被追踪，而不是把画面里的数字直接替换成想要的顺序。
cues.en: Choose three as the pivot value. It is a comparison value, not a known final index. Every item begins in the unknown region. Keep the original numbers attached so each swap can be followed, rather than replacing the picture with a desired order.

cues.title: 换到右边，指针先别走
cues.titleEn: Swap right, but keep the scan
cues.caption: 6 送往右段，换来的 3 仍待检查。
cues.captionEn: 6 moves right; the incoming 3 still needs inspection.
cues.zh: 第一个六比主元大，把它与未知区间末端交换。六可以留在大于段，右边界收缩。但是扫描索引仍停在零，因为换来的三刚到这里，还没有分类。若每次交换后都前进，就可能漏检这个新来的项。
cues.en: The first value, six, exceeds the pivot. Exchange it with the last unknown item and shrink the upper boundary. Six can stay in the greater region. The scan remains at zero because the arriving three has not yet been classified. Advancing after every swap could skip that incoming item.

cues.title: 较小项穿过等值区
cues.titleEn: Move a smaller item through the equal region
cues.caption: 2 到左边界，lt 与 i 一起前进。
cues.captionEn: 2 reaches the left boundary; lt and i both advance.
cues.zh: 相等的三逐渐留在中间，扫描继续向前。经过几次右侧交换，二来到扫描位置。它比主元小，要送到左边界。原来在边界的三换回扫描位置后仍属于等值段，所以这一次左边界和扫描索引都可以前进。
cues.en: The threes collect in the middle as the scan advances. After right-side swaps, two arrives at the scan. It belongs below the pivot, so exchange it with the lower boundary. The displaced three still belongs to the equal region. This time both the lower boundary and the scan can advance.

cues.title: 重复键直接留在中间
cues.titleEn: Collect duplicate keys in the middle
cues.caption: 三个 3 已分类，无需继续递归它们。
cues.captionEn: All three 3s are classified and need no further recursion.
cues.zh: 未知区间继续收缩，三个三都进入等值段。这里不是只安放某一个主元对象，而是同时识别所有等于这个值的项。等值段已经满足最终大小关系，不需要再递归。自由探索把八项都改成三，就能看到这一轮直接处理完所有相等键。
cues.en: As the unknown region disappears, all three threes enter the equal region. This places every key equal to the pivot value, rather than settling only one pivot object. No recursion is needed on that group. In exploration, setting all eight values to three completes their classification in one pass.

cues.title: 分区完成，内部仍然乱序
cues.titleEn: A completed partition can still contain disorder
cues.caption: 右段的 8、6 说明分区不是完整排序。
cues.captionEn: The right group’s 8,6 inversion shows that partitioning is not sorting.
cues.zh: 看大于主元的那一段：五、七、八、六。八仍然在六前面，内部显然没有排好。分区只保证跨段的关系：小的在一边，相等的在中间，大的在另一边。它没有替每一段内部解决顺序。
cues.en: Inspect the greater group: five, seven, eight, six. Eight still precedes six, so that group is not internally sorted. Partitioning guarantees relations between groups: below, equal and above. It does not solve the order within each outer group.

cues.title: 只递归尚未解决的两段
cues.titleEn: Recurse only on the unsolved groups
cues.caption: 中间不动，外侧逐步排成完整顺序。
cues.captionEn: Keep the equal group; sort the outer regions.
cues.zh: 现在只在外侧两段继续同样的过程。细线标出当前递归处理的区间，中间的三个三不再反复参与。最后数值排好了，但看看三个三旁边的编号：相同键的原始先后已经改变。这个交换式分区不保证稳定性。
cues.en: Apply the same process only to the outer regions. The thin line marks the current recursive range; the middle threes do not participate again. Eventually all values are ordered. Yet the original numbers beside the threes have changed relative order. This swapping partition does not guarantee stability.

cues.title: 极端主元，会一层层剥掉
cues.titleEn: Extreme pivots peel away one item at a time
cues.caption: 相同八项：极端分区 35 次，均衡对照 17 次。
cues.captionEn: The same eight values: 35 classifications versus 17.
cues.zh: 最后对相同八个有序值，刻意比较总选最小值和选真实中位数。前者每层只剥掉一项，累计分类三十五项次；均衡对照是十七。这里没有计算寻找主元的工作，不能当成完整速度排名。它隔离展示的是：分区有多均衡，会改变后续还要处理多少项。
cues.en: Finally use the same eight ordered values to contrast always choosing the minimum with choosing the exact median. One peels off a single item per level, totaling thirty-five classifications; the balanced comparison gives seventeen. Pivot-selection work is excluded, so this is not a runtime ranking. It isolates how balance changes the amount of later partition work.

cues.title: 先看两边的波前
cues.caption: 界面两边的波前相接，传播方向改变。
cues.captionEn: Wavefronts join at the interface while the direction changes.
cues.zh: 先看一组平行波前抵达界面。进入折射率更高的介质后，相邻波前靠得更近，传播方向也改变。界面上的节拍必须连续，两边不能任意错开。图中的光线始终垂直于波前，它标出这束单色光的传播方向。
cues.en: Watch the parallel wavefronts meet the interface. In the higher-index material they become closer together and the propagation direction changes. Their timing along the boundary must match. The ray stays perpendicular to the wavefronts, marking the propagation direction of this monochromatic wave.

cues.title: 正入射的反例
cues.caption: 波长改变，并不一定让光线转弯。
cues.captionEn: A changed wavelength does not always bend the ray.
cues.zh: 把入射方向逐渐转向法线。到正入射时，光仍然进入折射率更高的一侧，波前间距仍然缩短，但中心光线不再转弯。这是一个重要的边界情况：介质改变光的传播速度，并不意味着每一种入射方向都发生偏折。
cues.en: Rotate the incoming beam toward the normal. At normal incidence it still enters a higher-index material, so the wavefront spacing still contracts, but the ray no longer turns. This boundary case matters: changing propagation speed does not require bending for every possible incident direction.

cues.title: 只改折射率
cues.caption: 相同入射角下，更高折射率使折射方向靠近法线。
cues.captionEn: At fixed incidence, a higher second index moves the ray toward the normal.
cues.zh: 恢复相同的斜入射角，只改变第二介质的折射率。光线与法线之间的折射角逐渐减小，波前间距也同步缩短。数值并不是凭外观调整：两边折射率乘角度正弦的结果保持相同，这就是斯涅尔关系。
cues.en: Restore oblique incidence and change only the second index. The transmitted angle to the normal decreases while the wavefront spacing contracts. Both values come from the same calculation. Index times the sine of the angle remains equal across the interface: the Snell relation links the geometry to the wavefronts.

cues.title: 反向穿过界面
cues.caption: 从高折射率走向低折射率，光线偏离法线。
cues.captionEn: From higher to lower index, the ray bends away from the normal.
cues.zh: 现在让光从折射率较高的一侧进入较低的一侧。折射角大于入射角，光线偏离法线，波前间距反而变大。这里仍在能传播出去的角度范围内。若继续增大入射角，可能出现全反射，那需要额外的临界条件，不能把任意角度都代入一个实数折射角。
cues.en: Now send light from the higher index into the lower one. The transmitted angle is larger and the ray bends away from the normal. Wavefront spacing increases. This shot remains below the critical boundary. At larger angles, total internal reflection may replace a propagating transmitted ray; not every input has a real refraction angle.

cues.title: 频率没有换掉
cues.caption: 频率连续，介质内波长按折射率改变。
cues.captionEn: Frequency remains continuous while wavelength changes with index.
cues.zh: 停在同一个界面上，比较两边经过的波前。它们共用同一节拍，进入介质并不会在这个静止界面上自动换一种频率。改变的是相位传播速度和介质内波长。界面两侧的频率一致，才能让每个接触位置随时间保持相容。
cues.en: Pause the geometry and compare successive fronts on both sides. They share the same temporal rhythm. Crossing this stationary boundary does not automatically change the frequency. Phase speed and wavelength change instead. A common frequency lets the wave remain compatible at every contact point as time passes.

cues.title: 角度从法线量起
cues.caption: 把角度改从表面量，公式就不再是同一个正弦关系。
cues.captionEn: Measuring from the surface changes which angle enters the sine relation.
cues.zh: 最后再改变一次入射方向，认清参考线。虚线是垂直于界面的法线，两个角度都从它量起，不是从界面量起。随着光线转动，圆弧、读数和波前都来自同一个状态。先明确介质、入射方向和角度定义，才能判断光究竟向哪边偏折。
cues.en: Change the direction once more and identify the reference. The dashed line is normal to the interface. Both angles are measured from that line, not from the surface. The arcs, numerical readings and wavefronts all follow one state. Establish the media, direction and angle convention before deciding which way light bends.

cues.title: 先有反射与透射
cues.caption: 临界角以下，部分功率反射，部分传播到外侧。
cues.captionEn: Below critical incidence, power divides between reflection and transmission.
cues.zh: 从折射率较高的一侧，把一束光射向界面。先保持不太大的入射角，一部分光返回原介质，另一部分传播到外侧。反射角等于入射角，折射角则更大。虚线标出这对介质的临界方向，接下来只转动入射光，界面和折射率保持不变。
cues.en: Send a beam toward the boundary from the higher-index side. At this moderate angle, some power returns and some propagates outside. The reflection angle matches incidence, while refraction bends farther from the normal. Dashed guides mark the critical directions. We will rotate the beam while keeping the interface and indices fixed.

cues.title: 折射方向贴近界面
cues.titleEn: The transmitted direction approaches the surface
cues.caption: 临界时，传播折射方向达到相对法线90度。
cues.captionEn: At critical incidence, the transmitted direction reaches ninety degrees.
cues.zh: 逐渐增大入射角，观察外侧光线越来越贴近界面。临界角由两个折射率的比值决定。对折射率一点五进入空气，这个角约为四十一点八度。临界处的折射方向达到九十度，已经不能再向外侧法线方向偏得更多。
cues.en: Increase incidence and watch the transmitted direction approach the surface. The index ratio sets the critical angle. For index one point five into air, it is about forty-one point eight degrees. At the boundary, refraction reaches ninety degrees to the normal. There is no further real angle that would keep this propagating branch going.

cues.title: 超过临界角
cues.caption: 没有向外传播的法向功率，反射功率达到100%。
cues.captionEn: No outward propagating normal power remains; reflection reaches one hundred percent.
cues.zh: 再越过临界角，外侧不再有离开界面的传播光束。无吸收模型中，反射功率达到百分之百，仍然遵守反射角等于入射角。这不是把折射角硬设成某个更大的数，而是原来的传播解不再存在。这里的全，指的是理想界面的功率账本。
cues.en: Go beyond the critical angle. There is no longer a propagating beam carrying power away from the surface into the second medium. In the lossless model, reflection reaches one hundred percent and still obeys equal angles. We have not forced refraction to an impossible larger angle; that propagating solution no longer exists.

cues.title: 只改外侧介质
cues.caption: 固定入射角，提高外侧折射率可以恢复传播透射。
cues.captionEn: At fixed incidence, raising the outer index can restore transmission.
cues.zh: 固定入射角为五十二度，只提高外侧介质的折射率。临界角随之改变，当它超过当前入射角时，向外传播的光又出现了。全反射不是这块界面永久拥有的属性，它取决于传播方向、两边折射率和入射角这三个条件。
cues.en: Hold incidence at fifty-two degrees and raise only the outer index. The critical angle changes. Once it exceeds the current incidence, a propagating transmitted beam returns. Total internal reflection is not a permanent label attached to a surface: direction, both indices and incident angle must be specified together.

cues.title: 反过来未必全反射
cues.titleEn: The reverse direction need not totally reflect
cues.caption: 从低折射率走向高折射率，没有同样的临界角。
cues.captionEn: Lower-to-higher index incidence has no corresponding critical angle.
cues.zh: 现在让入射侧折射率低于外侧，仍然保持同样的入射角。光线又可以传播出去，而且向法线靠近。没有可用的临界角读数，因为这一方向不满足全反射的必要条件。仅仅把入射角调大，并不能保证任意介质和任意方向都会出现全反射。
cues.en: Make the incident index lower than the outer index, keeping the same angle. Light propagates through and bends toward the normal. There is no critical-angle reading for this direction because the necessary index ordering is absent. A large angle alone cannot guarantee total reflection for arbitrary media or propagation direction.

cues.title: 外侧并非没有电场
cues.titleEn: The outer field is not zero
cues.caption: 消逝场沿法线衰减，不是离开界面的传播光束。
cues.captionEn: The evanescent field decays normally instead of propagating away.
cues.zh: 回到全反射状态，再近看界面外侧。那里并非完全没有电场，而是出现随距离快速衰减的消逝场。读数给出电场幅度降到约百分之三十七的距离，图中厚度已放大。这个近场不等同于把平均功率送向远处；加入吸收介质或靠近另一块玻璃，会是需要新模型的另一种实验。
cues.en: Return to total reflection and inspect the outer side closely. The electric field is not zero: an evanescent field decays rapidly with normal distance. The reading gives the distance over which field amplitude falls to about thirty-seven percent, with the thickness enlarged in the drawing. This near field is not a beam carrying average power away; absorption or nearby glass requires a different model.

cues.title: 一次进入，一次离开
cues.caption: 光线在棱镜的两个真实表面分别折射。
cues.captionEn: The ray refracts at the prism’s two physical surfaces.
cues.zh: 先只看一束单色光。它射到三棱镜的第一个表面，在玻璃内改变方向，接着遇到第二个表面，再折射回空气。留意两个转折点：光线在入射面和出射面各改变一次方向。先把这条连续路径认清，再加入不同波长。
cues.en: Begin with one wavelength. It enters the first prism face, changes direction inside the glass, and meets the second face before returning to air. Follow the two turning points: the beam bends at the entry face and again at the exit face.

cues.title: 把多种波长一起送入
cues.caption: 同一白光输入中，不同波长出射方向略有不同。
cues.captionEn: Different wavelengths in the same input leave in slightly different directions.
cues.zh: 现在把入射光换成多个波长的白光取样。它们从同一方向、同一位置进入同一块棱镜，却在离开后略微分开。玻璃的折射率随波长变化，这种材料性质叫色散。角度条把很小的差别局部放大，不能把它当作一块按距离等比例绘制的接收屏。
cues.en: Replace the input with several wavelengths representing white light. They enter the same prism at the same location and direction, yet leave at slightly different angles. The material index depends on wavelength: this is dispersion. The angle strip enlarges that small difference; it is an angular display, not a distance-scaled physical screen.

cues.title: 读取真实材料色散
cues.caption: N-BK7在可见光范围内，较短波长的折射率较高。
cues.captionEn: In visible N-BK7 glass, shorter wavelengths have higher index.
cues.zh: 跟踪一个波长，从红光逐渐移到蓝光。下方的折射率来自厂商给出的N-BK7材料公式，并不是为彩虹效果随意选择。这里较短波长的折射率更高，经过两次折射后偏向角也更大。材料和波长范围必须说清，不能把这个顺序当成所有材料的一条无条件定律。
cues.en: Track one wavelength from red toward blue. The index readout comes from the manufacturer’s N-BK7 dispersion formula, rather than colours chosen for a rainbow effect. Shorter visible wavelengths have higher index here and a larger final deviation after both refractions. The named material and wavelength range matter; this ordering is not a universal law for all media.

cues.title: 保留棱镜，关闭色散
cues.titleEn: Keep the prism but remove dispersion
cues.caption: 相同折射率仍使光偏折，却不把波长分开。
cues.captionEn: A common index still deflects light but no longer separates wavelengths.
cues.zh: 做一个控制比较：棱镜几何和照明都保留，只假设所有波长使用同一个折射率。出射光仍然偏向，但各波长重合。恢复真实的材料色散，颜色才重新分开。三角形形状负责两次折射的几何关系，波长相关的折射率才让这些方向不再完全相同。
cues.en: Keep the prism and illumination, but give every wavelength the same index. The beam is still deflected, yet the wavelengths overlap. Restore the real dispersion and they separate again.
