cues.captionEn: HELLO becomes HELLO!; the right side changes and verification fails.
cues.zh: 只在消息末尾加一个感叹号，签名仍保持原样。挑战改变，右边的计算随之改变，等式不再成立。签名并没有隐藏内容，却能核对收到的内容是否仍与签名关系一致。
cues.en: Add one exclamation mark while keeping the signature unchanged. The challenge changes, altering the right-hand computation and breaking equality. The signature does not hide content, but it checks whether received content still fits the signed relation.

cues.title: 公钥也必须正确
cues.titleEn: The key must also be the right one
cues.caption: 换公钥会失败；公钥与真实身份的绑定需要另外认证。
cues.captionEn: Another public key fails; binding the key to identity needs separate authentication.
cues.zh: 恢复原消息，却换另一把公钥，验证同样失败。反过来，一把能验签的公钥也不自动告诉你它属于谁。真实身份与公钥的绑定，需要证书、可信渠道或其他认证依据。
cues.en: Restore the original message but substitute another public key: verification also fails. Conversely, a key that verifies does not automatically tell you who owns it. Certificates, trusted channels or another authentication basis must bind the key to a real identity.

cues.title: 复用 nonce，泄露私钥
cues.titleEn: Nonce reuse exposes the private key
cues.caption: HELLO 与 WORLD 复用 R，两式实际恢复出私钥 137。
cues.captionEn: HELLO and WORLD reuse R; their equations recover private scalar 137.
cues.zh: 最后让两条不同消息复用同一个 nonce，于是 R 相同。两份公开签名相减，可以消去 nonce，求出私钥一百三十七。固定 nonce 在这里是刻意构造的失败例子；真实签名必须遵守标准中的安全生成规则。
cues.en: Finally reuse one nonce for two different messages, repeating R. Subtracting the public signature equations eliminates the nonce and recovers private scalar one hundred thirty-seven. Fixed nonce reuse is an intentional failure here; real signatures must follow a standard’s secure generation rules.

cues.title: 两边各留私数
cues.caption: Alice 留 6，Bob 留 7；小群仅作不安全教学。
cues.captionEn: Alice keeps 6, Bob 7; the tiny group is insecure teaching only.
cues.zh: Alice 和 Bob 各自保留一个私数。接下来使用同一组公开参数做指数计算。这里模二十三，候选很少，完全没有实际安全性；先用它看清共享值从哪里来。
cues.en: Alice and Bob each retain a private exponent and use shared public group parameters. This example works modulo twenty-three and is entirely insecure. Its small numbers make the origin of the shared value inspectable.

cues.title: 私数变成公开值
cues.caption: A=18、B=13 可以发送，私数并未直接发送。
cues.captionEn: A=18 and B=13 are public; the private exponents are not sent.
cues.zh: Alice 用私数六计算公开值十八，Bob 用七得到十三。发送的是这两个结果，而不是私数本身。但没有直接发送，不等于一定安全；还必须依靠适当参数下的计算困难性。
cues.en: Alice’s exponent six produces public eighteen; Bob’s seven produces thirteen. They send those results rather than their private exponents. Not sending a value directly does not establish security; suitable parameters must make recovery computationally hard.

cues.title: 交叉收到公开值
cues.caption: Alice 收到 13，Bob 收到 18，各自保留自己的私数。
cues.captionEn: Alice receives 13, Bob receives 18, retaining their own exponents.
cues.zh: 现在交换公开值。Alice 收到十三，却仍只使用自己的六；Bob 收到十八，保留自己的七。双方不需要把私数交给对方，也没有在这里传送一条已经加密的消息。
cues.en: Exchange the public values. Alice receives thirteen and still uses her own six. Bob receives eighteen and retains seven. Neither sends its private exponent, and no encrypted application message has been transmitted here.

cues.title: 指数次序给出同值
cues.caption: 13⁶ 与 18⁷ 模 23，都等于 6。
cues.captionEn: 13⁶ and 18⁷ modulo 23 both equal 6.
cues.zh: Alice 对收到的公开值再做六次指数，Bob 做七次。两种计算都等价于同一个指数乘积，因此共享值都是六。真实协议还要从这个共享输入派生合适的应用密钥，不能把协商和值直接当作完整加密。
cues.en: Alice raises the received value to six; Bob raises his to seven. Both compose the same exponent product and derive six. A real protocol still derives an application key from the shared input; agreement alone is not complete encryption.

cues.title: 改一个私数，两边一起变
cues.titleEn: Change one exponent, both results change
cues.caption: Alice 的 6 改为 7，公开值与两侧共享值一起变化。
cues.captionEn: Changing Alice from 6 to 7 changes her public value and both shared results.
cues.zh: 只把 Alice 的私数从六改成七。她的公开值变化，Bob 收到的新值也随之变化，两侧共享结果一起变成九。不是手工把结果调成相等，而是指数关系在新输入下仍然成立。
cues.en: Change only Alice’s exponent from six to seven. Her public value changes, Bob receives that new value, and both shared results become nine. Agreement follows the exponent relation under the new input.

cues.title: 小群可轻易倒查
cues.titleEn: The tiny group is easy to search
cues.caption: 十个候选就恢复私数 6；这些参数不提供保密。
cues.captionEn: Ten candidates recover exponent 6; these parameters provide no secrecy.
cues.zh: 观察者只看到十八，在这个小群里也能试遍十个私数，找到六，再算出共享值。小例子的公开计算便于学习，却不提供保密；复杂的排版不能替代安全群与标准协议。
cues.en: An observer seeing eighteen can try all ten private exponents, recover six and compute the shared value. Small public arithmetic is useful for learning but provides no confidentiality; visual complexity cannot replace secure groups and standard protocols.

cues.title: 主动替换打破端到端
cues.caption: 中间人替换为 8、16，并分别算出端点的 13、18。
cues.captionEn: An intermediary substitutes 8 and 16 and computes endpoint values 13 and 18.
cues.zh: 最后让中间人分别换掉两边收到的公开值。Alice 算出十三，Bob 算出十八，中间人也能分别算出两者。单独 DH 没有证明对端身份；必须把本次交换与经认证的身份和会话上下文绑定。
cues.en: Finally an intermediary replaces each received public value. Alice derives thirteen and Bob eighteen; the intermediary derives both. Plain DH has not authenticated the peer. The exchange must be bound to authenticated identities and session context.

cues.title: 先不用近轴近似
cues.caption: 球面不同高度的反射光，不经过同一轴上交点。
cues.captionEn: Rays reflected at different spherical-mirror heights have different axial crossings.
cues.zh: 把一束平行光射向凹球面镜。靠近光轴的光与靠近外缘的光，碰到的表面法线不同，反射后也不全经过同一个点。中央区域很小时，半径的一半可以近似表示焦距；这里保留更宽的口径，直接按照每一个真实法线计算反射，差异便显现出来。
cues.en: Send parallel light toward a concave spherical mirror. Near-axis and outer rays encounter different surface normals and do not all cross at one point. Half the sphere radius approximates focal distance only for a sufficiently small central region. A wider aperture reveals the different crossings when each actual normal determines the reflection.

cues.title: 放大交会区域
cues.caption: 浅绿近轴交点与橙色边缘交点，在轴上分开。
cues.captionEn: The pale near-axis crossing and warm marginal crossing are separated along the axis.
cues.zh: 放大焦区，纵横仍使用相同的比例。浅绿色标记近轴的交点，橙色标记边缘光的交点。它们沿光轴分开，中间各个高度的光还有各自的位置。这段展开的交会区域就是球差的几何证据；它不是几种颜色各找一个焦点，这里只跟踪同一组反射光。
cues.en: Enlarge the focal region with equal horizontal and vertical scales. Pale green marks the near-axis crossing and warm gold the marginal crossing. Other pupil heights cross between them. This spread along the axis is geometric evidence of spherical aberration. It is not different wavelengths choosing different foci; the diagram follows one reflected bundle.

cues.title: 调焦不能让全部重合
cues.caption: 移动接收面能缩小光斑，但不能同时消除各高度的差异。
cues.captionEn: Moving the screen can reduce the spot without eliminating every ray’s error.
cues.zh: 沿光轴移动接收面。下面的小图记录同一个平面上的三维光线落点，范围始终固定，窗口跟随主光线。光斑一度缩小，然后又扩大，却无法让所有落点同时重合。调焦选择的是哪一个截面最合适，不能把球面本身造成的不同交会位置一起搬到同一点。
cues.en: Move the receiving plane along the axis. The small plot shows three-dimensional ray hits on that same plane, at a fixed scale following the chief ray. The spot shrinks and then grows, but all hits never merge. Refocusing selects a better section through the bundle; it does not make the mirror’s different ray crossings coincide.

cues.title: 只接收靠轴部分
cues.caption: 有效口径缩小，几何球差减弱，接收面积也下降。
cues.captionEn: A smaller effective pupil reduces geometric blur while reducing accepted area.
cues.zh: 回到完整镜面，只接收越来越靠近光轴的一圈光，并为每个口径重新选择轴上最小均方半径的接收面。下面的几何光斑明显缩小，但有效面积也按半径的平方下降。半径从四十缩到十毫米，只剩原面积的十六分之一。这不是免费提升；更小口径还要面对本篇没有计算的衍射与信号限制。
cues.en: Return to the complete mirror and retain a progressively smaller central pupil, refocusing for each aperture. Geometric blur decreases, but accepted area falls with radius squared. Reducing the radius from forty to ten millimetres keeps only one sixteenth of the area. This is not a free improvement; diffraction and signal limitations are outside the geometric model.

cues.title: 改变面形，而非接收面
cues.titleEn: Change the surface, not the screen
cues.caption: 保持顶点与近轴焦距，把球面改为抛物面。
cues.captionEn: Keep vertex and paraxial focal length while changing the sphere to a parabola.
cues.zh: 恢复完整口径，接收面固定在五十毫米处。这次逐渐把球面改为具有相同顶点和近轴焦距的抛物面。细曲线显示相对球面的形变量，反射法线随真实曲面一起变化。焦区中各高度的光逐渐会合，理想轴上几何光斑趋近零；真实衍射光斑仍不会因此消失。
cues.en: Restore the full pupil and fix the screen fifty millimetres from the vertex. Change the sphere toward a parabola with the same vertex and paraxial focal length. The small profile shows its departure from the sphere. As the surface normals change, rays from different heights converge together. Ideal on-axis geometric blur approaches zero, without eliminating real diffraction.

cues.title: 轴上校正仍有条件
cues.caption: 抛物面消除轴上球差，不保证离轴也无其他像差。
cues.captionEn: A parabola corrects on-axis spherical aberration without eliminating every off-axis aberration.
cues.zh: 保留抛物面，只让平行入射光稍微偏离光轴。光斑又开始展开，并出现不对称的分布。这属于离轴像差的边界，包含彗差的表现，不是原来的轴上球差又被调焦调回来。一个设计解决某个条件下的问题，不代表所有视场和所有波动条件都自动得到完美成像。
cues.en: Keep the parabola and tilt the parallel input slightly away from the optical axis. The spot spreads again and becomes asymmetric, illustrating off-axis aberration including coma. This is a different condition from on-axis spherical aberration. Correcting one imaging condition does not automatically produce perfect results across every field or account for wave effects.

cues.title: 先明确原始表示
cues.caption: 8×8 像素，每像素 1 字节，共 64 字节。
cues.captionEn: 8×8 pixels at one byte per pixel: 64 bytes.
cues.zh: 这块图按行遍历，每个颜色索引先占一个字节，合计六十四字节。先约定基础表示，才能准确讨论压缩大小。图上相近的颜色，不一定在遍历顺序里连续。
cues.en: Traverse this image row by row, initially storing each color index in one byte: sixty-four bytes total. Define the baseline before comparing sizes. Nearby colors in a picture are not necessarily adjacent in traversal order.

cues.title: 只合并连续同值
cues.caption: 值不变就增加计数，遇到新值才开启下一段。
cues.captionEn: Increase the count while values match; a new value starts a run.
cues.zh: 扫描第一个色块，值始终为零，连续计数一路增加。遇到下一种值，前段结束，新段重新计数。默认四块横色带各有十六个连续字节，所以最终只有四段。
cues.en: Scan the first block: the byte stays zero and its count grows. A different value closes that run and starts another. The four horizontal bands each contain sixteen consecutive bytes, producing just four runs.

cues.title: 序列化真实字节
cues.caption: 四段各 2 字节，加 R1 头 2 字节，共 10 字节。
cues.captionEn: Four two-byte runs plus a two-byte R1 header total 10 bytes.
cues.zh: R1 是这里明确定义的教学格式。先放两字节头，再依次写变长计数和一个值字节。四个十六都只需一字节计数，四段八字节，加头共十字节。这个数字来自实际码流，不是对图片文件的估算。
cues.en: R1 is the explicitly defined teaching format. Its two-byte header is followed by a variable-length count and one value byte per run. Each sixteen fits one count byte: eight run bytes plus the header total ten. This is an actual byte stream, not an image-file estimate.

cues.title: 按次数展开
cues.caption: 解码逐段恢复，最终字节与原始数据完全相同。
cues.captionEn: Decode each run; the recovered bytes exactly match the original.
cues.zh: 读取十六个零，就展开十六份零，再处理下一段。图像按完整段恢复，最终六十四个字节与原始数据逐一相同。无损指可还原这些数据，不只是画面看上去差不多。
cues.en: Reading sixteen zeros expands to sixteen copies, then decoding continues to the next run. Complete runs restore the image until all sixty-four bytes match the original. Lossless means recovering the data exactly, not merely producing a similar-looking picture.

cues.title: 短段会放大开销
cues.caption: 细竖纹有 64 段，实际 R1 变成 130 字节。
cues.captionEn: Thin stripes have 64 runs and produce 130 R1 bytes.
cues.zh: 换成细竖纹。同样六十四个像素，逐行读却每个字节都换值，于是每一段只有一项。每项都要计数和值，再加格式头，总共一百三十字节。游程编码并不保证缩小。
cues.en: Switch to thin vertical stripes. The same sixty-four pixels alternate on every byte in row order, so every run has length one. Each needs count and value plus the format header, totaling one hundred thirty bytes. Run-length encoding does not guarantee compression.

cues.title: 计数也有编码成本
cues.caption: 127 次用 7f，128 次用 80 01，完整表示从 4 到 5 字节。
cues.captionEn: 127 uses 7f; 128 uses 80 01, growing the full record from 4 to 5 bytes.
cues.zh: 最后看独立字节串的计数边界。一百二十七个相同字节，计数是七 f；一百二十八个，变成八零、零一，需要两字节计数。完整 R1 从四变五字节。压缩收益取决于数据结构，也取决于格式开销。
cues.en: Finally inspect a separate byte-run boundary. One hundred twenty-seven uses count seven-f; one hundred twenty-eight uses eight-zero, zero-one and needs two count bytes. Complete R1 grows from four bytes to five. Savings depend on both data structure and format overhead.

cues.title: 自转之外，还有进动
cues.titleEn: Spin and precession are different rotations
cues.caption: 转盘绕轴自转，轴线绕竖直方向进动。
cues.captionEn: The disk spins about its shaft while the shaft precesses.
cues.zh: 先分清两种转动。转盘绕自己的轴快速自转，整根轴又绕支点的竖直方向缓慢转向，这叫进动。这里预先建立了水平匀速进动，轴一直保持水平。直接松开正在转动的轮子，还可能出现上下摆动；我们先看清这个稳态中的力矩关系。
cues.en: Separate two rotations. The disk spins rapidly about its shaft, while the shaft turns around the vertical through its pivot. That second motion is precession. This scene begins in prepared horizontal steady precession. A direct release can also produce a nodding motion; here we examine the torque relationship in the steady state.

cues.title: 重量仍在，力矩有方向
cues.titleEn: Weight remains; torque has its own direction
cues.caption: 支点承担重量，重力矩沿水平方向。
cues.captionEn: The pivot carries weight; gravity produces horizontal torque.
cues.zh: 金色箭头是作用在质心处的重力。支点反力的竖直分量承担重量，水平分量让质心绕圈。重力相对于支点还有力矩，棕色箭头指向水平切线。力矩不是另一个向下的力；它描述外力怎样改变绕支点的角动量。
cues.en: The gold arrow is weight acting at the center. The pivot reaction supports that weight and supplies the inward force needed for circular motion. Gravity also produces torque about the pivot, shown by the brown horizontal arrow. Torque is not another downward force: it describes how external forces change angular momentum.

cues.title: 力矩让角动量转向
cues.caption: 水平角动量的端点沿圆周移动。
cues.captionEn: The horizontal momentum tip follows a circle.
cues.zh: 俯视蓝色箭头，它表示角动量的水平分量。棕色力矩沿圆周切线，让蓝色箭头不断转向。它的长度保持不变，但方向持续改变。模型还保留一小部分竖直角动量；这个分量在水平匀速进动中保持恒定，所以这里单独画出正在改变方向的水平部分。
cues.en: Look down on the blue arrow, the horizontal part of angular momentum. The brown torque is tangent to its circular path, continually turning the blue direction without changing its length. The model also retains a small vertical momentum component. That component stays constant in this horizontal steady state.

cues.title: 自转加倍，进动减半
cues.caption: 相同重力矩改变更大的角动量，转向更慢。
cues.captionEn: The same torque turns a larger momentum more slowly.
cues.zh: 把自转速度加倍，质量、半径和支点距离保持不变。蓝色水平角动量箭头也加倍长，同一重力矩让它转过同一角度需要更久。进动角速度从大约一点一一降到零点五六弧度每秒。自转更快，稳态进动反而更慢。
cues.en: Double axial spin while keeping mass, radius and pivot distance fixed. The blue horizontal momentum arrow doubles in length. The same torque now takes longer to turn it through a given angle. Precession drops from about one-point-one-one to zero-point-five-six radians per second. Faster spin gives slower steady precession.

cues.title: 反转自转，也反转进动
cues.caption: 重力不变，角动量与进动方向都反转。
cues.captionEn: Gravity stays the same; momentum and precession reverse.
cues.zh: 现在反转转盘自转。水平角动量箭头朝向轴的另一端，而重力矩仍由当前位置和向下的重力决定。为了让角动量的变化符合这个力矩，进动方向也反过来。数值的正负表示方向，并不表示轮子失去了角动量。
cues.en: Reverse the disk spin. Horizontal angular momentum points toward the other end of the shaft, while torque still follows from the current position and downward gravity. To make the momentum change match that torque, precession also reverses. The signs indicate direction; a negative reading does not mean momentum has disappeared.

cues.title: 去掉重力矩
cues.caption: 无重力矩、零初始进动，轴向保持不变。
cues.captionEn: With no gravity torque and zero initial precession, the axis stays fixed.
cues.zh: 最后准备一个没有重力场、也没有初始进动的状态，固定支点仍然保留。转盘继续自转，轴线和蓝色角动量方向保持不变。对比前面，转向来自外部力矩，不是转盘自己选择绕圈。真实释放、摩擦和章动需要另外求解，不能只套用这个稳态公式。
cues.en: Finally prepare zero gravity and zero initial precession, retaining the fixed pivot. The disk still spins, but its shaft and blue momentum direction remain fixed. Compared with the earlier states, the turning comes from external torque. Real release transients, friction and nutation require a separate analysis beyond this steady solution.

cues.title: 均匀空气中的视线
cues.caption: 没有温度梯度时，这条向下的视线直接到达路面。
cues.captionEn: Without a temperature gradient, this downward direction reaches the road.
cues.zh: 先让空气温度均匀。眼睛看向略低于水平线的方向，沿这条方向反向追踪，光路保持直线，最后到达路面。图中的高度已经放大，实际仰角只有零点几度。我们要问的是：热路面上方的空气能不能改变这条路径，让眼睛收到原本来自天空方向的光？
cues.en: Begin with uniform air. Trace outward from an eye looking slightly below horizontal. The path stays straight and reaches the road. Height is exaggerated here; the actual elevation is only a fraction of a degree. Could air above a hot road change this route so the eye receives light from a skyward direction instead?

cues.title: 热空气改变折射率
cues.caption: 地面附近更热、折射率更低，光在薄层中逐渐弯曲。
cues.captionEn: Hotter near-ground air has a lower index, bending the ray within a thin layer.
cues.zh: 逐渐加热近地空气，上方空气仍保持原来的温度。较热空气的密度与折射率更低，光路在向下进入这片区域时不断改变方向。这条光不再到达路面，而是在空气里转向，再朝上方继续延伸。长距离上大部分光路仍接近直线，真正明显的弯曲集中在很薄的一层。
cues.en: Warm the near-ground air while the upper air stays fixed. The warmer, less dense air has a lower refractive index. The ray changes direction continuously as it enters the layer. It now turns before reaching the road and continues upward. Most of the long path remains straight; the significant curvature is concentrated in a thin region.

cues.title: 没有一面空气镜
cues.caption: 放大近地2cm，最低点仍在空气中，切线连续变化。
cues.captionEn: Inside the enlarged 2 cm layer, the minimum stays above ground and the tangent changes continuously.
cues.zh: 现在只放大近地两厘米，横向仍表示二十四米。蓝点是这条光路的最低处，它与路面之间仍留有空气。光线的切线平滑经过水平方向，再转向上方，没有在一条界面上突然折返。这个镜头解释的是连续折射，不能把它理解成地面上出现了一面平整的空气镜子。
cues.en: Enlarge just the lowest two centimetres across a twenty-four-metre window. The blue minimum remains above the road. The tangent passes smoothly through horizontal and turns upward, without a sudden bounce at an interface. This view shows continuous refraction rather than a flat reflecting surface suspended above the pavement.

cues.title: 眼睛按来向定位
cues.caption: 把入眼切线当直线延长，会指向更低的路面位置。
cues.captionEn: Extending the arrival tangent as a straight line points toward the road.
cues.zh: 回到完整路程。蓝色是真实弯曲路径，虚线是眼睛收到光时那一小段方向的直线延长。虚线指向路面附近，真实路径却在远处重新朝向天空。于是天空的亮光出现在较低的方向，让干燥路面看起来像有一片映着天空的水。本模型跟踪的是来光方向，不在这里预测整幅倒像。
cues.en: Return to the complete path. Blue follows the actual ray; the dashed line extends its arrival direction as if it stayed straight. That extension points toward the road, while the actual path turns skyward farther away. Sky light can therefore appear in a low direction, resembling water reflecting the sky. This model follows direction, not a complete inverted image.

cues.title: 并非所有角度都返回
cues.caption: 视线更陡时，光真的到达地面，路径就在那里终止。
cues.captionEn: A steeper direction really reaches the ground, where the ray must stop.
cues.zh: 保持同一温度层，只把向下看的角度变陡。最低处逐渐靠近路面，随后这条光线真正到达地面。图中的轨迹就在接触点结束，不会穿过地下再转回来。是否形成一条回到上方的路径，取决于折射率差和入射方向，并不是热空气能把所有方向的光都送回眼睛。
cues.en: Keep the temperature layer and look more steeply downward. The minimum approaches the road until the ray actually reaches it. The trace stops at contact rather than continuing underground and turning back. A returning skyward route depends on both index contrast and direction. Hot air cannot redirect every possible ray toward the eye.

cues.title: 视点也是条件
cues.caption: 改变眼高，同样入眼角对应的近地位置随之移动。
cues.captionEn: Changing eye height moves the near-ground part of the same viewing direction.
cues.zh: 恢复能转向的仰角，并改变眼高。薄层的温度和厚度没有动，入眼角度也保持相同，但光到达近地层的位置已经改变，直线延长指向的位置也跟着移动。这说明蜃景与观察位置有关。自由探索还可以让近地空气比上方更冷，比较弯曲方向的反转；真实天气中的完整成像还需要更详细的温度结构。
cues.en: Restore a turning direction and change eye height. The layer, temperature and viewing angle stay fixed, but the near-ground encounter and straight viewing extension move. Mirage appearance depends on viewpoint too. Exploration can reverse the temperature gradient and bending direction. Complete real atmospheric images require a more detailed temperature profile.

cues.title: 一个脉冲，一份响应
cues.caption: 索引 2 的单位脉冲，让 h 的 1、0.5、0.25 整体移位。
cues.captionEn: A unit impulse at 2 shifts response 1,0.5,0.25 together.
cues.zh: 先看一个单位脉冲。在线性时不变系统里，它激起固定的冲激响应。脉冲放在索引二，响应的一、零点五、零点二五也从二开始出现，形状保持，只改变位置。
cues.en: Start with one unit impulse. A linear time-invariant system gives its fixed impulse response. Place the impulse at index two, and one, one-half and one-quarter begin at two too. The response keeps its shape and shifts in position.

cues.title: 非对称核要翻转
cues.caption: 原核顺序是 1、0.5、0.25；对齐输入时反向排列。
cues.captionEn: Original order is 1,0.5,0.25; alignment reverses it.
cues.zh: 先看核从零到二的顺序。一旦按输入索引向右排列，要实现 n 减 k，权重就需要反过来，再滑到当前 n。这里故意不用对称核，避免把翻转这个区别藏掉。
cues.en: Inspect the kernel from zero to two. Against increasing input indices, implementing n minus k reverses the weights before sliding them to n. The kernel is deliberately asymmetric so reversal cannot hide behind symmetry.

cues.title: 重叠项相乘再求和
cues.caption: n=3 时，贡献 2、0.5、0，相加得到 2.5。
cues.captionEn: At n=3, contributions 2,0.5,0 sum to 2.5.
cues.zh: 停在 n 等于三。对应样本二乘一，前一个样本一乘零点五，再前一个零乘零点二五。三份贡献相加，得到二点五。每个输出都来自这些真实重叠项，不是直接描出一条平滑曲线。
cues.en: Pause at n equals three. Sample two times one, the preceding one times one-half, and the preceding zero times one-quarter contribute two, one-half and zero. Their sum is two and a half. The output comes from aligned products rather than a decorative smooth curve.

cues.title: 滑动建立整个序列
cues.titleEn: Slide to build the output sequence
cues.caption: 每移动一格，重新计算相应乘积和。
cues.captionEn: Move one index and recompute the aligned product sum.
cues.zh: 沿输出索引继续滑动，每次重新对齐样本，再把贡献相加。组合脉冲的输出逐项建立。核没有归一化成平均值，所以幅度变化由实际权重和决定，不能默认说成只做模糊或平滑。
cues.en: Slide along output indices, realign samples and add contributions each time. The combined pulse builds its output sample by sample. The kernel is not normalized as a mean, so amplitudes follow actual weights; this is not automatically just blurring or smoothing.

cues.title: 相关没有同样翻转
cues.caption: 同一 n=2，卷积为 1，前向相关为 2.25。
cues.captionEn: At the same n=2, convolution is 1 and forward correlation is 2.25.
cues.zh: 把两个结果放在同一零到六的索引窗口。卷积在 n 等于二时为一，前向相关为二点二五。相关在这里使用 n 加 k，而卷积使用 n 减 k。非对称核和这个输入，让两种定义的差别直接显现。
cues.en: Compare both results in the same zero-to-six index window. At n equals two, convolution is one while forward correlation is two and one-quarter. Correlation here uses n plus k; convolution uses n minus k. This asymmetric kernel and input expose the difference.

cues.title: 截取会丢掉真实尾部
cues.caption: 末端脉冲完整输出有尾部 0.5、0.25；取前 7 项会舍弃。
cues.captionEn: The final impulse has a 0.5,0.25 tail; the first-7 crop drops it.
cues.zh: 把单位脉冲移到输入末端。完整零延拓仍保留后面两项零点五、零点二五。若只取前七项，尾部会被舍弃。这是明确的因果截取，不是所有软件里 same 模式的统一含义。
cues.en: Move the unit impulse to the end. Full zero extension retains the following one-half and one-quarter. Keeping only the first seven drops that tail. This is an explicitly causal crop, not a universal meaning of software same mode.

cues.title: 循环边界把尾部折回
cues.titleEn: Periodic boundaries fold the tail back
cues.caption: 周期假设让 0.5、0.25 回到索引 0、1。
cues.captionEn: Periodicity folds 0.5,0.25 into indices 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 最后改成周期边界。输入被假定每七项重复，所以尾部贡献绕回开头，出现在零和一。结果不同，是边界假设不同，不只是换了一种显示裁切。计算、索引和画面必须一起遵守这个约定。
cues.en: Finally assume a periodic boundary. The input repeats every seven samples, so tail contributions wrap into indices zero and one. The result changes because the boundary assumption changes, not merely the display crop.

cues.title: 先保持质量位置不变
cues.caption: 没有外力矩，转台保持原来的角动量。
cues.captionEn: Without external torque, the rotor keeps its angular momentum.
cues.zh: 俯视这个转台，两块相同的质量块通过导轨和内部执行器连在同一个系统上。先让它们保持在外侧。理想轴承没有绕竖直轴的阻力矩，转速保持不变。下方的角动量读数是整个系统绕这根轴的总量，不是单独某一块的数值。
cues.en: Look down on the turntable. Two equal masses are connected through guides and internal actuators as one system. First keep them at the outer radius. The ideal bearing supplies no resisting axial torque, so speed stays constant. The angular-momentum reading belongs to the entire system about this axis.

cues.title: 向内移动，速度上升
cues.caption: 惯量减小，角速度增加，乘积保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Inertia falls and speed rises, preserving their product.
cues.zh: 让内部执行器把两块同时向中心拉。当前轨道缩小，转动惯量下降，转台越来越快。角速度读数上升，角动量却保持二点二九。这里没有额外的外力矩，改变的是质量距转轴的分布；惯量与角速度的乘积仍然相同。
cues.en: The internal actuators draw both masses toward the center. Their orbit shrinks, rotational inertia falls, and the rotor speeds up. Angular speed rises while angular momentum remains two-point-two-nine. With no external axial torque, the changing mass distribution alters inertia and speed while keeping their product fixed.

cues.title: 再向外，转速下降
cues.caption: 相同角动量下，质量远离轴线使速度降低。
cues.captionEn: At fixed momentum, moving mass outward lowers speed.
cues.zh: 现在从收拢的状态开始，把质量块向外移。它们离转轴更远，转动惯量增加，速度逐渐下降。回到原来的半径时，也回到原来的角速度。向内和向外这两个过程说明，决定速度的不只是质量有多少，还包括质量离转轴有多远。
cues.en: Start from the inward state and move the masses outward. Greater distance from the axis increases inertia, reducing speed. Returning to the original radius also restores the original angular speed. Together, inward and outward motion show that rotational behavior depends on where mass is placed, as well as how much there is.

cues.title: 角动量不变，动能增加
cues.titleEn: Momentum stays fixed while energy rises
cues.caption: 增加的动能来自内部执行器做功。
cues.captionEn: Internal actuator work supplies the kinetic-energy increase.
cues.zh: 再看一次收拢，这次跟随能量条。初始动能用刻线标出，当前动能逐渐超过它。终点多出的约三点八八焦耳，正是内部执行器做的功。运动途中还包含很小的径向动能。角动量守恒限制的是惯量与速度的乘积，不会阻止内部能源转化为动能。
cues.en: Repeat the inward motion and follow the energy bar. Its tick marks the initial kinetic energy; the current value grows beyond it. At the endpoint, about three-point-eight-eight extra joules come from internal actuator work. A small radial kinetic-energy term is included during travel. Momentum conservation does not prevent internal energy becoming motion.

cues.title: 只收拢一部分
cues.caption: 半径停在450 mm，得到中间的惯量和速度。
cues.captionEn: Stopping at 450 mm gives intermediate inertia and speed.
cues.zh: 这次只把半径从六百五十毫米收至四百五十毫米。转动惯量确实减小，但没有上次减得那么多，所以速度也只增加一部分。两个质量块对惯量的贡献与半径平方有关，不能把移动距离直接当成速度增加的比例。自由探索可以连续改变这个终点。
cues.en: This time move from six hundred fifty to four hundred fifty millimeters. Inertia decreases, but less than in the full inward move, so speed rises by a smaller amount. The two masses contribute in proportion to radius squared. Travel distance alone therefore does not give a proportional change in speed.

cues.title: 外力矩改变守恒条件
cues.caption: 半径不变，反向外力矩仍会减少角动量。
cues.captionEn: An opposing external torque reduces momentum even at fixed radius.
cues.zh: 最后固定两块的位置，施加反向的外力矩。此时惯量不变，角速度和角动量都下降。外力矩随时间积累的角冲量，正好对应角动量的变化。判断能否使用守恒，先看系统边界以及绕这根轴的外合力矩，而不是只看它有没有在旋转。
cues.en: Finally fix the mass positions and apply opposing external torque. Inertia remains constant while both speed and angular momentum fall. Angular impulse accumulated from the external torque equals the momentum change. To apply conservation, first identify the system and its net external torque about the chosen axis.

cues.title: 压力变化在传播
cues.caption: 波形表示压缩与稀疏，不是管道横向摆动。
cues.captionEn: The curve represents compression and rarefaction, not sideways motion of a tube.
cues.zh: 先看一个沿介质传播的压力脉冲。曲线高于中线代表压缩，低于中线代表稀疏；它不是把空气画成横向起伏的绳子。脉冲向两种介质的边界靠近。这里使用特性比声阻抗，也就是密度乘声速，描述同样的粒子速度对应多大的压力变化。
cues.en: Follow a pressure pulse through a medium. Above the centre line means compression and below means rarefaction, rather than sideways motion of a string. The pulse approaches a boundary. Characteristic specific acoustic impedance, density times sound speed, relates pressure to particle velocity in a travelling plane wave.

cues.title: 一部分返回，一部分通过
cues.caption: 较高阻抗一侧产生同号的反射压力脉冲。
cues.captionEn: A higher-impedance second medium produces an upright reflected pressure pulse.
cues.zh: 让脉冲经过边界。橙色部分返回，浅绿部分进入第二种介质。第二侧阻抗是第一侧的四倍，因此返回的压力脉冲主峰仍然向上，只是幅度为原来的六成。边界两侧的总压力和法向粒子速度必须接续，这两个条件一起确定反射与透射，而不只是由箭头决定声音往哪里走。
cues.en: Let the pulse cross. Orange returns and pale green enters the second medium. Its impedance is four times the first, so reflected pressure retains an upward main peak at sixty percent amplitude. Total pressure and normal particle velocity must both remain continuous at the boundary. Those two conditions determine reflection and transmission together.

cues.title: 压力幅度不是能量份额
cues.titleEn: Pressure amplitude is not an energy share
cues.caption: 透射压力为1.6倍，但透射能量只有64%。
cues.captionEn: Transmitted pressure is 1.6 times the input, but its energy share is only 64%.
cues.zh: 停在同一时刻比较两路。透射压力主峰是一点六倍，看起来超过了入射，是否创造了能量？没有。第二侧阻抗更高，同样压力对应更小的粒子速度，能流要把这两者合起来看。下面记录整束脉冲的能量分配：反射百分之三十六，透射百分之六十四，合起来仍是一百。
cues.en: Freeze the two outgoing portions. Transmitted pressure reaches 1.6 times the incident peak. That does not create energy. A higher impedance gives less particle velocity for a given pressure, and energy flow depends on both. The full-pulse energy shares are thirty-six percent reflected and sixty-four percent transmitted, still adding to one hundred.

cues.title: 低阻抗反过来
cues.caption: 改为低阻抗第二介质，反射压力发生符号翻转。
cues.captionEn: A lower-impedance second medium reverses the reflected pressure sign.
cues.zh: 把第二侧阻抗改成第一侧的四分之一，再发送同样的脉冲。返回主峰现在朝下：原来的压缩在反射压力里变成稀疏。反射幅度仍是六成，能量份额也仍是百分之三十六，因为能量与幅度平方有关。符号记录相位关系，能量份额不能带着这个负号一起理解。
cues.en: Make the second impedance one quarter of the first and send the same pulse again. The reflected main peak now points down: compression becomes rarefaction in reflected pressure. Its magnitude remains sixty percent and its energy share thirty-six percent. Sign describes phase; energy depends on the square of amplitude and does not inherit that negative sign.

cues.title: 速度不同也能不反射
cues.titleEn: Different speeds can still be matched
cues.caption: 保持阻抗相等，只改声速，反射仍为零。
cues.captionEn: With equal impedances, changing sound speed still produces zero reflection.
cues.zh: 现在两侧阻抗相等，只把第二侧声速降低。为保持阻抗相同，第二侧密度相应增加。反射消失，透射脉冲却在同一时刻走得更近、空间宽度也更窄。声速不同不必然产生回声；决定这个正入射匹配条件的是密度与声速的乘积。
cues.en: Match the impedances and lower only the second sound speed, increasing its density correspondingly. Reflection remains zero. At the same snapshot time the transmitted packet travels a shorter distance and occupies a narrower spatial width. Different speeds do not necessarily cause an echo; this normal-incidence match depends on the density–speed product.

cues.title: 再看粒子速度
cues.caption: 反向波的压力与速度反号，不能把压力曲线当速度曲线。
cues.captionEn: Pressure and velocity have opposite signs in a backward wave.
cues.zh: 回到较高阻抗的例子，用实线显示归一化粒子速度，虚线保留同一时刻的压力参考。看返回脉冲：压力主峰向上，速度主峰却向下。对于向右的行波，两者同号；向左传播时，它们反号。边界连续的是总压力和总法向速度，因此讨论反射翻转时必须先说清在看哪一个物理量。
cues.en: Return to the higher-impedance example. Solid now shows normalized particle velocity; dashed retains pressure at the same instant. In the returning packet, pressure points upward while velocity points downward. They have matching signs for a right-going wave and opposite signs for a left-going wave. State which physical quantity you mean before describing a reflection as inverted.

cues.title: 下降方向来自梯度
cues.titleEn: The gradient gives a descent direction
cues.caption: 损失 f=(x²+8y²)/2，负梯度为 (−x,−8y)。
cues.captionEn: Loss f=(x²+8y²)/2 has negative gradient (−x,−8y).
cues.zh: 等高线来自这一个二次损失。y 方向比 x 方向陡八倍，因此负梯度并不是直接指向原点的直线。先沿它选择局部下降方向，再决定实际走多远。
cues.en: These contours come from one quadratic loss. Curvature along y is eight times that along x, so the negative gradient does not point straight to the origin. It selects a local descent direction; the step distance is a separate choice.

cues.title: 用步长决定真实位移
cues.caption: η=0.08 的第一步到 (2.3,0.54)，损失降到 3.8114。
cues.captionEn: With η=.08, the first step reaches (2.3,.54), reducing loss to 3.8114.
cues.zh: 学习率零点零八，把当前位置减去零点零八倍梯度。起点二点五、一点五，真实下一点是二点三、零点五四。损失从十二点一二五降到约三点八一，而不是沿任意画好的轨迹移动。
cues.en: Rate zero point zero eight subtracts that fraction of the gradient. From two point five, one point five, the next point is two point three, zero point five four. Loss falls from twelve point one two five to about three point eight one.

cues.title: 重复同一更新
cues.caption: 两个方向都缩小，有限步后接近最低点。
cues.captionEn: Both components contract, approaching the minimizer over finite steps.
cues.zh: 继续重复这条更新，x 和 y 都逐渐缩小，损失随之下降。画面停在有限步数，接近最低点不等于已经精确到达。这里每一步都重新读取当前位置的梯度。
cues.en: Repeat the update. Both x and y shrink and loss decreases. A finite sequence approaches the minimum without claiming exact arrival. Each step evaluates the gradient at its current position.

cues.title: 之字形也能收敛
cues.caption: η=0.22，y 每步反号但幅度减小，损失仍下降。
cues.captionEn: With η=.22, y alternates sign while shrinking and loss still decreases.
cues.zh: 把学习率改成零点二二。y 每步跨到谷底另一边，形成之字形，但每次越过的幅度都减小，损失依然下降。看见来回摆动，不能只凭形状就断言发散。
cues.en: Change the rate to zero point two two. The y component crosses the valley every step, making a zigzag, but each crossing shrinks and loss still decreases. Alternation alone does not establish divergence.

cues.title: 大步会越过下降区域
cues.caption: η=0.3，让陡方向误差放大，损失增长。
cues.captionEn: At η=.3, the steep-direction error and loss grow.
cues.zh: 再增到零点三。y 的反号幅度越来越大，损失反而上升。图会按这一组完整轨迹调整等比例范围，请同时看坐标刻度。负梯度只保证局部方向，不保证任意大步仍下降。
cues.en: Increase the rate to zero point three. The alternating y magnitude grows and loss rises. Equal-unit axes fit this complete trajectory, so read the tick values too. Negative gradient gives a local direction, not a guarantee for an arbitrarily large step.

cues.title: 临界点不等于安全内部
cues.titleEn: The boundary is not the stable interior
cues.caption: η=0.25 时 |y| 保持 1.5，损失趋近 9 而不是 0。
cues.captionEn: At η=.25, |y| stays 1.5 and loss approaches 9 rather than 0.
cues.zh: 恰好零点二五时，y 只反号，幅度始终是一点五。x 虽继续减少，总损失却接近九，而非零。对这个严格凸二次例子，要从任意起点收敛，步长必须严格小于零点二五；这个结论不能照搬到所有非凸训练。
cues.en: At exactly zero point two five, y changes sign but keeps magnitude one point five. Although x decreases, loss approaches nine rather than zero. For this strictly convex quadratic, convergence from every start needs a rate strictly below zero point two five. That conclusion is not a general guarantee for nonconvex training.

cues.title: 先看均值在哪里
cues.caption: 八点均值为 (4,3)，偏移不等于变化方向。
cues.captionEn: The eight-point mean is (4,3); offset is not variation.
cues.zh: 这八个点的中心在四、三。整组离原点较远，只说明位置偏移，不说明哪种变化最值得保留。PCA 首先区分点云的位置和它内部的变化。
cues.en: The eight-point cloud is centered at four, three. Being far from the origin describes location, not the variation worth preserving. PCA first separates that location from the cloud’s internal variation.

cues.title: 逐列减去均值
cues.caption: 减去 (4,3)，均值到零，点间相对关系不变。
cues.captionEn: Subtract (4,3): the mean reaches zero while point differences stay unchanged.
cues.zh: 逐列减去均值，整组点平移到零附近。点和点之间的相对位置没有改变。接下来让投影轴穿过中心，研究保留哪一个方向，而不把这个整体偏移算进去。
cues.en: Subtract the coordinate means and translate the cloud toward zero. Relative differences between points do not change. The projection axis can now pass through the center, so variation is measured without counting the overall offset.

cues.title: 随便选轴会丢更多
cues.caption: 水平轴保留 3.8125，正交均方误差为 1.4375。
cues.captionEn: The horizontal axis retains 3.8125 with mean-square error 1.4375.
cues.zh: 先用水平轴，把每个点垂直投下去。保留的方差是三点八一二五，丢掉的正交平方误差是一点四三七五。这不是预测某个 y，而是用一维表示整组二维观测。
cues.en: Start with a horizontal axis and project orthogonally. Retained variance is three point eight one two five; discarded mean-square error is one point four three seven five. This represents two-dimensional observations with one dimension rather than predicting y alone.

cues.title: 旋转找到最大变化
cues.caption: 30° 时保留 5、误差 0.25，保留比例约 95.24%。
cues.captionEn: At 30°, retained variance is 5, error 0.25 and retained fraction 95.24%.
cues.zh: 旋转投影轴，金色投影更分散，虚线残差逐渐缩短。到三十度，保留方差为五，平均平方误差只剩零点二五。最大保留方差与最小正交误差，是这组中心化线性投影的两个等价目标。
cues.en: Rotate the axis. The gold projections spread while residual segments shorten. At thirty degrees, retained variance is five and mean squared error is one-quarter. Maximum retained variance and minimum orthogonal error are equivalent goals for this centered linear projection.

cues.title: 保留多数，仍会丢信息
cues.titleEn: Most variation is not all information
cues.caption: 八个点压成一维，成对点得到相同坐标。
cues.captionEn: Eight observations become one-dimensional scores; pairs share a coordinate.
cues.zh: 保留百分之九十五以上，不代表什么都没丢。八个点的一维坐标成对相同，重建只能落在轴上，不能恢复被丢掉的另一侧偏移。误差零点二五正记录了这种损失。
cues.en: Retaining over ninety-five percent does not preserve everything. Pairs of the eight points share a score. Reconstruction lies on the axis and cannot recover the discarded side displacement. The one-quarter error records that loss.

cues.title: 单位改变度量
cues.caption: x 数值乘 10，主轴与保留比例随新单位改变。
cues.captionEn: Multiply x by 10: the principal axis and fraction change with the units.
cues.zh: 把 x 的数值单位放大十倍，再重新计算。主方向更靠近水平，保留比例也变了。不是数据突然更有意义，而是协方差采用的距离度量变了；是否标准化要根据问题决定。
cues.en: Multiply x values by ten and refit. The principal direction moves closer to horizontal and the retained fraction changes. The data have not suddenly become more meaningful: the covariance metric changed. Standardization must follow the problem.

cues.title: 有时没有唯一第一方向
cues.titleEn: Sometimes no first direction is unique
cues.caption: 等方差四点在任何轴上都保留 0.5、丢失 0.5。
cues.captionEn: The isotropic points retain 0.5 and lose 0.5 in every direction.
cues.zh: 换成各方向等方差的四点，转动任何轴，保留和误差始终各为零点五。这里没有唯一第一主方向。PCA 找的是选定度量下的变化结构，不自动揭示因果，也不保证得到最好的预测特征。
cues.en: Use four isotropic points. Rotating the axis keeps retained variance and error at one-half each. No unique first direction exists. PCA finds variation under a chosen metric; it neither establishes causes nor guarantees the best predictive features.

cues.title: 相同质量的小车相遇
cues.caption: 等质量时，分离后速度交换。
cues.captionEn: Equal masses exchange velocities after separation.
cues.zh: 左边一千克的小车驶向同样重、暂时静止的右车。弹簧接触后，左车慢下来，右车动起来。分离时，左车停止，右车获得原来的速度。先记住这个等质量结果，接下来把接触放慢，看动量和能量怎样经过两只弹簧。
cues.en: A one-kilogram cart approaches an identical stationary cart. After their springs meet, the left cart slows and the right cart starts moving. At separation the left cart stops and the right cart has its original speed. Keep that equal-mass result in mind as we slow down the contact.

cues.title: 压缩时，动能暂存
cues.caption: 接触力等大反向，部分动能变成弹簧能量。
cues.captionEn: Equal opposite forces transfer kinetic energy into the springs.
cues.zh: 放大两只接触弹簧。它们各自缩短，端板保持相接，作用在小车上的力等大反向。绿色的平移动能减少，金色的弹簧能量增加，总量保持不变。压缩最深时，两车瞬时速度相同，但弹簧力还存在，碰撞过程还没有结束。
cues.en: Enlarge the contacting springs. Both shorten while their endplates remain together, exerting equal opposite forces on the carts. Green translational kinetic energy falls as gold spring energy grows, preserving their sum. At maximum compression the carts briefly share a velocity, but spring force remains. The collision is not over.

cues.title: 回弹把能量交回来
cues.caption: 弹簧恢复原长后，平移动能恢复。
cues.captionEn: After the springs regain their free length, kinetic energy is restored.
cues.zh: 接着看回弹。弹簧继续向两侧推，左车进一步减速，右车继续加速。金色能量逐渐回到绿色部分。恢复原长时，接触力降为零，两车分开。弹性碰撞要求碰撞前后总平移动能相同，并不要求变形过程中的平移动能始终不变。
cues.en: During extension, the springs keep pushing outward. The left cart slows further and the right cart accelerates, returning the gold stored energy to the green segment. At free length the contact force reaches zero and the carts separate. Elasticity concerns the kinetic energy before and after contact, not every instant of deformation.

cues.title: 轻车撞重车，会反弹
cues.titleEn: A light cart rebounds from a heavy one
cues.caption: 质量不相同，速度不再简单交换。
cues.captionEn: Unequal masses do not simply exchange velocities.
cues.zh: 把右车增加到三千克，左车仍是一千克，以每秒一米靠近。这次分离后，左车以每秒零点五米反弹，右车以同样的速率向前。两车接触冲量仍等大反向，但相同冲量作用于不同质量，带来的速度变化不同。
cues.en: Make the right cart three kilograms while the one-kilogram left cart approaches at one meter per second. After contact the left rebounds at half a meter per second, while the right moves forward at that speed. Their contact impulses remain equal and opposite, but equal impulse changes unequal masses by different velocities.

cues.title: 重车让轻车跑得更快
cues.titleEn: A heavy cart sends the light one faster
cues.caption: 轻车可以比重车原先更快，总能量仍守恒。
cues.captionEn: The light cart can leave faster than the incoming heavy cart.
cues.zh: 交换两车质量。三千克左车撞上静止的一千克右车，分离后自己仍向前，速度降到每秒零点五米；右车达到每秒一点五米。轻车更快，并没有违反能量守恒。计算能量要同时看质量和速度平方，不能只比较一个物体的速度。
cues.en: Swap the masses. A three-kilogram cart strikes a stationary one-kilogram cart. The heavy cart continues forward at half a meter per second, while the light cart reaches one-point-five. That higher outgoing speed does not violate energy conservation. Kinetic energy depends on both mass and speed squared across the complete system.

cues.title: 换到质心参考系
cues.caption: 两车动量等大反向，质心保持静止。
cues.captionEn: The two momenta are equal and opposite around a fixed center.
cues.zh: 最后让两车相向运动，并明确切到质心参考系。中间的虚线固定，下方改为显示两车各自的动量。它们始终等大反向，接触前后方向互换；质量不同，所以速度大小仍不同。换参考系改变读数，但不改变弹簧压缩或两车之间的相对运动。
cues.en: Finally let the carts approach one another and explicitly switch to the center-of-mass frame. The dashed center stays fixed, and the readings now show each cart’s momentum. They remain equal and opposite, reversing through contact. Unequal masses still have unequal speeds. Changing frame preserves spring compression and relative motion.

cues.title: 开放端不等于空气不动
cues.titleEn: An open end does not freeze the air
cues.caption: 开放端压力变化接近零，空气位移却可以很大。
cues.captionEn: An open end has nearly zero pressure variation but can have large particle motion.
cues.zh: 先看两端开放的等效声柱。浅色点沿管的方向来回移动，旁边的蓝线表示同一时刻的压力变化。开放端的压力节点，并不是空气粒子被钉住的位置；相反，粒子在开放端附近可以有较大的往复位移。当前基频把半个波长放进声柱中。
cues.en: Start with an equivalent column open at both ends. Pale particles move along the pipe, while blue shows pressure at the same instant. A pressure node at an open end does not pin the air in place. Particle displacement can be large there. The fundamental fits half a wavelength into the column.

cues.title: 经过平衡时动得最快
cues.caption: 压力与位移减小时，粒子速度可以正在增大。
cues.captionEn: Pressure and displacement can fall while particle speed grows.
cues.zh: 把振动缓缓推进四分之一周期。压力曲线逐渐回到中线，粒子也穿过自己的平衡位置，但金色速度箭头正在变长。位移小不等于速度小，压力曲线也不能直接当成空气速度曲线。在同一个正常模态中，空间节点的位置和随时间变化的相位，两者都需要分清。
cues.en: Advance one quarter-cycle slowly. Pressure approaches its centre line and particles pass their equilibrium positions, while the gold velocity arrows grow. Small displacement does not mean small velocity, and pressure is not a velocity plot. Both spatial node positions and time phase matter within one normal mode.

cues.title: 封闭顶端
cues.caption: 同样长度，一端塞闭后的基频约低一个八度。
cues.captionEn: At the same length, stopping one end lowers the ideal fundamental by an octave.
cues.zh: 保持声柱长度不变，塞闭顶端。顶端空气不能穿过塞子，位移节点固定在那里，压力却成为波腹。另一端仍是压力节点，因此基频只需要四分之一个波长就能填满声柱。允许的波长比原来长一倍，频率变成一半，也就是低一个八度。
cues.en: Keep the column length and stop the top. Air cannot move through the cap, so displacement has a node there while pressure has an antinode. The other end remains pressure-release. The fundamental now fits a quarter-wavelength into the length. Its wavelength doubles and frequency halves: one octave lower.

cues.title: 第二个模态不是二倍频
cues.titleEn: The second mode is not twice the fundamental
cues.caption: 理想塞闭圆柱的下一允许模态是三倍基频。
cues.captionEn: The next allowed stopped-cylinder mode is three times the fundamental.
cues.zh: 保持塞闭结构，换到下一个允许模态。管内多出节点，但两端仍必须分别满足开放与封闭条件。这个模式的频率是基频三倍，而不是两倍。下面的理想频率标记因此跳过偶数。它们表示可满足边界的模态，不是在预测真实风琴每个泛音的响度。
cues.en: Keep the stopped geometry and select the next allowed mode. Additional nodes appear, while the two ends must still satisfy their different conditions. This mode is three times the fundamental, not twice. The ideal frequency markers skip even multiples. They indicate allowed modes rather than predicting the loudness of a real organ’s harmonics.

cues.title: 长度选择音高
cues.caption: 同样边界下，声柱变长，允许波长增长，频率下降。
cues.captionEn: With the same boundaries, a longer column gives a longer wavelength and lower frequency.
cues.zh: 回到塞闭管的基频，让实际声柱逐渐变长。边界类型不变，管内仍放四分之一个波长，但这一段现在更长，所以频率下降。管口与塞子的距离拉长，压力分布也随声柱展开。画面中的长度与读数同步变化。更精确地预测真实乐器，还需要管径、端口和驱动过程等条件。
cues.en: Return to the stopped fundamental and lengthen the column. The boundary types stay the same and still contain a quarter-wavelength, now a longer one, so frequency falls. Follow the increasing distance from the mouth to the cap as the pressure pattern stretches. Predicting a real instrument more precisely also requires bore, openings and excitation conditions.

cues.title: 开放端不是精确零面
cues.titleEn: The open boundary is not exactly at the rim
cues.caption: 低频端修正把压力节点移到管口之外，使频率略降。
cues.captionEn: Low-frequency end correction moves the pressure node outside the rim and lowers frequency.
cues.zh: 最后开放两端，放大下端管口。加入低频端修正后，蓝色压力节点逐渐移到管口外面，几何长度没变，有效声长却增加了，频率略微降低。每个无凸缘开放端这里取零点六一倍半径。这只是近似边界模型，不能把它当成任意管形、任意频率都通用的精确修正。
cues.en: Open both ends and enlarge the lower rim. Adding low-frequency end correction moves the pressure node slightly outside. Geometric length stays fixed, effective length grows, and frequency decreases. Each unflanged open end adds about 0.61 radii here. This approximation is not an exact correction for every bore, opening or frequency.

cues.title: 空气也能组成振子
cues.caption: 颈部空气来回运动，腔内压力随之变化。
cues.captionEn: Neck air moves back and forth as cavity pressure changes.
cues.zh: 看这只刚性容器的剖面。金色区域是颈部一同往复运动的空气，位移已经放大。它向外移动时，腔内空气占据的体积稍微增加，压力下降；向内移动时则压缩腔内空气，压力上升。这里跟踪的是颈部空气的惯性与腔内空气的压缩，不需要在瓶身里放进半个波长。
cues.en: Watch the rigid cavity in section. Gold marks the neck air moving together, with displacement enlarged. An outward motion slightly expands the cavity air and lowers its pressure. An inward motion compresses it and raises pressure. This oscillator combines neck-air inertia with cavity compression; it need not fit half a wavelength inside the vessel.

cues.title: 从压缩能到动能
cues.caption: 经过平衡位置时，颈部空气速度最大。
cues.captionEn: Neck-air speed is greatest through equilibrium.
cues.zh: 从颈部空气偏在外侧的状态开始。腔内较低的压力把它拉回，金色空气柱接近平衡位置，压缩能逐渐转成动能。经过平衡位置时，腔内压力变化为零，空气却没有停下。惯性让它继续向内，接着压高腔内压力，准备再次折返。
cues.en: Begin with the neck air displaced outward. Reduced cavity pressure pulls it back. As the gold column approaches equilibrium, compression energy becomes kinetic energy. At equilibrium, the pressure perturbation is zero but the air has not stopped. Its inertia carries it inward, raising cavity pressure before the next reversal.

cues.title: 装水为什么升高音调
cues.caption: 空气体积越小，同样位移产生的压力变化越大。
cues.captionEn: Less cavity air gives a larger pressure change for the same displacement.
cues.zh: 保持颈部不变，逐渐升高静止水面。水占去一部分容积，剩余空气更少。同样的颈部位移，现在带来更大的相对体积变化，压力的恢复作用更强，所以频率升高。这里水面只是设置空气体积；画面没有把水的振动当成这个共鸣的动力。
cues.en: Keep the neck unchanged and raise the stationary water level. Less air remains in the cavity. The same neck displacement now changes a larger fraction of that volume, producing a stronger pressure restoring force and a higher frequency. Water sets the air volume here; its own vibration is outside this model.

cues.title: 长颈增加惯性
cues.caption: 同样腔体，更长的空气柱使振动变慢。
cues.captionEn: With the same cavity, a longer moving air column lowers frequency.
cues.zh: 把水面和颈部半径固定，只伸长颈部。参与往复的空气质量增加，而腔内的压缩关系不变。同样的压力恢复作用，需要推动更多空气，因此振动变慢，频率下降。观察几何颈长和有效颈长，它们始终保留同一组端口修正。
cues.en: Hold water level and neck radius fixed, then lengthen the neck. More air participates in the motion while the cavity compression law stays unchanged. The same pressure restoring force must accelerate more mass, so the frequency falls. Geometric and effective neck lengths retain the same end corrections throughout.

cues.title: 宽颈不只是更重
cues.titleEn: A wider neck changes more than mass
cues.caption: 截面积同时改变惯性、体积通量和恢复力。
cues.captionEn: Area changes inertia, volume displacement and restoring force together.
cues.zh: 现在加宽颈部。空气柱确实变重，但相同位移也扫过更大体积，让腔内压力变化增大；压力还作用在更大面积上。在当前模型和这些尺寸中，恢复作用的增长占上风，频率上升。只说空气越重音调越低，会漏掉截面积同时改变的另外两件事。
cues.en: Widen the neck. Its moving air does become heavier, but the same displacement also sweeps a larger volume, causing a larger cavity-pressure change. That pressure acts over a larger area too. For these dimensions, the stronger restoring effect wins and frequency rises. Mass alone cannot predict the effect of changing neck area.

cues.title: 管口不是运动终点
cues.caption: 加入两端附近的空气，有效颈长增加、频率降低。
cues.captionEn: Air near both ends adds effective length and lowers frequency.
cues.zh: 最后保持器物尺寸不变，逐渐加入端修正。金色虚框延伸到颈部内外，因为附近空气也随颈部空气运动。增加的是参与惯性的有效质量，计算频率因此降低。这个修正只是近似；腔体尺寸远小于声波波长、壁面刚性、振幅足够小时，集中参数的图像才适合使用。
cues.en: Keep the vessel dimensions fixed and add end corrections. The gold outline extends inside and outside the neck because nearby air moves with the neck air. This adds effective inertial mass and lowers the calculated frequency. The correction is approximate. The compact picture requires a rigid cavity much smaller than the wavelength and sufficiently small oscillations.

cues.title: 质心不是几何中点
cues.caption: 较重的平台，让质心更靠近平台中心。
cues.captionEn: The heavier platform draws the center closer to its midpoint.
cues.zh: 平台是一百二十千克，左侧配重是六十千克。把它们连同导轨和内部驱动作为一个系统。金色虚线表示系统质心的水平投影，它位于两部分中心之间，更靠近较重的平台。质心要按质量加权，不能简单取两个位置的中点。
cues.en: The platform is one hundred twenty kilograms and the left-hand cargo is sixty. Include both, their guide and the internal drive in one system. The gold line marks the horizontal center of mass, between their centers but closer to the heavier platform. Mass weighting matters; a geometric midpoint would be wrong.

cues.title: 配重前进，平台后退
cues.titleEn: Cargo advances while the platform retreats
cues.caption: 无水平外力、最初静止，系统质心保持不动。
cues.captionEn: With no external horizontal force and no initial drift, the center stays fixed.
cues.zh: 让配重沿导轨向右移动。平台随之向左退，地面刻线和金色质心线保持原位。内部驱动能改变两部分的相对位置，但对整个系统的水平合力为零。这个例子最初整体静止，所以系统质心仍然停在原来的位置。
cues.en: Move the cargo right along the guide. The platform shifts left while the ground marks and gold center line stay fixed. The internal drive changes the relative positions of the parts, but contributes zero net horizontal force to the complete system. Since that system began at rest, its center remains at its original position.

cues.title: 相对平台与相对地面
cues.titleEn: Platform-relative travel differs from ground travel
cues.caption: 相对平台走1.6 m，配重对地只走约1.07 m。
cues.captionEn: A 1.6 m relative trip moves the cargo about 1.07 m over the ground.
cues.zh: 跟随两条位移读数，它们都以地面为参照。配重相对平台走了一点六米，但平台已经退了约零点五三米，所以配重对地只走约一点零七米。把两段带方向的地面位移分别乘上质量，正好抵消。不能把内部行程直接当成整体前进的距离。
cues.en: Both displacement readings use the ground. The cargo travels one-point-six meters relative to the platform, but the platform retreats about zero-point-five-three. The cargo therefore advances only about one-point-zero-seven over the ground. Multiplying their signed ground displacements by their masses gives cancelling contributions. Internal travel is not whole-system travel.

cues.title: 质量相同，位移对称
cues.caption: 两部分同为120 kg，对地位移等大反向。
cues.captionEn: Both parts are 120 kg and travel equal distances in opposite directions.
cues.zh: 把配重增加到一百二十千克，平台质量不变。现在两部分一样重，内部走过同样的一点六米，它们对地各移动零点八米，方向相反。总质心仍不动。较轻的部分通常移动更多，质量改变的是两部分怎样分配相对位移。
cues.en: Increase the cargo to one hundred twenty kilograms, leaving the platform unchanged. The masses are now equal. Across the same one-point-six-meter relative trip, each moves zero-point-eight meters over the ground in opposite directions. The center stays fixed. Mass determines how the parts share the relative travel.

cues.title: 无外力，也可以一直前进
cues.titleEn: Zero external force can still mean steady motion
cues.caption: 质心原先有速度，就保持匀速运动。
cues.captionEn: A center with initial velocity continues at that constant velocity.
cues.zh: 重新用六十千克配重，但让整个系统一开始就以每秒零点三五米前进。配重仍在内部移动，金色质心线却匀速通过固定的地面刻线。位移曲线是一条直线。无外力保证的是质心速度不变，只有最初速度为零时，质心才会停住。
cues.en: Return to sixty-kilogram cargo, but give the whole system an initial speed of zero-point-three-five meters per second. The cargo still moves internally while the gold center line crosses fixed ground marks uniformly. Its displacement graph is straight. Zero external force preserves center velocity; it implies rest only when the initial velocity is zero.

cues.title: 外力让质心加速
cues.titleEn: An external force accelerates the center
cues.caption: 外合力除以总质量，决定质心加速度。
cues.captionEn: Net external force divided by total mass gives center acceleration.
cues.zh: 最后从整体静止开始，对平台施加向右的三十六牛顿外力。平台和配重总质量是一百八十千克，因此质心加速度为每秒平方零点二米。金线越来越快，三秒位移达到零点九米。内部驱动决定配重怎样相对平台移动，外合力决定整个系统的质心怎样加速。
cues.en: Finally start the system at rest and apply a thirty-six-newton rightward force to the platform. Total mass is one hundred eighty kilograms, so the center accelerates at zero-point-two meters per second squared. The gold line speeds up, traveling zero-point-nine meters in three seconds. Internal actuation sets relative travel; external force sets center acceleration.

cues.title: 下一步只问当前状态
cues.caption: 每一行描述从当前状态出发的下一步概率。
cues.captionEn: Each row gives next-step probabilities conditional on the present state.
cues.zh: A 和 B 是两个抽象状态。从 A 出发，下一步有八成留在 A，两成转去 B；从 B 出发，三成转去 A。这里假设转移规则固定，而且给定当前状态后，不再需要更早的历史。
cues.en: A and B are abstract states. From A, eighty percent remain in A and twenty percent move to B. From B, thirty percent move to A. We assume fixed transition rules, with the present state providing all the history needed for the next step.

cues.title: 概率质量怎样流动
cues.caption: 从全 A 出发，一步后成为 80% A、20% B。
cues.captionEn: Starting entirely in A produces 80% A and 20% B after one step.
cues.zh: 先把全部概率放在 A。蓝色带把其中八成送回 A，两成送去 B。B 起初没有概率质量，因此这一刻不会从 B 流出。带子的粗细表示当前概率乘以条件转移概率，不是只看矩阵数字。
cues.en: Start with all probability mass in A. Blue ribbons send eighty percent back to A and twenty percent to B. No mass leaves B because none starts there. Ribbon width multiplies the current probability by the conditional transition probability.

cues.title: 重复更新逐渐接近
cues.caption: 固定规则反复更新，分布趋近 60% A、40% B。
cues.captionEn: Repeated updates under these rules approach 60% A and 40% B.
cues.zh: 继续用同一组规则更新。每一步都把所有流入 A 的质量相加，再对 B 做同样的事。最初的全 A 分布逐渐接近六成和四成。这里接近的是总体概率分布，不要求每条个体轨迹都长得一样。
cues.en: Repeat the update, summing all mass arriving at each state. The initial all-A distribution approaches sixty percent in A and forty percent in B. This is the population distribution; individual trajectories need not follow the same sequence.

cues.title: 分布不动，个体仍动
cues.caption: 60/40 更新后仍是 60/40，个体轨迹仍能切换。
cues.captionEn: The 60/40 distribution stays fixed while an individual can still switch.
cues.zh: 从六成、四成直接开始，下一步仍然相同。两个方向各交换百分之十二的质量，流入流出恰好平衡。下面选一条从 A 开始的个体轨迹，它仍会切换；稳态不等于所有个体停在原地。
cues.en: Start directly at sixty-forty and the next distribution is unchanged. Twelve percent crosses in each direction, so exchanges balance. Below, one selected individual starting in A can still switch. A stationary distribution does not mean that individuals stop moving.

cues.title: 规则改变，平衡也变
cues.caption: A→B 为 50%、B→A 为 10%，稳态改为约 16.7/83.3。
cues.captionEn: With A→B at 50% and B→A at 10%, stationarity becomes about 16.7/83.3.
cues.zh: 把离开 A 的概率改成五成，离开 B 的概率改成一成。B 更容易留住质量，新的平衡变成六分之一在 A、六分之五在 B。稳态由转移规则决定，并不是预先指定的六成、四成。
cues.en: Make leaving A fifty percent likely and leaving B ten percent likely. B retains more mass. The new balance has one-sixth in A and five-sixths in B. Transition rules determine stationarity; the earlier sixty-forty split was not a universal target.

cues.title: 存在不保证收敛
cues.caption: 每步必定翻转；50/50 是稳态，全 A 起点却永远交替。
cues.captionEn: Every step flips; 50/50 is stationary, but an all-A start alternates forever.
cues.zh: 现在每一步都必定去另一个状态。从全 A 出发，分布在全 A 和全 B 之间来回跳动。五成、五成仍然是唯一稳态，可这个起点永远不走向它。周期性让稳态的存在与收敛成为两件事。
cues.en: Now every step must switch. Starting entirely in A makes the distribution alternate between all A and all B. Fifty-fifty is still the unique stationary distribution, but this start never approaches it. Periodicity separates existence from convergence.

cues.title: 完全不转移，稳态不唯一
cues.caption: 两项转移概率都为零，每种初始分布都保持。
cues.captionEn: With both switching probabilities at zero, every initial distribution stays fixed.
cues.zh: 最后让两项切换概率都变成零。全 A 不变，四分之一在 A 的分布也不变。这里不是没有稳态，而是稳态不唯一。判断长期行为，要分别问稳态是否存在、是否唯一，以及给定起点能否收敛。
cues.en: Finally, set both switching probabilities to zero. All A stays fixed, and so does a distribution with one-quarter in A. Stationary distributions are nonunique, rather than absent. Ask separately about existence, uniqueness and convergence from a specified start.

cues.title: 真空并不隔绝辐射
cues.titleEn: A vacuum does not stop radiation
cues.caption: 物体发射辐射，也吸收环境送来的辐射。
cues.captionEn: The object emits radiation and absorbs radiation from its surroundings.
cues.zh: 中央球面与外面的恒温黑腔之间，没有传导或对流通道。金色线表示球面发射，蓝色线表示球面吸收的环境辐射。两件事同时发生。球面比黑腔温度高，发射功率超过吸收功率，差值才是净向外传出的热。不要把发射功率本身当成全部热损失。
cues.en: There is no conduction or convection path between the sphere and the isothermal black enclosure. Gold shows emission; blue shows radiation absorbed from the surroundings. Both happen at once. The hotter sphere emits more than it absorbs. Their difference, rather than emission alone, is the net outward heat transfer.

cues.title: 相等不代表停止
cues.caption: 同温时两项相等，净热流为零。
cues.captionEn: At equal temperatures, the two powers balance and net heat flow is zero.
cues.zh: 保持球面温度不变，让黑腔逐渐升温。蓝色吸收功率上升，金色发射仍保持原值。当两者温度相同，两项功率相等，净热流降到零，但两个方向的辐射都还存在。热平衡描述的是能量收支，不是所有微观交换一起停止。
cues.en: Keep the sphere temperature fixed and warm the enclosure. Absorbed power rises while emitted power stays unchanged. At equal temperatures, the two powers balance and net heat transfer reaches zero. Radiation still travels in both directions. Thermal equilibrium is an energy balance, not a halt to microscopic exchange.

cues.title: 四次方看的是开尔文
cues.caption: 绝对温度加倍，发射功率变为十六倍。
cues.captionEn: Doubling absolute temperature multiplies emission by sixteen.
cues.zh: 把黑腔恢复为三百开尔文，再将球面从三百升到六百开尔文。表面积和发射率没有变，球面发射功率却变成原来的十六倍。这里的加倍必须使用绝对温度。环境仍不断向球面送入辐射，所以净向外的功率要减去吸收项，不能直接照搬十六倍。
cues.en: Restore the enclosure to three hundred kelvins and heat the sphere from three hundred to six hundred. With area and emissivity fixed, emission increases sixteenfold. This doubling must use absolute temperature. The enclosure continues supplying absorbed radiation, so net outward power is emission minus absorption; it does not inherit that same simple ratio.

cues.title: 低发射率改变两项
cues.caption: 灰体发射减弱，吸收也按相同比例减弱。
cues.captionEn: A grey surface emits less and absorbs less by the same factor.
cues.zh: 固定两个温度，只降低灰体发射率。金色发射和蓝色吸收一起减小，净热流的方向仍由两个温度决定。低发射率不是只能阻止热向外走的单向阀。这个比较使用同一个发射率处理所有波长；真实材料的可见颜色，不足以告诉我们它在热红外中的发射率。
cues.en: Fix both temperatures and lower grey-surface emissivity. Emission and absorption fall together, while the temperature ordering still determines net direction. Low emissivity is not a one-way valve against outward heat. This comparison uses one value at every wavelength. A material’s visible colour alone cannot establish its thermal-infrared emissivity.

cues.title: 环境更热会怎样
cues.caption: 球面仍在发射，但吸收更强，净能量向内。
cues.captionEn: The sphere still emits, but stronger absorption gives a net inward transfer.
cues.zh: 保持球面四百开尔文，继续升高黑腔温度。当黑腔超过球面，吸收功率超过发射功率，净热流转向球面内部。金色发射没有消失。画面中两个温度都由外界维持，因此读数表示这一瞬间需要平衡的辐射功率，而不是已经算出球面随时间升温的过程。
cues.en: Hold the sphere at four hundred kelvins and raise the enclosure temperature beyond it. Absorbed power overtakes emission, reversing net heat transfer into the sphere. Emission does not disappear. Both temperatures are externally maintained here, so the readings describe radiative powers, not a computed warming history of the sphere.

cues.title: 热辐射不需要看得见
cues.titleEn: Thermal radiation need not be visible
cues.caption: 三百到六百开尔文的谱峰仍在红外。
cues.captionEn: The peak remains in the infrared from three hundred to six hundred kelvins.
cues.zh: 最后展开球面发射的光谱。虚线是三百开尔文参考，实线随当前温度变化，每条曲线都按自己的峰值归一。升温时谱峰向短波长移动，从约九点七微米移到四点八微米，但仍处于红外。归一化图只比较峰的位置；真实总发射功率的增长，仍由前面的四次方关系给出。
cues.en: Open the emission spectrum. The dashed curve is the three-hundred-kelvin reference; the solid curve follows current temperature. Each is normalized to its own peak. Warming shifts the peak from about nine point seven to four point eight micrometres, still in the infrared. This normalized view compares peak location; the fourth-power law describes the growth in total emitted power.

cues.title: 把面积变成命中比例
cues.titleEn: Turn area into a hit fraction
cues.caption: 独立均匀抽样时，圆内命中比例估计 π/4。
cues.captionEn: Independent uniform sampling makes the hit fraction estimate π/4.
cues.zh: 单位正方形里，曲线围出四分之一圆。点落在曲线内就算命中。只有在点独立、均匀地落在整个正方形时，命中比例才估计面积比例。这里圆的面积已知为圆周率的四分之一，用来核对方法。
cues.en: A quarter circle sits inside a unit square. Points inside the curve count as hits. Under independent uniform sampling, the hit fraction estimates the area fraction. Here the known area, one-quarter of pi, lets us check the method.

cues.title: 真实计数给出估计
cues.caption: 每个新增点改变整数计数，估计为 4×命中/N。
cues.captionEn: Each point updates integer counts; the estimate is 4×hits/N.
cues.zh: 看这些点依次加入。命中和总数都来自实际坐标判定，再把命中比例乘四。早期只有几个点，估计会大幅变动。这里没有把结果强行拉向圆周率，也不会为了画面漂亮而换掉没命中的点。
cues.en: Each new point changes the actual hit count and sample count. Multiply their ratio by four. With only a few points, estimates can jump substantially. Misses remain in the sequence, and no correction pulls the result toward pi.

cues.title: 更多点，不保证步步更准
cues.titleEn: More points need not improve every step
cues.caption: 前缀估计会上下波动，不单调逼近已知基准。
cues.captionEn: Prefix estimates fluctuate instead of approaching the reference monotonically.
cues.zh: 继续累积同一序列，下面的曲线记录每个前缀的估计。它有时靠近基准，有时暂时远离。更多样本减少的是典型随机波动，不是保证下一点加入后，实际误差一定更小。
cues.en: Continue the same sequence. The trace records estimates of its prefixes, sometimes nearer the reference and sometimes farther away. More samples reduce typical sampling fluctuation; they do not guarantee that the next added point decreases the realized error.

cues.title: 同样数量，也有不同结果
cues.titleEn: Equal counts can give different results
cues.caption: 四个固定种子各取 256 点，估计不同。
cues.captionEn: Four fixed seeds each use 256 points and produce different estimates.
cues.zh: 这四次演示各用二百五十六个点，只改变固定种子。估计值并不完全相同，说明同样数量的抽样也会产生不同误差。单看某一次特别接近的结果，不能推出这套方法总是这么精确。
cues.en: These four demonstrations each use two hundred fifty-six points, changing only the fixed seed. Their estimates differ. Equal sample counts can produce different realized errors, so one unusually close result does not establish the method’s typical precision.

cues.title: 样本乘四，标准误差减半
cues.caption: 独立均匀条件下，N 从 1024 到 4096，理论 SE 减半。
cues.captionEn: Under independent uniform sampling, N rising from 1024 to 4096 halves theoretical SE.
cues.zh: 在独立均匀条件下，理论标准误差按样本量平方根的倒数下降。样本从一千零二十四变成四千零九十六，标准误差减半。显示的百分之九十五的 Wilson 区间描述重复抽样方法的覆盖性质，不保证这一个区间必定包含圆周率。
cues.en: Under independent uniform sampling, theoretical standard error decreases as the inverse square root of sample count. Moving from one thousand twenty-four samples to four thousand ninety-six halves it. The nominal ninety-five percent Wilson interval describes repeated-sampling coverage, without guaranteeing that this particular interval contains pi.

cues.title: 更多点不能修复抽样偏差
cues.titleEn: More points cannot repair sampling bias
cues.caption: 改用 x=u²，点偏向左侧，未加权命中比例不再表示面积。
cues.captionEn: With x=u², points favor the left; an unweighted hit fraction no longer measures area.
cues.zh: 保持同一个底层序列，却把横坐标改成原随机数的平方。点更多地挤到左侧，命中概率提高。此时继续把比例乘四，会稳定在错误目标附近。增加数量只能减小这个错误目标周围的波动，不能把非均匀抽样变成均匀面积。
cues.en: Keep the same underlying sequence but square the horizontal coordinate. Points crowd toward the left and hits become more likely. Multiplying that fraction by four now targets the wrong quantity. More points reduce variation around this wrong target; they do not turn nonuniform sampling into uniform area.

cues.title: 没有样本，与只有一次命中
cues.caption: N=0 时未定义；N=1 即使命中，区间仍很宽。
cues.captionEn: N = 0 is undefined; even one hit at N = 1 leaves a wide interval.
cues.zh: 没有样本时，不能做除法，估计和区间都未定义。只抽一个点，即使命中，估计等于四，区间仍然很宽。全部命中不等于已经知道概率为一。先检查抽样前提，再看数量和不确定性，才能解释一个蒙特卡洛结果。
cues.en: With no samples, both estimate and interval are undefined. With one point, even a hit and an estimate of four leave a wide interval. All observed samples hitting does not establish a probability of one. Check sampling assumptions before interpreting sample count and uncertainty.

cues.title: 孔会缩小吗
cues.caption: 自由均匀膨胀时，孔径也随整体变大。
cues.captionEn: Under free uniform expansion, the hole grows with the plate.
cues.zh: 先看这块带孔金属板，虚线保留初始的内外边界。均匀升温后，材料上各个标记之间的距离按同一个比例增大，孔缘也向外移动。孔不会被周围膨胀的金属挤小。可以想象把原先挖去的圆片放回去，它也会随整体变大。画面的尺寸变化放大了一百倍。
cues.en: Watch the perforated plate. Dashed lines retain its original boundaries. Uniform heating increases separations between material markers by the same fraction, moving the hole rim outward too. Surrounding expansion does not squeeze the hole shut. Imagine replacing the removed disk: it would grow with the plate. Dimensional changes are enlarged a hundred times.

cues.title: 只加热孔板
cues.caption: 孔变大，保持初温的塞子与孔缘间隙增加。
cues.captionEn: The hole grows while a cold plug stays the same size.
cues.zh: 放大孔缘与塞子之间的一小段。灰蓝色是保持初温的塞子，金色是加热的孔板。温度上升时，塞子的边缘不动，孔缘向外退，径向间隙从二十微米增到七十微米。这里没有接触压力，读数使用真实尺寸，局部画面的微米倍率始终固定。
cues.en: Enlarge one small clearance between rim and plug. The blue-grey plug stays at its reference temperature; the gold plate is heated. The plug edge stays put while the hole edge moves outward. Radial clearance grows from twenty to seventy micrometres. There is no contact force, and the detail keeps a fixed micrometre scale.

cues.title: 塞子也会膨胀
cues.caption: 同材质塞子随后升温，额外间隙大部分消失。
cues.captionEn: Heating the matching plug removes most of the extra clearance.
cues.zh: 保持孔板温度不变，现在让同材质的塞子也逐渐升温。塞子边缘向外移动，间隙重新变小。两者都达到同样温升时，它们按相同比例膨胀，原有间隙也只按这个比例略微变大，而不是仍保留只加热孔板时的七十微米。要预测配合关系，两件零件的温度都需要知道。
cues.en: Hold the plate temperature and warm the matching plug. Its edge advances outward, reducing clearance again. At equal temperature changes, both parts expand by the same fraction. The original clearance grows only by that small fraction, rather than retaining the larger gap from heating the plate alone. A fit depends on both parts’ temperatures.

cues.title: 允许伸长时
cues.caption: 同一热应变，杆的自由增量与初长成正比。
cues.captionEn: For the same thermal strain, free extension is proportional to initial length.
cues.zh: 把同一个均匀膨胀规律用到一根杆上。一端只用于定位，另一端可以移动。升温后杆的长度增加，灰色虚线仍标记初始端点。长度增量等于膨胀系数、初长与温差的乘积。没有轴向阻挡时，模型中不需要用压缩应力把杆压回去。
cues.en: Apply the same uniform thermal strain to a rod. One end locates it while the other is free to move. Heating extends it beyond the dashed original endpoint. Extension is the expansion coefficient times original length times temperature change. With no axial restraint, no compressive stress is needed to force it back.

cues.title: 挡住伸长时
cues.caption: 两端固定，长度不变，压缩应力随温升增加。
cues.captionEn: Fixed ends preserve length while compressive stress grows with heating.
cues.zh: 回到初始长度，把杆的另一端也固定，然后升温。杆想产生的自由热应变仍然存在，但约束要求总长度不变。弹性压缩抵消这部分热应变，读数因此成为负的压缩应力。这里并没有把膨胀系数变成零，而是用约束产生的力阻止自由变形。
cues.en: Return to the reference length, restrain the second end, and heat again. The free thermal strain still exists, but the constraints require unchanged total length. Elastic compression cancels thermal expansion, producing negative axial stress. The expansion coefficient has not become zero; forces from the restraints oppose the free deformation.

cues.title: 冷却时方向反过来
cues.caption: 同样固定两端，冷却会产生拉应力。
cues.captionEn: With the same fixed ends, cooling produces tensile stress.
cues.zh: 再回到参考温度，保留两端约束并逐渐冷却。自由的杆本来会缩短，但现在不能缩短，因此需要弹性拉伸来抵消热收缩。应力由压缩换成拉伸。自由膨胀与受约束应力是同一个热应变遇到不同边界的结果，不能只看温度就判断物体实际改变了多少尺寸。
cues.en: Return to reference temperature, retain both restraints and cool the rod. A free rod would shorten. Here it cannot, so elastic tension must cancel thermal contraction. Stress switches from compression to tension. Free expansion and constrained stress arise from the same thermal strain under different boundaries; temperature alone does not determine the actual size change.

cues.title: 从正极板到负极板
cues.titleEn: From the positive plate to the negative
cues.caption: 电势沿电场方向降低。
cues.captionEn: Potential decreases along the field direction.
cues.zh: 看两块极板中央的一小段间隙。左板带正自由电荷，右板带负自由电荷，电场向右。下方曲线沿同一横坐标画出电势，从左侧十二伏降到右侧零伏。这里忽略边缘效应，先把场的方向、两板电压和间隙距离区分开。
cues.en: Look at a small central section between the plates. Positive free charge is on the left and negative charge on the right, so the field points right. Below, potential falls from twelve volts to zero along the same horizontal coordinate. Neglecting edge effects, distinguish field direction, plate voltage and separation.

cues.title: 提高电压，电势坡更陡
cues.titleEn: Raise voltage and steepen the potential slope
cues.caption: 间距不变，电压越高，场强越大。
cues.captionEn: At fixed separation, higher voltage gives a stronger field.
cues.zh: 保持空气间隙不变，把电源电压从三伏提高到十二伏。电势曲线变得更陡，空气场强上升。电源也向极板提供更多等量异号的自由电荷。电场强度描述每单位距离的电势变化，不能只看曲线一共下降了多少伏。
cues.en: Keep the air gap fixed and raise the source from three to twelve volts. The potential profile steepens, showing a stronger field. The source supplies more equal and opposite free charge to the plates. Field strength is potential change per distance, not simply the total voltage drop.

cues.title: 隔离后拉开极板
cues.caption: 自由电荷固定，空气场强不变，电压升高。
cues.captionEn: Fixed free charge preserves the air field while voltage rises.
cues.zh: 这次把极板隔离，固定自由电荷，再改变两板距离。中央空气场强由面电荷密度决定，因此保持不变。可是间隙更长，累积的电势下降也更多，所以两板电压升高。固定电荷与固定电压是两种不同的实验边界，不能混用结论。
cues.en: Isolate the plates to fix their free charge, then vary their separation. The central air field depends on surface charge density and stays unchanged. Across a longer gap, the accumulated potential drop is larger, so voltage rises. Fixed charge and fixed voltage are different experimental boundaries with different consequences.

cues.title: 同样电荷，比较不同介质
cues.titleEn: Compare dielectrics at the same free charge
cues.caption: 完全填充时，介电常数4使电压降到四分之一。
cues.captionEn: A full dielectric of relative permittivity four quarters the voltage.
cues.zh: 保持隔离，比较完全填满间隙的不同介质。介质朝向正极板的一面出现负束缚电荷，另一面出现正束缚电荷，极化产生的场抵消一部分原来的场。介电常数从一升至四，自由电荷不变，净场强和电压都降为原来的四分之一。
cues.en: Keep the capacitor isolated and compare materials filling the entire gap. Polarization produces negative bound charge near the positive plate and positive bound charge at the other side, opposing part of the original field. Raising relative permittivity from one to four leaves free charge fixed while quartering net field and voltage.

cues.title: 同样电压，电源补充电荷
cues.titleEn: At fixed voltage, the source supplies charge
cues.caption: 完全填充后场强仍是V/d，自由电荷增加。
cues.captionEn: With full filling, field remains V/d while free charge increases.
cues.zh: 现在重新接上十二伏电源，比较同样的介质变化。电源保持两板电压不变，间距也相同，因此净场强仍然是电压除以距离。为了满足这个条件，极板自由电荷不断增加；介电常数为四时，达到原来的四倍。判断介质作用，必须先说明固定的是哪一个量。
cues.en: Reconnect a twelve-volt source and repeat the material comparison. Voltage and separation remain fixed, so the net field stays equal to voltage divided by distance. The source supplies additional free charge to satisfy that condition, reaching four times the original charge at relative permittivity four. Always state which quantity is held fixed.

cues.title: 空气与介质分担电压
cues.titleEn: Air and dielectric share the voltage drop
cues.caption: 界面电势连续，不同材料中的斜率不同。
cues.captionEn: Potential is continuous while slopes differ between materials.
cues.zh: 最后只让中央一半厚度是介质，两边留空气。电势曲线在两处界面连续，但斜率改变：空气中的场强是介质中的四倍。没有额外自由界面电荷时，法向电位移相同，而电场要除以各自介电常数。各段电势下降相加，才是极板间的总电压。
cues.en: Finally place dielectric in the central half of the gap, leaving air on both sides. Potential stays continuous across both interfaces but changes slope: the air field is four times the dielectric field. Normal electric displacement matches where no free interface charge exists. Adding each region’s potential drop gives the total plate voltage.

cues.title: 一次试验只有两根柱
cues.caption: 一次公平 0/1 试验，两种结果各占一半。
cues.captionEn: One fair 0/1 trial assigns one-half to each outcome.
cues.zh: 先看一次公平试验，只会得到零或一，各有一半概率。原始分布没有钟形。中央极限定理也不要求单次结果本来是正态，它研究许多次结果相加之后，适当变换的分布形状。
cues.en: One fair trial returns zero or one, each with probability one-half. Its original distribution is not bell-shaped. The central limit theorem does not require normal observations; it concerns a suitably transformed sum of many trials.

cues.title: 独立相加，路径汇入中间
cues.caption: 两次试验中，01 和 10 都得到成功次数 1。
cues.captionEn: For two trials, both 01 and 10 produce one success.
cues.zh: 两次独立试验有四种等可能结果。零零得到零，一一得到二；零一和一零都汇到中间的一。于是中间概率是一半，两侧各四分之一。柱子的形状来自实际结果相加，不是先画一条钟形线。
cues.en: Two independent trials have four equally likely outcomes. Zero-zero gives zero and one-one gives two. Zero-one and one-zero both give one. The middle therefore has probability one-half, while each side has one-quarter. The shape comes from summing actual outcomes.

cues.title: 有限次数仍然离散
cues.caption: 8 次公平试验的精确分布仍有离散格子。
cues.captionEn: Eight fair trials still give an exact discrete distribution.
cues.zh: 相加八次，精确二项分布的中间已经更高，两边更低。棕色线是相同均值、方差的正态近似。它不等于每个柱子的精确概率，有限次数也不会让只能取整数的成功次数突然变成连续数。
cues.en: After eight trials, the exact binomial distribution has a higher middle and lower sides. The brown curve is a normal approximation with matching mean and variance. It is not the exact bar probabilities, and a finite integer count does not become continuous.

cues.title: 减去中心，再缩放
cues.caption: 32 次的和减去均值、除以标准差，改用 z 坐标。
cues.captionEn: Center the 32-trial sum and divide by its standard deviation to obtain z.
cues.zh: 把三十二次的和减去均值，再除以标准差，横轴改成 z。这样不同次数有共同的位置与尺度，才是在比较标准正态极限。原始的零一数据没有改变；改变的是求和之后，用什么坐标观察它的分布。
cues.en: Subtract the mean of the thirty-two-trial sum and divide by its standard deviation. The horizontal coordinate becomes z. This puts different sums on a common location and scale for comparison with a standard normal limit. The original zero-one observations have not changed.

cues.title: 和变宽，均值更集中
cues.caption: N 从 8 到 32，均值标准差减半，和的方差反而增加。
cues.captionEn: From N = 8 to 32, mean SD halves while sum variance increases.
cues.zh: 换成样本均值这条横轴，从八次增加到三十二次，分布更集中在二分之一附近。均值的标准差减半，和的方差却从二增到八。中央极限定理的标准化，与平均值越来越集中，是相关但不同的描述。
cues.en: Now view the sample mean. Increasing from eight trials to thirty-two concentrates its distribution around one-half. Mean standard deviation halves, while sum variance rises from two to eight. Standardized limit shape and concentration of an average are related but different descriptions.

cues.title: 稀少事件仍很偏斜
cues.caption: p = 0.05、N = 8 时，零次成功仍占约 66.3%。
cues.captionEn: At p = 0.05 and N = 8, zero successes still has about 66.3% probability.
cues.zh: 把成功概率降到百分之五，仍只相加八次。零次成功的概率超过六成，形状明显偏斜，即使标准化也没有立刻变成钟形。近似好不好，还取决于原始分布与所求事件，不能只背一个固定次数。
cues.en: Reduce success probability to five percent while keeping eight trials. Zero successes still accounts for over sixty percent, leaving a visibly skewed shape. Standardization does not instantly make it normal. Approximation quality depends on the original distribution and the event being considered.

cues.title: 复制不等于独立信息
cues.caption: 同一次结果复制 32 份，和只有 0 或 32。
cues.captionEn: Copy one outcome 32 times: the sum can only be 0 or 32.
cues.zh: 最后只做一次试验，把同一个结果复制三十二份。它们完全相关，和只可能是零或三十二，均值仍是那一次的零或一。增加复制数量没有增加独立信息，也不满足本片中央极限定理的独立前提。
cues.en: Finally, draw once and copy that result thirty-two times. The copies are perfectly dependent. Their sum is zero or thirty-two, and their mean remains the original zero or one. More copies add no independent information and violate the independence condition used here.

cues.title: 碰撞怎样变成压强
cues.caption: 壁面得到的冲量，除以时间与面积，给出平均压强。
cues.captionEn: Wall impulse divided by time and area gives mean pressure.
cues.zh: 先追踪金色代表粒子。它在箱壁反弹时，垂直壁面的速度分量反向，将冲量交给壁面。右侧壁的圈标出刚发生的碰撞。把一个时间窗口中所有代表粒子的冲量相加，再除以时间和壁面面积，就得到下面的平均压强。有限样本的读数会在状态方程结果附近波动。
cues.en: Follow the gold representative particle. An elastic wall collision reverses its normal velocity and transfers impulse to the wall. Rings mark recent right-wall impacts. Sum the impulses over a time window, then divide by duration and wall area to obtain mean pressure. Finite sampling makes that reading fluctuate near the state-equation value.

cues.title: 定容加热
cues.caption: 相同粒子数和容积，绝对温度加倍使压强加倍。
cues.captionEn: At fixed amount and volume, doubling absolute temperature doubles pressure.
cues.zh: 保持粒子数量和箱体容积不变，将绝对温度提高。代表轨迹速度随温度的平方根增加，粒子更频繁地撞壁，每次撞击的冲量也更大。两项共同让平均压强与温度成正比。这里比较不同温度下的宏观状态，不追踪热源怎样逐次改变每个原子的能量。
cues.en: Hold particle amount and box volume fixed while raising absolute temperature. Representative speeds grow with the square root of temperature. Impacts become more frequent and each transfers more momentum. Together they make mean pressure proportional to temperature. These are representative macroscopic states; individual energy transfers from a heat source are not simulated.

cues.title: 等温缩小容积
cues.caption: 速度不变，壁面往返距离更短，压强上升。
cues.captionEn: Speeds stay fixed; shorter wall round trips raise pressure.
cues.zh: 保持温度与粒子数量不变，只减小箱体的长度。右壁面积没有改变，粒子到同一面壁往返的距离却缩短了，单位时间里的撞击增加。容积减半，理想气体的绝对压强加倍。这个比较要求温度被维持；真实快速压缩会升温，不能直接沿用这里的等温结果。
cues.en: Keep temperature and amount fixed while shortening the box. Right-wall area stays unchanged, but particle round trips to that wall become shorter. More impacts occur per unit time. Halving volume doubles ideal-gas absolute pressure. Temperature must be maintained; a real rapid compression can heat the gas and needs a different process model.

cues.title: 增加的是原子数量
cues.caption: 同温、同容积，数量增加使平均压强增加。
cues.captionEn: At equal temperature and volume, more atoms give more pressure.
cues.zh: 比较同温、同容积的三组样本。每个点代表相同数量的原子，因此点的数量增加，就对应气体物质的量增加。速度尺度保持不变，但更多粒子会把冲量交给同一面壁，压强随物质的量成正比。画面直接比较三个样本，没有把增加粒子解释成升温。
cues.en: Compare three samples at the same temperature and volume. Each dot represents the same number of atoms, so more dots mean more gas. The speed scale stays unchanged, but more particles deliver momentum to the same wall. Pressure is proportional to amount. The film compares these samples directly rather than treating extra particles as extra temperature.

cues.title: 表压有另一个零点
cues.caption: 状态方程算绝对压强；表压还要减去环境压强。
cues.captionEn: The gas law gives absolute pressure; gauge pressure subtracts ambient pressure.
cues.zh: 再次固定数量与容积，让温度从三百升到六百开尔文。这次看压强条上的环境标记。绝对压强从接近一百千帕升到约二百千帕，而表压是它与环境的一百零一点三千帕之差。表压可能接近零甚至为负，所以不能把表压直接代进压强加倍的关系。
cues.en: Heat the fixed sample from three hundred to six hundred kelvins again, now watching the ambient marker. Absolute pressure rises from about one hundred to two hundred kilopascals. Gauge pressure subtracts the ambient one hundred and one point three kilopascals. It can be near zero or negative, so it cannot replace absolute pressure in the doubling rule.

cues.title: 重原子不一定压强更高
cues.titleEn: Heavier atoms need not mean higher pressure
cues.caption: 同温、同数量、同容积，换成较重原子仍给出相同压强。
cues.captionEn: At equal temperature, amount and volume, heavier atoms give the same pressure.
cues.zh: 最后将氦参数换成较重的氖参数，同时保持温度、物质的量和容积。氖的代表粒子移动更慢，但每个原子的质量更大。在同温条件下，平均平动动能相同；质量与速度的平方组合后，仍得到相同理想气体压强。只比较原子有多重，不能判断一整瓶气体的压强。
cues.en: Replace helium parameters with heavier neon while holding temperature, amount and volume. Neon representatives move more slowly, but each atom is heavier. At equal temperature their mean translational kinetic energies match. Mass combined with squared speed gives the same ideal-gas pressure. Atomic mass alone cannot determine the pressure of the sample.

cues.title: 一步一格，真实累积
cues.caption: 每步 ±1；下行位置等于前面步长的累积。
cues.captionEn: Each step is ±1; lower positions accumulate the preceding moves.
cues.zh: 从零出发，每次独立地向左或向右走一格。上行是这一次的步长，下行把前面所有步长累加，得到当前位置。它是一条具体轨迹，不是平均位置，也没有为了对称而强制左右交替。
cues.en: Start at zero and independently move one unit left or right. The upper row gives each move; the lower row accumulates those moves into position. This is one actual trajectory, not an average and not a forced left-right alternation.

cues.title: 一条路可以很曲折
cues.caption: 曲线记录一个个体的位置，不要求最终回到零。
cues.captionEn: The curve follows one individual and need not end at zero.
cues.zh: 让同一条轨迹走下去。横轴是步数，纵轴是位置。即使左右概率相同，它也可能连续几步朝一个方向走，最后停在非零位置。所谓公平，只约束每一步的概率，不规定这一条路的终点。
cues.en: Continue the same trajectory. Time runs horizontally and position vertically. Equal left-right probabilities still allow consecutive moves in one direction and a nonzero endpoint. Fairness constrains each step’s probability, without prescribing this path’s final position.

cues.title: 总体分布不是三条样本
cues.titleEn: A population is not three sample paths
cues.caption: 精确终点分布均值为零，三条样本末点不必对称。
cues.captionEn: The exact endpoint distribution has zero mean; three sample endpoints need not be symmetric.
cues.zh: 换看三十二步后所有可能终点的精确概率。柱子左右对称，均值为零。下面三个金点只是三条固定样本的末点，未必对称，更不能代替总体分布。平均不动与个体在移动，可以同时成立。
cues.en: Now examine exact probabilities of all endpoints after thirty-two steps. The bars are symmetric with zero mean. Three gold dots are only endpoints of fixed sample paths. They need not be symmetric and do not replace the population distribution.

cues.title: 时间乘四，RMS 乘二
cues.caption: 公平无限格点从 16 到 64 步，RMS 从 4 到 8。
cues.captionEn: For a fair unbounded walk, 16 to 64 steps raises RMS from 4 to 8.
cues.zh: 把步数从十六增加到六十四，均值仍为零，均方根位移却从四增到八。典型扩散按步数的平方根增长。RMS 是平方后平均再开根号，不是每条路径都必须走到的位置，也不是平均绝对距离。
cues.en: Increase from sixteen to sixty-four steps. Mean position stays zero, but root-mean-square displacement rises from four to eight. This square-root scale is not a mandatory endpoint for each path, nor is it mean absolute displacement.

cues.title: 偏置带来漂移
cues.caption: P(+1)=0.7 时，32 步均值为 12.8，标准差约 5.185。
cues.captionEn: With P(+1) = 0.7, the 32-step mean is 12.8 and SD is about 5.185.
cues.zh: 让向右概率变成七成，分布整体往右漂移。三十二步的平均位置是十二点八，围绕这个均值的标准差约五点一八五。RMS 还把整体漂移算进去，因此不再等于标准差。要把移动的中心和周围的散布分开。
cues.en: Make rightward steps seventy percent likely. The distribution drifts right. After thirty-two steps, mean position is twelve point eight and standard deviation is about five point one eight five. RMS also includes drift, so it no longer equals spread around the mean.

cues.title: 奇偶性限制当前位置
