cues.caption: 31 步不可能恰在零；32 步返回零的概率非零。
cues.captionEn: Zero is unreachable after 31 steps but has positive probability after 32.
cues.zh: 每走一步，位置的奇偶性就改变一次。从零出发，三十一步不可能刚好在零，三十二步才重新允许零这个终点。隔开的空柱不是漏画，也不表示它之前没有回过零；读数只问当前这一步在哪里。
cues.en: Every step flips position parity. Starting at zero makes zero unreachable after thirty-one steps, but reachable after thirty-two. Empty alternating bins are not missing data. The return readout concerns this endpoint, without claiming whether a path returned earlier.

cues.title: 碰到边界就留下
cues.caption: ±4 一旦触及便停止，边界概率累积而不丢失。
cues.captionEn: At ±4, walkers stop and boundary probability accumulates rather than disappearing.
cues.zh: 最后在正负四加入吸收边界。到达边界就留在那里，概率质量仍然计入总体。两边堆积，内部逐渐减少。现在过程已经改变，不能继续照搬无限格点的平方根公式；先说明边界规则，再解释扩散。
cues.en: Finally, add absorbing boundaries at plus and minus four. Reaching an edge means staying there, with probability still included in the population. Mass accumulates at the edges as the interior empties. The process has changed, so unbounded square-root formulas no longer apply unchanged.

cues.title: 电流逐渐建立
cues.caption: 电感限制电流变化的速度。
cues.captionEn: Inductance limits the rate of current change.
cues.zh: 合上开关，沿电源、电阻、线圈和开关追踪这个回路。电流从零开始，并没有立刻达到零点三安。刚接通时，电感两端承受六伏，电流以最大的变化率上升。随着电流接近稳态，曲线越来越平，线圈里的磁场能量也逐渐建立。
cues.en: Close the switch and follow the source, resistor, coil and switch around the loop. Current starts at zero rather than immediately reaching point three amps. Initially the inductor has six volts across it, so current rises most rapidly. The trace gradually levels off as current approaches its steady value and magnetic energy accumulates.

cues.title: 六伏如何分配
cues.caption: 电阻压降增大，电感压降减小。
cues.captionEn: The resistor drop rises as the inductor drop falls.
cues.zh: 再看同一次接通过程中的两个电压。电流增加，二十欧电阻的压降随之增加；电源仍然只有六伏，留给电感的压降就越来越小。两项读数之和始终是六伏。直流稳态时，理想电感压降趋近零，电流由电源电压和串联电阻决定。
cues.en: Watch the two voltages during the same buildup. Rising current increases the drop across the twenty-ohm resistor. Since the source remains at six volts, less voltage is left across the inductor. The two readings always add to six volts. In DC steady state, an ideal inductor has zero voltage drop; source voltage and resistance set the current.

cues.title: 增大电感只改变快慢
cues.caption: 电感加倍，时间常数加倍，终值相同。
cues.captionEn: Double inductance doubles the time constant, not the final current.
cues.zh: 把电感从一百毫亨换成二百毫亨，重新从零电流开始。实线比一百毫亨的虚线升得更慢，但最终仍然趋近零点三安。时间常数是电感除以电阻，因此这次加倍。更大的电感改变建立过程；它并没有在直流稳态中变成一个额外电阻。
cues.en: Replace the hundred-millihenry inductor with two hundred millihenries and restart from zero. The solid trace rises more slowly than the dashed reference, but both approach point three amps. The time constant is inductance divided by resistance, so it doubles. Greater inductance changes the buildup, without acting as extra resistance in DC steady state.

cues.title: 开关断开，回路改变
cues.titleEn: Open the switch and change the loop
cues.caption: 电流方向保持，线圈电压反转。
cues.captionEn: Current keeps its direction while coil voltage reverses.
cues.zh: 现在先让电流达到零点三安，再断开开关。注意线圈下端：电流仍向下，却转入右侧钳位支路，回到电阻上游。电源支路不再有电流。线圈电压变成负值，说明它正在释放磁能。零点七伏的续流钳位让电流慢慢衰减，开关上端则升到六点七伏。
cues.en: First prepare point three amps, then open the switch. Current still leaves the bottom of the coil, but now returns through the clamp to the resistor. The source branch carries no current. Coil voltage becomes negative as magnetic energy is released. A point-seven-volt clamp allows a gradual decay, while the switch node rises to six point seven volts.

cues.title: 更快释放的代价
cues.titleEn: The voltage cost of faster release
cues.caption: 30 V钳位缩短衰减，开关承受36 V。
cues.captionEn: A 30 V clamp speeds release; the switch sees 36 V.
cues.zh: 从相同的稳态电流重新开始，这次把钳位压降设成三十伏。电感上的反向电压更大，电流曲线迅速落到零；虚线保留零点七伏钳位的较慢过程。代价也直接显示出来：开关电压是六伏电源再加三十伏钳位，达到三十六伏。
cues.en: Restart from the same steady current with a thirty-volt clamp. A larger reverse voltage across the inductor drives current to zero much sooner. The dashed trace retains the slower point-seven-volt case. The voltage tradeoff appears in the reading: the switch sees the six-volt supply plus the thirty-volt clamp, making thirty-six volts.

cues.title: 磁能去了哪里
cues.caption: 磁能变成电阻热与钳位热，总量守恒。
cues.captionEn: Magnetic energy becomes resistor and clamp heat.
cues.zh: 最后回到低压钳位，把最初四点五毫焦的磁能逐项追踪。金色部分随电流下降而减少，另外两部分分别记录电阻和钳位器获得的热量。三部分总和不变。电流达到零之后，钳位器截止，不会让这个单向续流回路继续产生反向电流。
cues.en: Return to the low-voltage clamp and track the initial four point five millijoules. The gold portion shrinks with current, while the other portions accumulate heat in the resistor and clamp. Their total stays fixed. Once current reaches zero, the clamp stops conducting; this one-way release loop does not continue into a negative current.

cues.title: 没有热输入，也能升温
cues.caption: 绝热压缩中，外界做功增加气体内能。
cues.captionEn: Adiabatic compression adds internal energy through work.
cues.zh: 活塞缓缓压下，气体占据的容积减小，外壁的隔热层阻止热量交换。但外界仍通过活塞做功，把能量送进气体。温度从三百升到约三百九十六开尔文，压强也比单纯的等温缩容上升得更多。绝热说的是热交换为零，不是能量只能保持原样。
cues.en: The piston moves down, reducing gas volume while insulation blocks heat exchange. The surroundings still transfer energy through piston work. Temperature rises from three hundred to about three hundred and ninety-six kelvins, and pressure rises beyond the isothermal value. Adiabatic means zero heat transfer, not zero energy transfer.

cues.title: 沿程的功在哪里
cues.caption: 压强乘小体积变化，沿路径累计为活塞功。
cues.captionEn: Pressure times a small volume change accumulates into piston work.
cues.zh: 把同一段压缩展开成压强与体积图。金色曲线是准静态绝热路径，阴影累计活塞沿程传入的功。每一个小步骤都要在当时的压强下改变容积，因此不能只拿最终压强乘总位移。下方账本中，热输入始终为零，功输入与内能增量相等。
cues.en: Unfold the compression on a pressure-volume plot. Gold is the quasistatic adiabatic path; shading accumulates piston work. Each small volume change occurs at its own pressure, so final pressure times the whole volume change is not the path work. In the ledger, heat input stays zero and work input equals the internal-energy increase.

cues.title: 保持同温需要热流
cues.caption: 等温压缩时，输入的功以热量移走。
cues.captionEn: During isothermal compression, work input is removed as heat.
cues.zh: 回到相同初态，改用连接恒温热库的导热壁，再压到同样容积。温度现在不变，并不是外界没有做功，而是压缩输入的能量同时以热量移走。热输入读数为负，内能增量为零。相同的终态容积，不同热边界，会给出不同温度、压强和沿程功。
cues.en: Return to the same initial state and connect conducting walls to a constant-temperature reservoir. Compress to the same final volume. Work is still supplied, but its energy leaves as heat, keeping temperature fixed. Heat input is negative and the internal-energy change is zero. Equal final volume does not imply equal temperature, pressure or work under different thermal boundaries.

cues.title: 热容改变温升
cues.titleEn: Heat capacity changes the temperature rise
cues.caption: 同样压缩比，较大γ对应更大的绝热温升。
cues.captionEn: At the same compression ratio, larger gamma gives a greater adiabatic temperature rise.
cues.zh: 固定初态和二比一的绝热压缩比，比较两种恒定热容参数。热容比从一点四改为三分之五时，温度和压强进一步上升。热容较小的模型，需要更少内能就能产生同样温升，压缩路径也随之改变。这个比较保留理想气体与恒定热容条件，不把参数当成任何温度下都不变的真实空气性质。
cues.en: Keep the initial state and two-to-one adiabatic compression ratio, then compare constant heat-capacity models. Changing gamma from one point four to five-thirds gives a larger temperature and pressure rise. Lower constant-volume heat capacity changes how internal energy relates to temperature and alters the compression path. Real heat capacities need not stay constant across all temperatures.

cues.title: 反向释放活塞
cues.caption: 绝热膨胀时，气体对外做功，内能与温度下降。
cues.captionEn: In adiabatic expansion, gas does work and loses internal energy.
cues.zh: 从刚才压缩后的状态出发，沿同一条理想绝热路径缓缓释放活塞。气体推动外界，功输入变为负值，温度逐渐降回三百开尔文。这次没有热量流出，内能减少来自对外做功。账本以压缩后的状态重新作为起点，显示这一段返回过程的能量变化。
cues.en: Begin at the compressed state and release the piston quasistatically along the same ideal adiabatic path. The gas does work on the surroundings: work input is negative, and temperature returns to three hundred kelvins. No heat leaves. The internal-energy loss comes from work. The ledger resets its reference to the compressed state for this return path.

cues.title: 绝热不保证降温
cues.titleEn: Adiabatic does not always mean cooling
cues.caption: 向真空自由膨胀：没有热交换，也没有边界功。
cues.captionEn: Free expansion into vacuum has neither heat transfer nor boundary work.
cues.zh: 最后换成一只隔热的刚性双腔容器。比较打开隔板前后的两个平衡状态，另一腔最初是真空。气体扩展到两腔，没有推动外部活塞，也没有交换热量。理想气体内能和温度保持不变，压强降为一半。这个不可逆过程不满足前面的可逆绝热曲线，不能只见到绝热二字就套用同一公式。
cues.en: Now use a rigid insulated two-chamber vessel. Compare equilibrium before and after removing a partition into an initially empty chamber. The gas pushes no external piston and exchanges no heat. For an ideal gas, internal energy and temperature remain unchanged while pressure halves. This irreversible process does not follow the reversible adiabatic curve; zero heat transfer alone is not enough to select that formula.

cues.title: 数量很少时，近似指数
cues.caption: N 远小于 K 时，限制因子接近 1。
cues.captionEn: When N is much smaller than K, the limiting factor is near 1.
cues.zh: 先看数量远低于承载量的一小段。绿色逻辑斯谛曲线与棕色指数对照很接近，因为限制因子接近一。这里画的是局部放大，不代表数量可以永远按指数增长；资源限制会逐渐改变斜率。
cues.en: Look closely at an early interval far below carrying capacity. Logistic growth lies close to the exponential comparison because its limiting factor is near one. This local view does not promise exponential growth forever: density limitation gradually changes the slope.

cues.title: 数量与限制共同决定增速
cues.caption: 总增速是 rN 与 1−N/K 的乘积。
cues.captionEn: Total growth multiplies rN by 1−N/K.
cues.zh: 数量逐渐增加，限制因子一减数量除以承载量，持续下降。但总增速还要乘已有数量。所以下面的数量曲线可以先变陡，再变平；不能只看人均增长率下降，就判断总增长立即下降。
cues.en: As abundance rises, the limiting factor one minus N over K declines. Total growth also multiplies by current abundance, so the time curve can first steepen and later flatten. Declining per-capita growth alone does not imply immediate decline in total growth.

cues.title: 总增速在一半处最大
cues.caption: K=100 时，N=25/50/75 的增速为 11.25/15/11.25。
cues.captionEn: At K = 100, N = 25, 50 and 75 give rates 11.25, 15 and 11.25.
cues.zh: 停在三个数量上比较。二十五和七十五的总增速相同，都是十一点二五；五十时达到十五。承载量的一半，是这条抛物线的最高处。人均增速仍一直下降，达到最大的是整个种群的总增速。
cues.en: Compare three abundances. Twenty-five and seventy-five share total growth eleven point two five; fifty reaches fifteen. Half of carrying capacity is the rate parabola’s peak. Per-capita growth still keeps declining; it is total population growth that reaches this maximum.

cues.title: 从下方渐近承载量
cues.caption: 0<N<K 时增速为正，接近 K 时趋近零。
cues.captionEn: For 0<N<K, growth is positive and approaches zero near K.
cues.zh: 继续从承载量以下演化。只要数量还在零与承载量之间，增速就是正的，但越接近平衡，增加得越慢。在这个没有时滞的一阶连续模型里，正初值不会自己冲过平衡点来回摆动。
cues.en: Continue below capacity. Growth remains positive between zero and K, but additions slow near equilibrium. In this first-order continuous model without delays, a positive initial state does not spontaneously overshoot equilibrium and oscillate.

cues.title: 超载时，同一规则给出下降
cues.titleEn: Above capacity, the same rule gives decline
cues.caption: N₀=140>K=100，限制因子为负，数量从上方趋近。
cues.captionEn: With N₀ = 140 above K = 100, negative limitation approaches equilibrium from above.
cues.zh: 改从一百四十开始，超过一百的承载量，限制因子为负。同一条方程现在给出下降，而不是把超出的部分瞬间裁掉。数量从上方接近平衡，说明承载量是动力学的平衡尺度，不是画面的硬上限。
cues.en: Start at one hundred forty, above capacity one hundred. The limiting factor is negative, so the same equation produces decline rather than instantly clipping excess abundance. The state approaches from above: capacity is a dynamical equilibrium scale, not a graphical ceiling.

cues.title: 承载量改变，斜率也改变
cues.caption: t=6 时 K 从 100 降到 60，数量连续而增速转负。
cues.captionEn: At t = 6, K falls from 100 to 60; abundance stays continuous while growth turns negative.
cues.zh: 在第六个时间单位，把承载量从一百降到六十。数量此时约八十点二六，不能瞬间跳变，但增速马上转为负，轨迹向新平衡下降。过去的数量保留原样，新规则只影响切换之后的演化。
cues.en: At time six, lower capacity from one hundred to sixty. Abundance is about eighty point two six and stays continuous, but its growth rate immediately becomes negative. The trajectory declines toward the new equilibrium, preserving its history before the switch.

cues.title: 零初值与零增长率
cues.titleEn: Zero initial abundance and zero rate
cues.caption: 没有迁入时零初值不增长；r=0 时任意初值保持。
cues.captionEn: Without immigration, zero stays zero; at r = 0 every initial abundance stays fixed.
cues.zh: 如果初始数量为零，又没有迁入，这条模型不会凭空产生种群。若增长率为零，任意初始数量都保持不动。这些边界与前面的曲线属于同一个方程，也提醒我们：真实生态中的迁入、时滞与随机性，都需要额外模型。
cues.en: With zero initial abundance and no immigration, this equation creates no population. With growth rate zero, any initial amount remains unchanged. These boundaries belong to the same equation. Real immigration, delays and randomness require additional modeling rather than assumptions hidden inside this curve.

cues.title: 浸下去多少，排开多少
cues.caption: 浸没体积增加，浮力随之增加。
cues.captionEn: Buoyant force grows with immersed volume.
cues.zh: 定位杆把物体缓缓放入水中。蓝色液面保持不变，括线追踪浸在水里的高度。进入水中的体积越多，排开的水越多，浮力就越大。这里物体的位置由定位杆控制，所以即使浮力暂时不等于重力，它也不必马上上浮或下沉。
cues.en: The positioning rod lowers the object into water. The surface stays fixed and the bracket tracks immersed height. More submerged volume displaces more water and produces more buoyancy. The rod controls position here, so unequal buoyancy and weight need not immediately move the object.

cues.title: 更深，不一定浮力更大
cues.titleEn: Deeper need not mean more buoyancy
cues.caption: 完全浸没后，深度增加但上下压力差不变。
cues.captionEn: After full immersion, greater depth leaves the pressure difference unchanged.
cues.zh: 完全浸没后，继续把物体向下放。上下表面的压力都随着深度增加，底面向上的作用始终大于顶面向下的作用。但两者增加相同的那一部分会抵消，合力保持不变。左右压力也彼此抵消。对这个不可压缩液体中的固定体积物体，更深不是更大的浮力。
cues.en: Lower the fully immersed object further. Pressure rises on both upper and lower faces. The upward bottom force exceeds the downward top force, but the common increase cancels. Side forces cancel too. In this incompressible liquid, a fixed fully submerged volume does not gain buoyancy just by moving deeper.

cues.title: 放手才看净力
cues.caption: 轻物体上浮，直到部分浸没时浮力与重力相等。
cues.captionEn: A light object rises until partial immersion balances its weight.
cues.zh: 移开定位杆，让这块较轻的物体从全浸没处释放。起初浮力大于重力，物体向上运动。越过液面时，排液体积减小，浮力也减小，最后停在部分浸没的位置。画面的运动由力积分得到，并加入温和阻尼；最终约七成体积浸在水中，浮力与重力相等。
cues.en: Remove the rod and release the lighter block from full immersion. Buoyancy initially exceeds weight, so it rises. As it crosses the surface, displaced volume and buoyancy decrease. The force-based motion with gentle damping settles at partial immersion. About seventy percent of its volume is submerged, balancing buoyancy and weight.

cues.title: 加重会吃水更深
cues.titleEn: A heavier load needs more draft
cues.caption: 漂浮平衡时，排液重量必须随总重量增加。
cues.captionEn: A floating equilibrium displaces liquid equal to the total weight.
cues.zh: 保持外部体积不变，比较逐渐加重后的漂浮平衡。内部载荷增加了质量，物体需要更大的排液重量来支撑，因此吃水更深。此时浮力跟着重力一起增加，而不是始终固定成全浸没时的最大值。只要还未完全浸没，这个物体仍有增加排液体积的余地。
cues.en: Keep the outer volume and compare equilibria with added internal load. More mass requires more displaced liquid weight, so the object sits deeper. Buoyancy increases with weight rather than staying fixed at its fully immersed maximum. While some volume remains above water, more displacement is still available.

cues.title: 下沉也有浮力
cues.caption: 重物体浮力仍向上，但不足以平衡重力。
cues.captionEn: A sinking object still has upward buoyancy, smaller than its weight.
cues.zh: 把总质量增加到连完全浸没也无法支撑的程度，再释放。物体开始下沉，但蓝色浮力并没有消失。浸没体积已达到上限，浮力小于重力，不能形成漂浮平衡。运动中阻力也向上，却不应混进阿基米德浮力的读数；图中的蓝色合力只来自静水压力差。
cues.en: Increase mass beyond the fully immersed support limit and release it. The object sinks, but upward buoyancy remains. Displaced volume has reached its maximum and cannot balance weight. Motion also experiences upward drag, which must not be folded into Archimedes buoyancy. The blue force reading comes only from hydrostatic pressure.

cues.title: 换液体，平衡怎样调整
cues.caption: 更密的液体让同一轻物体浮得更高，平衡浮力仍等于重力。
cues.captionEn: A denser liquid gives less draft; equilibrium buoyancy still equals weight.
cues.zh: 最后恢复同一块轻物体，比较不同液体密度下的漂浮平衡。液体越密，支撑相同重量需要排开的体积越小，物体浮得更高。不要说平衡浮力因此比重力更大：两个力仍然相等，改变的是排液体积。浸没体积、液体密度和物体重量，需要放在同一张账里核对。
cues.en: Restore the same light object and compare floating equilibria across liquid densities. Denser liquid requires less displaced volume to support the same weight, so the object floats higher. Equilibrium buoyancy has not become greater than weight; the forces still match. What changes is displaced volume. Check volume, liquid density and object weight together.

cues.title: 先比较一个位置
cues.caption: Q 到各站点的直线距离来自实际坐标。
cues.captionEn: Actual coordinates determine straight-line distances from Q to each site.
cues.zh: 先放四个站点，只问查询点 Q 离谁最近。每条连线的长度都由坐标算出，最短的连线决定最近站点。Voronoi 图要做的，是把这个比较扩展到平面上每一个位置。
cues.en: Place four sites and ask which is nearest to query Q. Each segment length comes from coordinates, and the shortest segment identifies the nearest site. A Voronoi diagram extends this comparison to every position in the plane.

cues.title: 两个站点，一条平分线
cues.caption: 两站点等距位置在垂直平分线上，两侧分别更近。
cues.captionEn: The perpendicular bisector ties two sites; opposite sides favor opposite sites.
cues.zh: 先只留 A 和 B。等距位置连成两点连接线的垂直平分线。Q 从一侧移动到另一侧，最近站点也改变。它不是把中间随意切一刀，分界线的位置和角度都由两点几何决定。
cues.en: Keep only A and B. Their equidistant positions form a perpendicular bisector. Moving Q across it changes the nearest site. The boundary is not an arbitrary cut: both its position and angle follow from the two sites.

cues.title: 多个条件一起求交
cues.caption: 每个单元必须同时比其他所有站点更近。
cues.captionEn: A cell must satisfy every competing nearest-site inequality at once.
cues.zh: 把另外两个站点放回。要属于 A 的区域，必须同时比 B、C、D 都近。把这些半平面求交，就得到 A 的单元。其他单元也同样生成，画面矩形只负责裁剪显示范围，不是自然的领地边界。
cues.en: Restore the other two sites. A’s cell contains positions closer to A than to B, C and D simultaneously. Intersect those halfplanes to obtain the cell, and repeat for the other sites. The rectangle merely clips the display; it is not a natural territorial boundary.

cues.title: 移动站点，比较重新计算
cues.caption: D 移到 (200,125)，固定 Q 的最近站点从 B 改为 D。
cues.captionEn: Moving D to (200,125) changes fixed Q’s nearest site from B to D.
cues.zh: 保持 Q 不动，把 D 移近。每个半平面随坐标重新计算，周围边界跟着改变。现在 Q 由最近 B 变成最近 D。原先属于 B 的一部分位置，现在变得离 D 更近。
cues.en: Hold Q fixed and move D closer. Each distance halfplane recomputes, changing surrounding boundaries. Q switches from B to D. Positions previously belonging to B can now become closer to D as D approaches.

cues.title: 边与顶点可以平局
cues.caption: 共享边上两站点等距，三单元交点可同时等距。
cues.captionEn: Shared edges can tie two sites; a three-cell vertex can tie three.
cues.zh: 让 Q 落在共享边上，到 A 和 B 的距离相同。再移到三个单元的交点，同一个圆同时经过 A、B、C。这里最近可以有多个答案，不能为了界面只显示一个名字，就声称几何归属唯一。
cues.en: Put Q on a shared edge: A and B have equal distance. At a three-cell vertex, one circle passes through A, B and C. Nearest can have multiple answers. Displaying a single name would not make the geometric ownership unique.

cues.title: 重合不是一条平局边
cues.titleEn: Coincidence creates more than one tied edge
cues.caption: A 与 B 重合，整个对应区域都等距；填色约定不等于唯一。
cues.captionEn: Coincident A and B tie across a region; coloring order does not make ownership unique.
cues.zh: 让 B 与 A 完全重合。现在不只是某条边平局，它们在整个对应区域都一样远。画面按输入顺序选一种颜色来绘制，同时明确标出 A 和 B 都最近。确定性的画法，不等于唯一的数学答案。
cues.en: Make B coincide with A. They now tie throughout their corresponding region, rather than along a single edge. Input order chooses a deterministic color, while the measurements still report both nearest sites. Deterministic rendering is not a unique mathematical answer.

cues.title: 直线最近，不一定绕行最短
cues.titleEn: Straight-line nearest can lose on route cost
cues.caption: 有墙时 A 直线最近，绕端点后 B 的路程更短。
cues.captionEn: With a wall, A is nearest by straight line but B has the shorter route.
cues.zh: 最后加入一段有限的墙。Q 到 A 的直线更短，可实际折线必须绕过墙端点；到 B 可以直达，反而路程更短。背景仍是欧氏距离单元。若改问道路或绕行距离，必须重新定义度量，不能直接拿这张图当导航。
cues.en: Add a finite wall. A is closer in a straight line, but its shortest path must detour around an endpoint. B is directly reachable and has the shorter route. Colors still represent Euclidean cells. Route or road distance requires a new metric rather than treating this diagram as navigation.

cues.title: 没有端电流，仍有内建场
cues.titleEn: Zero terminal current, a built-in field
cues.caption: 耗尽区留下固定离子，电场从n指向p。
cues.captionEn: Fixed ions remain; the field points from n to p.
cues.zh: 先看没有外加电压的结。空心和实心圆表示可以移动的载流子，小方块表示固定掺杂离子。结附近的移动载流子很少，却留下了两侧异号的固定电荷。它们形成从n区指向p区的内建电场。热平衡下漂移与扩散相互抵消，外部电流仍为零。
cues.en: Start with no applied voltage. Circles represent mobile carriers; squares mark fixed dopant ions. Near the junction, mobile carriers are scarce, but opposite fixed charges remain on either side. They create a built-in field from n to p. At thermal equilibrium, drift balances diffusion, so the external terminal current is still zero.

cues.title: 宽度不同，电荷相等
cues.caption: 低掺杂一侧耗尽得更宽，正负面积相等。
cues.captionEn: The less doped side depletes farther; signed areas cancel.
cues.zh: 把视线移到空间电荷剖面。p侧负电荷密度较低，却占了更宽的区域；n侧正电荷密度是三倍，宽度只有三分之一。两块面积的大小相等，正负总电荷互相抵消。耗尽层不是一片没有电荷的空白，而是这两片固定电荷形成的区域。
cues.en: Look at the space-charge profile. The negative p-side density is lower but extends farther. The positive n-side density is three times larger and occupies one third of the width. The two areas have equal magnitudes, so their charges cancel. The depletion layer contains these fixed charges; it is not an electrically empty gap.

cues.title: 正向偏置降低势垒
cues.caption: 结电压升高，势垒与耗尽宽度减小。
cues.captionEn: Rising forward junction voltage lowers and narrows the barrier.
cues.zh: 让p端相对n端逐渐变正。下方的内部电势差随之减小，耗尽区两条边界也向结靠近。势垒降低后，载流子注入更容易，正向电流增加。注意电流已经在较低电压出现，没有一个固定的零点七伏开门瞬间。
cues.en: Raise the p-terminal voltage relative to n. The internal potential difference decreases and both depletion boundaries move toward the junction. A lower barrier allows more carrier injection, increasing forward current. Notice that current already exists at lower voltages. There is no universal instant when a gate opens at point seven volts.

cues.title: 小幅电压，大幅电流
cues.titleEn: Small voltage changes, large current changes
cues.caption: 300 K时，约60 mV对应十倍理想正向电流。
cues.captionEn: At 300 K, about 60 mV gives ten times the ideal forward current.
cues.zh: 这次把正向电压从零点四五伏缓缓提高到零点六伏。电流读数跨越很大的范围，因此曲线使用对数纵轴。在这个三百开尔文的理想扩散模型里，增加约六十毫伏，电流就约增大十倍。常说的导通电压，取决于你采用哪一个电流来判断。
cues.en: Sweep forward voltage from point four five to point six volts. Current spans a wide range, so the vertical axis is logarithmic. In this ideal diffusion model at three hundred kelvin, adding about sixty millivolts multiplies current by ten. A quoted forward voltage therefore depends on which current you choose as the reference.

cues.title: 反向偏置拉宽耗尽层
cues.caption: 势垒升高，理想反向电流趋近微小饱和值。
cues.captionEn: The barrier rises while ideal reverse current approaches saturation.
cues.zh: 再把p端电压降到负值。两侧固定电荷区向外延伸，内部势垒升高。电流读数很快接近负的一皮安，这里特意保留了正负号。实际二极管还有温度、复合漏电和反向击穿等影响；眼前的模型只比较低反向电压下的理想支路。
cues.en: Now make the p terminal negative. Fixed space charge extends farther on both sides, and the internal barrier rises. Current quickly approaches negative one picoamp; its sign is retained in the reading. Real devices also exhibit temperature effects, recombination leakage and reverse breakdown. This model compares only the ideal branch at modest reverse voltage.

cues.title: 外加电压不全落在结上
cues.caption: 串联电阻分担电压，必须同时满足回路方程。
cues.captionEn: The resistor shares the voltage; the loop equation must hold.
cues.zh: 最后加入一百欧串联电阻，再提高外加电压。观察电压条：一部分落在PN结，另一部分落在电阻上，两者相加才是外加电压。电流增加时，电阻压降也增加。要预测这个电路，必须把指数关系与回路电压方程一起求解。
cues.en: Finally add a hundred-ohm resistor and raise the applied voltage. The bar divides voltage between the PN junction and resistor; their sum equals the applied value. As current increases, the resistor drop grows too. Predicting this circuit requires solving the exponential junction relation together with the loop voltage equation.

cues.title: 只追踪垂直深度
cues.caption: 探头越深，液体重量带来的表压越大。
cues.captionEn: Greater depth gives greater hydrostatic gauge pressure.
cues.zh: 三个金色探头保持相同高度，缓缓向下移动。它们上方的垂直液柱变高，液体重量带来的压强增加。这里的深度从自由液面竖直向下量，不是沿斜壁量，也不是从容器口或地板随意选一个起点。相同液体中，同深探头的读数始终相同。
cues.en: Three gold probes descend at the same elevation. Greater vertical depth below the free surface increases hydrostatic pressure. Depth is measured vertically from that surface, not along a sloping wall or from an arbitrary rim or floor. In the same liquid, the equal-depth probes keep equal pressure readings.

cues.title: 形状不同也能同压
cues.caption: 连通静止液体的共同液位，让同底深度给出同压。
cues.captionEn: A common level in connected static liquid gives equal bottom pressure.
cues.zh: 把探头放到底部，比较直壁、上宽和上窄的容器。它们装入的液体量不同，但自由液面承受相同气压，底部处在相同深度，所以底压相同。下方通道把同一种液体连通起来；图中比较的是已经静止的状态，没有用容器装水总量替代垂直深度。
cues.en: Put the probes at the bottoms and compare straight, flared and tapered vessels. They contain different amounts of liquid, but share surface gas pressure and bottom depth, so their bottom pressures match. Lower passages connect the same liquid. These are static states; total liquid amount does not replace vertical depth.

cues.title: 换密度，改变梯度
cues.caption: 同样深度，更密的液体产生更大的静水表压。
cues.captionEn: At equal depth, denser liquid gives greater hydrostatic gauge pressure.
cues.zh: 固定液位和探头深度，比较不同密度的液体。相同体积里，密度更大的液体重量更多，所以同一垂直深度产生更大的表压。三只探头仍相等。这个比较假定液体均匀且不可压缩；分层液体要把各层的密度与厚度分别累加，不能只看最底下一层。
cues.en: Hold level and probe depth while comparing liquid densities. More mass in the same volume means more weight, giving greater gauge pressure over the same depth. All three probes still agree. The liquid is uniform and incompressible here. Layered liquids require adding each layer’s density and thickness separately.

cues.title: 液面本身也受压
cues.caption: 改变共同液面气压，绝对压强一起平移。
cues.captionEn: Changing common surface pressure shifts all absolute readings.
cues.zh: 深度和液体都不变，只提高三个液面共同承受的气压。绝对压强一起上升，液体重量额外带来的表压却不变。这两个读数使用不同零点：一个从真空算起，一个从当前共同液面气压算起。说静水压只取决于深度时，必须保留这个边界气压条件。
cues.en: Keep depth and liquid fixed, then raise the gas pressure over all surfaces equally. Absolute pressure rises everywhere, while the extra pressure due to liquid weight stays unchanged. One reading starts at vacuum; the other uses current surface pressure as its reference. A depth-only statement must retain that boundary-pressure condition.

cues.title: 底部没有独自承重
cues.titleEn: The bottom need not carry all the weight
cues.caption: 斜壁的竖直分力，让同底压与不同液重同时成立。
cues.captionEn: Vertical wall forces reconcile equal bottom pressure with unequal liquid weight.
cues.zh: 再看三只容器中液体的重量。底面积和底压相同，底部合力也相同，为什么液重却不同？上宽容器的斜壁给液体向上的分力，分担一部分重量；上窄容器的斜壁分力向下，反而增加底部负担。直壁没有这种竖直分量。把壁面也算进来，力的收支就闭合了。
cues.en: Now compare liquid weights. Equal bottom areas and pressures give equal bottom forces, yet weights differ. Flared walls exert upward components that support some liquid weight. Tapered walls exert downward components, adding to bottom load. Straight walls have no vertical component. Including the walls closes the vertical force balance.

cues.title: 同压不等于同力
cues.titleEn: Equal pressure is not equal force
cues.caption: 同一点处增大膜片面积，压强不变，总力增加。
cues.captionEn: At one depth, larger diaphragm area increases force, not pressure.
cues.zh: 最后放大同一深度的小膜片，同时看正面和侧面。只改变膜片面积，局部液体压强不变，但相对参考气压的总作用力随面积增加。压强是每单位面积的法向力，总力还需要乘以面积。图中用放大局部追踪面积变化，读数保留真实平方厘米与牛顿。
cues.en: Enlarge a small diaphragm at the same depth, showing its face and edge. Changing area leaves local pressure unchanged but increases force relative to the reference pressure. Pressure is normal force per unit area; total force also requires area. The detail is magnified while readouts retain square centimetres and newtons.

cues.title: 正午有两个参照
cues.titleEn: Noon starts with two aligned references
cues.caption: 先用一年 12×24h 的放大模型，区分恒星与太阳方向。
cues.captionEn: Use an enlarged 12×24 h year to separate stellar and solar directions.
cues.zh: 从观察点 P 的正午开始，它正朝向太阳，也与固定恒星参照同向。先用一年只有十二个二十四小时的放大模型，让角差看得清楚。这不是地球真实公转速度，后面再切回地球近似比例。
cues.en: Start at noon for observer P, facing the Sun and the initial fixed-star reference. We first use an enlarged model year lasting twelve times twenty-four hours so the angular difference is visible. This is not Earth’s actual orbital speed; an Earth-like ratio follows later.

cues.title: 转一圈，只保证恒星方向恢复
cues.titleEn: One spin restores the stellar reference
cues.caption: P 相对恒星转完一圈，太阳方向已随公转改变。
cues.captionEn: After P completes one spin relative to stars, orbital motion has changed the Sun direction.
cues.zh: 让行星自转一整圈。P 又朝向原来的恒星方向，恒星日已经结束。但小轨道图中，行星同时沿轨道前进，近景里的太阳方向也跟着改变。回到同一个恒星方向，不等于太阳又到了同一个方向。
cues.en: Complete one spin. P again faces the original stellar direction, ending a sidereal day. Meanwhile, the planet has advanced along its orbit, changing the Sun direction in the close view. Restoring the star reference does not restore the Sun reference.

cues.title: 再追上太阳，才到下个正午
cues.titleEn: Catch the Sun to reach the next noon
cues.caption: 继续自转，P 再次朝向太阳，太阳日才结束。
cues.captionEn: Continue spinning until P faces the Sun again, completing a solar day.
cues.zh: 再转一小段，P 才重新朝向太阳。顺行自转和公转同向，太阳相对行星的角速度，要用自转减去公转。因此相邻正午比相对恒星转一圈花得更久；两种日长回答的是不同参照下的问题。
cues.en: A little more spin brings P back toward the Sun. With prograde spin and orbit in the same direction, relative solar angular speed is spin minus orbit. Successive noons therefore take longer than one stellar rotation. The two periods answer questions with different references.

cues.title: 关闭公转，保留原自转
cues.caption: 只关闭公转，两种参照的周期变得相同。
cues.captionEn: Switching off orbit alone makes both reference periods equal.
cues.zh: 现在保持原来的自转角速度，只关闭公转。太阳方向不再移动，相对恒星转完一圈时，也正好重新朝向太阳。两种日长变得相同，说明先前的差来自参照方向随公转变化，而不是多加了一段任意等待。
cues.en: Hold the spin rate fixed and switch off orbital motion. The Sun direction no longer shifts. One stellar rotation also restores the solar direction, so the periods coincide. The earlier difference came from the changing orbital reference, rather than an arbitrary extra delay.

cues.title: 地球比例约差四分钟
cues.titleEn: Earth-like periods differ by about four minutes
cues.caption: 地球近似比例：恒星日约 23:56:04，平均太阳日 24h。
cues.captionEn: Earth-like ratio: about 23:56:04 per sidereal day versus a 24 h mean solar day.
cues.zh: 切回一年约三百六十五点二五六个二十四小时的比例。角差现在很小，但时钟显示恒星日约二十三小时五十六分四秒，平均太阳日为二十四小时。本片用圆轨道与匀速模型，不计算轴倾斜、椭圆轨道或真实每天的正午间隔。
cues.en: Use a year of about three hundred sixty-five point two five six times twenty-four hours. The angle is small, while clocks show roughly twenty-three hours fifty-six minutes four seconds versus a twenty-four-hour mean solar day. Circular uniform motion omits tilt, eccentricity and actual daily noon variations.

cues.title: 反向自转，关系可以反过来
cues.titleEn: Reverse spin and the ordering can reverse
cues.caption: 反向自转使相对角速度绝对值增大，太阳日可更短。
cues.captionEn: Retrograde spin increases relative-speed magnitude, so the solar day can be shorter.
cues.zh: 最后反转自转方向，速率大小不变。相减的是有方向的角速度，如今太阳相对转动得更快，P 在转满一个恒星日之前就再次对准太阳。太阳日并非永远更长；必须先说明自转、公转的方向与参照。
cues.en: Finally reverse spin while keeping its speed. Angular velocities have signs. Their relative magnitude now increases, so P faces the Sun before completing one stellar rotation. A solar day is not always longer: directions and references must be specified first.

cues.title: 先留下上下摆动的空间
cues.caption: 基极偏置决定集电极的静态输出。
cues.captionEn: Base bias sets the collector operating point.
cues.zh: 先沿五伏电源往下看。电流经过二点二千欧电阻，再进入晶体管。基极电压较低时，集电极电流很小，输出接近五伏。缓缓提高偏置，电阻压降增加，输出下降。把静态输出停在二点五伏附近，就为两侧的变化留下了空间。
cues.en: Follow the five-volt supply through the two-point-two-kilohm resistor into the transistor. With a low base voltage, collector current is small and output stays near five volts. Raising the bias increases the resistor drop and lowers the output. Setting the static output near two point five volts leaves room for excursions in both directions.

cues.title: 电流增大，输出降低
cues.caption: 输出等于电源电压减去集电极电阻压降。
cues.captionEn: Output equals supply voltage minus the collector resistor drop.
cues.zh: 在这个工作点附近，只改变十几毫伏的基极电压。沿曲线看，基极越高，输出反而越低。原因就在集电极电阻：电流增加，电阻消耗的电压份额增加，留给输出节点的电压减少。这个负斜率说明共射极放大器会反相。
cues.en: Around this operating point, change the base voltage by only a few millivolts. The transfer curve slopes downward: a higher base voltage produces a lower output. Collector current increases the voltage drop across the resistor, leaving less voltage at the output node. This negative slope is why the common-emitter amplifier inverts.

cues.title: 用同一时刻对照波形
cues.titleEn: Compare both traces at the same instant
cues.caption: 毫伏输入产生较大的反向输出变化。
cues.captionEn: A millivolt input produces a larger inverted output variation.
cues.zh: 现在叠加八毫伏峰值的正弦输入。跟随共同的时间标记：输入到达峰值时，输出靠近谷值。输入纵轴用毫伏，输出纵轴用伏，比较时要注意单位。波形在工作点附近近似成比例，但晶体管的指数关系仍会留下少量非线性。
cues.en: Add a sine input with an eight-millivolt peak. Follow the shared time marker: an input peak corresponds to an output trough. The input axis uses millivolts and the output axis uses volts, so check the units when comparing amplitudes. Around the operating point, the response is approximately proportional, with some residual transistor nonlinearity.

cues.title: 输入过大，放大失去比例
cues.caption: 正半周饱和，负半周接近截止。
cues.captionEn: One side saturates while the other approaches cutoff.
cues.zh: 把输入峰值提高到八十毫伏。正半周要求更大的集电极电流，但输出已经逼近低端，基集结也进入正向偏置，晶体管饱和。负半周则让电流接近零，输出靠近五伏电源。此时波形明显失真，继续增加输入，无法换来同样比例的输出。
cues.en: Increase the input peak to eighty millivolts. During the positive half-cycle, the requested collector current drives the output toward its lower limit. The base–collector junction becomes forward biased and the transistor saturates. On the other half-cycle, current approaches zero and output approaches five volts. More input no longer gives proportionally more output.

cues.title: 发射极电阻形成负反馈
cues.caption: 电流升高时，Ve升高，抵消部分Vb变化。
cues.captionEn: Rising current raises Ve, opposing part of the Vb change.
cues.zh: 改用四十毫伏输入，加入一百欧发射极电阻，并重新设定同样的静态中点。电流增加时，发射极电压也升高，抵消部分基极电压变化。实线增益较小，却比没有这只电阻的虚线更平顺。这里比较的是相同输入幅度、相同静态集电极电流。
cues.en: Use a forty-millivolt input, add a hundred-ohm emitter resistor, and re-establish the same operating point. Increasing current raises emitter voltage, cancelling part of the base-voltage change. The solid trace has less gain but remains smoother than the dashed circuit without this resistor. Both use the same input amplitude and static collector current.

cues.title: 放大的能量从哪里来
cues.caption: 主要功率来自集电极电源，基极功率也计入。
cues.captionEn: Most power comes from the collector supply; base power also counts.
cues.zh: 回到小信号电路，看功率从哪里进入。金色部分来自五伏集电极电源，绿色小部分来自基极驱动。它们相加，恰好对应电阻和晶体管内部的耗散。输入信号控制电流变化，电源提供大部分能量。这里输出只作高阻测量，没有另接扬声器或其他负载。
cues.en: Return to the small-signal circuit and track power entering it. Gold comes from the five-volt collector supply; the small green portion comes from the base driver. Together they match resistor and transistor dissipation. The input controls current variation while the supply provides most of the energy. Output is measured at high impedance, without a separate speaker or other load.

cues.title: 从液位差读流量
cues.titleEn: Read flow from a level difference
cues.caption: 宽段与喉部静压不同，双液管把差值变成液位差。
cues.captionEn: Wide and throat static pressures differ; a manometer turns that into a level difference.
cues.zh: 沿着管内的金色标记，经过宽段、喉部，再回到宽段。两个侧壁小孔取的是静压，分别连到同一只双液差压管。喉部静压较低，两边测压液出现高度差。知道液体密度与管径，就可以从这个压差反推流量大小；仪表不需要数出所有流过的水滴。
cues.en: Follow the gold marker through the wide section, throat and wide outlet. Two flush side taps sample static pressure and connect to one two-liquid manometer. Lower throat pressure produces unequal interface heights. With known densities and diameters, that difference gives flow magnitude without counting every passing drop.

cues.title: 收窄的是面积
cues.caption: 同一流量穿过更小面积，喉部速度增加、静压降低。
cues.captionEn: The same flow through less area raises throat speed and lowers static pressure.
cues.zh: 保持流量不变，逐渐收窄喉部。圆管面积随直径的平方改变，不能直接把直径当成面积。相同体积的水必须更快穿过更小的截面，动能密度增加，静压因此下降。流动标记沿实际体积坐标推进，差压管中的液位差也随同一个计算结果增大。
cues.en: Keep flow fixed and narrow the throat. Circular area depends on diameter squared, not diameter alone. The same volume must cross a smaller section faster, increasing kinetic energy density and lowering static pressure. Flow markers advance in volume coordinates, while the manometer level difference follows that same computed state.

cues.title: 压差不是正比刻度
cues.titleEn: The differential scale is not linear
cues.caption: 管径固定时，流量加倍需要四倍压差。
cues.captionEn: With fixed geometry, doubling flow requires four times the pressure difference.
cues.zh: 保持两个管径不变，逐渐增加流量。速度与流量成正比，而压强差来自速度平方的差，因此压差随流量的平方增长。流量加倍，压差变成四倍；反过来，从压差求流量需要开平方。上方读数使用这个反算，不把液位差线性换成流量。
cues.en: Hold both diameters and increase flow. Speeds are proportional to flow, but pressure difference depends on squared speeds. Doubling flow therefore quadruples the differential. Inferring flow reverses that relationship with a square root. The displayed estimate uses this inverse calculation rather than a linear level-to-flow scale.

cues.title: 喉部压降不等于全损失
cues.titleEn: Throat pressure drop is not all lost
cues.caption: 理想扩散段减速，静压恢复，机械能密度总和不变。
cues.captionEn: The ideal diffuser slows flow and recovers static pressure at constant total energy density.
cues.zh: 把同一流动的机械能密度拆成两部分。蓝色是静压，金色是单位体积的动能，三处总高度相同。喉部以更多动能换取较低静压，随后扩散段减速，静压恢复。这里忽略真实损耗；不能把宽段到喉部的整个测量压差，直接叫作仪表永久消耗掉的压强。
cues.en: Separate mechanical energy density into blue static pressure and gold kinetic energy per volume. Total heights match at all three stations. The throat trades static pressure for motion; the diffuser slows the flow and recovers pressure. Real losses are omitted. The measured wide-to-throat differential is not the meter’s permanent pressure loss.

cues.title: 有收缩也可以没有压差
cues.titleEn: A constriction can have zero differential
cues.caption: 零流量时标记静止，双液界面同高。
cues.captionEn: At zero flow, markers stop and manometer interfaces align.
cues.zh: 保持喉部仍然狭窄，把规定流量设为零。标记停住，两个静压口读数相同，测压液界面回到同高。几何收缩本身不会在静止液体里凭空制造这个速度压差。这也是检查模型和仪表零点的重要边界：没有流动，就不应只因为画了一段窄管而出现流量读数。
cues.en: Leave the throat narrow and set flow to zero. Markers stop, static taps agree, and interfaces align. A geometric constriction alone cannot create this velocity-related differential in resting liquid. This is a useful zero check: drawing a narrow tube must not produce a nonzero flow reading when nothing moves.

cues.title: 同样差值，不同方向
cues.caption: 这两个静压读数可求大小，单独不能判断流向。
cues.captionEn: These two static readings give magnitude, not direction by themselves.
cues.zh: 最后比较正向和反向两个理想稳态，流量大小相同。标记的运动方向反过来，但宽段与喉部的速度平方没有改变，差压管仍给出相同液位差。由压差反推的数值只是流量大小。要判断方向，还需要其他测量或已知的系统条件，不能从这个开平方结果里凭空选出正负号。
cues.en: Compare opposite ideal steady flows of equal magnitude. Markers reverse direction, but squared speeds at the wide section and throat remain unchanged. The manometer keeps the same level difference. Its inverse result is a magnitude. Direction needs another measurement or known system conditions; the square root alone cannot supply a sign.

cues.title: 先有一条圆轨道
cues.caption: 初始圆轨道速度由半径与中心引力决定。
cues.captionEn: Initial circular speed follows radius and central gravity.
cues.zh: 先看一条圆轨道。飞行器的半径、速度与引力互相匹配，不需要发动机持续托住。要去更高的圆轨道，不能只把位置向外搬；必须先改变速度，让自然运动转入另一条轨道。
cues.en: Begin on a circular orbit. Radius and speed match central gravity without continuous engine support. Reaching a higher circle requires changing velocity first, which changes the orbit followed under gravity.

cues.title: 第一次加速，位置不跳
cues.titleEn: Impulse one changes velocity, not position
cues.caption: 第一次顺行脉冲使圆轨道转为相切椭圆。
cues.captionEn: A prograde first impulse produces a tangent transfer ellipse.
cues.zh: 在同一个位置沿运动方向加速。位置没有跳变，速度与能量却增加，飞行器进入与原圆相切的转移椭圆。这里把点火理想化为瞬时脉冲，随后发动机关闭，靠引力自然滑行。
cues.en: Apply a prograde impulse at the same position. Position stays continuous while velocity and energy change, producing a tangent transfer ellipse. This ideal instantaneous burn is followed by an engine-off coast under gravity.

cues.title: 上升滑行，速度下降
cues.caption: 椭圆滑行中 E 保持，半径增加而速度下降。
cues.captionEn: Coast energy E stays fixed while radius rises and speed falls.
cues.zh: 沿椭圆上升时，半径逐渐增加，速度反而下降。单位质量能量保持不变，速度箭头随实际速度缩短。这个过程没有持续向后点火；动能与引力势能在同一轨道上交换。
cues.en: During outward coasting, radius rises and speed falls while specific energy stays constant. The velocity arrow follows that actual speed. No continuous braking is applied: kinetic and gravitational potential energy exchange along one orbit.

cues.title: 到达高度，速度还不匹配
cues.caption: 远端 v≈0.630，小于圆轨道所需 0.745。
cues.captionEn: Arrival speed about 0.630 is below required circular speed 0.745.
cues.zh: 停在远端比较。转移椭圆速度约零点六三零，而同一半径的圆轨道需要零点七四五。高度虽然已经到了，速度仍不匹配。飞行器不会自动进入目标圆，还缺第二次沿运动方向的速度改变量。
cues.en: Pause at arrival. Transfer speed is about zero point six three zero, below circular speed zero point seven four five at that radius. Altitude matches, but velocity does not. A second tangential increment is required.

cues.title: 第二次加速，圆化轨道
cues.caption: 第二次增加约 0.115，随后保持目标圆半径。
cues.captionEn: A second increment of about 0.115 establishes the target circle.
cues.zh: 再沿当时运动方向加速约零点一一五。位置仍连续，速度改成目标圆所需值，随后半径保持不变。升轨两次脉冲都加速，中间上升滑行却会变慢，这两件事并不矛盾。
cues.en: Add about zero point one one five along the current velocity. Position remains continuous as speed becomes suitable for the target circle. Both raising impulses add speed, although the coast between them slows.

cues.title: 省略第二次，就继续返回
cues.titleEn: Skip impulse two and the ellipse returns
cues.caption: 不圆化就继续原椭圆，回到原来的低半径。
cues.captionEn: Without circularization, the same ellipse returns to the original lower radius.
cues.zh: 省略第二次点火，看看后面发生什么。能量与角动量没有再次改变，飞行器沿原椭圆继续运动，重新回到低处。没有到站就自动停留的规则；决定轨道的是当前位置和速度，而不只是高度。
cues.en: Omit impulse two. With energy and angular momentum unchanged, the spacecraft continues along the original ellipse and returns toward the lower radius. Reaching an altitude does not mean staying there: position and velocity together determine the orbit.

cues.title: 降轨反过来，两次减速
cues.caption: 降轨两次 Δv 为负，中间下落仍会加速。
cues.captionEn: Lowering uses two negative increments, although the falling coast gains speed.
cues.zh: 反过来去较低圆轨道，两次点火都逆着当时运动方向，计划速度改变量为负。但中间向下滑行时，速度仍会增加。要把点火瞬间和无推力滑行分开，减速降轨并不是全程都在变慢。
cues.en: Reverse the transfer to a lower circle. Both impulses oppose local velocity, giving negative increments. Yet speed increases during the falling coast. Braking to lower an orbit does not mean slowing throughout the entire transfer.

cues.title: 大增益不会自动找到正确输出
cues.titleEn: Large gain alone does not find the desired output
cues.caption: 开环中，1 mV也能把输出推到电源轨。
cues.captionEn: Open loop, even 1 mV can drive output to a rail.
cues.zh: 先把反相端接地，断开返回路径。同相端只有一毫伏，可是运放的开环增益很大，输出仍一路向上，最后碰到十伏的限制。观察输入读数，它们始终不同。两输入电压近似相等，并不是一个脱离电路条件就能使用的规则。
cues.en: Ground the inverting input and leave the return path open. The non-inverting input is only one millivolt, but the large open-loop gain drives output upward until it reaches the ten-volt limit. The input readings remain different. Nearly equal input voltages are not a rule that works independently of circuit conditions.

cues.title: 让输出返回反相端
cues.titleEn: Return output to the inverting input
cues.caption: 输出升高，反馈电压升高，误差减小。
cues.captionEn: Rising output increases feedback voltage and reduces error.
cues.zh: 现在通过九十千欧和十千欧电阻，把十分之一的输出送回反相端。输入跳到零点五伏后，输出开始上升，反馈电压也跟着上升。差分误差越来越小，响应逐渐放缓，最终停在接近五伏的位置。负反馈让输出对自己的变化作出校正。
cues.en: Return one tenth of output through the ninety-kilohm and ten-kilohm divider. After a half-volt input step, output rises and the feedback voltage rises with it. Differential error shrinks, the response slows, and output settles near five volts. Negative feedback makes the circuit correct its response to its own output.

cues.title: 电阻比例设定闭环增益
cues.titleEn: The resistor ratio sets closed-loop gain
cues.caption: 改变反馈比例，输出随之调整。
cues.captionEn: Changing the feedback fraction changes the required output.
cues.zh: 保持输入零点五伏，比较不同的反馈电阻。上方电阻从十千欧增到九十千欧，返回比例从二分之一降到十分之一。为了把反相端维持在接近输入的位置，输出就要从约一伏升到约五伏。读数显示，决定闭环比例的是这条分压路径。
cues.en: Keep input at half a volt and compare feedback resistors. Raising the upper resistor from ten to ninety kilohms reduces the returned fraction from one half to one tenth. To keep the inverting input near the applied input, output rises from about one volt to about five. The divider determines the closed-loop ratio.

cues.title: 虚短究竟有多近
cues.titleEn: How close is a virtual short?
cues.caption: 环路增益有限，两输入仍有差值。
cues.captionEn: Finite loop gain leaves a nonzero differential error.
cues.zh: 把开环增益先设为二十。此时两根电压条明显不等，输出只有约三点三三伏。再逐渐提高增益，反相端越来越接近同相端，误差读数缩小。增益达到十万时，误差仍约五十微伏。虚短是一种可量化的近似，而不是误差严格等于零。
cues.en: Start with an open-loop gain of twenty. The voltage bars differ visibly, and output is only about three point three three volts. Increasing gain brings the inverting input closer to the non-inverting input and reduces the error. At a gain of one hundred thousand, roughly fifty microvolts remain. A virtual short is a quantitative approximation, not exactly zero error.

cues.title: 碰到电源轨，校正停住了
cues.titleEn: At the rail, correction runs out of room
cues.caption: 输出饱和后，输入误差持续存在。
cues.captionEn: Saturation leaves a persistent input error.
cues.zh: 现在把输入继续提高。按照约十倍的闭环比例，一点五伏输入需要十五伏输出，可是这只模型的输出上限只有十伏。反馈端因此最多达到一伏，两根电压条重新分开，留下半伏误差。即使负反馈接线还在，饱和时也不能继续套用虚短。
cues.en: Raise the input further. A closed-loop gain near ten would require fifteen volts out for one point five volts in, but this model stops at ten. Feedback can reach only one volt, so the bars separate and half a volt of error remains. The feedback connection is still present, but saturation invalidates the virtual-short approximation.

cues.title: 输出变化也有速度上限
cues.titleEn: Output also has a speed limit
cues.caption: 较大阶跃沿相同斜率爬升更久。
cues.captionEn: A larger step follows the same limited slope for longer.
cues.zh: 最后同时比较零点二伏和零点八伏输入阶跃。两条响应最初都沿着每微秒零点五伏的斜率爬升；较大的输出摆幅，需要保持这段斜坡更久。接近目标后，曲线再转为缓慢收尾。电源轨限制的是幅度，转换速率限制的是变化速度，它们是不同的边界。
cues.en: Finally compare point-two-volt and point-eight-volt input steps. Both responses initially rise at half a volt per microsecond. The larger output excursion must stay on that ramp longer. Near the target, each trace changes to an exponential tail. Rails limit output amplitude; slew rate limits how fast output can change. They are different boundaries.

cues.title: 没有大尾涡的阻力
cues.caption: 低Re时，黏性效应主导；球面流体相对速度为零。
cues.captionEn: At low Re, viscosity dominates and relative velocity vanishes on the surface.
cues.zh: 从固定在画面中的刚性球观察流体。远处流体缓缓向上，靠近球面时受到无滑移条件约束，速度趋于零。流线前后对称，没有画出惯性主导的大尾涡，但阻力并不为零。这里显示的是三维球体流场的一个经线截面，不是二维圆柱绕流。
cues.en: Watch from the rigid sphere’s frame. Fluid moves upward far away and approaches zero relative velocity at its no-slip surface. Fore-and-aft streamlines are symmetric, without a large inertial wake, yet drag is nonzero. This is a meridional section of flow around a three-dimensional sphere, not two-dimensional cylinder flow.

cues.title: 低速下是一次方
cues.caption: 尺寸和黏度固定，阻力与相对速度成正比。
cues.captionEn: At fixed size and viscosity, drag is proportional to relative speed.
cues.zh: 保持球半径与液体黏度不变，增加规定的相对流速。流动标记变快，阻力读数按相同比例增加。斯托克斯定律在低雷诺数条件下是速度的一次方，而不是熟悉的高速平方阻力。这里先规定速度再求阻力，还没有要求球靠重力自由沉降。
cues.en: Hold radius and viscosity while increasing prescribed relative flow speed. Markers accelerate and drag grows by the same factor. In the low-Reynolds-number limit, Stokes drag is linear in speed rather than the familiar high-speed square law. Speed is prescribed here; gravity has not yet selected a free settling speed.

cues.title: 黏度改变应力大小
cues.caption: 规定速度相同，黏度增加使阻力增加，归一流线形状不变。
cues.captionEn: At the same prescribed speed, viscosity raises drag without changing normalized streamline shape.
cues.zh: 固定速度和球的尺寸，只提高动力黏度。阻力增加，流线形状和规定速度却保持不变。对于这个无惯性的解析问题，速度边界决定归一后的流场形状，黏度改变维持这套流动所需的应力。不能把更黏直接画成规定流速也自动变慢；那需要另外指定驱动力条件。
cues.en: Fix speed and sphere size, then increase dynamic viscosity. Drag rises while streamline shape and prescribed speed remain unchanged. In this creeping-flow solution, velocity boundaries determine the normalized field; viscosity sets the stress required to maintain it. A more viscous liquid does not automatically slow a speed that has been externally prescribed.

cues.title: 半径不能随便换成面积
cues.caption: 规定速度下，球阻力与半径成正比。
cues.captionEn: At prescribed speed, sphere drag is proportional to radius.
cues.zh: 再保持速度与黏度不变，让球半径从零点一五增加到零点三毫米。球的真实尺寸变大，周围流线也由新的球面条件重新计算。阻力增加两倍，不是按迎风面积增加四倍。低雷诺数球体的作用范围与黏性流场一起决定尺度，不能只套用高速阻力的面积直觉。
cues.en: Keep speed and viscosity fixed and grow radius from zero point one five to zero point three millimetres. The sphere grows and surrounding contours follow its new boundary. Drag doubles rather than quadrupling with projected area. At low Reynolds number, the sphere and its viscous disturbance set the scale; high-speed area intuition is insufficient.

cues.title: 终端速度是力平衡
cues.caption: 终端沉降时，阻力加浮力等于重力。
cues.captionEn: At terminal settling, drag plus buoyancy equals weight.
cues.zh: 现在让重力决定终端沉降速度。画面跟着球移动，所以球仍固定，液体相对它上行。增加球密度，重力减去浮力的差值增大，需要更快相对运动才能提供足够阻力。三个力最终平衡，速度并不是零。这个模式只求终端状态，不把起步瞬态套进稳态流场。
cues.en: Now let gravity select terminal settling speed. The view follows the sphere, so it stays fixed while liquid moves upward relative to it. Increasing sphere density raises weight minus buoyancy and requires faster motion for sufficient drag. The three forces balance at a nonzero speed. Only the terminal state is solved; start-up transients are not represented by the steady field.

cues.title: 先算，再检查假设
cues.caption: 黏度降低后，斯托克斯试算可能不再满足低Re条件。
cues.captionEn: Lower viscosity can make the Stokes trial violate its own low-Re assumption.
cues.zh: 最后逐渐降低黏度。斯托克斯终端速度试算会不断增大，但必须把结果代回雷诺数检查。超过保守显示界限后，流场图停止外推，读数只保留试算值和不自洽提示。这不表示刚过界就突然湍流，而是原先忽略惯性的近似已不足以支撑这里的预测，需要更完整的阻力模型。
cues.en: Finally lower viscosity. A Stokes terminal-speed trial grows, but its Reynolds number must be checked afterward. Beyond the conservative display limit, the field stops extrapolating and the reading is explicitly a trial that fails its assumption. Crossing this marker does not suddenly create turbulence; it calls for a drag model that retains more physics.

cues.title: 满月可以绕开影子
cues.titleEn: A full Moon can miss the shadow
cues.caption: i≈5.145°，满月离交点较远时越过影区。
cues.captionEn: At i ≈ 5.145°, a full Moon far from a node misses the shadow.
cues.zh: 满月意味着月球在太阳的对面附近，不代表它一定穿过地球影子。月球轨道相对黄道倾斜约五度，多数满月从影子上方或下方通过。左边是影子截面，右边把同一个月面投影另行放大。
cues.en: A full Moon is near the opposite direction from the Sun, without necessarily crossing Earth’s shadow. About five degrees of lunar-orbit inclination lets most full Moons pass above or below. The left section and enlarged lunar view share one geometry.

cues.title: 把倾角设为零作对照
cues.caption: 只把倾角设为零，同一满月对日几何进入本影。
cues.captionEn: Setting inclination to zero centers this full-Moon alignment in the umbra.
cues.zh: 只把轨道倾角改成零，保留满月对日关系。月心就落到影轴上，整个月球投影进入本影。这是反事实对照，说明阻止每月都发生月食的关键，是轨道的倾斜及满月相对交点的位置。
cues.en: Set only orbital inclination to zero while preserving full-Moon alignment. The lunar center reaches the shadow axis and the whole disk enters the umbra. This counterfactual isolates why inclination and full-Moon position relative to a node matter.

cues.title: 接近交点才进入影区
cues.titleEn: Move the full-Moon geometry toward a node
cues.caption: 恢复倾角，再把满月距交点角 F 从 35° 降到零。
cues.captionEn: Restore inclination and reduce full-Moon node angle F from 35° to zero.
cues.zh: 恢复约五度倾角，再比较满月越来越接近交点的几种几何。月心偏移减小，月球投影开始进入影区。这里扫描的是不同满月位置的条件，不是一场真实月食按分钟播放的路线。
cues.en: Restore the inclination and compare full-Moon geometries progressively nearer a node. The axial offset shrinks and the projected disk enters the shadow. This scans possible configurations rather than minutes along one real eclipse.

cues.title: 半影不等于本影
cues.caption: 只进入半影时，本影覆盖仍为 0%，月面却可稍暗。
cues.captionEn: A penumbral eclipse can have 0% umbral area while the Moon dims slightly.
cues.zh: 现在月球只进入半影，没有碰到本影。半影中只遮住一部分太阳直射光，所以月面可以略暗，却没有本影的深暗缺口。百分比读数仍为零，因为它测的是进入本影的投影面积，不是所有明暗变化。
cues.en: Here the Moon enters only the penumbra. Some direct sunlight is blocked, allowing slight dimming without an umbral bite. Umbral percentage remains zero because the readout measures projected umbral area, rather than every change in brightness.

cues.title: 部分投影进入本影
cues.titleEn: Part of the projected disk enters the umbra
cues.caption: 月球圆投影与本影部分重叠，成为月偏食。
cues.captionEn: Partial overlap of the lunar projection and umbra produces a partial eclipse.
cues.zh: 再靠近影轴，月球的一部分投影进入本影，月偏食出现。局部图的缺口和左边两个圆的相交来自同一几何。不能只看月心是否进入；全食要求整个月球投影都被本影包含。
cues.en: Closer to the axis, part of the lunar projection enters the umbra, producing a partial eclipse. The close-view bite matches the same circle intersection. The center alone does not decide totality: the entire projected disk must fit inside the umbra.

cues.title: 全食不意味着绝对无光
cues.titleEn: Totality does not mean absolute darkness
cues.caption: 整个投影在本影中；大气余光可让月面仍显铜红。
cues.captionEn: The whole disk is in the umbra, yet atmospheric light can leave a copper-red Moon.
cues.zh: 整个月球投影进入本影，直射太阳被完全挡住，就是月全食。但地球大气仍能把经过散射、折射的余光送入影区，使月面可能呈铜红色。这里逐渐加入定性余光示意，不预测实际亮度或某次全食的颜色。
cues.en: The entire disk fits in the umbra, blocking direct sunlight. Earth’s atmosphere can still scatter and refract remaining light into the shadow, sometimes giving a copper-red Moon. The added tint is qualitative, without predicting an event’s brightness or color.

cues.title: 距离也改变相交范围
cues.caption: 月地距离改变时，月心偏移与影锥截面同时改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing lunar distance changes both axial offset and the shadow-cone section.
cues.zh: 保持同样倾角和交点角，只改变月地距离。影锥截面半径变了，月心偏移也随距离变化，进入本影的面积比例因此改变。这套球形近轴模型说明几何原因，不包含真实历表和大气影子扩大，不能拿来预测月食日期或接触时刻。
cues.en: Keep inclination and node angle fixed while changing lunar distance. Both shadow radius and axial offset change, altering the umbral overlap. This spherical paraxial model explains the geometry, without real ephemerides or atmospheric shadow enlargement needed for event contacts.

cues.title: 电流方向与电子漂移
cues.caption: 传统电流向右，电子平均漂移向左。
cues.captionEn: Conventional current goes right; electrons drift left.
cues.zh: 先把磁场关掉，只看这片导体中的电流。上方箭头是传统电流方向，向右；电子带负电，平均漂移却向左。我们把运动放慢，只显示少量示踪载流子。上下表笔之间暂时没有霍尔电压，纵向导电与横向测量是两件不同的事。
cues.en: Start with the magnetic field off. The arrow shows conventional current to the right, while negatively charged electrons drift left. Motion is slowed, and only selected tracer carriers are shown. There is no Hall voltage between the upper and lower probes. Longitudinal conduction and transverse measurement are different parts of the experiment.

cues.title: 磁力指向哪一边
cues.titleEn: Which way does magnetic force point?
cues.caption: 负电子向左、磁场穿出屏幕，磁力向下。
cues.captionEn: For electrons drifting left in an outward field, force points down.
cues.zh: 加入穿出屏幕的磁场，圆点标记它的方向。先看中心电子的磁力FB：结合速度、磁场和负电荷符号，它指向下边缘。下边缘因此相对带负，上边缘相对带正。红表笔接在下边缘，黑表笔接在上边缘，所以这个接线约定下，电压表读负值。
cues.en: Apply a field out of the screen, marked by dots. First inspect magnetic force FB on the central electron. Velocity, field and negative charge together make it point downward. The lower edge is relatively negative and the upper edge positive. With red connected below and black above, this probe convention gives a negative voltage.

cues.title: 电场力让横向偏转停止
cues.titleEn: Electric force balances the sideways push
cues.caption: 稳态时，FE与FB等大反向。
cues.captionEn: In steady state, FE and FB are equal and opposite.
cues.zh: 再看电场力FE。边缘的电荷分离建立了横向电场，对负电子产生向上的力，恰好抵消向下的磁力。达到这个平衡后，平均漂移仍沿着导体长度方向，不会不断冲向侧边。眼前比较的是稳态，箭头表示方向；磁力本身垂直于速度，并不直接做功。
cues.en: Now inspect electric force FE. Separated edge charge creates a transverse electric field that pushes negative electrons upward, balancing magnetic force downward. In steady state, average drift stays along the bar instead of continually accelerating sideways. The arrows show direction. Magnetic force itself is perpendicular to velocity and does no direct work.

cues.title: 反转磁场，读数翻转
cues.titleEn: Reverse the field and the reading
cues.caption: 只反转B，边缘极性与霍尔电压一起翻转。
cues.captionEn: Reversing only B reverses edge polarity and Hall voltage.
cues.zh: 保持电流与电子类型不变，把磁场从穿出屏幕逐渐改成进入屏幕。经过零磁场时，横向电压也经过零。随后磁力方向、边缘电荷正负和电压表读数全部翻转。表笔没有移动，因此读数变化来自磁场，而不是接线被换了方向。
cues.en: Keep current and carrier type fixed while reversing the field from outward to inward. Hall voltage passes through zero with the field. Magnetic force, edge polarity and the meter reading then reverse together. The probes have stayed in place, so the sign change comes from the field rather than a swapped measurement connection.

cues.title: 换载流子，不换传统电流
cues.caption: 正载流子漂移反向，磁力仍向同一侧。
cues.captionEn: Positive carriers drift the other way, but magnetic force stays downward.
cues.zh: 恢复穿出屏幕的磁场，传统电流仍向右。这次换成正载流子，它们向右漂移。注意磁力仍指向下边缘，因为速度与电荷符号同时改变了。可是下边缘积累的现在是正电荷，固定表笔读到正电压。霍尔测量因此能帮助判断主导载流子的符号。
cues.en: Restore the outward field and keep conventional current rightward. Positive carriers now drift to the right. Magnetic force still points downward because both velocity and charge sign changed. But the lower edge now carries positive charge, so the same probes read a positive voltage. Hall measurements can therefore help identify the dominant carrier sign.

cues.title: 同样电流，更少载流子
cues.titleEn: The same current with fewer carriers
cues.caption: 密度降低，需要更快漂移，霍尔电压增大。
cues.captionEn: Lower density requires faster drift and gives a larger Hall voltage.
cues.zh: 回到电子样品，保持电流和磁场不变，逐渐降低载流子密度。更少的载流子要输送同样电流，平均漂移必须更快，平衡磁力所需的横向电场也更强。密度降为原来的四分之一，霍尔电压的绝对值增至四倍。反推密度时，还必须知道厚度并确认单载流子近似。
cues.en: Return to electrons and hold current and field fixed while reducing carrier density. Fewer carriers must drift faster to carry the same current, requiring a stronger transverse field for force balance. Quartering density multiplies Hall-voltage magnitude by four. Inferring density from a measurement also requires sample thickness and a valid single-carrier approximation.

cues.title: 上板启动后
cues.caption: 靠近上板的流体先动，动量向内部扩散。
cues.captionEn: Fluid near the upper plate moves first as momentum diffuses inward.
cues.zh: 上板突然开始匀速移动，下面的流体最初静止。金色标记线靠近上板的部分先被带走，影响逐渐向下传。绿色曲线给出同一时刻的速度。这里用的是均匀流体启动解，动量扩散需要时间，不会让整层液体瞬间都获得同一个速度。
cues.en: The upper plate begins moving at constant speed above initially resting fluid. Gold markers near it move first as the influence spreads downward. Green shows velocity at that same instant. This uniform-fluid startup solution lets momentum diffuse over time rather than instantly giving the entire gap one common speed.

cues.title: 速度建立之后
cues.caption: 下板固定、上板匀速时，稳态速度沿高度线性变化。
cues.captionEn: A fixed lower plate and moving upper plate give a linear steady profile.
cues.zh: 速度建立后，放入一条新的竖直参考标记线。每个高度按自己的速度移动，两秒后形成倾斜的直线。下板处速度为零，上板处与上板相同，中间线性过渡。流体没有被分成互不作用的硬薄片；这些横层只帮助我们观察连续速度梯度。
cues.en: Once the profile settles, introduce a new vertical reference line. Each height moves at its own speed, producing a slanted straight line after two seconds. Velocity is zero at the lower plate and matches the upper plate at the top, with a linear transition between. The layers describe a continuous gradient, not independent rigid sheets.

cues.title: 两种黏度相接
cues.caption: 界面速度连续，相同剪应力对应不同速度梯度。
cues.captionEn: Interface velocity stays continuous while equal stress permits different gradients.
cues.zh: 保持板速和间隙不变，提高上层液体的黏度。两层交界处，金色线与绿色曲线都没有断开，但斜率发生改变。稳态中传递的剪应力相同，较黏的一层只需要较小速度梯度。不能把黏度跳变画成界面上的速度突然跳变，那会违反这里的连续边界条件。
cues.en: Keep plate speed and gap fixed while increasing upper-layer viscosity. Gold and green remain connected at the interface, but their slopes change. Steady shear stress is shared across the layers; higher viscosity needs a smaller velocity gradient. A viscosity jump is not a velocity jump under these interface conditions.

cues.title: 间隙也是条件
cues.titleEn: The gap is a condition too
cues.caption: 同样板速下，间隙增大使剪应力减小。
cues.captionEn: At the same plate speeds, a wider gap reduces shear stress.
cues.zh: 比较几何间隙不同的稳态剪切单元。上板速度、两种黏度与层厚比例保持不变，间隙逐渐增大。相同速度差分摊在更远距离上，剪应力减小。标记线比较的是每个固定间隙中相同两秒的结果，不是把正在流动的液体实际拉开并忽略挤压流。
cues.en: Compare steady cells with different gaps, keeping plate speeds, viscosities and layer fractions fixed. A wider distance spreads the same velocity difference over more height and reduces shear stress. Gold compares the same two-second interval in each fixed gap; it does not simulate physically separating plates while omitting squeeze flow.

cues.title: 换序，不换总阻力
cues.caption: 等厚两层换序后，总剪应力相同，界面速度不同。
cues.captionEn: Swapping equal-thickness layers preserves total stress but changes interface speed.
cues.zh: 把两种等厚液体的上下顺序交换。颜色随液体身份换位，界面速度改变，标记线的折角也换了位置。但两层厚度除以各自黏度的和没有改变，因此在相同板速差下，总剪应力保持相同。整体读数一样，并不代表内部每处速度都一样。
cues.en: Swap the order of the equal-thickness liquids. Colours follow fluid identity; interface speed and the kinked profile change. Yet the sum of each thickness divided by its viscosity is unchanged, so the same plate-speed difference requires the same overall stress. Equal total readings need not imply equal internal velocities.

cues.title: 匀速仍要持续做功
cues.caption: 板输入的机械功率，等于流体中的黏性耗散。
cues.captionEn: Mechanical power from the plates equals viscous dissipation.
cues.zh: 看已经稳定的两层流动。上板一直匀速，净加速度为零，但仍需克服液体的切向阻力持续输入功。下方把单位面积的机械功率与沿间隙积分得到的耗散并列，它们相等。模型只核对能量速率，没有继续计算温升；稳态速度不等于可以不再供能。
cues.en: Watch the steady two-layer flow. The upper plate has zero acceleration but still needs continuous work against tangential resistance. Mechanical input per area equals dissipation integrated across the gap. The model balances these energy rates without computing a temperature rise. A steady velocity does not mean that energy supply can stop.

cues.title: 一起移动没有剪切
cues.caption: 两板同速时，标记线整体平移，速度梯度和耗散为零。
cues.captionEn: Equal plate speeds translate the line with zero gradient and dissipation.
cues.zh: 最后让上下板以同样速度移动。金色线整体平移而不再倾斜，绿色剖面在所有高度给出相同速度。虽然流体正在移动，速度梯度为零，剪应力与黏性耗散也为零。这个反例说明，黏性剪切关心的是相邻位置的速度差，不是相对画面移动了多快。
cues.en: Move both plates at the same speed. Gold translates without tilting, and green gives one velocity at every height. The fluid moves, but its gradient, shear stress and viscous dissipation are zero. Viscous shear responds to differences between neighbouring velocities, not merely to motion relative to the picture.

cues.title: 半年两端，量到的是 2p
cues.caption: 相对两端隔 2B，天空角位移为 2p，p 是半幅。
cues.captionEn: Opposite viewpoints span 2B and an angular displacement 2p; p is the half-amplitude.
cues.zh: 从轨道相对两端观察，附近恒星相对固定远参考发生小小位移。天空图把角度明确放大，半年两端差是二倍视差，定义的 p 只有这个幅度的一半。轨道小图另用长度比例，不能与天空角度直接拼成一个距离图。
cues.en: Opposite orbital viewpoints shift a nearby star against fixed distant references. This sky plate explicitly enlarges angles. Their half-year separation is twice the parallax p, which is the half-amplitude. The orbit inset has its own length scale.

cues.title: 距离加倍，视差减半
cues.caption: B = 1 AU 时，距离 1→2 pc，p 约从 1″ 到 0.5″。
cues.captionEn: At B = 1 AU, increasing distance from 1 to 2 pc reduces p from about 1″ to 0.5″.
cues.zh: 保持一单位天文单位的轨道半径，把目标距离从一秒差距增为二。天空里摇摆的幅度减半，角秒坐标的比例保持不变。对这样的小角，距离约等于基线除以视差；地球一单位基线时，就是熟悉的一除以 p。
cues.en: Keep orbit radius at one astronomical unit and increase distance from one parsec to two. Angular amplitude halves on the unchanged sky scale. For these small angles, distance is approximately baseline divided by parallax; the familiar one-over-p rule assumes a unit baseline.

cues.title: 基线减半，也会减小位移
cues.titleEn: A smaller baseline also reduces motion
cues.caption: 距离不变，B 从 1 到 0.5 AU，p 减半但估距不变。
cues.captionEn: At fixed distance, B changing from 1 to 0.5 AU halves p without changing inferred distance.
cues.zh: 距离保持一秒差距，只把观察轨道半径减半。视差同样减半，但正确使用已知基线，算出的距离仍是一秒差距。看到更小位移，不能直接说目标更远，还要知道观察位置相隔多大。
cues.en: Hold distance at one parsec and halve the observer-orbit radius. Parallax halves too, but including the known baseline preserves the inferred distance. A smaller angular displacement alone does not prove a greater distance: viewpoint separation also matters.

cues.title: 天空形状由方向投影
cues.caption: 黄纬 0°、45°、90° 对应近线、椭圆、近圆。
cues.captionEn: Ecliptic latitudes 0°, 45° and 90° produce near-line, elliptical and near-circular tracks.
cues.zh: 目标在不同黄纬方向，地球圆轨道投到天空的形状也不同。黄道附近接近直线，极点附近接近圆，中间一般是椭圆。改变的是三维视线的投影，不是所有恒星都会在天空描出同一个圆。
cues.en: At different ecliptic latitudes, the same circular observer orbit projects differently. Near the ecliptic the track approaches a line, near its pole a circle, and between them an ellipse. Actual three-dimensional sight projections determine the pattern.

cues.title: 自行让一年后不完全重合
cues.titleEn: Proper motion prevents an exact annual return
cues.caption: 叠加 0.35″/年横向自行，年度周期随线性漂移前进。
cues.captionEn: Add 0.35″ per year of proper motion and the annual pattern drifts.
cues.zh: 加入每年零点三五角秒的横向自行。视差周期仍在，但整条轨迹缓慢向一边走，同一季节一年后不再重合。真实天文测量要把位置、视差与自行分别估计；本片分解的是已知理想量，不把所有摇摆都解释成距离。
cues.en: Add transverse proper motion of zero point three five arcseconds per year. The annual pattern remains while drifting, so equal seasons one year apart do not coincide. Real astrometry estimates position, parallax and proper motion separately; this film decomposes known ideal components.

cues.title: 没有基线，就失去这项距离信息
cues.titleEn: No baseline removes this distance information
cues.caption: B 从 1 变为零，视差消失，估距不再定义。
cues.captionEn: Set B from 1 to zero: parallax disappears and the distance inference becomes undefined.
cues.zh: 最后把观察轨道半径设为零。没有观察位置的变化，这项视差也消失，界面不再给出有限距离。零位移在这个对照里是基线为零造成的，不代表目标突然无限远。先知道参照和基线，才能从角度谈距离。
cues.en: Finally set observer-orbit radius to zero. With no viewpoint change, parallax vanishes and this distance inference is undefined. Here zero displacement comes from zero baseline, without sending the target infinitely far away. References and baseline must precede distance inference.

cues.title: 移动不等于相对运动
cues.caption: 两板速度同为 (1,0)，边界没有相对张开或错动。
cues.captionEn: Both plates moving at (1,0) give no relative opening or sliding.
cues.zh: 先让两块板都以同样速度移动。以右板为参照，它们看起来都不动，边界也没有张开或挤压。边界类型取决于相对速度，不是随便挑一个固定背景，看哪块板在画面里移动。
cues.en: Give both plates the same velocity. In the right-plate frame, neither moves relative to the other and the boundary does not open or compress. Boundary type follows relative velocity, rather than which plate appears to move against an arbitrary background.

cues.title: 法向张开，出现新生宽度
cues.caption: 法向相对速度为正，新生宽度等于速度乘时间。
cues.captionEn: Positive normal relative velocity creates width equal to speed times time.
cues.zh: 让两板沿边界法向分离，新生区域逐渐展开。它的总宽度等于法向相对速度乘经过时间，中央脊线位于两侧新生区之间。这里解释空间如何生成，不把这条速度关系冒充岩浆或热量的完整计算。
cues.en: Separate the plates normal to their boundary. New width grows as relative normal speed times elapsed time, with a ridge between the new portions. This accounts for generated space, without claiming a complete magma-flow or thermal solution.

cues.title: 汇聚下的俯冲需要前提
cues.titleEn: Subduction under convergence needs a premise
cues.caption: 给定左板可俯冲，物质沿连续等弧长路径下沉。
cues.captionEn: Assuming left-plate subduction, material follows a continuous unit-arclength path.
cues.zh: 改为汇聚，并先给定左板可俯冲的前提。剖面标记从海沟前进，沿连续弯曲路径进入深处。板厚由同一条中心线推导，不会在转弯处突然断开。这是运动学演示，不是从速度直接求出了真实俯冲角。
cues.en: Switch to convergence and separately assume the left plate can subduct. Material markers approach the trench and follow a continuous descending path. Both surfaces derive from one centerline. This is kinematics, without deriving a real subduction angle from velocity alone.

cues.title: 纯错动，没有法向新生量
cues.titleEn: Pure sliding has no normal opening
cues.caption: 法向为零，切向运动使两侧参照线错开。
cues.captionEn: Zero normal velocity with tangential motion offsets the reference lines.
cues.zh: 把法向相对速度设为零，只保留沿边界的切向运动。两侧参照线逐渐错开，法向却没有新生或消耗的宽度。这就是转换型边界的局部运动学特征；箭头表示运动速度，不是两股推力。
cues.en: Set normal relative velocity to zero and retain tangential motion. The paired reference lines offset without creating or consuming normal width. This is the local kinematic signature of a transform boundary. Arrows show velocities rather than opposing forces.

cues.title: 斜向边界可以同时有两项
cues.caption: 同一相对速度可同时包含汇聚与切向错动。
cues.captionEn: One relative velocity can combine convergence with tangential sliding.
cues.zh: 现在斜着运动。实线速度箭头分解成法向和切向两项，因此汇聚与错动可以同时发生。不能只根据箭头朝哪个象限，就忽略另一项；它们分别改变跨边界的距离和沿边界的对齐。
cues.en: Move obliquely. The relative velocity decomposes into normal and tangential components, allowing convergence and sliding together. These components separately change cross-boundary separation and along-boundary alignment; choosing one label does not remove the other component.

cues.title: 相同汇聚，不自动决定俯冲
cues.titleEn: The same convergence does not decide subduction
cues.caption: 取消可俯冲前提，刚体停在大陆接触处，需额外变形模型。
cues.captionEn: Remove the subduction premise: rigid geometry stops at contact and needs a deformation model.
cues.zh: 保持同样汇聚速度，但取消左板可俯冲的前提，改看大陆接触。这个刚体模型停在接触处，不让两块板互相穿透，也不凭速度制造确定的山脉。真实变形需要密度、温度、受力与历史；运动分类并没有替代地球动力学。
cues.en: Keep the same convergence but remove the assumed subductability. The rigid model stops at continental contact, without interpenetration or invented quantitative mountain building. Real deformation requires density, temperature, forces and history. Kinematic classification does not replace geodynamics.

cues.title: 一个环，两个切口
cues.caption: 切面中的两个涡核属于同一个闭合环。
cues.captionEn: The two section cores belong to one closed ring.
cues.zh: 先正对这个闭合的涡环，再把视线转到侧面。环的上部和下部被同一个经线平面切到，形成两个涡核。它们在切面中旋转方向相反，却是同一条有向涡丝的两段。圆点表示涡量朝向我们，叉号表示朝向画面里面；这不是两只独立的烟圈。
cues.en: Look along the axis of one closed vortex ring, then turn to a side view. A meridional plane cuts the same ring at its top and bottom. The two cores have opposite rotation in this section because they belong to opposite sides of one directed loop. A dot points vorticity toward us; a cross points away. They are not two separate rings.

cues.title: 跟住一小团流体
cues.caption: 流体绕核运动，环并非一只刚体。
cues.captionEn: Fluid rolls around a core; the ring is not a rigid body.
cues.zh: 现在跟着涡环移动，把整个环暂时固定在视野中。金色标记是一小团流体，它经过环内侧，再绕到外侧。淡线记录这个参考系中的轨迹。环的传播和流体局部运动是不同的量，轴心处流体的速度也不等于环的前进速度。
cues.en: Move with the ring so its cores stay in view. The gold marker follows one fluid parcel as it passes inside the ring and travels around a core. The faint line records its path in this frame. Local fluid motion and propagation of the whole ring are different quantities. Even the fluid at the axis centre does not move at the ring speed.

cues.title: 增加环量
cues.caption: 半径与核宽比固定，速度随环量同比增加。
cues.captionEn: At fixed geometry, velocity scales with circulation.
cues.zh: 保持环的半径与相对核宽不变，只增加环量。环量衡量围绕涡丝的有向循环强度。速度场的每一项都与它成正比，因此环的传播速度和流体运动同时加快。自由探索中把环量改成负值，两个涡核的方向与传播方向会一起反转。
cues.en: Keep the radius and relative core width fixed, and increase circulation. Circulation measures the directed strength of the motion around the filament. Every term in this velocity field is proportional to it, so both ring propagation and fluid motion speed up. In exploration, negative circulation reverses the two core directions and the propagation together.

cues.title: 同样环量，扩大半径
cues.caption: 相似核形下，传播速度与半径成反比。
cues.captionEn: For similar cores, propagation speed is inversely proportional to radius.
cues.zh: 这次保持环量不变，同时让核宽随半径按相同比例放大。相似几何下，环的传播速度与半径成反比。较大的环在这里反而走得较慢。这个比较必须同时说明固定的是环量和核宽比；如果实际喷口同时改变这些量，不能只看烟圈大小来判断速度。
cues.en: This time keep circulation fixed, while widening the core in the same proportion as the ring radius. For similar geometry, ring speed is inversely proportional to radius. The larger ring therefore moves more slowly here. The comparison depends on holding circulation and relative core width fixed. Size alone cannot predict speed when a real nozzle changes those quantities as well.

cues.title: 换回实验室
cues.caption: 环向前传播，流体相对环仍在翻滚。
cues.captionEn: The ring advances while fluid keeps rolling relative to it.
cues.zh: 把观察者固定回实验室。背景刻线不动，环向前移动；刚才相对于环的流体运动，现在叠加了环的位移。远处的流体在实验室中趋于静止。更换参考系不会产生另一种流动，只是从每一点的速度中减去或加回同一个平移速度。
cues.en: Fix the observer in the laboratory. The background lines remain still while the ring advances. The motion previously seen relative to the ring now includes its displacement. Far from the ring, laboratory fluid velocity approaches zero. Changing frames does not create another flow: it subtracts or restores the same translation velocity at every point.

cues.title: 核宽也参与答案
cues.caption: 同样半径和环量，核模型改变传播速度。
cues.captionEn: Core structure changes speed even at fixed radius and circulation.
cues.zh: 最后保持半径与环量，只比较较窄和较宽的平滑核。传播读数仍然改变，所以环的速度不能只由外形直径决定。这里用平滑的涡丝速度场避开无限大的核内速度；它没有计算烟雾浓度、黏性扩散或破裂。真实烟圈还会受到这些过程的影响。
cues.en: Finally, hold radius and circulation fixed while comparing narrower and wider smoothed cores. The propagation speed still changes, so outer diameter alone is not enough. This model smooths the filament field to avoid infinite velocity at its centre. It does not predict smoke concentration, viscous spreading or breakup, all of which also matter for a real smoke ring.

cues.title: 追波峰，还是追水？
cues.titleEn: A crest or a water parcel?
cues.caption: 波峰前进，水质点在局部往复。
cues.captionEn: The crest travels while a parcel moves locally.
cues.zh: 先看上方的波峰向前，再看下方同一深度的一颗水质点。下方把局部位移放大，金点绕着固定平均位置运动。波形经过许多位置，不等于这颗水质点也走过同样距离。这里是一阶小振幅理论，闭合轨道并不否定真实水波可能出现更高阶的净漂移。
cues.en: Watch a crest travel above, then follow one water parcel below. Its local displacement is enlarged around a fixed mean position. The waveform crosses many locations while the parcel moves nearby. These are first-order, small-amplitude orbits. Their closure does not rule out higher-order drift in real water waves.

cues.title: 往深处看
cues.caption: 深水中，轨道随深度迅速缩小。
cues.captionEn: In deep water, orbital motion decays rapidly with depth.
cues.zh: 保持同一波长和水深，只把观察点从表层移向水底。深水中的质点轨道接近圆形，尺寸却随着深度快速衰减。水面下半个波长处，位移只剩表层的大约百分之四。水面有明显波浪，不表示整个水柱都在以相同幅度运动。
cues.en: Keep wavelength and depth fixed, and move the observation level downward. In deep water, parcel orbits are nearly circular, but their size decays rapidly with depth. Half a wavelength below the mean surface, displacement is only about four percent of its surface value. Visible waves do not mean that the whole water column moves equally.

cues.title: 水底压扁轨道
cues.caption: 底面禁止竖直穿透，水平运动仍可存在。
cues.captionEn: The bed prevents vertical motion but allows horizontal motion.
cues.zh: 现在比较越来越浅的均匀水域。观察点保持在水深的同一比例，轨道逐渐压成扁椭圆。到底面时，竖直位移严格为零，水仍可以水平往返。这来自不可穿透底面的边界条件；本图没有把它解释成底部摩擦，也没有模拟向岸边传播时的增幅和破碎。
cues.en: Compare progressively shallower uniform water bodies. Keep the parcel at the same fraction of depth and watch its orbit flatten into an ellipse. At the bed, vertical displacement is exactly zero while horizontal motion remains. This follows from an impermeable boundary. The model does not attribute it to bed friction or simulate shoaling and breaking toward a beach.

cues.title: 长波与短波
cues.caption: 同样深水中，较长的重力波相速更大。
cues.captionEn: Longer gravity waves travel faster in the same deep water.
cues.zh: 重新看较深的水域，只增加波长。上方固定十八米的观察窗口中，波峰间隔拉大，计算出的相位速度也上升。重力波的波长和频率不能任意搭配，它们由水深参与的色散关系联系。改变振幅则不改变这套线性模型的速度；大浪超出这个近似。
cues.en: Return to deeper water and increase only wavelength. Within the fixed eighteen-metre window, crest spacing grows and the calculated phase speed rises. Wavelength and frequency cannot be chosen independently: water depth enters their dispersion relation. Amplitude does not change speed in this linear model. Large waves require a different approximation.

cues.title: 两种速度
cues.caption: 深水中，包络传播慢于内部波峰。
cues.captionEn: In deep water, the envelope moves more slowly than its crests.
cues.zh: 把两条波长相近的重力波相加，下面出现一串强弱起伏的波组。金色竖线跟住包络的峰，浅色点跟住内部相位。两者都来自上面两个分量，却走得不同。两波越来越接近时，包络速度趋于群速度；深水重力波的群速度接近相速的一半。
cues.en: Add two gravity waves with nearby wavelengths. Their sum forms alternating strong and weak groups. The gold line follows an envelope peak; the pale dot follows the carrier phase. Both come from the two components, yet they travel differently. As the component wavelengths approach one another, envelope speed tends to group speed, about half the phase speed in deep water.

cues.title: 浅水让两者接近
cues.caption: 长波浅水极限中，群速与相速趋于相同。
cues.captionEn: For long waves in shallow water, group and phase speeds converge.
cues.zh: 保留两波叠加，这次让波长远大于水深。包络和内部相位的速度现在很接近，因为长波浅水极限中的速度主要由水深决定，约等于重力加速度乘水深后开方。最后区分三件事：水质点局部运动、波峰的相速、波组的传播速度；它们不能互相替代。
cues.en: Keep the two-wave sum, but make wavelength much larger than depth. Envelope and carrier speeds are now close. In the shallow-water, long-wave limit, speed depends mainly on depth and approaches the square root of gravity times depth. Keep three quantities separate: local parcel motion, crest phase speed and group propagation. They are not interchangeable.

cues.title: 有磁场，却没有制动
cues.caption: 均匀磁场中，电势可以抵消运动电动势。
cues.captionEn: In a uniform field, electrostatic potential cancels motional emf.
cues.zh: 先看整片金属在均匀磁场中向右移动。圆点表示磁场穿出屏幕，但画面没有闭合电流，制动力也为零。金属内部的电荷分离建立了静电场，抵消运动产生的电动势。因此，有磁场又有运动，并不自动意味着持续的涡流制动。
cues.en: Start with a sheet moving right through a uniform field. Dots indicate a field out of the screen, yet there are no closed current loops and drag is zero. Charge separation establishes an electrostatic field that cancels the motional electromotive force. A field and motion alone do not guarantee sustained eddy-current braking.

cues.title: 局部磁场打开回路
cues.caption: 局部磁场让电流在金属内部闭合。
cues.captionEn: A localized field drives closed currents inside the metal.
cues.zh: 现在把磁场集中到中间区域，金属仍以相同速度移动。不同位置受到的运动电动势不同，无法由一个静电势处处抵消，于是出现左右两组闭合电流。沿绿色回路追踪方向：这些电流在磁场中受力，合力指向左，抵抗薄片向右的运动。
cues.en: Concentrate the field near the center while keeping the same sheet speed. The motional electromotive force now varies with position and cannot be canceled everywhere by one electrostatic potential. Two families of current loops appear. Follow their green arrows: magnetic forces on these currents sum to a leftward force, resisting the sheet moving right.

cues.title: 把运动反过来
cues.caption: 速度反向，电流与制动力一起反向。
cues.captionEn: Reverse velocity and both current and braking force reverse.
cues.zh: 保持磁场不变，让速度从向右逐渐经过零，再变成向左。绿色箭头随速度反向，制动力也反向，但始终反对运动。经过零速度时，电流、力和发热同时消失。这里比较的是外部驱动规定的速度，方向变化不是由这个制动力自行产生的。
cues.en: Keep the field fixed and move speed gradually from rightward through zero to leftward. Green current arrows reverse, and so does the force, always opposing motion. At zero speed, current, force and heating vanish together. These speeds are prescribed by an external drive; the force itself is not being used to calculate the reversal.

cues.title: 越慢，制动力越小
cues.caption: 涡流制动不能提供静止保持力。
cues.captionEn: Eddy-current braking cannot hold a stationary sheet.
cues.zh: 恢复向右移动，再逐渐降速。这个低速范围内，制动力与速度成正比，发热功率则与速度平方成正比。快停下时，制动力也越来越弱；完全静止后，涡流无法把金属锁住。需要停车保持的装置，仍要有其他产生静止保持力的机制。
cues.en: Restore rightward motion and gradually reduce speed. In this low-speed range, drag is proportional to speed, while heating power follows speed squared. As motion approaches rest, braking becomes weaker. At rest, eddy currents cannot lock the sheet in place. A device that must remain stopped needs another mechanism to provide a static holding force.

cues.title: 切开大回路
cues.caption: 纵向绝缘切缝显著减小制动力。
cues.captionEn: Longitudinal insulating slits greatly reduce drag.
cues.zh: 保持原来的速度和磁场，把薄片分成八条相互绝缘的导电带。原先跨越整片的大回路不能再闭合，只剩各条带内的小回路。比较下方制动力，材料的电导率和总面积没有改变，制动却显著减弱。关键变化是电流能够绕行的路径。
cues.en: Keep the original speed and field, but divide the sheet into eight insulated conducting strips. Large loops spanning the sheet can no longer close; only smaller loops within each strip remain. Compare the force below. Conductivity and total modeled metal area are unchanged, yet braking is greatly reduced because the available current paths have changed.

cues.title: 机械功率变成热
cues.caption: 维持匀速所补充的功率等于焦耳热。
cues.captionEn: Power supplied to maintain speed equals Joule heating.
cues.zh: 回到完整薄片，维持速度不变并逐渐增强磁场。电流随磁场增大，而电流受到的磁力还要再乘一次磁场，所以低速制动力与磁场平方成正比。最后比较两项功率：外部驱动补足的机械功率，恰好等于金属中的焦耳热；磁场负责转移作用，能量来自维持运动的驱动。
cues.en: Return to the intact sheet, hold speed fixed and increase the field. Current grows with field strength, and magnetic force multiplies by the field once more, so low-speed drag scales with field squared. Finally compare the two powers: mechanical power supplied by the external drive equals Joule heat in the sheet. The drive maintaining motion supplies that energy.

cues.title: 先核对没有灰层作用的平衡
cues.titleEn: First balance an inactive gray layer
cues.caption: ε=0 时，表面辐射直接逸出，约 238.2 W/m²。
cues.captionEn: At ε = 0, surface radiation escapes directly at about 238.2 W/m².
cues.zh: 先让灰层不吸收也不发射长波。扣除反射并对全球面积平均后，太阳输入约二百三十八点二瓦每平方米，表面也向太空发出同样能量。在这些理想参数下，平衡表面约二百五十四点六开尔文。
cues.en: Begin with no gray-layer longwave coupling. After reflection and global averaging, absorbed sunlight is about two hundred thirty-eight point two watts per square meter. The surface emits the same amount, equilibrating near two hundred fifty-four point six kelvins.

cues.title: 灰层双向发射，不创造能量
cues.caption: 灰层吸收表面长波，再向上、向下发射；自己的账也要平衡。
cues.captionEn: The layer absorbs surface IR and emits both ways, balancing its own budget.
cues.zh: 让灰层吸收一部分表面长波，再向上、向下发射。向下的能量不是凭空多出来，它来自灰层吸收的能量。表面现在同时接受太阳与向下长波，因此自身发射更大；顶层仍由直接逸出和灰层向上发射共同结账。
cues.en: Let the layer absorb surface IR and emit upward and downward. Downward energy comes from absorption rather than creation. The surface receives sunlight plus downward IR and emits more, while direct escape and atmospheric upward emission together close the planetary budget.

cues.title: 参数骤变，温度不能瞬跳
cues.caption: ε 从 0.4 变到 0.8，初温保持，净储热率约 +59.5 W/m²。
cues.captionEn: Step ε from 0.4 to 0.8 at fixed initial temperatures: net storage is about +59.5 W/m².
cues.zh: 先回到零点四发射率的平衡，再把它突然改成零点八。热容存在，温度来不及瞬间变化，逸出却先减少。顶层出现约每平方米五十九点五瓦的正储热率。改变参数与已经升温到新平衡，是两个不同状态。
cues.en: Start from equilibrium at emissivity zero point four, then step it to zero point eight. Heat capacities keep temperatures continuous while outgoing energy initially falls.
