Net storage begins near fifty-nine point five watts per square meter. A parameter change is not an instantaneous new equilibrium.

cues.title: 多余输入成为储热
cues.caption: 正热容方程使温度逐渐变化，储热与顶层净通量积分一致。
cues.captionEn: Positive heat capacities evolve temperatures; stored heat matches integrated planetary imbalance.
cues.zh: 让两层温度按各自热容逐渐变化。吸收比逸出多的部分进入储热，表面和灰层发射随温度上升，逸出逐渐恢复。这里五年末仍有小的净输入，不把有限时间的最后一帧误当成精确平衡。
cues.en: Evolve each layer with its positive heat capacity. Excess input becomes stored heat. Rising temperatures increase emission and restore outgoing flux. A small imbalance remains after five model years; that finite final frame is not exact equilibrium.

cues.title: 更暖的平衡，逸出仍等于输入
cues.titleEn: A warmer equilibrium still balances the same input
cues.caption: ε=0.8 解析平衡：表面约 289.3 K，逸出仍约 238.2 W/m²。
cues.captionEn: At ε = 0.8 equilibrium, the surface is about 289.3 K while outgoing flux remains 238.2 W/m².
cues.zh: 单独看解析的新平衡。表面约二百八十九点三开尔文，直接逸出加灰层向上发射，仍等于原来的太阳吸收。更暖不表示能量持续累积；内部分别交换的较大通量，与整体净收支为零可以同时成立。
cues.en: Now show the analytic new equilibrium. Surface temperature is about two hundred eighty-nine point three kelvins, while direct and atmospheric escape still equal absorbed sunlight. Larger internal exchanges coexist with zero planetary net storage.

cues.title: 改变反照率，改变的是输入
cues.caption: α 从 0.3 到 0.6，吸收太阳减少，与长波 ε 的作用不同。
cues.captionEn: Changing α from 0.3 to 0.6 reduces absorbed sunlight, unlike changing longwave ε.
cues.zh: 保持长波参数不变，把反照率从零点三提高到零点六。更多太阳光先被反射，吸收输入减少，平衡温度下降。它改变的是短波输入，不能与大气吸收、发射长波的机制混成同一个参数。
cues.en: Keep longwave properties fixed and raise albedo from zero point three to zero point six. More sunlight is reflected, reducing absorption and the equilibrium temperature. This changes shortwave input, a different role from gray-layer thermal absorption and emission.

cues.title: 全吸收，也仍能向太空发射
cues.titleEn: Complete absorption still allows emission to space
cues.caption: ε=1 时表面直达为零，灰层向上长波仍平衡太阳输入。
cues.captionEn: At ε = 1 direct surface escape is zero, but upward atmospheric IR still balances sunlight.
cues.zh: 最后让灰层吸收全部表面长波。直达通道变成零，但灰层仍向太空发射，顶层依然能平衡输入。不是热量永远锁住，也不是温度无限升高。这是一层灰体的教学模型，不能直接把发射率当作真实二氧化碳浓度或气候预测。
cues.en: At complete surface-IR absorption, the direct channel vanishes but the layer still emits to space and balances sunlight. Energy is not permanently imprisoned, and temperature need not grow without bound. This gray-layer teaching model does not turn emissivity into CO₂ concentration or a climate forecast.

cues.title: 不必等到沸腾
cues.caption: 水膜蒸发，温度先向下。
cues.captionEn: Evaporation makes the film temperature fall.
cues.zh: 水膜和空气最初都是三十摄氏度，没有温差传热，水却开始变冷。因为表面的饱和蒸气压高于空气中的水汽分压，水分净离开表面。每单位蒸发质量需要潜热，最初主要由水膜自身的内能提供。图中的箭头表示净通量，不是可见的蒸汽云。
cues.en: The water film and air both start at thirty degrees Celsius. There is no temperature difference, yet the water begins cooling. Surface saturation pressure exceeds the vapour partial pressure in the air, producing a net outward water flux. Vaporization requires latent heat, initially supplied by the film itself. The arrow shows net flux, not a visible steam cloud.

cues.title: 湿空气，冷却较少
cues.caption: 同样空气温度，湿度改变蒸发驱动力。
cues.captionEn: At the same air temperature, humidity changes evaporation.
cues.zh: 把其他条件固定，只比较较干与较湿的空气。金色曲线是百分之二十湿度，浅色曲线是百分之八十。湿空气的水汽分压更接近水面饱和值，蒸发驱动力较小，降温也较少。空气不是一个装满水汽的容器；这里比较的是气液两侧的分压和相平衡。
cues.en: Hold other conditions fixed and compare dry and humid air. Gold is twenty percent relative humidity; the pale curve is eighty percent. Humid air has vapour pressure closer to saturation at the surface, reducing the evaporation driving force and cooling. This compares partial pressures and phase equilibrium, rather than treating air as a container that fills with water.

cues.title: 换气改变速度
cues.caption: 同时加强传热和传质，较快接近相同平衡。
cues.captionEn: Stronger heat and mass exchange reaches the same balance faster.
cues.zh: 现在比较较慢和较快的换气。这个教学模型让空气传热和水分传质系数按相同倍率变化。较快换气使水温更早接近平衡，但两条曲线最后趋向同一温度。真实风速与这两个系数的关系需要实验标定，不能从这里推出风越大，最终温度就无限降低。
cues.en: Compare slower and faster exchange. This teaching model scales the heat and mass-transfer coefficients by the same factor. Faster exchange brings the water to equilibrium sooner, but both curves approach the same temperature. Real wind requires calibrated transfer coefficients. Faster airflow does not imply an unlimited decrease in the final temperature.

cues.title: 冷下来后，谁来供热？
cues.caption: 平衡时，空气补热等于相变带走。
cues.captionEn: At equilibrium, air heat input balances latent heat loss.
cues.zh: 水膜变冷以后，空气比水暖，开始向水膜供热。蒸发仍在继续，水量仍缓慢减少，但温度变化越来越小。此时不是蒸发停止了，而是空气补进的热量，接近水分相变带走的热量。下面两项功率的差，决定此刻还会继续冷却还是转为升温。
cues.en: Once the film is cooler than the air, sensible heat flows into it. Evaporation continues and water mass keeps decreasing, while temperature changes less and less. Evaporation has not stopped: heat supplied by the air nearly balances latent heat carried away. The difference between the two powers determines whether the film keeps cooling or warms.

cues.title: 关闭质量出口
cues.caption: 同温、无蒸发时，没有这条冷却通道。
cues.captionEn: At equal temperatures, removing evaporation removes this cooling pathway.
cues.zh: 把蒸发通道关掉，保留相同空气传热条件。水膜最初仍与空气同温，现在温度保持不变。作为对照，允许蒸发的曲线继续下降。这个开关只隔离相变机制，并不代表某种真实盖子的全部传热性质；它说明水分离开时携带的能量，是本次降温不可省略的一项。
cues.en: Disable the evaporation pathway while retaining the same air heat transfer. The film starts at air temperature and now stays there. The reference with evaporation cools. This switch isolates phase change rather than representing all thermal properties of a physical lid. Energy carried by the escaping water is an essential term in this cooling process.

cues.title: 太冷时，方向反过来
cues.titleEn: A colder surface reverses the flux
cues.caption: 凝结增加液体质量，并向水膜释放潜热。
cues.captionEn: Condensation adds liquid mass and releases latent heat.
cues.zh: 最后把水膜预先冷到十二摄氏度，放进三十摄氏度、较湿的空气。水面饱和蒸气压现在低于环境水汽分压，净水流反向，水汽凝结到表面。相变功率也变成流入水膜，和空气传热一起使它升温。同一组质量与能量方程，必须同时解释蒸发冷却和凝结放热。
cues.en: Finally, start the film at twelve degrees in warm, humid air. Saturation pressure at the cold surface is below ambient vapour pressure, so the net water flux reverses and condensation adds liquid. Latent heat now enters the film and, together with heat from the air, warms it. One mass and energy balance must explain both evaporation cooling and condensation heating.

cues.title: 同温，读数为零
cues.caption: 两端都是25°C，热电电压为零。
cues.captionEn: Both ends are at 25°C, so thermoelectric voltage is zero.
cues.zh: 先沿导线认清回路。两根K型合金线在右边连接，左边通过铜线接到高阻电压表。两个铜接点放在同一个等温块里。现在测量端和接线端都是二十五摄氏度，电压却为零。这说明零电压不代表零摄氏度，热电偶必须结合参考端温度才能判断测量端温度。
cues.en: Trace the circuit first. Two type K alloy wires join on the right and connect through copper leads to a high-impedance voltmeter on the left. Both copper contacts share an isothermal block. The measuring and reference ends are now both at twenty-five degrees Celsius, yet voltage is zero. Zero voltage therefore does not mean zero Celsius; the reference temperature is essential.

cues.title: 只加热测量端
cues.caption: 接线端保持25°C，热端升温，电压增加。
cues.captionEn: Keep the reference at 25°C and heat the measuring junction.
cues.zh: 保持左边接线端二十五摄氏度，逐渐升高右边测量端温度。两种材料沿温度梯度产生不同的热电贡献，电压表读数增加。注意单位是毫伏，这个信号很小。下方把读数直接当成冷端为零摄氏度的标准表来换算，所以显示温度低于右边真正的测量温度。
cues.en: Hold the reference block at twenty-five degrees while heating the measuring junction. The two materials contribute differently along the thermal gradient, increasing the meter reading. Its unit is millivolts, a small signal. Below, converting this voltage with a table that assumes a zero-Celsius reference gives a temperature lower than the actual measuring-junction temperature.

cues.title: 热端不变，读数仍会变
cues.titleEn: A fixed hot end can give changing voltage
cues.caption: 接线端变暖，原始毫伏读数下降。
cues.captionEn: Warming the reference end reduces the raw millivolt reading.
cues.zh: 现在右边固定在四百摄氏度，只把左边接线端从二十五度升到一百度。电压下降，错误换算的温度也下降，可是被测物并没有降温。冷端这个名称只是历史习惯，它可以是温暖的接线盒；没有参考端的温度信息，同一个热电压无法告诉我们绝对温度。
cues.en: Fix the measuring end at four hundred degrees and warm only the reference block from twenty-five to one hundred. Voltage falls, and the incorrectly converted temperature falls with it, although the measured object has not cooled. Cold junction is a historical name; it can be a warm terminal box. Without its temperature, thermoelectric voltage cannot specify absolute temperature.

cues.title: 先补电压，再换温度
cues.caption: 加入参考端热电势，恢复同一个400°C。
cues.captionEn: Adding the reference EMF recovers the same 400°C result.
cues.zh: 重复刚才的接线端升温，这次读取等温块内的温度传感器。先把测得的参考温度换算成对应热电势，再加到原始电压上，最后通过K型参考函数反算温度。观察等式：两个加数都在变，总和却保持不变，补偿后的显示始终回到四百度。不能简单把两项温度相加。
cues.en: Repeat the reference warming, now using the block’s temperature sensor. Convert its measured temperature into reference EMF, add that to the raw voltage, then invert the type K reference function. Watch the equation: both terms change while their sum stays fixed, returning four hundred degrees. Because the reference function is nonlinear, simply adding two temperatures is not the correct procedure.

cues.title: 加一种金属，何时不出错
cues.titleEn: When an extra metal adds no error
cues.caption: 金属M的两个新接点同温，净贡献为零。
cues.captionEn: Metal M adds no net EMF when its new contacts are isothermal.
cues.zh: 把热端焊点换成一小段第三种金属M，两处新接点仍然都在四百摄氏度。电压没有变化，因为这段材料从同一个温度开始，又回到同一个温度，热电势的净积分为零。这个等温条件很关键；如果接头两侧存在温差，错误材料或不合适的延长线就可能带来额外误差。
cues.en: Replace the hot weld with a short piece of a third metal, M. Both new contacts remain at four hundred degrees. Voltage is unchanged because that material’s thermoelectric integral begins and ends at the same temperature. This isothermal condition matters: a temperature difference across an unsuitable connector or extension material can introduce an additional error.

cues.title: 温度梯度换位置
cues.caption: 均匀导线端点不变，积分电压不变。
cues.captionEn: Unchanged endpoints give the same integral in homogeneous wires.
cues.zh: 最后保持两端温度不变，把温度变化逐渐集中到测量端附近。下面的温度曲线弯曲了，导线上的热分布也改变了，但电压积分没有变化。对于均匀材料，热电势取决于温度积分的端点，不取决于温差在导线上分布在哪里。材料老化或成分不均匀时，这个简化就需要重新检查。
cues.en: Finally, keep both endpoint temperatures fixed while concentrating the temperature change near the measuring junction. The temperature profile bends and heat colors shift along the wires, but integrated voltage stays unchanged. For homogeneous material, thermoelectric EMF depends on the temperature endpoints rather than where the gradient lies along the wire. Aging or inhomogeneity can invalidate that simplification.

cues.title: 先看能量从哪里来
cues.caption: PEM 电解：直流电源输入能量，两个产气侧分开。
cues.captionEn: PEM electrolysis takes energy from a DC source and separates the two gas sides.
cues.zh: 这次先不把氢和氧放在一起，而是从水出发。画面中间是质子交换膜组件，上方直流电源提供拆水所需的电能，两侧分别收集产物。先保持不通电，水不会在这个理想模型中自行持续分解。
cues.en: Begin with water, rather than a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen. A proton exchange membrane assembly sits between separate product channels. The DC source above supplies energy for splitting water. With no sustained current, this ideal model produces no gas.

cues.title: 正阳极把水氧化
cues.titleEn: Oxidize water at the positive anode
cues.caption: 正阳极：两份水给出一份氧、四份 H⁺ 与四份 e⁻。
cues.captionEn: Positive anode: two waters give one oxygen, four H⁺ and four e⁻.
cues.zh: 接通电源后，先看正阳极。两份水反应，留下一个氧分子，同时给出四个质子和四个电子。这一半叫氧化。氧从阳极侧引出，质子与电子不能都直接穿过中间的膜，它们将走不同的通道。
cues.en: At the positive anode, two water molecules yield one oxygen molecule, four protons and four electrons. This half-reaction is oxidation. Oxygen leaves on the anode side. The charged products take different routes: the membrane is not an electronic shortcut between the electrodes.

cues.title: 两条通道在阴极汇合
cues.titleEn: Reunite two carrier routes at the cathode
cues.caption: H⁺ 穿膜；e⁻ 经过外部电源；负阴极还原生成 H₂。
cues.captionEn: H⁺ crosses the membrane; e⁻ passes through the source; reduction makes H₂ at the negative cathode.
cues.zh: 质子穿过中间的膜，电子则沿导线经过外部电源，被送到负阴极。在阴极，四个质子接受四个电子，成为两个氢分子。这一半叫还原。小点标出载流路线，不把它们的移动速度或数量当成真实分子的统计。
cues.en: Protons cross the membrane, while electrons travel through wires and the external source to the negative cathode. Four protons accept four electrons to form two hydrogen molecules: reduction. The moving dots identify routes only; they do not measure particle populations or drift speeds.

cues.title: 用电荷核对两倍产量
cues.titleEn: Check the two-to-one yield with charge
cues.caption: 2 A × 60 s = 120 C：H₂ 约 0.622、O₂ 约 0.311 mmol。
cues.captionEn: 2 A × 60 s = 120 C: about 0.622 mmol H₂ and 0.311 mmol O₂.
cues.zh: 现在核对累计量。两安培持续六十秒，送过一百二十库仑电荷。每两摩尔电子对应一摩尔氢，而每四摩尔电子才对应一摩尔氧。因此这里得到约零点六二二毫摩尔氢、零点三一一毫摩尔氧，两侧刻度固定，比例由反应决定。
cues.en: Two amperes for sixty seconds transfer one hundred twenty coulombs. Each two moles of electrons produce one mole of hydrogen; four produce one mole of oxygen. The result is about zero point six two two millimoles hydrogen and zero point three one one oxygen, on fixed amount scales.

cues.title: 把电流翻倍，比例不变
cues.titleEn: Double current without changing the ratio
cues.caption: 同样 60 s，电流从 2 A 到 4 A，两种累计产量都翻倍。
cues.captionEn: For the same 60 s, stepping current from 2 A to 4 A doubles both amounts.
cues.zh: 把通电时间保持六十秒，只将电流从两安培改成四安培。累计电荷翻倍，氢和氧的物质的量都翻倍，而两比一不变。反过来，电流加倍、时间减半，累计电荷相同，理想产量也相同。这里采用百分之百法拉第效率。
cues.en: Keep sixty seconds and double current from two to four amperes. Charge doubles, and both product amounts double without changing their two-to-one ratio. Conversely, doubling current while halving duration preserves charge and ideal yield. These results assume one hundred percent Faradaic efficiency, without side reactions.

cues.title: 同样产量，不同电输入
cues.titleEn: Equal yield can cost different electrical input
cues.caption: 相同电荷下，1.60 V → 2.00 V 不改产量，却增加电输入与净放热。
cues.captionEn: At equal charge, 1.60 V → 2.00 V preserves yield but increases electrical input and heat out.
cues.zh: 再把电流和时间固定，只比较一点六伏与两伏。产量取决于电荷，所以没有变化；电输入等于电压乘电流，却增加了。画面用液态水的标准状态焓核对净放热。电压与电流在真实电解槽中相互关联，这里只做规定电流下的能量比较。
cues.en: Hold current and time, and compare one point six with two volts. Ideal yield stays fixed because charge is unchanged, but voltage times current increases. Heat is accounted against the liquid-water standard-state reaction enthalpy. Real voltage and current are coupled; this comparison prescribes current rather than predicting a cell polarization curve.

cues.title: 有限的水会让累计量停住
cues.caption: 只有 0.300 mmol 水：耗尽后产量封顶，持续电流归零。
cues.captionEn: With only 0.300 mmol water, depletion caps yield and stops sustained current.
cues.zh: 最后只给零点三毫摩尔水。随着电荷积累，约二十八点九秒后水被耗尽，氢最多零点三毫摩尔，氧最多零点一五毫摩尔。不能让动画在没有反应物后继续产气。这是路径与守恒教学模型，不是制氢实验指导，氢氧混合和点火有危险。
cues.en: Provide only zero point three millimoles of water. Around twenty-eight point nine seconds, it is exhausted, capping hydrogen at zero point three and oxygen at zero point one five millimoles. Sustained current then stops. This is a conservation model, not experimental guidance; hydrogen–oxygen mixtures and ignition are hazardous.

cues.title: 冷一点，还没有露
cues.caption: 镜面降温，环境水汽分压保持不变。
cues.captionEn: The mirror cools while ambient vapour pressure stays fixed.
cues.zh: 环境空气是三十摄氏度、相对湿度百分之五十。先把镜面从三十度降到二十度。蓝色曲线给出各温度的饱和蒸气压，金色横线是环境水汽分压。镜面仍高于两线相交的露点，所以还没有净凝结。水汽本身不可见，下面的镜面并没有被一团可见蒸汽包住。
cues.en: Ambient air is thirty degrees Celsius at fifty percent relative humidity. Cool the mirror from thirty to twenty degrees. Blue shows saturation pressure at each temperature; the gold line is ambient vapour pressure. The mirror remains above their intersection, the dew point, so net condensation has not begun. Water vapour itself is invisible.

cues.title: 穿过露点
cues.caption: 镜面饱和值低于环境分压，净凝结出现。
cues.captionEn: Below the dew point, ambient vapour pressure exceeds surface saturation.
cues.zh: 继续冷却，直到温度游标穿过露点。镜面温度下的饱和蒸气压，现在低于环境水汽分压，水汽开始净凝结在表面。液滴只标出条件已经满足，不表示这个简化图预测了凝结数量或生长速度。露点是给定水汽分压的相平衡温度，不是固定的十八度或某个通用常数。
cues.en: Continue until the cursor crosses the dew point. Saturation pressure at the mirror is now below ambient vapour pressure, so net condensation can occur. The droplets mark this condition; their number does not predict growth rate or condensed mass. Dew point is the phase-equilibrium temperature for the given vapour pressure, not a universal fixed temperature.

cues.title: 同一镜面，更湿空气
cues.caption: 空气温度不变，水汽增加会抬高露点。
cues.captionEn: At fixed air temperature, more vapour raises the dew point.
cues.zh: 把镜面保持十五摄氏度，只增加环境相对湿度。空气温度不变时，相对湿度增加意味着水汽分压增加，金线升高，露点也向右移动。原本干燥的镜面因此可以开始结露。判断要同时知道环境水汽状态和表面温度，不能只看镜面是不是比空气凉。
cues.en: Keep the mirror at fifteen degrees and increase ambient humidity. At fixed air temperature, higher relative humidity means higher vapour pressure. The gold line rises and the dew point moves right. A previously dry mirror can begin condensing. Surface temperature alone, or merely being cooler than the air, is not enough to decide.

cues.title: 升温不一定减少水汽
cues.caption: 定压且水汽比例不变时，露点不变、相对湿度变。
cues.captionEn: At fixed pressure and mixing ratio, dew point stays while relative humidity changes.
cues.zh: 现在保持水汽与干空气的比例和总压力不变，只把环境空气从二十度加热到三十五度。水汽分压和露点保持不变，相对湿度却下降，因为饱和蒸气压随温度上升。下降的是一个比值，不是水汽凭空消失。这里的定压条件很关键，固定体积密闭加热则不能直接照搬这个比较。
cues.en: Keep the water-to-dry-air ratio and total pressure fixed, then warm the air from twenty to thirty-five degrees. Vapour pressure and dew point remain fixed, but relative humidity falls because saturation pressure rises. A ratio has changed; water has not disappeared. Constant pressure matters: sealed, fixed-volume heating is a different comparison.

cues.title: 继续冷却后的水账
cues.caption: 低于露点，部分水汽变成液水；总水量守恒。
cues.captionEn: Below the dew point, vapour becomes liquid while total water is conserved.
cues.zh: 接下来改看一团缓慢定压冷却的空气，而不是持续流过镜面的大空气库。用每千克干空气作为统一基准。露点以上，水汽量不变；露点以下，气相沿饱和曲线下降，差额变成保留下来的液水。色条显示质量比例，气液合计始终相同。冷却装置还必须带走凝结释放的潜热。
cues.en: Now follow a parcel cooled slowly at constant pressure, rather than a large reservoir passing a mirror. Use one kilogram of dry air as the basis. Above the dew point, vapour mass stays fixed. Below it, the gas follows saturation and the difference becomes retained liquid. The phase bar shows mass proportions with a constant total. External cooling must also remove released latent heat.

cues.title: 复热，再回到水汽
cues.caption: 保留液水时，复热可逆转气液分配。
cues.captionEn: With condensate retained, reheating reverses the phase allocation.
cues.zh: 把同一团空气缓慢复热，并且保留刚才凝结的液水。温度上升，液水逐渐蒸发，气相水量增加；到原始状态时，水分总账仍然对得上。这个平衡模型忽略过饱和成核与温度梯度，也没有预测液滴的生长时间。它要说明的是露点条件、相对湿度和水分守恒之间的区别。
cues.en: Reheat the same parcel slowly, retaining its condensate. As temperature rises, liquid evaporates and gas-phase water increases. On returning to the original state, the water balance still closes. This equilibrium model excludes nucleation supersaturation, temperature gradients and droplet-growth times. It separates dew-point conditions, relative humidity and conservation of water.

cues.title: 加力，建立电压
cues.caption: 理想绝缘时，电荷变化与力成正比。
cues.captionEn: With ideal isolation, charge change is proportional to force.
cues.zh: 先看理想绝缘的陶瓷片。上方压头逐渐加力，下面的支座固定，两层电极之间建立电压。这里把纳米级形变放大一万五千倍，虚线保留零载荷轮廓。正压电效应把力的变化连接到电荷变化；在没有漏电的理想开路中，达到同样的力就得到同样的电压。
cues.en: Begin with an ideally insulated ceramic plate. A plunger applies force while the lower support stays fixed, and voltage builds between the electrodes. Nanometer deformation is magnified fifteen thousand times; the dashed line marks the unloaded outline. The direct piezoelectric effect couples changing force to changing charge. With no leakage, the same force produces the same voltage.

cues.title: 力还在，电压却消退
cues.caption: 载荷保持100 N，电压按RC时间常数衰减。
cues.captionEn: At a held 100 N, voltage decays with time constant RC.
cues.zh: 换成有实际漏电路径的测量回路。加到一百牛后保持压力不变，力仍然是一百牛，陶瓷也仍被压缩，可是电压不断下降。电荷通过材料和仪表的等效电阻慢慢流失。这里电容两纳法、电阻一吉欧，时间常数两秒；每过两秒，电压降到上一时刻的大约百分之三十七。
cues.en: Now include the measurement circuit leakage path. After reaching one hundred newtons, hold the force constant. The ceramic remains compressed, but voltage steadily falls as charge leaks through the equivalent material and instrument resistance. Two nanofarads and one gigaohm give a two-second time constant. Every two seconds, voltage falls to about thirty-seven percent of its previous value.

cues.title: 卸载会出现反向脉冲
cues.caption: 负电压出现时，压力正在回到零。
cues.captionEn: The voltage turns negative as compressive force returns to zero.
cues.zh: 保持一段时间后，再把压力卸去。之前产生的电荷已有很多流失，现在力减小，带来相反方向的电荷变化，电压就越过零变成负值。观察压头与读数：外力只是从压力回到零，并没有变成拉力。因此，不能只看电压的正负就判断这一瞬间的力方向。
cues.en: After holding the load, remove it. Much of the earlier charge has leaked away. Falling force now produces an opposite charge change, taking voltage through zero into a negative pulse. Inspect the force reading: compression is only returning to zero, without becoming tension. Voltage polarity alone therefore does not identify the instantaneous direction of applied force.

cues.title: 仪表改变可观察的时间
cues.titleEn: The instrument changes the observable timescale
cues.caption: 电阻减小十倍，保持信号消失得更快。
cues.captionEn: Ten times less resistance makes the held signal disappear faster.
cues.zh: 比较同一次加力在两种输入电阻下的读数。虚线仍是一吉欧，实线降到零点一吉欧。电容没有变，时间常数缩短十倍，实线很快贴近零。陶瓷没有失去压电效应，只是测量回路更快地放走了电荷。要观察缓慢变化，传感器和后面的电路必须一起设计。
cues.en: Compare the same force history with two input resistances. The dashed trace retains one gigaohm; the solid trace uses one tenth of that. Capacitance is unchanged, so the time constant is ten times shorter and the solid signal quickly approaches zero. The ceramic still has its piezoelectric coupling; the circuit simply drains charge faster. Slow measurements depend on both sensor and electronics.

cues.title: 同样的力，慢加读数更小
cues.titleEn: The same force can give a smaller slow signal
cues.caption: 慢加力时，电荷一边产生一边流失。
cues.captionEn: During a slow ramp, charge leaks while it is generated.
cues.zh: 现在电阻相同，比较快慢两种加力过程。虚线在零点一秒内达到一百牛，实线用四秒达到同一个目标。慢加力期间，电荷一边产生一边通过电阻流失，电压峰值明显更低。这个例子解释了压电传感器为什么适合冲击和振动，而持续称重需要格外处理低频和静态误差。
cues.en: Keep resistance the same and compare two loading speeds. The dashed trace reaches one hundred newtons in a tenth of a second; the solid trace takes four seconds to reach the same force. During the slower ramp, charge leaks while being generated, producing a much smaller peak. This is why piezo sensors suit impacts and vibration, while sustained weighing requires careful treatment of low-frequency and static errors.

cues.title: 把电压变成微小位移
cues.titleEn: Turn voltage into a small displacement
cues.caption: 没有外力时，电压正负控制伸缩方向。
cues.captionEn: With no external force, voltage polarity controls deformation direction.
cues.zh: 最后撤去压头，接入规定电压的电源。正负电压让陶瓷交替伸长和缩短，这就是逆压电效应。当前接线下，正电压产生负的压缩量，也就是伸长。直接测力与电驱动位移使用同一个耦合系数；真实行程只有纳米量级，画面仍然按同一倍率放大，便于比较。
cues.en: Remove the plunger and connect a voltage source. Positive and negative voltages alternately extend and contract the ceramic: the inverse piezoelectric effect. Under this wiring convention, positive voltage gives negative compression, meaning extension. Force sensing and electrical displacement share the same coupling coefficient. Actual motion is only nanometers, still displayed with the same magnification for comparison.

cues.title: 有电压，不等于正在供电
cues.titleEn: Voltage does not mean current is flowing
cues.caption: 负载开路：可以有参考开路电压，却没有持续电流与电输出。
cues.captionEn: Open load: a reference open-circuit voltage can exist without sustained current or power.
cues.zh: 这次把化学能送到外部负载。左侧送氢，右侧送氧，中间是膜与两侧电极。先把外部回路断开：即使两侧有反应物，也不能持续把电子送过负载。画面可以保留参考开路电压，电流与电功率却都是零。
cues.en: This time chemical feed supplies an external load. Hydrogen enters at the left, oxygen at the right, with a membrane between the electrodes. An open load interrupts sustained electron transport. A reference open-circuit voltage may remain, while both current and delivered electrical power are zero.

cues.title: 负阳极让氢失去电子
cues.titleEn: Hydrogen loses electrons at the negative anode
cues.caption: 燃料电池的负阳极氧化氢：2 H₂ → 4 H⁺ + 4 e⁻。
cues.captionEn: The negative fuel-cell anode oxidizes hydrogen: 2 H₂ → 4 H⁺ + 4 e⁻.
cues.zh: 接通回路，先看负阳极。氢在这里失去电子，形成质子。这叫氧化，所以这一侧叫阳极。阳极不是永远为正：燃料电池在输出能量，水电解槽在接受电能，极性会不同，而氧化和还原的命名没有改变。
cues.en: Close the circuit and inspect the negative anode. Hydrogen loses electrons and becomes protons: oxidation, which defines the anode. Anode does not always mean positive. A fuel cell delivers energy whereas an electrolyzer receives electrical energy, so their signs differ while the reaction-based names remain consistent.

cues.title: 膜内与膜外两路汇合
cues.titleEn: Two routes meet at the positive cathode
cues.caption: H⁺ 穿膜，e⁻ 经负载；正阴极将氧还原并生成水。
cues.captionEn: H⁺ crosses the membrane, e⁻ passes through the load, and oxygen becomes water at the positive cathode.
cues.zh: 膜允许质子通过，却不允许电子直接穿过。电子沿外部负载到达正阴极；氧在阴极接受电子，并和质子生成水。电子在外部的流动方向与常规电流相反。这里的小点只标出路线，不把它的数量或速度当成真实粒子的统计。
cues.en: The membrane conducts protons while blocking direct electron passage. Electrons instead travel through the load to the positive cathode, where oxygen accepts electrons and joins protons to form water. External electron flow opposes conventional current. Moving dots show the routes, not actual particle counts or velocities.

cues.title: 把物质变化系在同一份电荷上
cues.titleEn: Tie material conversion to the same charge
cues.caption: 每生成两份水，消耗两份氢与一份氧；累计量由电荷决定。
cues.captionEn: Two waters require two hydrogens and one oxygen; transferred charge fixes the accumulated amounts.
cues.zh: 两边的半反应相加，每两份氢和一份氧生成两份水。累计电子电荷决定反应进行多少：每两摩尔电子消耗一摩尔氢，每四摩尔电子消耗一摩尔氧。画面同时列出耗氢、耗氧和产水，不能只让灯亮起来，却不扣除反应物。
cues.en: Adding the half-reactions gives two hydrogens plus one oxygen forming two waters. Transferred charge fixes conversion: two moles of electrons consume one mole of hydrogen, and four consume one mole of oxygen. The ledger tracks both reactants and water, rather than showing output without consuming any feed.

cues.title: 降低负载，先让输出增加
cues.titleEn: Lower the load to increase output first
cues.caption: 固定 r=0.20 Ω：R 从 2.00 到 0.20 Ω，电输出增大，焓效率下降。
cues.captionEn: With r = 0.20 Ω, R from 2.00 to 0.20 Ω increases output but lowers HHV efficiency.
cues.zh: 固定内部等效电阻，把外负载从两欧姆降到零点二欧姆。电流增加，电输出也增加；但更多反应能量变成热，焓口径的电效率下降。在这条明确简化的线性模型里，外负载等于内阻时达到最大功率，不意味着达到最大效率。
cues.en: Hold the internal resistance and lower the load from two ohms to zero point two. Current and external power increase, while more reaction energy becomes heat and HHV electrical efficiency falls. In this explicitly linear model, matching external and internal resistance maximizes power, rather than maximizing efficiency.

cues.title: 接近短路不是更好的供能
cues.titleEn: A near short is not better power delivery
cues.caption: R 降到 0.05 Ω：电流更大，外部功率反而低于匹配负载。
cues.captionEn: At R = 0.05 Ω, current rises but external power falls below the matched-load output.
cues.zh: 继续把外负载降到零点零五欧姆。电流虽然更大，外负载上的电压却更低，电输出反而减少，内部耗散增加。能量条把电输出与总放热分开。总放热还包括该参考状态下的可逆熵热，所以不能把它全部简单叫作内阻热。
cues.en: Lower the load further to zero point zero five ohms. Current rises, but load voltage drops enough that delivered power decreases and internal dissipation increases. The energy ribbon separates electricity from total heat. Total heat also includes the reference reversible entropy contribution; it is not all internal ohmic heating.

cues.title: 氧耗尽后，剩氢也不能继续供电
cues.titleEn: Excess hydrogen cannot replace exhausted oxygen
cues.caption: 氧额度 0.100 mmol：最多产水 0.200 mmol，留下氢 1.800 mmol。
cues.captionEn: An oxygen allowance of 0.100 mmol caps water at 0.200 mmol and leaves 1.800 mmol hydrogen.
cues.zh: 最后保持充足的氢，只给零点一毫摩尔氧。氧耗尽后，水最多零点二毫摩尔，仍有一点八毫摩尔氢，持续电流却停止。两种原料都不可缺少。这是守恒和等效负载教学模型，不是储运氢或实验指导，氢氧混合与点火有危险。
cues.en: Keep excess hydrogen but allow only zero point one millimoles of oxygen. Depletion caps water at zero point two millimoles, leaving one point eight millimoles hydrogen, yet sustained current stops. Both reactants are necessary. This conservation model is not hydrogen-handling or experimental guidance; mixtures and ignition are hazardous.

cues.title: 相差120°的三条波形
cues.caption: 三相同频同幅，峰值到达时间依次错开。
cues.captionEn: The phases share frequency and amplitude but reach peaks at different times.
cues.zh: 先只看三条电压波形。它们频率相同、幅度相同，相位依次相差一百二十度，也就是一个周期的三分之一。移动的竖线标出同一时刻：一相经过零时，另外两相并不同时为零。这里每相有效值二百三十伏、频率五十赫兹，画面把两个电周期放慢展开。
cues.en: Start with the three voltage waves. Their frequency and amplitude match, with successive phases separated by one hundred twenty degrees, or a third of a cycle. The moving cursor marks the same instant on all three. When one crosses zero, the other two do not both vanish. Each phase is two hundred thirty volts RMS at fifty hertz, with two electrical cycles shown slowly.

cues.title: 两相之间要做相减
cues.caption: 230 V相电压对应约398 V线电压。
cues.captionEn: A 230 V phase voltage gives about 398 V between phases.
cues.zh: 把三条电压画成相量。它们从同一个中性点出发，夹角是一百二十度。测A与B之间的电压，要从B的端点指向A的端点，也就是两条相量之差。绿色线段比一条相量长，却没有两倍长，长度是根号三倍。所以二百三十伏相电压对应大约三百九十八伏线电压。
cues.en: Represent the phase voltages as vectors from a common neutral point, separated by one hundred twenty degrees. Voltage from B to A is the vector from the tip of B to the tip of A. The green difference is longer than one phase vector but shorter than two. Its length is square root three times a phase, giving about three hundred ninety-eight volts from two hundred thirty volts per phase.

cues.title: 先看单相功率的起伏
cues.caption: 单相电阻功率在零与两倍平均值之间起伏。
cues.captionEn: Single-phase resistive power varies from zero to twice its average.
cues.zh: 先只接通A相电阻，另外两条负载支路断开。瞬时功率是此刻电压乘以此刻电流。电压与电流一起过零时，功率也为零；两者一起达到正峰或负峰时，功率都为正。于是每个电周期出现两次功率峰值，平均功率只有峰值的一半，中性线承担返回电流。
cues.en: Connect only the resistive load on phase A, leaving the other two branches open. Instantaneous power is instantaneous voltage multiplied by instantaneous current. When both cross zero, power is zero; when both reach positive or negative peaks, their product is positive. Power therefore has two peaks per electrical cycle, with its average at half the peak. Neutral carries the return current.

cues.title: 三相把起伏拼成恒定总和
cues.titleEn: Three phases form a constant sum
cues.caption: 各相仍在起伏，粗线总功率却保持水平。
cues.captionEn: Individual phases pulsate while their bold total remains level.
cues.zh: 接通另外两条相同负载。三条细线仍然各自起伏，但峰谷交错，粗线表示的总功率始终保持一点五八七千瓦。与此同时，三个相电流的代数和为零，中性线不再有电流。这并不表示各相停止供电，而是同一时刻的返回路径由另外的相共同承担。
cues.en: Connect the other two identical loads. Each thin power trace still pulsates, but their peaks and troughs complement one another. The bold total stays at one point five eight seven kilowatts. The three signed phase currents also sum to zero, so neutral current vanishes. Individual phases continue supplying power; at each instant the other phases provide the corresponding return paths.

cues.title: 储能回送，不破坏平衡总和
cues.titleEn: Energy return can preserve the balanced sum
cues.caption: 共同滞后45°，各相可回送能量，总有功仍恒定。
cues.captionEn: A common 45-degree lag permits phase energy return with constant total power.
cues.zh: 把三相负载一起换成感性阻抗，电流都滞后电压四十五度。每相曲线的一小段进入零线下方，表示储能暂时返回电源。但三相仍然平衡，总瞬时有功依旧是一条水平线，只是数值降低。这个对照保持阻抗幅值不变，同时改变电阻与电感，所以电流有效值保持相同。
cues.en: Change all three loads to inductive impedances so current lags voltage by forty-five degrees. A short portion of each phase-power curve falls below zero, indicating stored energy returning to the source. The phases remain balanced, so total instantaneous active power is still constant, at a lower value. This comparison holds impedance magnitude fixed by changing both resistance and inductance, keeping RMS current unchanged.

cues.title: 只改一相，平衡就消失
cues.titleEn: Change one phase and balance disappears
cues.caption: A相阻抗减半，中性线电流与功率起伏一起出现。
cues.captionEn: Halving A impedance creates both neutral current and total-power ripple.
cues.zh: 恢复电阻负载，再只把A相阻抗减半。A相电流增大，三个相电流不再恰好抵消，中性线开始承担差额。看下方粗线，总功率也随时间起伏。之前的恒定功率和零中性线电流都有明确条件：电源对称、正弦稳态、三相负载平衡；实际谐波和不平衡都需要另行分析。
cues.en: Restore resistive loads and halve only phase A impedance. Its current increases, the three currents no longer cancel, and neutral carries the difference. The bold total-power trace now pulsates too. Constant total power and zero neutral current depended on symmetric sources, sinusoidal steady state and balanced loads. Unbalance and harmonics in real systems require separate analysis.

cues.title: 常压的沸点
cues.caption: 常压液汽共存时，继续供热主要增加相变。
cues.captionEn: At ambient-pressure equilibrium, further heat mainly drives phase change.
cues.zh: 先看常压敞口对照。液水和蒸汽已经达到环境压力对应的沸点，继续供热，水量减少，温度却基本保持。沸点不是水独有的固定一百度，它还取决于周围压力。这篇从液汽共存开始，不包括冷锅中空气被排出的启动阶段。
cues.en: Start with an open vessel already boiling at ambient pressure. Further heat reduces liquid mass while temperature stays nearly constant. Boiling temperature is not a universal one hundred degrees; it depends on pressure. This film begins with liquid and steam in equilibrium, after air removal, rather than simulating a cold vessel startup.

cues.title: 阀座挡住出口
cues.titleEn: A seated valve closes the outlet
cues.caption: 阀口尚未打开，供热提高温度与饱和压力。
cues.captionEn: Before the valve lifts, heat raises temperature and saturation pressure.
cues.zh: 换成带理想配重阀的刚性容器。蒸汽还不足以抬起配重，阀座支撑剩余的向下作用。热量输入以后，液水温度和饱和压力一起上升，气相质量也增加。不是盖子直接把水加热，而是出口受约束以后，系统可以沿着更高压力的液汽平衡状态前进。
cues.en: Now use a rigid vessel with an ideal weighted valve. Steam cannot yet lift the weight; the seat supplies the remaining support. Heat input raises liquid temperature and saturation pressure, and increases the vapour inventory. The lid is not a heat source. Restricting the outlet allows the system to reach higher-pressure liquid–vapour equilibrium states.

cues.title: 压差抬起配重
cues.caption: 压差乘阀座面积，与配重重力平衡。
cues.captionEn: Pressure difference times seat area balances the weight.
cues.zh: 当锅内外压差乘以阀座面积，达到配重重力，理想阀开始抬起。跟着浅色路径，从液面上方经过通管，再穿过配重下方的阀隙到外面。两个方向的受力达到平衡后，排汽通道调节流量。图中的阀隙纵向放大，不代表真实器具的位移尺寸。
cues.en: When pressure difference times seat area balances the weight, the ideal valve lifts. Follow the pale path from the liquid surface through the vent tube and the gap beneath the weight to the outside. Once opposing forces balance, the opening accommodates steam outflow. The gap is enlarged vertically and does not show the displacement of a real appliance.

cues.title: 供热更大，排汽更多
cues.caption: 调压状态下，供热主要改变流量，不持续抬高温度。
cues.captionEn: During regulation, more heat mainly changes flow rather than temperature.
cues.zh: 保持同一个配重和环境压力，只增加供热功率。已经调压的容器中，温度和压力保持相同，排汽质量流率却增加，所需阀隙也变大。液体逐渐减少时，气相占据的空间还会增加，模型把这部分蒸汽也计入质量与能量账。不能把更多热量直接画成无限升温。
cues.en: Keep weight and ambient pressure fixed while increasing heat input. Once regulated, temperature and pressure remain the same, but steam mass flow and the required gap increase. As liquid decreases, vapour occupies more space; that changing inventory is included in the mass and energy balance. Additional heat is not drawn as an unlimited temperature rise.

cues.title: 模型配重与设定压力
cues.caption: 同一阀座面积，更大配重需要更大压差。
cues.captionEn: At the same seat area, a larger model weight needs more pressure difference.
cues.zh: 在模型中比较不同配重，阀座面积保持不变。更大的向下重力，需要更高的内外压差来平衡，因此设定绝对压力上升，对应的液汽平衡温度也上升。实际器具还受到弹簧、结构与校准约束；这里比较的是理想平阀的受力关系，不是对真实配重的调整方案。
cues.en: Compare different weights in the model at the same seat area. A larger downward force requires a greater pressure difference, raising set absolute pressure and its equilibrium temperature. Real devices also depend on their mechanisms and calibration. This is an ideal flat-valve force comparison, not a procedure for adjusting an actual regulator.

cues.title: 同样表压，不同环境
cues.caption: 环境压力降低，同一配重的绝对设定压力也降低。
cues.captionEn: Lower ambient pressure lowers absolute set pressure for the same weight.
cues.zh: 最后保持配重和阀座，降低环境压力。阀需要的压差没有改变，所以表压相同；但锅内绝对压力等于环境压力加表压，它随之降低，对应沸点也降低。把两个压力读数分开，才能看懂不同环境中的温度变化。完整过程仍依赖液汽共存和理想调压条件。
cues.en: Finally, keep weight and seat area fixed while lowering ambient pressure. The required pressure difference, or gauge pressure, is unchanged. Absolute pressure equals ambient plus gauge pressure, so it falls and the boiling temperature falls with it. Separating these pressures explains the change. The conclusion assumes coexisting liquid and vapour and an ideal regulating valve.

cues.title: 同穿一环，去回相抵
cues.titleEn: One core cancels outgoing and returning currents
cues.caption: 5.000 A 去、5.000 A 回，检测环中的剩余为零。
cues.captionEn: 5.000 A out and 5.000 A back leave zero residual in the shared core.
cues.zh: 先追踪一条完整回路。电流从 L 经过负载，再沿 N 返回，两根线共同穿过检测环，方向相反，磁作用相抵。这里不是少了一根线，而是把去、回两条路径放进同一个比较窗口。正常情况下，剩余电流为零。
cues.en: Follow a complete loop: current leaves through L, passes the load and returns through N. Both conductors share the sensing window. Their opposite signed currents cancel their core action. The detector compares both paths rather than observing just one wire, leaving zero residual in normal operation.

cues.title: 负载增大，差流仍可为零
cues.titleEn: A larger balanced load can still have zero residual
cues.caption: 平衡负载从 2 A 到 12 A，去回都增大，差流仍为零。
cues.captionEn: A balanced load from 2 A to 12 A increases both currents and leaves zero residual.
cues.zh: 把负载电流从两安培增加到十二安培。去、回读数一起增大，检测环内仍然相抵，所以这个纯差流模型不会跳闸。它并不单凭负载大就作决定，也不负责完整的过载判断。未跳闸绝不能用来证明电气设备安全。
cues.en: Increase balanced load current from two to twelve amperes. Both readings rise together and still cancel, so the pure residual-current model does not trip. Large balanced current is a different issue from a missing return. Absence of a residual trip is never a complete assessment of electrical safety.

cues.title: 一部分电流从环外返回
cues.titleEn: Part of the current returns outside the core
cues.caption: L=5.040 A，N=5.000 A；40 mA 经环外路径返回。
cues.captionEn: L = 5.040 A, N = 5.000 A; 40 mA returns outside the sensing window.
cues.zh: 现在让四十毫安从环外的路径返回。L 读数变成五点零四零安培，N 仍是五点零零零，两者不再完全抵消。电流没有消失，虚线把另一条闭合返回路径画了出来；检测环发现的是没有共同经过它返回的那一部分。
cues.en: Let forty milliamperes return outside the sensing window. L now reads five point zero four zero amperes while N remains five point zero zero zero. Current has not disappeared: the dashed route closes another return path. The sensing core detects the portion that did not return through its monitored N path.

cues.title: 先检测，再释放锁扣
cues.titleEn: Detect first, then release the latch
cues.caption: 示例差流持续 20 ms 后跳开两极；断开后当前电流归零。
cues.captionEn: After 20 ms of illustrative persistence, both poles open and present current becomes zero.
cues.zh: 让事件时间向前推进。四十毫安超过本片示例门槛，并持续二十毫秒，锁扣释放，两个触点一起打开。断开后电流为零，当前差流也为零，画面仍保留刚才的跳闸原因。门槛和延迟是教学设定，不是产品动作曲线或人体安全阈值。
cues.en: Advance event time. The residual exceeds this scene’s illustrative threshold for twenty milliseconds, releasing the latch and opening both poles. Present current and residual then become zero, while the recorded reason remains. These values are teaching settings, not a certified device curve or a safe human-current threshold.

cues.title: 故障清除，不会自动合闸
cues.titleEn: Fault removal does not automatically reclose
cues.caption: 100 ms 清除故障后，触点仍锁定在断开状态。
cues.captionEn: Removing the fault at 100 ms leaves the contacts latched open.
cues.zh: 接着把环外故障清除。虽然异常路径不在了，触点仍然保持断开，不能因为读数回到零就自动恢复供电。要分清故障是否存在、眼下是否有差流，以及保护机构是否已经跳开，这三个问题的答案不总是相同。
cues.en: Remove the outside-return fault. The abnormal route disappears, but the contacts remain latched open. Zero present residual does not automatically restore supply. Whether a fault exists, whether residual current is flowing now, and whether the mechanism has tripped are three separate questions with different possible answers.

cues.title: 内部测试制造另一种不平衡
cues.titleEn: The internal test creates a different imbalance
cues.caption: 测试支路从环前 L 到环后 N，无需 PE，也能形成差流。
cues.captionEn: The test bypass joins before-core L to after-core N, creating residual without PE.
cues.zh: 再看内部测试支路。它从检测环前的 L 接到环后的 N，测试电流不经过环中的 L，却经过 N 返回。因此不需要先把电流送到保护地线，也能形成差流并跳闸。这只检查相应内部功能，不能替整个接地系统和接线作完整保证。
cues.en: The internal test connects L before the core to N after it. Test current bypasses the monitored L path but returns through monitored N, producing residual and a trip without routing through PE. This checks the associated internal function; it cannot certify the complete earthing system or every wiring condition.

cues.title: 清除之后再合闸
cues.caption: 故障已清除再合闸，去回平衡恢复；故障仍在会再次跳开。
cues.captionEn: Reclosing after removal restores balance; a continuing fault would trip again.
cues.zh: 最后先消除故障，再重新合闸，去、回电流恢复平衡。探索中如果故障仍在，重新合闸后模型会再次跳开。真实设备还涉及类型、波形与其他保护条件，图示不是接线或带电检测指导，实际工作应由合格专业人员完成。
cues.en: Clear the fault before reclosing, restoring equal outgoing and returning currents. In Explore, a continuing fault produces another trip after reclosure. Real protection also depends on device type, waveform and other conditions. This diagram is not wiring or live-test guidance; qualified professionals must handle actual work.

cues.title: 常开，是未激励时的接触状态
cues.titleEn: Normally open describes the unenergized contacts
cues.caption: 线圈未激励，弹簧保持铜桥抬起，独立负载回路断开。
cues.captionEn: With the coil unenergized, the spring lifts the copper bridge and opens the independent load loop.
cues.zh: 先看两个相互独立的回路。线圈在控制侧，负载有自己的电源；中间通过绝缘推杆传递运动，而不是导电。没有激励时，弹簧把柱塞和铜桥抬起，两个固定触点之间留着间隙。这就是本片常开、单稳态继电器的起点。
cues.en: Begin with two separate circuits. The coil is on the control side; the load has its own source. An insulating linkage transfers motion rather than conducting between them. Without excitation, the spring lifts the plunger and copper bridge away from both fixed contacts: this normally-open monostable relay’s starting state.

cues.title: 电流建立，磁力才推动柱塞
cues.titleEn: Current builds before attraction moves the plunger
cues.caption: 施加 5 V：电流与磁力先建立，柱塞克服弹簧后才接触。
cues.captionEn: Apply 5 V: current and attraction build before the plunger overcomes the spring and closes the contacts.
cues.zh: 在线圈上施加五伏，先看电流建立。磁吸力超过弹簧预紧后，柱塞开始向磁极移动，带动绝缘推杆和铜桥。当两个圆触点真正碰到固定触点，负载回路才接通。电感建立电流、机械运动和触点到位，不是同一个瞬间。
cues.en: Apply five volts to the coil and watch current build first. Once attraction exceeds spring preload, the plunger moves toward the pole, carrying the insulating linkage and copper bridge. The load closes only when both moving contacts meet their fixed partners. Electrical buildup, mechanical motion and contact closure are distinct stages.

cues.title: 负载由自己的电源供能
cues.titleEn: The load uses its own energy source
cues.caption: 负载电源 5 V → 12 V，功率 0.25 W → 1.44 W，线圈状态不变。
cues.captionEn: Load source 5 V → 12 V gives 0.25 W → 1.44 W while coil state stays unchanged.
cues.zh: 保持线圈与机械位置不变，把独立负载电源从五伏改成十二伏。在这条一百欧姆负载上，功率从零点二五瓦变成一点四四瓦。额外能量来自负载电源，不是从小线圈电流凭空放大出来。线圈只负责让触点连接或断开。
cues.en: Keep the coil and mechanism unchanged while raising the independent load source from five to twelve volts. Across this one-hundred-ohm load, power rises from zero point two five to one point four four watts. The load source supplies that energy; the coil controls connection rather than creating extra electrical power.

cues.title: 从静止出发，2 V 不足以吸合
cues.titleEn: Two volts cannot pull in from rest
cues.caption: 开气隙下施加 2 V，磁力小于预紧力，触点仍开。
cues.captionEn: At the open gap, 2 V produces less attraction than preload, leaving the contacts open.
cues.zh: 回到弹簧抬起的初始位置，这次只给两伏。线圈仍有电流，也有磁吸力，但大气隙下的磁力不够克服预紧力，所以柱塞不动，负载依旧断开。不能把检测到线圈电压或电流，直接等同于继电器已经可靠吸合。
cues.en: Return to the lifted starting position and apply only two volts. Coil current and magnetic attraction exist, but the open-gap force cannot overcome preload. The plunger stays put and the load remains disconnected. Detecting coil voltage or current is therefore not the same as establishing that contacts have actually closed.

cues.title: 先吸合，再降到相同电压
cues.titleEn: Pull in first, then reduce to the same voltage
cues.caption: 先用 5 V 吸合再降到 2 V，小气隙增强磁力，仍可保持。
cues.captionEn: Pull in at 5 V, then reduce to 2 V: the smaller gap strengthens attraction enough to hold.
cues.zh: 先用五伏吸合，再把线圈降到同样的两伏。现在气隙已经从一毫米减到零点四毫米，同样的电流会产生更强磁吸力，足以保持闭合。不同结果来自不同的气隙和历史状态，并不是模型偷偷给两伏设了两个互相矛盾的开关规则。
cues.en: Pull in with five volts first, then reduce the coil to the same two volts. The gap has shrunk from one millimeter to zero point four. The same current now produces stronger attraction, sufficient to hold closure. Different geometry and history explain the different result, rather than two contradictory rules for one voltage.

cues.title: 断电之后，电流先续流再衰减
cues.titleEn: After switch-off, current recirculates before decaying
cues.caption: 本例含续流二极管：断源后线圈电流先衰减，弹簧再释放触点。
cues.captionEn: With the illustrated flyback diode, coil current decays after source removal before the spring releases the contacts.
cues.zh: 切断线圈电源，先停留看局部续流回路。电感中的电流不能凭空瞬间消失，本例经二极管循环并衰减；磁力随之降低，弹簧把柱塞推回，触点分开。这个镜头包含续流二极管，不是在演示没有抑制回路时的尖峰或电弧。
cues.en: Remove coil power and pause on the local recirculation route. Inductive current cannot simply disappear; the illustrated diode lets it circulate and decay. As attraction weakens, the spring returns the plunger and opens the contacts. This scene includes a flyback diode, rather than predicting unclamped voltage spikes or arcs.

cues.title: 有线圈电流，触点仍可能没动
cues.titleEn: Coil current does not prove contact movement
cues.caption: 柱塞被机械阻挡：线圈有电流和磁力，负载仍未接通。
cues.captionEn: A mechanically blocked plunger retains coil current and attraction while leaving the load disconnected.
cues.zh: 最后阻止柱塞移动。线圈照样有电流和磁力，铜桥却到不了接触位置，负载功率仍是零。供电、受力、实际运动和负载导通需要分别观察。这里的几何与参数用于解释原理，不是具体产品门槛，也不提供接线或带电维修指导。
cues.en: Finally block the plunger. Coil current and attraction remain, but the bridge cannot reach the fixed contacts and load power stays zero. Excitation, force, motion and load continuity require separate observations. Geometry and coefficients explain the principle rather than certify a product, and provide no wiring or live-repair guidance.

cues.title: 穿心一匝，测量大电流
cues.titleEn: One primary turn measures a large current
cues.caption: 低负担下，二次电流接近一次电流除以匝数。
cues.captionEn: With a low burden, secondary current nearly follows the turns ratio.
cues.zh: 先看结构。粗导体从磁芯中央穿过，形成一次一匝；右边的细线实际绕了一百匝，并通过负担电阻闭合。一次电流变化时，二次产生感应电流。图中虚线是理想匝数比给出的电流，实线是考虑磁芯励磁后的结果；低负担下两者非常接近，但并非强制相等。
cues.en: Inspect the structure first. The main conductor passes once through the core, while a hundred-turn secondary closes through the burden resistor. Changing primary current induces secondary current. The dashed trace is the ideal turns-ratio current; the solid trace includes core excitation. They closely agree at low burden, but the model does not force them to be equal.

cues.title: 没有完全抵消的安匝
cues.titleEn: The ampere-turns do not cancel completely
cues.caption: 一次安匝减去二次安匝，剩余部分建立磁场。
cues.captionEn: Primary minus secondary ampere-turns establishes the core field.
cues.zh: 把注意力放在安匝平衡。一次导体的电流产生磁场，二次线圈的电流建立反向作用，抵消其中的大部分。下方等式保留剩余项：一次安匝减去二次安匝，正好等于磁芯建立磁场所需的励磁安匝。剩余量虽然小，却解释了真实互感器为什么有比例和相位误差。
cues.en: Now inspect ampere-turn balance. Primary current establishes a magnetic field, and secondary current produces an opposing contribution that cancels most of it. The equation retains the remainder: primary minus secondary ampere-turns equals the excitation needed by the core. This small remainder explains why a real current transformer has both ratio and phase errors.

cues.title: 二次匝数加倍
cues.caption: 同样一次电流，二次电流大约减半。
cues.captionEn: The same primary current gives roughly half the secondary current.
cues.zh: 把二次线圈增加到二百匝，一次导体和一次电流不变。每安培二次电流现在能提供两倍的安匝，所以维持磁路平衡所需的二次电流大约减半。观察同一个安培坐标下的波形，幅度确实变小。匝数、负担与励磁共同决定实际误差，不能只凭一个比例忽略后面的电路。
cues.en: Increase the secondary to two hundred turns without changing primary current. Each ampere in the secondary now supplies twice the ampere-turns, so about half the secondary current is needed for magnetic balance. The waveform shrinks on the same ampere scale. Turns, burden and excitation jointly determine the actual error; the nominal ratio alone does not describe every operating condition.

cues.title: 负担变大，比例开始失真
cues.titleEn: A larger burden distorts the ratio
cues.caption: 更多电压需要更多磁通变化，非线性误差增大。
cues.captionEn: More required voltage drives larger flux changes and nonlinear error.
cues.zh: 恢复一百匝，把负担电阻从一欧提高到八欧。要维持同样的二次电流，就需要更高的感应电压，而电压的时间积分对应磁通变化。磁通密度增大后，磁芯需要更多励磁安匝，留给二次电流的部分减少。实线开始偏离虚线，说明高负担不仅改变电压，还会让测得的电流失真。
cues.en: Restore a hundred turns and raise the burden from one ohm to eight. Maintaining the same secondary current would require more induced voltage, whose time integral determines flux change. At higher flux density, the nonlinear core needs more excitation ampere-turns, leaving less for the secondary. The solid current departs from the dashed ideal: burden can distort the measurement, not merely change its voltage.

cues.title: 开路不等于没有电压
cues.titleEn: Open circuit does not mean zero voltage
cues.caption: 二次电流为零，变化磁通仍产生高电压。
cues.captionEn: Secondary current is zero, but changing flux still induces high voltage.
cues.zh: 这里仅比较二次开路的数学模型。电流没有闭合路径，反向安匝消失，一次电流全部用来励磁。磁芯中的磁通仍然变化，二次端电压出现明显尖峰，零电流并不代表零电压。真实带电互感器的二次侧不得开路；实际尖峰还取决于磁滞、寄生电容和绝缘等本模型未包含的因素。
cues.en: This is a mathematical comparison with an open secondary. Without a closed current path, opposing secondary ampere-turns disappear and all primary ampere-turns excite the core. Flux still changes, producing pronounced terminal-voltage peaks. Zero current does not imply zero voltage. An energized CT secondary must not be opened; real peaks also depend on hysteresis, parasitic capacitance and insulation omitted here.

cues.title: 有磁通，不一定有感应电压
cues.titleEn: Flux alone does not guarantee induction
cues.caption: 直流达到稳态后，磁通不变，感应输出为零。
cues.captionEn: After DC settles, flux is constant and induced output is zero.
cues.zh: 最后把一次电流换成已经稳定的一百安直流。磁芯里仍然有磁通，绿色方向标记也保留，但磁通不再随时间变化，因此二次感应电压和电流都为零。虚线按匝数比仍会预测一安，实线却停在零，直接揭示普通电磁互感器测不了稳定直流。霍尔等传感原理处理的是另一个测量机制。
cues.en: Finally, use a settled one-hundred-amp DC primary current. The core still has flux and its direction remains marked, but flux no longer changes, so induced secondary voltage and current are zero. A turns-ratio-only prediction would still show one ampere, while the actual trace stays at zero. Ordinary induction CTs cannot measure steady DC; Hall sensing uses a different measurement mechanism.

cues.title: 发热与散热能达到平衡
cues.titleEn: Heating and heat loss can balance
cues.caption: 1 A下，热量逐渐通过端帽导出。
cues.captionEn: At 1 A, heat increasingly escapes through the end caps.
cues.zh: 先看一根细银丝通入一安电流。电流持续发热，两端金属帽同时把热量带走。下面的空间曲线显示中间较热、两端较冷；随着温度上升，导出的热功率逐渐接近发热功率，温度趋于稳定。保险丝有电流、有温升，并不意味着它一定立即熔化。
cues.en: Start with one ampere through a thin silver wire. Current continuously produces heat while metal end caps conduct it away. The spatial profile shows a hotter middle and cooler ends. As temperature rises, escaping heat approaches the electrical heating rate and temperature levels off. Current and a temperature rise do not automatically mean immediate melting.

cues.title: 中间先达到熔点
cues.caption: 2.2 A过载下，最热处先到达961.9°C。
cues.captionEn: At 2.2 A, the hottest location first reaches 961.9°C.
cues.zh: 把电流提高到二点二安。焦耳热随电流平方增加，电阻还会随温度上升，热量积累更快。最热的中段率先达到银的熔点。我们在开始熔化的这一刻停住：它不是完成开断的时刻，后面还有熔化潜热、可能的金属断裂和电弧过程，因此金属开始熔化，还不能说明电路已经安全断开。
cues.en: Increase current to two point two amperes. Joule heating grows with current squared, and resistance rises with temperature, accelerating heat accumulation. The middle reaches the melting point first. We stop at melting onset, not completed interruption. Latent heat, possible rupture and an arc can follow, and those later processes are outside this thermal calculation.

cues.title: 短脉冲可以留下热，却不熔化
cues.titleEn: A brief pulse can heat without melting
cues.caption: 相同4 A，8 ms脉冲结束后开始冷却。
cues.captionEn: At the same 4 A, an 8 ms pulse ends before melting and then cools.
cues.zh: 比较同样四安的两种输入。虚线是持续电流，实线只持续八毫秒。短脉冲期间，温度确实迅速上升；脉冲结束后，电流变成零，电热输入停止，而已经存在的温度梯度仍把热量送向端帽。实线于是下降，没有达到熔点。峰值电流相同，持续时间不同，结果就可能不同。
cues.en: Compare two four-ampere inputs. The dashed trace is continuous; the solid one lasts only eight milliseconds. Temperature rises rapidly during the pulse. After current becomes zero, electrical heating stops, while the existing temperature gradient continues moving heat toward the end caps. Temperature then falls without reaching melting. Equal peak current can produce different outcomes when duration changes.

cues.title: 环境更热，余量更小
cues.titleEn: A warmer environment leaves less margin
cues.caption: 相同2.2 A，80°C环境更早到达熔点。
cues.captionEn: At the same 2.2 A, an 80°C environment reaches melting sooner.
cues.zh: 保持二点二安电流和原来丝径，把环境及端帽温度从二十度提高到八十度。新的实线从更高的温度出发，端帽也无法像原来那样冷却熔丝，首次到达熔点的时间提前。保险丝的工作结果依赖周围温度和散热条件，不能把同一个电流标签理解成任何安装环境下都一样的动作时刻。
cues.en: Keep the same current and diameter but warm the surroundings and contacts from twenty to eighty degrees. The solid trace starts hotter, and its contacts provide less cooling than before, so melting begins sooner. Fuse behavior depends on ambient temperature and heat removal. A current label alone cannot specify an identical operating time in every installation.

cues.title: 只变粗一点，升温就明显变慢
cues.titleEn: A thicker wire heats much more slowly
cues.caption: 直径50→70 µm，面积接近翻倍。
cues.captionEn: Changing diameter from 50 to 70 µm nearly doubles area.
cues.zh: 把环境恢复二十度，电流仍然二点二安，只将丝径从五十微米增到七十微米。截面积接近翻倍，电阻减小，同样电流产生的热量减少；参与吸热的金属质量又增加了。观察同一时间坐标，粗丝仍远低于熔点。几何尺寸同时改变电学、热容量和导热，不能只比较电流数字。
cues.en: Restore twenty-degree surroundings and keep two point two amperes, changing only diameter from fifty to seventy micrometers. Area nearly doubles, reducing resistance and electrical heating at the same current while increasing the mass that absorbs heat. On the same time axis, the thicker wire remains far below melting. Geometry changes resistance, thermal mass and conduction together.

cues.title: 电流加倍，短时升温约快四倍
cues.titleEn: Double current, roughly quarter the short heating time
cues.caption: 高电流短时间内，达到同一热状态的I²t近似相同。
cues.captionEn: During brief high-current heating, equal thermal endpoints need similar I²t.
cues.zh: 最后比较四安和八安。电流加倍，短时间内发热约增为四倍，来不及散出很多热，所以到达同一熔点的时间接近四分之一。两项电流平方乘时间约为同一个数。但I平方t的单位是安培平方秒，不是焦耳；实际热量还要计入电阻。这个近似也不能代替真实熔断器的熄弧时间、额定电压和分断能力。
cues.en: Finally compare four and eight amperes. Doubling current gives roughly four times the heating over a brief interval with little heat loss, so the same melting threshold is reached in about a quarter of the time. The two current-squared time integrals are similar. I squared t is measured in ampere-squared seconds, not joules; heat also depends on resistance. This approximation does not replace arc-extinction performance, voltage rating or breaking capacity.
